3.3 Implementing a wrapper for easier text generation

3.3 实现一个用于更轻松生成文本的封装器

In the previous section, we loaded the pre-trained LLM and set up the text generation functionality (as illustrated in figure 3.5), which are the first two steps of the evaluation process covered in the remainder of this chapter.

在上一节中，我们加载了预训练的语言模型，并搭建了文本生成功能（如图3.5所示），这是本章剩余部分所涵盖的评估流程中的前两步。

Figure 3.5 Illustration of steps 1 and 2 from the verifier workflow. A pre-trained LLM is loaded and prompted with a math problem, producing an output in raw LaTeX syntax. The answer is also shown in the rendered and more readable form.
图3.5 验证者工作流中的步骤1和步骤2示意图。加载一个预训练的语言模型，并将其输入一道数学题，模型会以原始LaTeX语法生成输出。答案同时以渲染后的、更易读的形式展示出来。

For additional convenience in later sections, we create a wrapper (listing 3.3) for the text generation function so that we only have to pass in the model, tokenizer, and prompt, along with some additional settings instead of repeating the tokenization and input preparation steps each time:

为了在后续章节中更加方便地使用，我们为文本生成函数创建了一个包装器（清单 3.3），这样我们只需传入模型、分词器和提示词，以及一些额外的设置，而无需每次都重复进行分词和输入准备步骤：

Listing 3.3 A wrapper for streamed text generation
def generate_text_stream_concat(
    model, tokenizer, prompt, device, max_new_tokens,
    verbose=False,
):
    input_ids = torch.tensor(                    #A
        tokenizer.encode(prompt), device=device  
        ).unsqueeze(0)                           
 
    generated_ids = []
    for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache(  #B
        model=model,                                
        token_ids=input_ids,                        
        max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,              
        eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,        
    ):                                              
        next_token_id = token.squeeze(0)
        generated_ids.append(next_token_id.item())
 
        
        if verbose: #C
            print(
                tokenizer.decode(next_token_id.tolist()),
                end="",
                flush=True
            )
    
    return tokenizer.decode(generated_ids)  #D
#A Encode prompt text into token IDs and place on device
#B Stream tokens one by one using cached generation
#C Optionally print tokens as they are generated
#D Decode all generated IDs into final text string
#A 将提示文本编码为令牌 ID，并将其放置在设备上 #B 使用缓存的生成过程逐个流式输出令牌 #C 可选地在令牌生成时将其打印出来 #D 将所有生成的 ID 解码为最终的文本字符串

This wrapper function in listing 3.3 handles the full cycle of text generation: it tokenizes the input prompt, streams new tokens from the model, and then decodes the results into a final string. And, as mentioned before, the optional verbose flag allows us to see tokens as they are generated in real time. The function can be used as follows:

清单 3.3 中的这个包装函数负责处理文本生成的完整流程：它对输入提示进行分词，从模型中流式获取新生成的标记，并将结果解码为最终的字符串。正如前面所提到的，可选的 verbose 标志让我们能够实时查看生成的标记。该函数的使用方式如下：

generated_text = generate_text_stream_concat(
    model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
    max_new_tokens=2048,
    verbose=True  #A
)
#A Using False will suppress the live token-by-token printing
#A 使用 False 将会禁止实时逐 token 打印。

This prints the exact same response as in section 3.2:

这会打印出与第3.2节中完全相同的响应：

[...]  #A
 
**Final Answer:**
 
\[
\boxed{\dfrac{14}{3}}
\]
#A Shortened for brevity
#为简洁起见而缩短

3.4 Extracting the final answer box

3.4 提取最终答案框

Now that we have the model loaded and ready, we can get to the chapter-specific and interesting parts: evaluating the model.

既然模型已经加载并准备就绪，我们就可以进入本章的特色环节——也是最有趣的部分：模型评估了。

Before we get started, it is worth recalling that this book takes a from-scratch approach, which naturally includes some detailed, sometimes tedious steps. This is intentional, since we want to build the evaluation pipeline ourselves to better understand how it works, rather than just calling predefined wrapper functions and building blocks.

在开始之前，值得提醒的是，本书采用从零开始的方法，因此不可避免地会包含一些细节繁杂、甚至略显繁琐的步骤。这样做是有意为之：我们希望通过亲手构建评估流水线，深入理解其工作原理，而不是简单地调用预定义的封装函数和模块。

In the previous section, we saw that the model returned the final answer in an answer box (written as r"\boxed{\dfrac{14}{3}}" in raw text). We did not explicitly enforce that format yet, but the model likely produced it because boxed answers are a common convention in math benchmarks and training data. This behavior is not necessarily proof of overfitting to the evaluation tasks we will run later. But it reflects that pre-trained models often encounter many problem formats online and learn to reproduce those stylistic conventions.

在上一节中，我们看到模型将最终答案输出在一个答案框中（以原始文本形式表示为 r"\boxed{\dfrac{14}{3}}"）。目前我们尚未显式地强制采用这种格式，但模型很可能生成了它，因为带框的答案是数学基准测试和训练数据中常见的约定。这种行为并不一定表明模型过拟合于我们后续将运行的评估任务。不过，它确实反映出预训练模型在互联网上会接触到多种题目格式，并学会复现这些风格化的惯例。

Ht's also true that as a general rule, it is fair to assume that any information available on the internet when a model was trained has been part of the training data.

同样地，作为一条一般性原则，可以合理地假设：在模型训练时互联网上可获取的任何信息都曾被用作训练数据的一部分。

Although it was not necessary here, when we evaluate the model in the MATH-500 dataset later on, we will add a specific prompt that instructs the model to return answers in this boxed form, as it is a common convention that makes the evaluation more consistent across different models and makes data extraction easier.

尽管在此处并非必要，但在稍后使用 MATH-500 数据集评估模型时，我们将添加一条明确的提示，指示模型以这种方框形式返回答案。这是因为这种格式是一种常见规范，能够使不同模型之间的评估更加一致，并简化数据提取工作。

Although this step is mechanical, it will keep reappearing later whenever we need to turn a model response into something that can be scored automatically at scale. We will now write code that performs this extraction of the boxed answer content as illustrated in figure 3.6.

尽管这一步骤较为机械化，但在后续工作中，每当我们需要将模型的输出转换为可大规模自动评分的形式时，它都会反复出现。接下来，我们将编写代码，按照图3.6所示的方式完成对方框内答案内容的提取。

Figure 3.6 An illustration of how the boxed result from the LLM output is extracted.
图3.6 展示了如何从大语言模型的输出中提取框选结果。

Specifically, this section implements step 3 shown in figure 3.6. The next section will implement the normalization method for step 4.

具体而言，本节实现了图3.6中所示的步骤3。下一节将实现步骤4的归一化方法。

Since your model may produce slightly different responses (depending on your hardware) than those shown above, we will work with a hard-coded answer for the time being (pretending that this answer was generated by the model). In later sections, we will revisit the model and have it generate answers for the tasks in the MATH-500 dataset.

由于您的模型可能会根据硬件的不同产生与上述示例略有差异的响应，我们暂时使用一个硬编码的答案（假装该答案是由模型生成的）。在后续章节中，我们将重新使用该模型，并让它为 MATH-500 数据集中的任务生成答案。

model_answer = (
r"""... some explanation...
**Final Answer:**
 
\[                     #A
\boxed{\dfrac{14}{3}}  #A
\]                     #A
""")
#A The answer box we want to extract
#A 我们想要提取的答案框
Note
注意

We are using a raw string (r"""...""" instead of a regular string """..."""). Raw strings make it easier to handle the \ characters, which would otherwise be treated as escape sequences and require doubling each backslash.

我们使用的是原始字符串（r"""..."""，而不是普通字符串"""..."""）。原始字符串可以更方便地处理反斜杠字符，否则这些反斜杠会被当作转义序列处理，需要将每个反斜杠都加倍。

Next, let's define a function in listing 3.4 to extract the answer box from the model_answer.

接下来，让我们在代码清单3.4中定义一个函数，用于从model_answer中提取答案框。

Listing 3.4 Extracting answer boxes
def get_last_boxed(text):
    boxed_start_idx = text.rfind(r"\boxed")  #A
    if boxed_start_idx == -1:
        return None
 
    current_idx = boxed_start_idx + len(r"\boxed")  #B
 
    #C
    while current_idx < len(text) and text[current_idx].isspace():
        current_idx += 1
 
    #D
    if current_idx >= len(text) or text[current_idx] != "{":
        return None
 
    current_idx += 1
    brace_depth = 1
    content_start_idx = current_idx
 
    #E
    while current_idx < len(text) and brace_depth > 0:
        char = text[current_idx]
        if char == "{":
            brace_depth += 1
        elif char == "}":
            brace_depth -= 1
        current_idx += 1
 
    
    if brace_depth != 0:  #F
        return None
 
    
    return text[content_start_idx:current_idx-1]  #G
#A Find the last occurrence of "\boxed"
#B Get position after "\boxed"
#C Skip any whitespace after "\boxed"
#D Expect an opening brace "{"
#E Parse the braces with nesting
#F Account for unbalanced braces
#G Extract content inside the outermost braces
#A 找到最后一个“\boxed” #B 获取“\boxed”后的位置 #C 跳过“\boxed”后的任何空白字符 #D 预期一个左花括号“{” #E 解析带有嵌套的花括号 #F 处理不匹配的花括号 #G 提取最外层花括号内的内容

The get_last_box helper utility function in listing 3.4 extracts out the content of the last \boxed{...} expression from a model's output. More specifically, it scans for the final \boxed, skips over whitespace, checks for braces, and handles any nesting so that we capture the intended answer string.

清单 3.4 中的 get_last_box 辅助实用函数从模型的输出中提取最后一个 \boxed{...} 表达式的内容。具体来说，它会查找最后一个 \boxed，跳过空白字符，检查是否包含大括号，并处理可能存在的嵌套情况，从而捕获预期的答案字符串。

While it may look a bit tedious, having this parser in place will pay off when we run evaluations on datasets like MATH-500, where extracting the correct final answer is the first step toward measuring a model's reasoning ability. (MATH-500 is a curated collection of 500 problems that is widely used as a reasoning model benchmark dataset, which we will use later in this chapter.)

虽然这看起来有些繁琐，但一旦搭建好这个解析器，在对 MATH-500 等数据集进行评估时，它就会发挥重要作用：准确提取最终答案是衡量模型推理能力的第一步。（MATH-500 是一个精心 curated 的 500 道题集合，被广泛用作推理模型的基准数据集，我们将在本章稍后使用它。）

Now, let's test it on the model answer:

现在，让我们在标准答案上测试一下：

extracted_answer = get_last_boxed(model_answer)
print(extracted_answer)
提取的答案 = 获取模型回答中最后一个方框内的内容(模型回答) print(提取的答案)

The output of this function call is "\dfrac{14}{3}", which is the boxed answer we wanted to extract.

该函数调用的输出是“\dfrac{14}{3}”，这正是我们想要提取的框选答案。

Rendering math formulas
渲染数学公式

We can render math formulas via the Latex class we introduced earlier. Alternatively, for single math formulas that are not accompanied by answer text, we can also use the simpler Math class:

我们可以通过之前介绍的 Latex 类来渲染数学公式。或者，对于不带答案文本的单个数学公式，也可以使用更简单的 Math 类：

from IPython.display import Math
display(Math(r"\dfrac{14}{3}"))
从 IPython.display 导入 Math 显示(Math(r"\dfrac{14}{3}"))

This renders the fraction as

这会将分数渲染为

While the previous get_last_boxed function correctly extracted the text, we will make the answer extraction a bit more robust to account for cases where a final answer box is either missing or incomplete via the extract_final_candidate function in listing 3.5:

虽然之前的 get_last_boxed 函数能够正确提取文本，但我们仍将通过清单 3.5 中的 extract_final_candidate 函数，使答案提取过程更加健壮，以应对最终答案框缺失或不完整的情况：

Listing 3.5 Extracting the final answer candidate
import re
 
RE_NUMBER = re.compile(  #A
    r"-?(?:\d+/\d+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)"
)
 
def extract_final_candidate(text, fallback="number_then_full"):
    
    result = ""  #B
 
    if text:  #C
        boxed = get_last_boxed(text.strip())
        if boxed:
            result = boxed.strip().strip("$ ")
 
        #D
        elif fallback in ("number_then_full", "number_only"):
            m = RE_NUMBER.findall(text)
            if m:
                result = m[-1]  #E
            elif fallback == "number_then_full":
                
                result = text  #F
    return result
#A Regular expression for extracting numeric values from the text
#B Default return value if nothing matches
#C Prefer the last boxed expression if present
#D If no boxed expression, try fallback
#E Use last number
#F Else return full text if no number found
#A 用于从文本中提取数值的正则表达式 #B 如果没有匹配项，则返回的默认值 #C 如果存在括号表达式，优先使用最后一个 #D 如果没有括号表达式，则尝试备用方案 #E 使用最后一个数字 #F 否则，如果未找到数字，则返回完整文本

The extract_final_candidate function in listing 3.5 provides fallback settings in case no boxed answer can be found, which are as follows:

清单 3.5 中的 extract_final_candidate 函数在无法找到封闭答案时提供了回退设置，具体如下：

  • "number_then_full" (default): pick the last simple number, else the whole text;
  • “number_then_full”（默认）：优先选择最后一个纯数字，否则选择整段文本；
  • "number_only": pick the last simple number, else return an empty string "";
  • "number_only": 选取最后一个纯数字，否则返回空字符串 ""；
  • "none": extract only boxed content, else return empty string "".
  • “none”：仅提取带框内容，否则返回空字符串 “”。

For the fallback setting, the code in listing 3.5 uses regular expressions (regex for short) via Python's re library. Regexes are a way to search for patterns in text. In our case, the regex pattern is designed to recognize numbers, including fractions, decimals, and scientific notation. While the regex syntax looks intimidating, you don't need to worry about the exact syntax here. What matters is that this gives us a reliable tool to extract the last numeric candidate from the model's output when no boxed answer is available.

对于回退设置，清单 3.5 中的代码通过 Python 的 re 库使用了正则表达式（简称 regex）。正则表达式是一种在文本中搜索特定模式的方法。在我们的场景中，正则模式旨在识别数字，包括分数、小数和科学计数法。虽然正则表达式的语法看起来有些复杂，但你无需担心具体的语法细节。重要的是，当模型输出中没有方框内的答案时，这种方法能够为我们提供一个可靠工具，用于从模型输出中提取最后一个数值候选。

Let's try it on our model answer:

让我们把它应用到我们的范文上：

print(extract_final_candidate(model_answer))
打印(提取最终候选(model_answer))

This correctly returns "\dfrac{14}{3}". Next, let's try some additional examples. First, another boxed candidate:

这会正确地返回“\dfrac{14}{3}”。接下来，我们再尝试几个额外的例子。首先，再来一个带框的候选答案：

print(extract_final_candidate(r"\boxed{ 14/3. }"))
打印(提取最终候选者(r"\boxed{ 14/3. }"))

This correctly returns "14/3.", stripping the extra whitespace but not the punctuation. The punctuation character will be handled correctly by the equality check we implement later.

这会正确地返回“14/3.”，去掉多余的空格，但保留标点符号。我们稍后实现的相等性检查将会正确处理这个标点符号。

Next, let's try a candidate without a box, which should trigger the fallback setting, and see what happens:

接下来，我们尝试一个没有盒子的候选元素，这应该会触发回退设置，看看会发生什么：

print(extract_final_candidate("abc < > 14/3 abc"))
打印(提取最终候选("abc < > 14/3 abc")))

Thanks to the default fallback setting, it will find the last number in the answer and also correctly return "14/3".

得益于默认的回退设置，它会找到答案中的最后一个数字，并正确返回“14/3”。

In this section, we defined utility functions to extract the LLM's answer from within its answer text context. This brings us one step closer to achieving the overall goal of verifying whether this answer is indeed correct. In the next section, we will normalize the response into a more general, canonical form before we implement the checking functionality.

在本节中，我们定义了效用函数，用于从大语言模型的回答文本上下文中提取其答案。这使我们离验证该答案是否确实正确的总体目标又近了一步。在下一节中，我们将把模型的响应归一化为一种更通用、规范化的形式，然后再实现检查功能。

Why not use an LLM for the answer extraction?
为什么不在答案抽取中使用大语言模型呢？

We could use an LLM itself to extract the boxed answer. This would introduce unnecessary complexity and potential errors. Extraction is a simple, mechanical task, assuming that the LLM outputs the answer in a specific format: we just need to locate the last boxed expression or, if that is missing, fall back to a number or the raw text.

我们也可以直接使用大语言模型来提取框中的答案。然而，这样做会引入不必要的复杂性和潜在的错误。事实上，只要大语言模型按照特定格式输出答案，答案提取就是一个简单、机械化的任务：我们只需找到最后一个被方框括起来的表达式；如果不存在这样的表达式，则退而求其次，提取其中的数字或直接使用原始文本。

Regular expressions may look complicated at first, but in the end, we have a small, reusable utility function that is cheap to execute and handles the extraction deterministically and reproducibly, without depending on the variability of another model's output.

正则表达式起初可能显得复杂，但最终我们得到一个小型、可重用的工具函数，它执行开销低，能够以确定性和可重复的方式完成提取任务，且不依赖于其他模型输出的不确定性。

3.5 Normalizing the extracted answer

3.5 对提取的答案进行归一化

Previously, we extracted the boxed answer "\dfrac{14}{3}" from the model's response. Models may print the same value in many ways, such as "\frac{14}{3}", "14/3", "$14/3$", or "(14)/(3)". To implement and use a robust checking system that can check whether the answer is correct, we first need a consistent method of comparing results.

此前，我们从模型的输出中提取了框选的答案“\dfrac{14}{3}”。模型可能会以多种方式输出同一个值，例如“\frac{14}{3}”、“14/3”、“$14/3$”或“(14)/(3)”。为了实现并使用一个健壮的答案校验系统，首先需要一种一致的结果比较方法。

In this section, we implement a normalization (or canonicalization) pass (step 4 in figure 3.7) that strips formatting and standardizes the answer.

在本节中，我们实现了一个归一化（或规范化）步骤（如图3.7中的第4步），用于去除格式并使答案标准化。

Figure 3.7 An illustration of how the boxed result from the LLM output is extracted and converted into a canonical plain form. This normalized answer is then later used for verification against the correct answer.
图3.7 展示了如何从大语言模型的输出中提取框选结果，并将其转换为规范的纯文本形式。随后，这一规范化答案将用于与正确答案进行核验。

The normalization step shown in figure 3.7 is implemented via the normalize_text function in listing 3.6.

图3.7所示的归一化步骤通过清单3.6中的normalize_text函数实现。

Listing 3.6 Normalizing extracted answers
LATEX_FIXES = [  #A
    (r"\\left\s*", ""),
    (r"\\right\s*", ""),
    (r"\\,|\\!|\\;|\\:", ""),
    (r"\\cdot", "*"),
    (r"\u00B7|\u00D7", "*"),
    (r"\\\^\\circ", ""),
    (r"\\dfrac", r"\\frac"),
    (r"\\tfrac", r"\\frac"),
    (r"°", ""),
]
 
RE_SPECIAL = re.compile(r"<\|[^>]+?\|>")  #B
SUPERSCRIPT_MAP = {
    "⁰": "0", "¹": "1", "²": "2", "³": "3", "⁴": "4",  #C
    "⁵": "5", "⁶": "6", "⁷": "7", "⁸": "8", "⁹": "9",    #C
    "⁺": "+", "⁻": "-", "⁽": "(", "⁾": ")",              #C
}
 
def normalize_text(text):
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = RE_SPECIAL.sub("", text).strip()
 
    #D
    match = re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]\s*[.:]\s*(.+)$", text)
    if match:
        text = match.group(1)
 
 
    text = re.sub(r"\^\s*\{\s*\\circ\s*\}", "", text)  #D
    text = re.sub(r"\^\s*\\circ", "", text)            #E
    text = text.replace("°", "")                       #E
 
    match = re.match(r"^\\text\{(?P<x>.+?)\}$", text)  #F
    if match:
        text = match.group("x")
 
    text = re.sub(r"\\\(|\\\)|\\\[|\\\]", "", text)  #G
 
    
    for pat, rep in LATEX_FIXES:  #H
        text = re.sub(pat, rep, text)
 
 
    def convert_superscripts(s, base=None):
        converted = "".join(
            SUPERSCRIPT_MAP[ch] if ch in SUPERSCRIPT_MAP else ch
            for ch in s
        )
        if base is None:
            return converted
        return f"{base}**{converted}"
 
    text = re.sub(
        r"([0-9A-Za-z\)\]\}])([⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁺⁻]+)",
        lambda m: convert_superscripts(m.group(2), base=m.group(1)),
        text,
    )
    text = convert_superscripts(text)
 
 
    #I
    text = text.replace("\\%", "%").replace("$", "").replace("%", "")
    text = re.sub(
        r"\\sqrt\s*\{([^}]*)\}",
        lambda match: f"sqrt({match.group(1)})",
        text,
    )
    text = re.sub(
        r"\\sqrt\s+([^\\\s{}]+)",
        lambda match: f"sqrt({match.group(1)})",
        text,
    )
 
    #J
    text = re.sub(
        r"\\frac\s*\{([^{}]+)\}\s*\{([^{}]+)\}",
        lambda match: f"({match.group(1)})/({match.group(2)})",
        text,
    )
    text = re.sub(
        r"\\frac\s+([^\s{}]+)\s+([^\s{}]+)",
        lambda match: f"({match.group(1)})/({match.group(2)})",
        text,
    )
 
    #K
    text = text.replace("^", "**")
    text = re.sub(
        r"(?<=\d)\s+(\d+/\d+)",
        lambda match: "+" + match.group(1),
        text,
    )
 
    #L
    text = re.sub(
        r"(?<=\d),(?=\d\d\d(\D|$))",
        "",
        text,
    )
 
    return text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "").strip().lower()
#A LaTeX formatting to be replaced (left: original value, right: new value)
#B Strip chat special tokens like "<|assistant|>"
#C Dictionary mapping to convert unicode superscripts to plaintext superscripts
#D Strip leading multiple-choice labels (e.g., like "c. 3" -> 3)
#E Remove angle-degree markers
#F Unwrap "\text{...}" if the whole string is wrapped
#G Strip inline/display math wrappers: \( \) \[ \]
#H LaTeX canonicalization
#I Normalize number and root expressions
#J Convert LaTeX fractions into division form
#K Handle exponents and mixed numbers
#L Remove thousands separators in numbers
#A 需要替换的 LaTeX 格式（左：原值，右：新值） #B 去除聊天中的特殊标记，如“<|assistant|>” #C 用于将 Unicode 上标转换为纯文本上标的映射字典 #D 去除开头的选择题标签（例如，“c. 3”→“3”） #E 移除角度单位标记 #F 如果整个字符串被“\text{...}”包裹，则将其展开 #G 去除行内和显示数学环境的标记：\( \)、\[ \] #H LaTeX 规范化 #I 规范化数字和根式表达式 #J 将 LaTeX 分数转换为除法形式 #K 处理指数和带分数 #L 移除数字中的千位分隔符

The normalize_text function in listing 3.6 takes an extracted answer string and rewrites it into a standardized format that we can reliably compare against reference solutions. It first strips away special tokens and unnecessary LaTeX clutter, such as \left, \right, or degree symbols. It then unwraps cases like \text{...}, removes inline math markers, and rewrites common structures into a calculator-style form. For example, it turns \sqrt{a} into sqrt(a) and \frac{a}{b} into (a)/(b). Finally, it normalizes exponents, mixed numbers, and thousands separators and cleans up braces and casing. In short, the function transforms differently formatted LaTeX outputs into a clean, standardized string representation.

清单 3.6 中的 normalize_text 函数接收一个提取出的答案字符串，并将其重写为一种标准化格式，以便我们能够可靠地与参考答案进行比较。首先，它会去除特殊标记以及不必要的 LaTeX 杂乱代码，例如 \left、\right 或度数符号等。接着，它会展开类似 \text{...} 的情况，移除行内数学公式标记，并将常见结构改写成计算器风格的形式。例如，将 \sqrt{a} 转换为 sqrt(a)，将 \frac{a}{b} 转换为 (a)/(b)。最后，它会对指数、带分数和千位分隔符进行规范化处理，并清理花括号和大小写问题。简而言之，该函数可以将格式各异的 LaTeX 输出转换为整洁、标准化的字符串表示形式。

Let's now try the normalize_text function on our model answer:

现在让我们在我们的模型答案上尝试使用 normalize_text 函数：

print(normalize_text(extract_final_candidate(model_answer)))
打印(标准化文本(提取最终候选答案(模型回答))))

As a result, instead of printing the answer with LaTeX formatting (r"\dfrac{14}{3}"), it returns the answer in a standardized, LaTeX-free form:

因此，它不会以 LaTeX 格式打印答案（r"\dfrac{14}{3}”），而是以标准化的、不含 LaTeX 的形式返回答案：

"(14)/(3)"
“(14）/（3）”

Next, let's try a differently formatted answer:

接下来，我们尝试一种不同格式的答案：

print(normalize_text(r"\text{\[\frac{14}{3}\]}"))
打印(normalize_text(r"\text{\[\frac{14}{3}\]}"))

This also returns, "(14)/(3)", as intended.

这也会按预期返回“(14)/(3)”。

We now have a robust method to extract answer texts from an LLM's response. The next task, covered in the next section, is to implement a function to compare the LLM answer to a correct reference answer.

我们现在已经具备了一种稳健的方法，可以从大语言模型的输出中提取答案文本。接下来的任务——将在下一节中介绍——是实现一个函数，用于将大语言模型的答案与正确的参考答案进行比较。

3.6 Verifying mathematical equivalence

3.6 验证数学等价性

So far, in this chapter, we implemented steps to ask an LLM to generate an answer, extract the relevant portion, and normalize it. The next step, as illustrated in figure 3.8, is to compare the extracted answer to a correct reference answer, which is, in technical contexts, referred to as ground truth.

到目前为止，在本章中，我们实现了以下步骤：调用大语言模型生成答案、提取相关部分，并对其进行规范化处理。下一步，如图3.8所示，是将提取出的答案与正确的参考答案进行比较；在技术语境中，这一参考答案被称为“黄金标准”或“真实标签”。

This is one of the main reasons for building the verifier carefully here: in chapter 6, the same basic idea will reappear as a verifiable reward signal, and in later chapters we will use it to check whether our training changes improved the model.

这正是我们在此处精心构建验证器的主要原因之一：在第6章中，同样的基本思想将以可验证奖励信号的形式再次出现；而在后续章节中，我们将利用它来检验我们的训练改进是否确实提升了模型性能。

Figure 3.8 An illustration of how an LLM-generated answer is checked against the correct reference answer (ground truth). The final boxed answer is extracted and normalized, then compared to the correct answer provided in the dataset. If both match, the response is graded as correct.
图3.8 展示了如何将大语言模型生成的答案与正确的参考答案（黄金标准）进行核对。首先提取并规范化最终的方框内答案，然后将其与数据集中提供的正确答案进行比较。若两者一致，则该回答被评为正确。

Note that if we want to implement the equality check shown in figure 3.8, a direct comparison using Python's == operator is not sufficient, since expressions like "14/3" and "(14)/(3)" would not match, and equivalent but unnormalized fractions such as "(28)/(6)" and "(14)/(3)" would also be treated as unequal.

需要注意的是，如果我们要实现图3.8所示的相等性检查，仅使用Python的==运算符进行直接比较是不够的，因为像“14/3”和“(14)/(3)”这样的表达式不会被判定为相等，而等价但未约分的分数，例如“(28)/(6)”和“(14)/(3)”，也会被视为不相等。

As part of our equality check, we implement an additional intermediate step: parsing the extracted and normalized answer using a symbolic math engine.

作为我们平等性检查的一部分，我们实施了一个额外的中间步骤：使用符号数学引擎对提取并归一化的答案进行解析。

For this, we use the SymPy open-source math library (https://sympy.org), which has been developed and tested for two decades and has become a staple of scientific computing in Python. The parsing function is implemented in listing 3.7.

为此，我们使用 SymPy 开源数学库（https://sympy.org），该库经过二十年的开发与测试，已成为 Python 科学计算领域的标准工具之一。解析函数已在清单 3.7 中实现。

Note
注意

If you haven't installed the dependencies in chapter 2, you can manually install SymPy via uv pip install sympy (or uv add sympy).

如果你尚未安装第2章中的依赖项，可以通过 uv pip install sympy（或 uv add sympy）手动安装 SymPy。

Listing 3.7 SymPy parser for mathematical equality check
from sympy.parsing import sympy_parser as spp
from sympy.core.sympify import SympifyError
from sympy.polys.polyerrors import PolynomialError
from tokenize import TokenError
 
def sympy_parser(expr):
    if expr is None or len(expr) > 2000: #A
        return None
 
    try:
        return spp.parse_expr(
            expr,
            transformations=(
                *spp.standard_transformations,  #B
                #C
                spp.implicit_multiplication_application,
            ),
 
            evaluate=True,  #D
        )
    except (SympifyError, SyntaxError, TypeError, AttributeError,
            IndexError, TokenError, ValueError, PolynomialError):
        return None
#A To avoid crashing on long garbage responses
#B Standard transformations like handling parentheses
#C Allow omitted multiplication symbols (e.g., 2y -> 2*y)
#D Evaluate during parsing so simple constants simplify (e.g., 2+3 -> 5)
#A 避免在处理较长的垃圾信息时程序崩溃 #B 标准的转换操作，例如处理括号 #C 允许省略乘号（例如，2y 转换为 2*y） #D 在解析过程中进行求值，以便简单的常量表达式能够直接化简（例如，2+3 转换为 5）

The sympy_parser function in listing 3.7 takes an input expression, such as the normalized answers we extract from the LLM response, and converts it into a SymPy object that can be reliably compared for mathematical equivalence. To do so, it applies SymPy's standard parsing rules, supports implicit multiplication like (2y instead of 2*y), and also simplifies basic arithmetic (so 2+3 becomes 5).

清单 3.7 中的 sympy_parser 函数接收一个输入表达式（例如我们从大语言模型响应中提取的标准化答案），将其转换为 SymPy 对象，以便可靠地比较其数学等价性。为此，该函数会应用 SymPy 的标准解析规则，支持隐式乘法（如使用 2y 而非 2*y），并简化基本算术运算（例如将 2+3 简化为 5）。

Note
注意

The sympy_parser takes into account what looks like an excessive amount of error cases, but these are all errors that I encountered when evaluating the model on all 500 MATH-500 problems, as the model does not always generate perfectly formatted outputs.

sympy_parser 考虑了看似过多的错误情况，但这些错误都是我在用全部 500 道 MATH-500 题目对模型进行评估时遇到的，因为模型并不总是能生成格式完全正确的输出。

Let's see it in action and apply it to the normalized answer candidate:

让我们来看一下它的实际运行，并将其应用于归一化后的答案候选：

print(sympy_parser(normalize_text(
    extract_final_candidate(model_answer)
)))
打印(sympy_parser(标准化文本( 提取最终候选答案(模型回答) ))))

This returns the fraction 14/3. Next, let's try an unnormalized fraction:

这会返回分数 14/3。接下来，我们试试一个未约分的分数：

print(sympy_parser("28/6"))
打印(sympy解析器("28/6"))

Similarly, this returns 14/3.

同样，这也会返回 14/3。

Using the sympy_parser, we can now implement the equality check function in listing 3.8:

利用 sympy_parser，我们现在可以实现清单 3.8 中的相等性检查函数：

Listing 3.8 Equality check function using SymPy
from sympy import simplify
 
def equality_check(expr_gtruth, expr_pred):
    if expr_gtruth == expr_pred:  #A
        return True
 
    #B
    gtruth, pred = sympy_parser(expr_gtruth), sympy_parser(expr_pred)
 
    if gtruth is not None and pred is not None:  #C
        try:
            return simplify(gtruth - pred) == 0  #D
        except (SympifyError, TypeError):
            pass
 
    return False
#A First, check if the two expressions are exactly the same string
#B Parse both expressions into SymPy objects (returns None if parsing fails)
#C If both expressions were parsed successfully, try symbolic comparison
#D If the difference is 0, they are equivalent
#A 首先，检查两个表达式是否完全相同 #B 将两个表达式解析为 SymPy 对象（解析失败时返回 None） #C 如果两个表达式都解析成功，则尝试进行符号比较 #D 如果它们的差为 0，则两者等价

The equality_check function in listing 3.8 determines whether a model's answer matches the ground-truth solution. It first looks for an exact string match, which is the simplest case. If the strings differ, it parses both expressions into SymPy objects (via the sympy_parser function we implemented in listing 3.7) and checks whether their difference simplifies to zero. This allows us to recognize answers that may look different on the surface (for example, 14/3 and 28/6) but are mathematically the same.

清单 3.8 中的 equality_check 函数用于判断模型的答案是否与标准答案匹配。它首先检查字符串是否完全相等，这是最简单的情况。如果字符串不同，则通过我们在清单 3.7 中实现的 sympy_parser 函数将两个表达式解析为 SymPy 对象，并检查它们的差值是否化简为零。这样就可以识别那些表面上看起来不同（例如 14/3 和 28/6），但在数学上却相等的答案。

Let's try the equality checker from listing 3.8 on an example:

让我们在示例中试用一下清单3.8中的相等性检查器：

print(equality_check(
    normalize_text("13/4."),
    normalize_text(r"(13)/(4)")
))
print(相等检查( 规范化文本("13/4."), 规范化文本(r"(13)/(4)") ))

As intended, this ignores the formatting and returns True. Next, let's try a more challenging example and see whether the symbolic math parser recognizes that 0.5 is the same as 1/2:

正如预期，这会忽略格式并返回 True。接下来，我们尝试一个更具挑战性的例子，看看符号数学解析器是否能识别出 0.5 与 1/2 是相等的：

print(equality_check(
    normalize_text("0.5"),
    normalize_text(r"(1)/(2)")
))
print(等式检查( 归一化文本("0.5"), 归一化文本(r"(1)/(2)") )))

This also returns True. Now, let's try a negative example:

这也会返回 True。现在，我们来尝试一个反例：

print(equality_check(
    normalize_text("14/3"),
    normalize_text("15/3")
))
print(等值检查( 规范化文本("14/3"), 规范化文本("15/3") ))

This returns False since the expressions are different.

这会返回 False，因为这两个表达式不同。

So far, so good. Based on the encouraging results above, we may conclude that we now have a robust equality checker that we can use to evaluate the LLM on a math benchmark dataset. Tmake sure that it's ready for prime time, let's try one more example:

到目前为止，一切顺利。基于上述令人鼓舞的结果，我们可以得出结论：我们现在拥有一款稳健的等式检查器，可用于在数学基准数据集上评估大型语言模型。为了确保它已准备好投入实际应用，我们再试一个例子：

print(equality_check(
    normalize_text("(14/3, 2/3)"),
    normalize_text("(14/3, 4/6)")
))
print(等值检查( 规范化文本("(14/3, 2/3)"), 规范化文本("(14/3, 4/6)") ))

In this case, we are comparing two tuples. Since 2/3 and 4/6 are mathematically equivalent, we would expect the result to be True. Instead, the function returns False, because it currently only handles simple expressions, not tuples. We will address this limitation in the next section.

在本例中，我们比较的是两个元组。由于 2/3 和 4/6 在数学上是等价的，我们预期结果应该是 True。然而，该函数却返回了 False，这是因为当前它仅支持处理简单表达式，而不支持元组。我们将在下一节中解决这一限制。

3.7 Grading answers

3.7 答案评分

Now, we will build upon the mathematical equality checking function from the previous section to implement a robust grading function that can also handle tuple-like expressions, such as correctly comparing expressions like "(14/3, 2/3)" and "(14/3, 4/6)".

现在，我们将基于上一节的数学等式检查函数，实现一个健壮的评分函数。该函数不仅能处理简单的表达式，还能处理元组类表达式，例如正确比较“(14/3, 2/3)”和“(14/3, 4/6)”。

First, we implement a Python helper function that splits such tuple-like expressions into individual subparts via listing 3.9.

首先，我们实现一个 Python 辅助函数，通过代码清单 3.9 将这类元组类似的表达式拆分为各个子部分。

Listing 3.9 Helper function to split tuple-like expressions
def split_into_parts(text):
    result = [text]
 
    if text:  #A
        if (
            len(text) >= 2
            and text[0] in "([" and text[-1] in ")]"
            and "," in text[1:-1]
        ):
            items = [p.strip() for p in text[1:-1].split(",")]  #B
            if all(items):
                result = items
    else:  #C
        result = []
 
    return result
#A Check if text looks like a tuple or list, e.g. "(a, b)" or "[a, b]"
#B Split on commas inside brackets and strip whitespace
#C If text is empty, return an empty list
#A 检查文本是否看起来像元组或列表，例如“(a, b)”或“[a, b]” #B 在括号内按逗号分割，并去除空白字符 #C 如果文本为空，则返回一个空列表

The split_into_parts function in listing 3.9 helps us handle answers with multiple components. If the input looks like a tuple or list, such as (a, b) or [a, b], it splits the content on commas and returns the individual pieces. (If the string is empty, it simply returns an empty list.) In essence, this function breaks down multi-part answers into smaller parts that can be checked one by one.

清单 3.9 中的 split_into_parts 函数有助于处理包含多个组成部分的答案。如果输入看起来像元组或列表，例如 (a, b) 或 [a, b]，它会按照逗号分割内容，并返回各个独立的部分。（如果字符串为空，则直接返回一个空列表。）本质上，这个函数将多部分答案拆解为更小的片段，以便逐一进行检查。

Before we implement the grading function next, let's take the split_into_parts for a test drive and try it on the tuple-like expression from earlier:

在我们接下来实现评分函数之前，先来试用一下 split_into_parts 函数，并把它应用到前面那个类似元组的表达式上：

split_into_parts(normalize_text(r"(14/3, 2/3)"))
拆分成部分(标准化文本(r"(14/3, 2/3)")))

This returns ['14/3', '2/3'], as desired.

这会返回 ['14/3', '2/3']，符合预期。

Now, we can implement the grade_answer function (listing 3.10), which splits tuple-like expressions (if present) into subparts, and then uses the equality_check function from the previous section to compare a generated answer to a reference (ground truth) answer.

现在，我们可以实现 `grade_answer` 函数（清单 3.10），该函数会将元组类型的表达式（如果存在）拆分为子部分，然后使用上一节中的 `equality_check` 函数来比较生成的答案与参考答案（真值）。

Listing 3.10 Function to grade predicted answers against ground truth
def grade_answer(pred_text, gt_text):
    result = False   #A
    if pred_text is not None and gt_text is not None:  #B
        gt_parts = split_into_parts(
            normalize_text(gt_text)
        )
        pred_parts = split_into_parts(
            normalize_text(pred_text)
        )
 
        if (gt_parts and pred_parts                #C
           and len(gt_parts) == len(pred_parts)):  #C
            result = all(
                equality_check(gt, pred)
                for gt, pred in zip(gt_parts, pred_parts)
            )  #D
 
    return result  #E
#A Default outcome if checks fail
#B Only continue if both inputs are non-empty strings
#C Ensure both sides have same number of valid parts
#D Check each part for mathematical equivalence
#E True only if all checks passed
#A 如果检查失败，则返回默认结果 #B 仅当两个输入均为非空字符串时才继续 #C 确保两边的有效部分数量相同 #D 检查每个部分是否数学等价 #E 只有所有检查都通过时才为真

The implementation of the grade_answer function in listing 3.10 first assumes the prediction is incorrect (False) and only continues if both prediction and ground truth are non-empty. It then normalizes each side and splits them into subparts (for example, breaking "(14/3, 2/3)" into ["14/3", "2/3"]). If the number of subparts matches, it compares them one by one using equality_check. The result is returned as correct (True) only if all pairs match mathematically.

清单 3.10 中的 `grade_answer` 函数的实现首先假设预测是错误的（False），只有当预测和真实答案都非空时才会继续执行。随后，它会分别对预测和真实答案进行规范化处理，并将其拆分成子部分（例如，将“(14/3, 2/3)”拆分为[“14/3”, “2/3”]）。如果子部分的数量一致，则逐一对它们调用 `equality_check` 进行比较。只有当所有对应项在数学上都相等时，函数才会返回正确（True）。

We can think of the grade_answer function as an advanced version of the equality_check function from the previous section. The grade_answer function can split tuple-like expressions and normalize the answers before applying the equality_check function.

我们可以把 grade_answer 函数看作是上一节中 equality_check 函数的升级版。grade_answer 函数能够在调用 equality_check 函数之前，先对元组类型的表达式进行拆分，并对答案进行标准化处理。

On simple expressions, it works similarly to the equality_check, returning True if two expressions are mathematically equivalent:

对于简单表达式，它的行为与 equality_check 类似：如果两个表达式在数学上等价，则返回 True。

grade_answer("14/3", r"\frac{14}{3}")
评分答案("14/3", r"\frac{14}{3}")

In addition, as described above, it now also returns True in case of two mathematically equivalent tuple-like expressions:

此外，如上所述，现在对于两个在数学上等价的元组类表达式，它也会返回 True：

grade_answer(r"(14/3, 2/3)", "(14/3, 4/6)")
批改答案(r"(14/3, 2/3)", "(14/3, 4/6)")

To check the grade_answer function more comprehensively, the code in listing 3.11 contains more diverse test cases.

为了更全面地测试 grade_answer 函数，清单 3.11 中的代码包含了更多样化的测试用例。

Listing 3.11 Test cases and demo function to test the grader
tests = [  #A
        ("check_1", "3/4", r"\frac{3}{4}", True),
        ("check_2", "(3)/(4)", r"3/4", True),
        ("check_3", r"\frac{\sqrt{8}}{2}", "sqrt(2)", True),
        ("check_4", r"\( \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{6} \)", "2/3", True),
        ("check_5", "(1, 2)", r"(1,2)", True),
        ("check_6", "(2, 1)", "(1, 2)", False),
        ("check_7", "(1, 2, 3)", "(1, 2)", False),
        ("check_8", "0.5", "1/2", True),
        ("check_9", "0.3333333333", "1/3", False),
        ("check_10", "1,234/2", "617", True),
        ("check_11", r"\text{2/3}", "2/3", True),
        ("check_12", "50%", "1/2", False),
        ("check_13", r"2\cdot 3/4", "3/2", True),
        ("check_14", r"90^\circ", "90", True),
        ("check_15", r"\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)", "3/4", True),
        ("check_16", r"2²", "2**2", True),
    ]
 
 
def run_demos_table(tests):
    header = ("Test", "Expect", "Got", "Status")
    rows = []
    for name, pred, gtruth, expect in tests:
        got = grade_answer(pred, gtruth)  #B
        status = "PASS" if got == expect else "FAIL"
        rows.append((name, str(expect), str(got), status))
 
    data = [header] + rows
    
    col_widths = [  #C
        max(len(row[i]) for row in data)
        for i in range(len(header))
    ]
 
    for row in data:  #D
        line = " | ".join(
            row[i].ljust(col_widths[i])
            for i in range(len(header))
        )
        print(line)
 
    passed = sum(r[3] == "PASS" for r in rows)  #E
    print(f"\nPassed {passed}/{len(rows)}")     #E
#A Define test cases: (name, prediction, ground truth, expected result)
#B Run equality check
#C Compute max width for each column to align table nicely
#D Print table row by row
#E Print summary of passed tests

With the grade_function implemented, we now have the building blocks in place to evaluate the LLM. In the next section, we will load a math dataset on which we will evaluate the LLM.

既然已经实现了评分函数，我们现在就具备了评估大语言模型所需的基石。在下一节中，我们将加载一个数学数据集，并在其上对大语言模型进行评估。

3.8 Loading the evaluation dataset

3.8 加载评估数据集

As we have seen in the chapter so far, implementing a robust verification pipeline can be a tedious task. Fortunately, we now have all the pieces in place, from answer extraction to grading, and are ready to evaluate the LLM on a benchmark dataset. For this, as illustrated in figure 3.9, we will use the MATH-500 dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500), a widely used benchmark for reasoning models. It is a curated collection of 500 problems sampled from the original MATH dataset.

正如我们在本章迄今所见，构建一条稳健的验证流水线可能是一项繁琐的工作。幸运的是，我们现已齐备从答案提取到评分的各项环节，可以着手在基准数据集上评估大语言模型了。为此，如图3.9所示，我们将使用MATH-500数据集（https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500），该数据集是推理模型领域广为采用的基准测试集。它是由原始MATH数据集中抽取的500道题目组成的精选集合。

Figure 3.9 Loading the evaluation dataset. After completing steps 2–6 on individual problems (generate, extract, normalize, verify, and grade answers) in the previous sections, the two remaining steps are to load the full dataset (step 7) and apply the same procedure across all problems to evaluate the model (step 8).
图3.9 加载评估数据集。在前面各节中完成针对单个题目的步骤2至步骤6（生成答案、提取答案、归一化处理、验证答案及评分）之后，剩下的两个步骤是加载完整数据集（步骤7），并针对所有题目重复相同的操作流程以评估模型（步骤8）。

This choice of using MATH-500 is practical for three reasons. First, MATH-500 is large enough to be meaningful but still small enough to make repeated evaluations manageable throughout the book, whereas running the full MATH dataset each time would be much slower. Second, in later chapters we use a non-overlapping training subset derived from the original MATH dataset, so keeping MATH-500 as a held-out evaluation set gives us a clean reference point. Third, MATH-500 is a common benchmark dataset in the reasoning-model literature, which makes the results in this book easier to compare with prior work. We also prefer MATH-500 over simpler datasets such as GSM8K here because it is more challenging for modern reasoning models and better matches the type of multi-step symbolic verification pipeline we are building in this chapter.

选择使用 MATH-500 具有现实意义，原因有三。首先，MATH-500 规模适中：既足以体现其意义，又不至于过大而使全书中的多次评估难以操作；相比之下，每次均使用完整的 MATH 数据集则会显著降低运行效率。其次，在后续章节中，我们将基于原始 MATH 数据集构建一个不重叠的训练子集，因此将 MATH-500 保留为独立的评估集，能够提供一个清晰的参考基准。第三，MATH-500 是推理模型研究领域中常用的基准数据集，这使得本书的结果更容易与既有工作进行对比。此外，我们在此更倾向于使用 MATH-500 而非 GSM8K 等更为简单的数据集，是因为前者对当前的推理模型更具挑战性，并且更加契合本章所构建的多步符号验证流水线的特性。

We will load the MATH-500 dataset (step 7 in figure 3.9) using the following code:

我们将使用以下代码加载 MATH-500 数据集（图 3.9 中的步骤 7）：

Listing 3.12 Loading the MATH-500 dataset
import json
import requests
 
def load_math500_test(local_path="math500_test.json", save_copy=True):
    local_path = Path(local_path)
    url = (
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/"
        "main/ch03/01_main-chapter-code/math500_test.json"
    )
 
    if local_path.exists():
        with local_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    else:
        r = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        data = r.json()
 
        if save_copy:  # Saves a local copy
            with local_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
 
    return data
 
math_data = load_math500_test()
print("Number of entries:", len(math_data))

As we can see, the dataset entry is formatted as a Python dictionary with keys and values. The relevant keys are

正如我们所见，数据集条目被格式化为一个包含键和值的 Python 字典。相关的键是

  • "problem": the math question or problem for the LLM to solve,
  • “问题”：大语言模型需要解答的数学题目或问题，
  • "answer": the correct (ground truth) answer we want to compare the LLM answer against,
  • “答案”：我们希望将大语言模型的回答与其进行对比的正确（真实）答案，
  • "solution": a worked-out, step-by-step explanation of the problem (not used in this chapter, but useful for training or analysis).
  • “解题过程”：对问题的详细、分步骤解析（本章未使用，但可用于训练或分析）。

(Note that the output contains the keys sorted in alphabetical order: "answer", "problem", "solution", but the bulleted uses the more logical ordering for readability.)

（请注意，输出中的键按字母顺序排序为：“answer”、“problem”、“solution”，而项目符号列表则采用了更符合逻辑的顺序，以提高可读性。）

Now that we have a pre-trained LLM, evaluation functions, and a benchmark dataset to work with, we can implement the model evaluation.

既然我们已经拥有了预训练的语言模型、评估函数以及基准数据集，就可以实施模型评估了。

3.9 Evaluating the model

3.9 评估模型

In this section, we put the LLM text generation and evaluation tools from steps 2–6 in figure 3.10 into practice and apply them to the MATH-500 dataset (step 8 in figure 3.10), which we loaded in the previous section.

在本节中，我们将图3.10中步骤2至6所介绍的大型语言模型文本生成与评估工具付诸实践，并将其应用于MATH-500数据集（图3.10中的步骤8），该数据集已在上一节中加载。

This full pipeline is important beyond this chapter as well, because it becomes the main way we will measure progress later when we compare prompting methods and training-based improvements.

这条完整的流水线不仅在本章中至关重要，而且在后续章节中也同样重要：它将成为我们比较提示方法和基于训练的改进时衡量进展的主要依据。

Figure 3.10 The complete evaluation pipeline on the MATH-500 dataset. After loading the dataset (step 7), steps 2–6 are applied systematically across all problems to obtain the final model evaluation (step 8).
图3.10 MATH-500数据集上的完整评估流程。加载数据集（步骤7）后，步骤2至6会系统地应用于所有题目，以获得最终的模型评估（步骤8）。

As you may recall from section 3.4 (Extracting the final answer box), our answer checking pipeline expects that the model returns the answer in boxed form, which is a common convention when evaluating reasoning models on math problems. To increase the likelihood that the model adheres to this format, we can format the prompt as shown in listing 3.13:

正如你在第3.4节（提取最终答案框）中所回忆的那样，我们的答案校验流水线期望模型以加框的形式返回答案，这是在数学问题上评估推理模型时的一种常见惯例。为了提高模型遵循该格式的可能性，我们可以按照清单3.13所示的方式格式化提示：

Listing 3.13 Function to render a prompt template for math evaluation
def render_prompt(prompt):
    template = (
        "You are a helpful math assistant.\n"
        "Answer the question and write the final result on a new line as:\n"
        "\\boxed{ANSWER}\n\n"
        f"Question:\n{prompt}\n\nAnswer:"
    )
    return template
def render_prompt(prompt): template = ( "你是一位 helpful 的数学助手。\n" "请回答问题，并将最终结果写在新的一行，格式为：\n" "\\boxed{ANSWER}\n\n" f"问题：\n{prompt}\n\n答案：" ) return template

Let's now apply the prompt template from listing 3.13 to the example prompt we introduced earlier in this chapter (section 3.2). For convenience, we redefine the example prompt here:

现在，让我们将清单3.13中的提示模板应用到本章前面（第3.2节）介绍的示例提示中。为方便起见，我们在此重新定义该示例提示：

prompt = (
    r"If $a+b=3$ and $ab=\tfrac{13}{6}$, "
    r"what is the value of $a^2+b^2$?"
)
prompt_fmt = render_prompt(prompt)
print(prompt_fmt)
prompt = ( r"如果 $a+b=3$ 且 $ab=\tfrac{13}{6}$，" r"那么 $a^2+b^2$ 的值是多少？" ) prompt_fmt = render_prompt(prompt) print(prompt_fmt)

The formatted prompt is now as follows:

格式化后的提示现在如下：

You are a helpful math assistant.
Answer the question and write the final result on a new line as:
\boxed{ANSWER}
 
Question:
If $a+b=3$ and $ab=\tfrac{13}{6}$, what is the value of $a^2+b^2$?
 
Answer:
你是一位乐于助人的数学助手。 请回答问题，并将最终结果写在新的一行，格式为： \boxed{答案} 问题： 若 $a+b=3$ 且 $ab=\tfrac{13}{6}$，则 $a^2+b^2$ 的值是多少？ 答案：

Next, we pass the prompt to the text generation wrapper function we defined in listing 3.3 in section 3.3 to recap the text generation process before we construct the model evaluation function:

接下来，我们将提示传递给我们在第3.3节的代码清单3.3中定义的文本生成封装函数，以回顾文本生成过程，然后再构建模型评估函数：

generated_text = generate_text_stream_concat(
    model, tokenizer, prompt_fmt, device,
    max_new_tokens=2048,
    verbose=True
)
generated_text = generate_text_stream_concat( model, tokenizer, prompt_fmt, device, max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True )

Using this prompt example, the model responds with a relatively brief answer: "\boxed{10}". (Note that the generated response may differ depending on whether you executed the code on a CPU, CUDA, or MPS device.)

使用这个提示示例，模型会给出一个相对简短的回答：“\boxed{10}”。（请注意，生成的回答可能会因你在 CPU、CUDA 或 MPS 设备上运行代码而有所不同。）

While brevity can speed up generation by reducing the number of tokens, the response is incorrect. In contrast, in section 3.3, without a prompt template, the model produced a longer response, which led to the correct answer, 14/3.

尽管简短的输入可以通过减少令牌数量来加快生成速度，但生成的响应却是错误的。相比之下，在第3.3节中，由于未使用提示模板，模型生成了更长的响应，从而给出了正确答案：14/3。

Whether a prompt template is well-suited for a given model and task ideally needs to be determined on a larger set of examples before we can draw any conclusions, for instance, the MATH-500 dataset we will evaluate the model on later in this section.

理想情况下，一个提示模板是否适合特定的模型和任务，需要在更大规模的示例集上进行评估后才能得出结论。例如，在本节稍后我们将用于模型评估的 MATH-500 数据集。

Prompt template choices
提示模板选项

The prompt template in listing 3.13 is used here to demonstrate how a model evaluation pipeline can be implemented with answers that are automatically checked for correctness. The chosen template encourages short outputs, which lets you work through this chapter efficiently on a first read. Afterward, I recommend revisiting the chapter with alternative settings to optimize accuracy on the official Qwen3 reasoning model variant that we use here as a reference model.

此处使用了清单 3.13 中的提示模板，以演示如何构建一个模型评估流水线，并对模型生成的答案进行自动正确性校验。所选模板鼓励生成简短的输出，便于读者在初次阅读时高效地完成本章内容。之后，建议重新回顾本章，尝试不同的配置设置，以在我们在此作为参考模型使用的通义千问3推理模型上进一步优化准确率。

As it turns out, using no prompt template boosts the base model performance by 50%, but it reduces the accuracy of the reasoning model by 40%.

结果表明，不使用提示模板能使基础模型的性能提升50%，但会使得推理模型的准确率下降40%。

Additionally, we may also experiment with alternative prompt templates. For instance, the common standard prompt for the MATH-500 benchmark is the following variant that swaps "Question:" with "Problem:" in listing 3.13. This seemingly minor change improves the base model’s accuracy by approximately 20%, likely because it better matches the memorized training data (assuming the MATH-500 test set was included in the training corpus). While the base model benefits from this change, the accuracy of the reasoning model variant drops by 30%.

此外，我们还可以尝试使用其他提示模板。例如，MATH-500 基准测试常用的标准提示是清单 3.13 中将“Question:”替换为“Problem:”的变体。这一看似微小的改动使基础模型的准确率提升了约 20%，这很可能是因为它更契合模型在训练过程中记忆的数据（假设 MATH-500 测试集包含在训练语料中）。尽管基础模型受益于这一改动，但推理模型变体的准确率却下降了 30%。

Earlier, we mentioned that answer extraction is a simple, mechanical task that can be solved with deterministic code rather than employing another LLM for the answer extraction. Based on the accuracy change due to different prompting templates, it looks like our extraction method may not be reliable. This is not necessarily the case.

此前我们提到，答案抽取是一项简单、机械的任务，完全可以通过确定性代码来实现，而无需再调用另一台大语言模型来进行答案抽取。然而，从不同提示模板导致的准确率变化来看，似乎我们的抽取方法并不可靠。其实未必如此。

Also, it's not necessarily the case that the LLM generates misformatted answers. It can just be incorrect, and switching to another LLM for extraction would not solve that. Smaller base models are often quite sensitive to prompt phrasing. In the next chapter, we will see how this becomes even more apparent once we introduce additional prompt variations.

此外，大语言模型并不一定会生成格式错误的回答。它也可能只是给出错误的答案，而换用另一款大语言模型来进行信息抽取并不能解决这个问题。较小的基础模型往往对提示的措辞非常敏感。在下一章中，我们将看到，一旦引入更多的提示变体，这一点就会变得更加明显。

Next, before we implement the final model evaluation function, let us test our model evaluation pipeline end to end on a smaller example via the demo function in listing 3.14:

接下来，在我们实现最终的模型评估函数之前，让我们通过清单 3.14 中的 demo 函数，在一个较小的示例上端到端地测试我们的模型评估流水线：

Listing 3.14 Demo function to run the evaluation pipeline
def mini_eval_demo(model, tokenizer, device):
    ex = {  #A
        "problem": "Compute 1/2 + 1/6.",
        "answer": "2/3"
    }
    prompt = render_prompt(ex["problem"])     #B
    gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat(   #C
        model, tokenizer, prompt, device,     #C
        max_new_tokens=64,                    #C
    )                                         #C
    pred_answer = extract_final_candidate(gen_text)  #D
    is_correct = grade_answer(                       #E
        pred_answer, ex["answer"]                    #E
    )                                                #E
    
    print(f"Device: {device}")
    print(f"Prediction: {pred_answer}")
    print(f"Ground truth: {ex['answer']}")
    print(f"Correct: {is_correct}")
#A Test example with "problem" and "answer" fields
#B 1. Apply prompt template
#C 2. Generate response
#D 3. Extract and normalize answer
#E 4. Grade answer
#A 一个包含“问题”和“答案”字段的测试示例 #B 1. 应用提示模板 #C 2. 生成回答 #D 3. 提取并规范化答案 #E 4. 批改答案

The mini_eval_demo function in listing 3.14 combines all the aspects we have covered so far in this chapter:

清单 3.14 中的 mini_eval_demo 函数结合了本章迄今为止我们所介绍的所有内容：

  1. Applying a prompt template
  2. 应用提示模板
  3. Feeding the formatted prompt to the LLM to generate an answer
  4. 将格式化的提示输入大型语言模型，以生成回答。
  5. Extracting and normalizing the answer
  6. 提取并规范化答案
  7. Grading the answer
  8. 批改答案

This mini_eval_demo function essentially connects the evaluation components together into a small function that we can use to test the code before coding the final evaluation pipeline for the MATH-500 dataset. The code starts from a toy example (ex), renders the problem into the prompt template (prompt), and streams a response from the model (generate_text_stream_concat). It then parses the model output to a final candidate answer (pred_answer) and grades it against the ground truth with grade_answer. Lastly, it prints the results for us to evaluate.

这个 mini_eval_demo 函数本质上是将评估的各个组件串联成一个小型函数，以便我们在为 MATH-500 数据集构建最终的评估流水线之前，先对代码进行测试。代码从一个玩具示例（ex）开始，将问题渲染到提示模板中（prompt），并从模型中流式获取响应（generate_text_stream_concat）。随后，它会将模型输出解析为最终的候选答案（pred_answer），并与真实答案进行比对评分（grade_answer）。最后，它会打印出结果，供我们评估。

Calling the mini_eval_demo(model, tokenizer, device) function results in the following output:

调用 mini_eval_demo(model, tokenizer, device) 函数会产生以下输出：

Device: mps
Prediction: 1/3
Ground truth: 2/3
Correct: False
设备：mps 预测：1/3 真实标签：2/3 正确：否

We can see that the generated answer ("1/3") was correctly extracted, but it doesn't match the correct answer ("2/3"), and hence the check returns False. (Note that the results may differ depending on whether you execute the code on a CPU, CUDA, or MPS device.)

我们可以看到，生成的答案（“1/3”）被正确提取出来了，但它与标准答案（“2/3”）不匹配，因此检查结果为 False。（请注意，执行结果可能会因你在 CPU、CUDA 或 MPS 设备上运行代码而有所不同。）

Now that we have tested our workflow on a simpler example, let's implement it to run on the MATH-500 dataset.

既然我们已经在更简单的示例上测试了工作流，接下来就将其部署到 MATH-500 数据集上运行吧。

Listing 3.15 End-to-end model evaluation pipeline for MATH-500 dataset
import time
 
 
def eta_progress_message(  #A
    processed,
    total,
    start_time,
    show_eta=False,
    label="Progress",
):
    progress = f"{label}: {processed}/{total}"
    pad_width = len(f"{label}: {total}/{total} | ETA: 00h 00m 00s")
    if not show_eta or processed <= 0:          
        return progress.ljust(pad_width)
 
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    if elapsed <= 0:
        return progress.ljust(pad_width)
 
    remaining = max(total - processed, 0)
 
    if processed:
        avg_time = elapsed / processed
        eta_seconds = avg_time * remaining
    else:
        eta_seconds = 0
 
    eta_seconds = max(int(round(eta_seconds)), 0)
    minutes, rem_seconds = divmod(eta_seconds, 60)
    hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
    if hours:
        eta = f"{hours}h {minutes:02d}m {rem_seconds:02d}s"
    elif minutes:
        eta = f"{minutes:02d}m {rem_seconds:02d}s"
    else:
        eta = f"{rem_seconds:02d}s"
 
    message = f"{progress} | ETA: {eta}"
    return message.ljust(pad_width)
 
 
def evaluate_math500_stream(
    model,
    tokenizer,
    device,
    math_data,
    out_path=None,
    max_new_tokens=512,
    verbose=False,
):
 
    if out_path is None:
        dev_name = str(device).replace(":", "-")      #B
        out_path = Path(f"math500-{dev_name}.jsonl")
 
    num_examples = len(math_data)
    num_correct = 0
    start_time = time.time()
 
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:   #C
        for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):
            prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"])     #D
            gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat(    #E
                model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                verbose=verbose,
            )
 
            extracted = extract_final_candidate(       #F
                gen_text
            )
            is_correct = grade_answer(                 #G
                extracted, row["answer"]
            )
            num_correct += int(is_correct)
 
            record = {                                 #H
                "index": i,
                "problem": row["problem"],
                "gtruth_answer": row["answer"],
                "generated_text": gen_text,
                "extracted": extracted,
                "correct": bool(is_correct),
            }
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
 
            progress_msg = eta_progress_message(
                processed=i,
                total=num_examples,
                start_time=start_time,
                show_eta=True,
                label="MATH-500",
            )
            print(progress_msg, end="\r", flush=True)
 
            if verbose:                                #I
                print(
                    f"\n\n{'='*50}\n{progress_msg}\n"
                    f"{'='*50}\nExtracted: {extracted}\n"
                    f"Expected:  {row['answer']}\n"
                    f"Correct so far: {num_correct}\n{'-'*50}"
                )
 
    seconds_elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    acc = num_correct / num_examples if num_examples else 0.0
    print(f"\nAccuracy: {acc*100:.1f}% ({num_correct}/{num_examples})")
    print(f"Total time: {seconds_elapsed/60:.1f} min")
    print(f"Logs written to: {out_path}")
    return num_correct, num_examples, acc
#A Helper function to print progress with optional ETA (estimated time to arrival)
#B Make filename compatible with Windows
#C Save results for inspection
#D 1. Apply prompt template
#E 2. Generate response
#F 3. Extract and normalize answer
#G 4. Grade answer
#H Record to be saved for inspection
#I Print responses during generation
#A 用于打印进度的辅助函数，可选显示预计到达时间（ETA） #B 使文件名兼容 Windows 系统 #C 保存结果以便检查 #D 1. 应用提示模板 #E 2. 生成响应 #F 3. 提取并归一化答案 #G 4. 评分答案 #H 待保存以供检查的记录 #I 在生成过程中打印响应

The evaluate_math500_stream function in listing 3.15 uses the same main steps as the smaller demo function from listing 3.14: for each problem, it renders the prompt, streams a model response, extracts the answer candidate, and grades it against the reference answer.

清单 3.15 中的 evaluate_math500_stream 函数采用了与清单 3.14 中的较小演示函数相同的主步骤：对于每个题目，它会渲染提示、流式获取模型响应、提取答案候选，并将其与参考答案进行评分。

In addition to iterating over a dataset with multiple entries, it adds some additional bells and whistles. For instance, it saves the generated responses to a JSON file in a Python dictionary-like format for record keeping and closer inspection.

除了遍历包含多条记录的数据集之外，它还增加了一些额外的功能。例如，它会将生成的响应以类似 Python 字典的 JSON 格式保存到文件中，以便存档和进一步检查。

Let's now run this function on a subset, the first 10 examples of MATH-500, which takes about 0.7 minutes on a Mac Mini with an M4 chip. (Evaluating the reasoning model variant takes about 7 min as it generates longer responses.)

现在我们在一个子集上运行这个函数，即 MATH-500 数据集的前 10 个示例。在配备 M4 芯片的 Mac Mini 上，这大约需要 0.7 分钟。（评估推理模型变体则需要约 7 分钟，因为它会生成更长的响应。）

print("Model:", WHICH_MODEL)
num_correct, num_examples, acc = evaluate_math500_stream(
    model, tokenizer, device, 
    math_data=math_data[:10],  #A
    max_new_tokens=2048,
    verbose=False              #B
)
#A Only evaluate on the first 10 examples
#B Set to true to read the responses as they are being generated
#A 仅在前10个示例上进行评估 #B 设置为真以在生成响应时实时读取

In the code example above, we set max_new_tokens to a generous 2048, since the reasoning model variant, per design, tends to generate much longer responses, and we don't want to cut it off prematurely. This leads to much longer evaluation times, where it may appear that the generation is stuck. Optionally, you could set verbose=True to see the response being generated live, token by token.

在上面的代码示例中，我们将 `max_new_tokens` 设置为充裕的 2048，因为该推理模型的变体按设计往往会生成更长的响应，我们不希望过早地截断它。这会导致评估时间显著延长，从而可能让人误以为生成过程卡住了。此外，你还可以选择将 `verbose` 设置为 `True`，以便实时逐个 token 地查看正在生成的响应。

The result of running the evaluate_math500_stream function is as follows:

运行 evaluate_math500_stream 函数的结果如下：

Device: mps
MATH-500: 10/10 | ETA: 00s
Accuracy: 30.0% (3/10)
Total time: 0.4 min
模型：base 设备：mps MATH-500：10/10 | 预计剩余时间：00秒 准确率：30.0%（3/10） 总耗时：0.4分钟

(Note that the results may differ depending on whether you execute the code on a CPU, CUDA, or MPS device.)

（请注意，执行结果可能会因你在 CPU、CUDA 或 MPS 设备上运行代码而有所不同。）

As we can see, the model achieves a relatively low accuracy of 30%. We can open the math500_base-mps.jsonl file in a text editor to analyze the results, together with the generated response. For instance, we find that the answers, in all cases, have been successfully extracted, but they are plain wrong, which indicates that the model does not have very strong math problem-solving capabilities (yet). This is expected since it's merely a base model.

正如我们所见，该模型的准确率相对较低，仅为30%。我们可以用文本编辑器打开 math500_base-mps.jsonl 文件，结合模型生成的响应来分析结果。例如，我们发现无论在何种情况下，答案都成功被提取出来，但却是完全错误的，这表明该模型目前的数学解题能力还很有限。考虑到它只是一个基础模型，这一结果也在预料之中。

Loading the .jsonl file programmatically
以编程方式加载 .jsonl 文件

The .jsonl file suffix is a convention used for JSON files with one data entry per row. You can view it in your favorite text editor. Optionally, we can load the .jsonl file created during the evaluation in Python using the following code:

.jsonl 文件后缀是一种约定，用于表示每行包含一条数据的 JSON 文件。你可以在自己喜欢的文本编辑器中查看它。可选地，我们可以在 Python 中使用以下代码加载评估过程中生成的 .jsonl 文件：

dev_name = str(device).replace(":", "-")
local_path = f"math500_{WHICH_MODEL}-{dev_name}.jsonl"
results = []
with open(local_path, "r") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.strip():
            results.append(json.loads(line))
dev_name = str(device).replace(":", "-") local_path = f"math500_{WHICH_MODEL}-{dev_name}.jsonl" results = [] with open(local_path, "r") as f: for line in f: if line.strip(): results.append(json.loads(line))

The reasoning model variant, which you can enable by setting WHICH_MODEL = "reasoning" in listing 3.1 in section 3.2, performs much better and achieves a 90% accuracy on the same 10-sample subset and 50.8% on the complete 500-sample dataset, as shown in table 3.1.

推理模型变体可通过在3.2节的清单3.1中将WHICH_MODEL设置为“reasoning”来启用。该变体性能显著提升，在相同的10样本子集上达到90%的准确率，在完整的500样本数据集上则达到50.8%，如表3.1所示。

表3.1 不同设备上MATH-500任务的准确率 模式 设备 准确率 MATH-500规模 基础 CPU 30% 10 基础 CUDA 30% 10 基础 MPS 30% 10 推理 CPU 90% 10 推理 CUDA 90% 10 推理 MPS 80% 10 基础 CUDA 15.3% 500 推理 CUDA 50.8% 500

As shown in table 3.1, the reasoning variant, with its longer responses, has a drastically improved accuracy, but also increases the compute intensity and answer generation time substantially (from 0.4 min for the base model to 7 min for the reasoning model on a Mac Mini with M4 chip on the 10-sample subset, and from 13.3 min to 185.4 min on an H100 on the 500-sample dataset), which highlights one of the trade-offs of using reasoning models. Please note that these numbers were obtained in PyTorch 2.8 and can differ in different versions of PyTorch.

如表3.1所示，推理增强型模型由于生成的响应更长，准确率得到了显著提升，但计算强度和答案生成时间也大幅增加（在配备M4芯片的Mac Mini上，针对10个样本的子集，从基础模型的0.4分钟增至推理模型的7分钟；而在H100 GPU上，针对500个样本的数据集，则从13.3分钟增至185.4分钟）。这凸显了使用推理模型时的一个权衡取舍。请注意，这些数值是在PyTorch 2.8版本下获得的，在不同版本的PyTorch中可能会有所差异。

Tip
提示

The code repository contains a bonus script (https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/blob/main/ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500_batched.py) that runs the code in this chapter in batched mode. This means it processes multiple examples per forward pass to accelerate the evaluation while requiring more RAM. With a batch size of 128, this reduces the runtime of the base model, when evaluating all 500 samples, from 13.3 min to 3.3 min on an H100 GPU. Similarly, it reduces the runtime of the reasoning model from 185.4 min to 14.6 min. Note that the H100 is used as an example, and the script is compatible with other GPUs as well.

该代码仓库包含一个附加脚本（https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/blob/main/ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500_batched.py），用于以批处理模式运行本章中的代码。这意味着每次前向传播会处理多个样本，从而在占用更多内存的前提下加快评估速度。使用批量大小为128时，在H100 GPU上对全部500个样本进行评估时，基础模型的运行时间可由13.3分钟缩短至3.3分钟；推理模型的运行时间则由185.4分钟缩短至14.6分钟。需要注意的是，此处以H100为例，但该脚本也兼容其他GPU。
