Note that this concludes our chapter on implementing a verification-based approach for math tasks (figure 3.11). We chose math because it is both natural to implement and widely used in reasoning-specific training, particularly reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which we will cover in chapter 6. The same concept can be extended to other domains, such as code, although we did not explore that here since executing code would require additional setup of a secure virtual environment.

请注意，至此我们关于实现基于验证的数学任务处理方法的章节（图3.11）就结束了。我们选择数学作为示例，是因为它既易于实现，又广泛应用于推理专用训练中，尤其是在可验证奖励的强化学习领域——这一点我们将在第6章中详细介绍。同样的思路也可以推广到其他领域，例如代码编写，不过由于执行代码需要额外搭建安全的虚拟环境，我们在本书中并未对此进行探讨。

Before we move on, it is worth noting that evaluation also comes in many other flavors. In this chapter we focused on verification-based accuracy for math problems, as it is a popular method, and because we will reuse the same verifier as part of the reinforcement learning pipeline in chapters 6 and 7.

在继续之前，值得注意的是，评估方法还有许多其他形式。在本章中，我们重点讨论了基于验证的数学问题准确率，因为它是一种较为流行的方法，而且我们将在第6章和第7章的强化学习流程中再次使用相同的验证器。

For a broader overview, appendix F walks through other common evaluation strategies, such as multiple-choice benchmarks, verifiers, leaderboards, and LLM-as-judge setups. This appendix provides an overview with hands-on examples if you want a quick tour of how these methods work in practice.

如需更全面的概览，附录F将介绍其他常见的评估策略，例如选择题基准测试、验证器、排行榜以及“大语言模型充当裁判”的设置。如果您希望快速了解这些方法在实践中的运作方式，本附录将提供概览并配有动手示例。

Figure 3.11 Mental model of the topics covered in this book. This chapter implemented a verifier-based evaluation pipeline. In the next chapter, we will improve the reasoning capabilities of the LLM via more advanced inference techniques.
图3.11 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型。本章实现了一个基于验证器的评估流水线。在下一章中，我们将通过更先进的推理技术来提升大语言模型的推理能力。

Now, with an evaluation framework in place, the next chapter, as shown in figure 3.11, focuses on improving the reasoning capabilities through more advanced inference (text generation) techniques.

如今，评估框架已就位，下一章（如图3.11所示）将重点放在通过更先进的推理（文本生成）技术来提升推理能力上。

3.10 Summary

3.10 总结

  • There are four main evaluation methods for LLMs: multiple choice, verifiers, leaderboards, and LLM judges
  • 大语言模型主要有四种评估方法：选择题、验证器、排行榜和由大语言模型担任的评委。
  • Verification-based evaluation methods allow free-form answers and use external tools to check correctness
  • 基于验证的评估方法允许自由作答，并使用外部工具来检查答案的正确性。
  • This chapter focuses on verification-based evaluation by building a math verifier that extracts, normalizes, and checks answers with SymPy
    • The verification pipeline involves several core steps from loading the LLM to running the evaluation on a dataset
    • 验证流程包含多个核心步骤，从加载大语言模型到在数据集上运行评估。
    • As part of the verification pipeline, answer extraction uses string parsing to locate boxed content (with fallback mechanisms for missing boxes)
    • 作为验证流水线的一部分，答案抽取通过字符串解析来定位被方框标注的内容（并对缺失的方框提供回退机制）。
    • Another step implements normalization, which standardizes diverse answer formats by stripping LaTeX and converting mathematical notation
    • 下一步实施归一化处理，通过去除 LaTeX 格式并转换数学符号，将多种答案格式标准化。
  • Finally, the pipeline uses mathematical equivalence checking (via SymPy) to compare expressions symbolically
  • 最后，该流水线使用数学等价性检查（通过 SymPy）来以符号方式比较表达式。
  • The MATH-500 dataset provides 500 curated math problems for evaluation
  • MATH-500 数据集提供了500道精心挑选的数学题目，用于评估。
  • Prompt templates significantly impact model performance
  • 提示模板显著影响模型性能。
  • The reasoning model achieves higher accuracy than the base model, but requires much longer runtime
  • 该推理模型的准确率高于基础模型，但运行时间显著更长。

4 Improving reasoning with inference-time scaling

4 通过推理时缩放提升推理能力

This chapter covers

本章涵盖

  • Prompting an LLM to explain its reasoning to improve answer accuracy
  • 提示大型语言模型解释其推理过程，以提高回答准确性。
  • Modifying the text generation function to produce diverse responses
  • 修改文本生成函数以产生多样化 responses
  • Improving reasoning reliability by sampling multiple responses
  • 通过采样多个响应来提升推理可靠性

Reasoning performance and answer accuracy can be improved without retraining or modifying the model itself. These methods operate during inference, when the model generates text. As shown in the overview in figure 4.1, in this chapter, we cover two inference-time scaling methods. As we will see later in this chapter, both methods more than double the accuracy of the base model we used in previous chapters.

推理性能和答案准确率可以在不重新训练或修改模型本身的情况下得到提升。这些方法在模型生成文本的推理阶段发挥作用。如图4.1所示的概览所示，本章将介绍两种推理时缩放方法。正如我们将在本章后续内容中看到的那样，这两种方法都能使我们在前几章中使用的基线模型的准确率提高一倍以上。

Figure 4.1 A mental model of the topics covered in this book. This chapter focuses on techniques that improve reasoning without additional training (stage 3). In particular, it extends the text-generation function and implements a voting-based method to improve answer accuracy. The next chapter then introduces an inference-time scaling approach where the model iteratively refines its own answers.
图4.1 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型。本章重点介绍无需额外训练即可提升推理能力的技术（阶段3）。具体而言，它扩展了文本生成功能，并实现了一种基于投票的方法来提高答案的准确性。下一章则介绍一种推理时缩放方法，该方法使模型能够迭代地优化自身生成的答案。

The next section provides a general introduction to inference-time scaling before discussing the inference methods that are shown in figure 4.1 in more detail.

下一节将对推理时的扩展进行概述，随后再更详细地讨论图4.1中所示的推理方法。

4.1 Introduction to inference-time scaling

4.1 推理时缩放简介

In general, there are two main strategies to improve reasoning:

一般来说，有两种主要策略来提升推理能力：

  1. Increasing training compute and
  2. 不断增加训练算力和
  3. increasing inference compute (also known as inference-time scaling or test-time scaling).
  4. 增加推理计算量（也称为推理时缩放或测试时缩放）。

(In machine learning and AI, "compute" refers to the computational resources required to train or run a model.) These two approaches are illustrated in figure 4.2.

（在机器学习和人工智能领域，“算力”指的是训练或运行模型所需的计算资源。）这两种方法如图4.2所示。

Figure 4.2 Comparing inference-time scaling (this chapter) and training-time scaling (after chapter 5). Both improve accuracy by using more compute, but inference-time scaling does this on the fly, without changing the model's weight parameters. The plots are inspired by OpenAI's article introducing their first reasoning model (https://openai.com/index/learning-to-reason-with-llms/).
图4.2 比较推理时扩展（本章）与训练时扩展（第5章之后）。两者都通过增加计算资源来提升准确率，但推理时扩展是在不改变模型权重参数的情况下，实时实现这一目标。这些图表的灵感来源于OpenAI介绍其首个推理模型的文章（https://openai.com/index/learning-to-reason-with-llms/）。

The plots shown in figure 4.2 make it look like we improve reasoning either by increasing training-time compute or inference-time compute. LLMs are usually designed to improve reasoning by combining heavy training-time compute (a topic of future chapters) and increased inference-time compute (the topic of this chapter).

图4.2中的图表似乎表明，我们可以通过增加训练时的计算资源或推理时的计算资源来提升模型的推理能力。大语言模型通常通过结合大量的训练时计算资源（这一主题将在后续章节中讨论）和更多的推理时计算资源（即本章所探讨的内容）来实现推理能力的提升。

Inference-time compute scaling (also called inference-time scaling and test-time compute scaling) means spending additional computation at answer-generation time, after the model has already been trained, to improve the quality of its response. Instead of changing the model's weights, we let the same trained model do more work per question, for example by generating more tokens and "thinking" longer, sampling multiple answers, or successively refining its answer.

推理时计算扩展（也称推理时缩放或测试时计算缩放）是指在模型训练完成后，在生成答案的过程中投入额外的计算资源，以提升输出质量。这种方法并不改变模型的权重，而是让同一已训练好的模型针对每个问题执行更多计算任务，例如生成更多的词元、延长“思考”时间、采样多个候选答案，或者对答案进行逐次精炼。

In this book, we focus on three practical and foundational inference-time techniques (figure 4.3):

在本书中，我们重点关注三种实用且基础的推理时技术（图4.3）：

  • Method 1: Extending the chain-of-thought response to prompt the model to explain its reasoning. This is a simple technique that can substantially improve accuracy.
  • 方法1：扩展思维链式回答，以引导模型解释其推理过程。这是一种简单却能显著提升准确性的技巧。
  • Method 2: Parallel sampling via self-consistency, where the model generates multiple responses and selects the most frequent one.
  • 方法2：通过自一致性进行并行采样，即模型生成多个响应，并选择出现频率最高的那一个。
  • Method 3: Iterative self-refinement, where the model reviews and improves its own reasoning and answers across multiple steps. (This topic is implemented and covered in more detail in the next chapter.)
  • 方法3：迭代式自我精炼，即模型在多个步骤中不断回顾并改进自身的推理过程和答案。（本主题将在下一章中详细阐述。）
Figure 4.3 Overview of three inference-time methods to improve reasoning covered in this book. The first modifies the prompt to encourage step-by-step reasoning, and the second samples multiple answers and selects the most frequent one. Both are discussed in this chapter. The third method, in which the model iteratively refines its own response, is introduced in the next chapter.
图4.3 本书所涵盖的三种推理时改进推理能力的方法概览。第一种方法通过修改提示词来鼓励分步推理，第二种方法则采样多个答案并选择出现频率最高的一个。这两种方法均在本章中讨论。第三种方法——模型迭代地优化自身输出——将在下一章中介绍。

The methods shown in figure 4.3 fall under the category of inference-time scaling because they cause the model to generate more tokens, which increases compute resources during inference. In other words, these methods achieve better accuracy while making the inference process more expensive, which is a common theme of inference-time scaling techniques.

图4.3所示的方法属于推理时缩放的范畴，因为它们会使模型生成更多的标记，从而在推理过程中增加计算资源的消耗。换言之，这些方法能够在提升准确率的同时，也使推理过程变得更加昂贵，这正是推理时缩放技术的一个普遍特点。

The first method in this chapter improves answer accuracy by prompting the model to explain its reasoning, a simple yet highly effective approach.

本章介绍的第一种方法通过提示模型阐述其推理过程来提高答案的准确性，这是一种简单却非常有效的方法。

Next, we extend the text generation function introduced earlier to enable sampling multiple responses for the same input (the 2nd method shown in figure 4.3). Using this modified function, we implement self-consistency, a voting-based inference-time scaling technique that increases answer accuracy by generating multiple answers and selecting the most frequent one.

接下来，我们扩展先前介绍的文本生成函数，使其能够为同一输入采样生成多个响应（如图4.3所示的第二种方法）。利用这一修改后的函数，我们实现了自一致性方法——一种基于投票的推理时缩放技术。该方法通过生成多个答案并选择出现频率最高的答案，从而提高回答的准确性。

In total, I evaluated more than ten different inference-time scaling techniques across thousands of experiments. The three methods illustrated in figure 4.3 were chosen for this book because they combine three desirable properties. They deliver strong accuracy improvements on the model used here, they represent the main practical paradigms of inference-time scaling, and they are simple enough to implement from scratch without introducing too much extra machinery. Concretely, they cover the two main patterns of generating longer responses and generating multiple responses.

总计，我在数千次实验中评估了十余种不同的推理时缩放技术。图4.3所示的三种方法之所以被选入本书，是因为它们兼具三项理想特性：其一，在本研究使用的模型上能够显著提升精度；其二，分别代表了推理时缩放的主要实用范式；其三，实现起来相对简单，无需引入过多额外的复杂机制即可从头开始构建。具体而言，这三种方法涵盖了生成更长响应和生成多个响应这两种主要模式。

Longer responses that include reasoning and explanations (methods 1 and 3) are what we typically expect from reasoning models, as discussed in previous chapters. And parallel sampling (method 2) is also widely used in production systems, such as Claude 4 (as described in https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4).

如前几章所述，包含推理和解释的较长回复（方法1和方法3）是我们通常对推理模型的期望。而并行采样（方法2）也在生产系统中得到广泛应用，例如Claude 4（详见https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4）。

4.2 Loading a pre-trained model

4.2 加载预训练模型

Before we begin implementing the inference-time scaling methods described in the previous section, we load the pre-trained base model we used in the previous sections.

在开始实现上一节中介绍的推理时缩放方法之前，我们先加载在前面几节中使用的预训练基础模型。

Listing 4.1 Load tokenizer and base model
import torch
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
     load_model_and_tokenizer
)
 
device = get_device()
device = torch.device("cpu")  #A
 
model, tokenizer = load_model_and_tokenizer(
    which_model="base",
    device=device,
    use_compile=False
)
#A Delete this line to run the code on a GPU (if supported by your machine)
#A 删除此行以在 GPU 上运行代码（如果您的机器支持）

The code in listing 4.1 loads the model and tokenizer we are using in this chapter. It is similar to the code we used in previous chapters.

清单4.1中的代码加载了我们在本章中使用的模型和分词器。它与我们在之前章节中使用的代码类似。

Since the code in this chapter is cheap to run, I recommend running this chapter on the "cpu" device for the first time to get the same results as shown in this chapter (running this chapter on a GPU can subtly alter the results.)

由于本章的代码运行成本很低，我建议首次运行时使用“cpu”设备，以获得与书中所示完全一致的结果（在GPU上运行可能会略微改变结果）。

Let's try the model on a prompt from the MATH-500 dataset, which we worked with in the previous chapter:

让我们用上一章中我们曾使用过的 MATH-500 数据集中的一个题目来测试这个模型：

from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import render_prompt
 
raw_prompt = (
    "Half the value of $3x-9$ is $x+37$. "
    "What is the value of $x$?"
)
prompt = render_prompt(raw_prompt)
print(prompt)
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 的 render_prompt 原始提示是： “$3x-9$ 的一半等于 $x+37$。那么 $x$ 的值是多少？” 提示经过 render_prompt 处理后，打印出结果。

The formatted prompt is as follows:

格式化的提示如下：

You are a helpful math assistant.
Answer the question and write the final result on a new line as:
\boxed{ANSWER}
 
Question:
Half the value of $3x-9$ is $x+37$. What is the value of $x$?
 
Answer:
你是一位乐于助人的数学助手。 请回答问题，并将最终结果写在新的一行，格式为： \boxed{答案} 问题： $3x-9$ 的一半等于 $x+37$。求 $x$ 的值。 答案：

We can use the prompt above as input to the generate_text_stream_concat we defined in the previous chapter. We want to compare several inference-time scaling strategies while keeping the rest of the code unchanged. For that reason, we make a small modification to the text generation wrapper so that we can swap in different generation functions and settings without rewriting the surrounding prompt-handling and output code. The changes are highlighted via the code comments in listing 4.2:

我们可以将上述提示作为输入，传递给我们在前一章中定义的 generate_text_stream_concat 函数。我们希望在保持其余代码不变的情况下，比较几种推理时的缩放策略。为此，我们对文本生成封装函数做了一点小修改，以便能够在不重写周围的提示处理和输出代码的前提下，切换不同的生成函数和设置。这些改动已在列表 4.2 中通过代码注释高亮显示：

Listing 4.2 Modified generate_text_stream_concat function
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import generate_text_basic_stream_cache
 
 
def generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
    model, tokenizer, prompt, device, max_new_tokens,
    verbose=False, 
    generate_func=None,  #A
    **generate_kwargs    #A
):
 
    if generate_func is None:  #B
        generate_func = generate_text_basic_stream_cache
        
    input_ids = torch.tensor(
        tokenizer.encode(prompt), device=device
        ).unsqueeze(0)
 
    generated_ids = []
    for token in generate_func(
        model=model,
        token_ids=input_ids,
        max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
        eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
        **generate_kwargs,  #C
    ):
        next_token_id = token.squeeze(0)
        generated_ids.append(next_token_id.item())
 
        if verbose:
            print(
                tokenizer.decode(next_token_id.tolist()),
                end="",
                flush=True
            )
    return tokenizer.decode(generated_ids)
#A We add parameters to accept a text generation function and additional arguments
#B If the text generation function is undefined, we use generate_text_basic_stream_cache similar to chapter 3
#C We can pass additional arguments to the text generation function if needed
#A 我们添加参数，用于接收文本生成函数及额外的参数 #B 如果文本生成函数未定义，则使用类似于第3章的generate_text_basic_stream_cache #C 如有需要，我们可以将额外的参数传递给文本生成函数

In short, the generate_text_stream_concat_flex function above is similar to the generate_text_stream_concat function from the previous chapter, except that we can now pass in the text generation function (like generate_text_basic_stream_cache) as a function argument instead of hard-coding it. The practical benefit is that the outer wrapper can keep handling prompt encoding, streaming, and decoding in one place, while the inner generation step can be replaced with different decoding strategies. This makes it easier to compare methods fairly, since we change only the generation logic rather than the entire pipeline. In future sections, we will swap the generate_text_basic_stream_cache function with more advanced functions.

简而言之，上述 generate_text_stream_concat_flex 函数与前一章的 generate_text_stream_concat 函数类似，唯一的区别在于，我们现在可以将文本生成函数（例如 generate_text_basic_stream_cache）作为函数参数传入，而无需将其硬编码在代码中。这样做的实际好处是：外层封装可以统一负责提示词的编码、流式传输和解码等操作，而内层的生成步骤则可以替换为不同的解码策略。这使得不同方法之间的公平比较变得更加容易，因为我们只需修改生成逻辑，而不必改动整个流水线。在后续章节中，我们将用更先进的函数来替换 generate_text_basic_stream_cache 函数。

The usage is also similar to before, except that we can now pass the text generator function (for example, generate_text_basic_stream_cache) explicitly:

用法也与之前类似，只不过现在我们可以显式地传递文本生成函数（例如 generate_text_basic_stream_cache）：

response = generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
    model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
    max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True,
    generate_func=generate_text_basic_stream_cache
)
response = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( model, tokenizer, prompt, device, max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True, generate_func=generate_text_basic_stream_cache )

The generated output is:

生成的输出是：

\boxed{20}
\boxed{20}

Note that the answer is wrong, and the correct solution is 83. In the remainder of this chapter, and the next chapter, we will implement inference-time scaling methods to get the model to generate the correct answer.

请注意，该答案是错误的，正确答案是83。在本章余下部分以及下一章中，我们将实现推理时的缩放方法，以使模型生成正确的答案。

4.3 Generating better responses with chain-of-thought prompting

4.3 通过思维链提示生成更优的回答

After loading the pre-trained base model in the previous section and setting up the text generation function, this section focuses on improving the model output via so-called chain-of-thought prompting.

在前一节加载了预训练的基础模型并搭建好文本生成函数之后，本节将重点探讨如何通过所谓的“思维链提示”来优化模型输出。

Chain-of-thought prompting is a classic, simple, and effective technique that modifies the input prompt to encourage the LLM to generate an explanation or so-called chain-of-thought (also called reasoning chain), as illustrated in figure 4.4.

思维链提示是一种经典、简单且有效的技术，通过修改输入提示来鼓励大语言模型生成解释或所谓的思维链（亦称推理链），如图4.4所示。

Figure 4.4 The first inference-time method, chain-of-thought prompting, modifies the prompt to encourage the model to explain its reasoning step by step before producing a final answer.
图4.4 第一种推理时方法——思维链提示——通过修改提示词，引导模型在给出最终答案之前，逐步解释其推理过程。

The simplest way to try chain-of-thought prompting is to append an extra instruction that asks the model to reason step by step. There are multiple ways to phrase this. For example, the original zero-shot chain-of-thought paper used "Let's think step by step." (https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.11916). This is just one example, and different phrasings may work better in practice depending on the model and task. Here, we use "Explain step by step." because it worked well in my experiments for this chapter and keeps the example simple, as shown below:

尝试思维链提示的最简单方法，就是在提示中附加一条额外的指令，要求模型逐步推理。这种指令有多种表达方式。例如，最初的零样本思维链论文就使用了“让我们一步步思考。”（https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.11916）。这只是一个例子，实际效果可能会因模型和任务的不同而有所差异。在本书这一章中，我们采用“请逐步解释。”，因为它在我的实验中表现良好，且使示例保持简洁，如下所示：

prompt_cot = prompt + " \n\nExplain step by step."
 
response_cot = generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
    model, tokenizer, prompt_cot, device,
    max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True,
)
prompt_cot = prompt + " \n\n请逐步解释。" response_cot = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( model, tokenizer, prompt_cot, device, max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True, )

The response is now as follows:

回复现在如下：

 To solve the problem, we need to find the value of \( x \) such that 
half the value of \( 3x - 9 \) is equal to \( x + 37 \).
 
# ...  #A
 
### Step 3: Solve for \( x \)
Subtract \( 2x \) from both sides to isolate \( x \):
\[
3x - 2x - 9 = 74
\]
Simplify:
\[
x - 9 = 74
\]
Add 9 to both sides to solve for \( x \):
\[
x = 74 + 9
\]
\[
x = 83
\]
 
### Final Answer:
\[
\boxed{83}
\]
#A The response was truncated to save space.
#A 为了节省空间，响应已被截断。

As we can see, the model now writes a lengthy step-by-step explanation and, in this case, now arrives at the correct answer.

正如我们所见，该模型现在会写出一段详尽的分步解释，并且在本例中得出了正确答案。

This simple chain-of-thought prompting is a good demonstration of the inference-time scaling trade-off. While the model now answers correctly, it expends many more tokens than before. As discussed in chapter 2, LLMs generate text one token at a time, and each additional token requires another forward pass through the model. So these intermediate reasoning steps do not just make the answer longer, they also directly increase latency, compute cost, and often API cost in practice.

这种简单的思维链提示方式很好地展示了推理时的规模权衡。虽然模型现在能够给出正确答案，但它消耗的令牌数量却比之前多得多。正如第2章所讨论的那样，大语言模型是逐个令牌生成文本的，每增加一个令牌，就需要在模型中再进行一次前向传播。因此，这些中间推理步骤不仅使答案变得更长，还会直接增加延迟、计算成本，以及在实际应用中常常伴随的API调用费用。

Note that while the model generates the correct answer in this case, not all problems benefit from chain-of-thought prompting. On simple problems, it can even sometimes degrade the model's performance, as the model might sometimes generate erroneous explanations and mislead itself. This phenomenon is also known as "overthinking."

需要注意的是，虽然在本例中模型生成了正确答案，但并非所有问题都能从思维链提示中受益。对于简单问题，思维链提示甚至有时会降低模型的性能，因为模型可能会生成错误的解释，从而误导自身。这种现象也被称为“过度思考”。

Lastly, not every model benefits from the "Explain step by step" (or similar) instruction. In this case, we use a simple base model that doesn't always generate explanations, so chain-of-thought prompting can clearly help. Trained reasoning models, such as the "reasoning" variant of the Qwen3 model we used in the exercises of the previous chapter, already write explanations alongside their responses and don't need or benefit from this type of chain-of-thought prompting.

最后，并非所有模型都能从“逐步解释”（或类似）的指令中受益。在本例中，我们使用的是一个简单的基础模型，它并不总是生成解释，因此采用思维链式提示显然能够起到帮助作用。而经过专门训练的推理模型——例如我们在前一章练习中使用的通义千问3模型的“reasoning”版本——本身就会在回答中附带解释，因此既不需要也不受益于这种思维链式提示。

Why chain-of-thought can improve accuracy
为什么思维链能够提高准确性

Chain-of-thought prompting asks the model to write out the intermediate steps that lead to a final answer. This helps in two practical ways.

思维链提示要求模型写出通向最终答案的中间步骤。这在实践中有两个好处。

First, walking through the steps gives the model more opportunities to correct itself.

首先，逐步执行这些步骤能让模型有更多机会自我纠正。

Second, step-by-step reasoning matches how many training examples are written. For instance, large math and logic datasets often contain detailed solutions, so asking for a chain of thought aligns the model with patterns it has already learned.

其次，逐步推理的方式与训练数据中示例的编写方式相匹配。例如，大型数学和逻辑数据集通常包含详细的解题步骤，因此要求模型输出思维链，能够使其与已学习到的模式保持一致。

At the same time, chains-of-thought are not a guarantee for correctness. It can still produce wrong reasoning, and for very simple problems it may even introduce unnecessary steps that lead to more mistakes. In other words, chains-of-thought can improve accuracy on many reasoning tasks, but it is not universally beneficial.

与此同时，思维链并不能保证推理的正确性。它仍然可能产生错误的推理；对于非常简单的问题，甚至可能会引入不必要的步骤，从而导致更多的错误。换句话说，思维链可以在许多推理任务上提高准确率，但并非在所有情况下都有效。

Overall, chain-of-thought answering does not provide the model with new knowledge, but it changes how the model uses its existing knowledge. Often, this shift can lead to more reliable answers. This is especially true for math, code, logic problems, and other sorts of multi-step problems.

总体而言，思维链式回答并不会为模型提供新知识，而是改变了模型运用已有知识的方式。通常，这种转变能够带来更可靠的答案。这一点在数学、编程、逻辑推理以及其他需要多步思考的问题中尤为明显。

Exercise 4.1: Use chain-of-thought prompting on MATH-500
练习4.1：在MATH-500数据集上使用思维链提示方法

Modify the evaluate_math500_stream function in section 3.9 of chapter 3 to see if chain-of-thought prompting improves the MATH-500 accuracy of the base model.

修改第3章第3.9节中的`evaluate_math500_stream`函数，以检验思维链提示是否能提升基础模型在MATH-500数据集上的准确率。

4.4 Controlling output diversity with temperature scaling

4.4 通过温度缩放控制输出多样性

The previous section gave a brief taste of inference-time scaling by extending the model's answer via chain-of-thought prompting. Chain-of-thought prompting can be seen as a sequential technique as we extend the number of next-token prediction steps.

前一节通过采用思维链提示方式扩展模型的回答，简要展示了推理时的规模扩展。思维链提示可以被视为一种序列化技术，因为我们逐步增加下一步标记预测的步数。

In the remainder of this chapter, we will implement a technique that generates multiple answers, as illustrated in figure 4.5. Since the answers are independent of each other, this can be implemented as a parallel sampling (if we have the necessary resources, for example, using multiple GPUs), which in this case wouldn't increase the wait time for a user to get the answer.

在本章的剩余部分，我们将实现一种如图4.5所示、能够生成多个答案的技术。由于这些答案彼此独立，因此可以采用并行采样的方式来实现（只要具备必要的计算资源，例如使用多块GPU）。在这种情况下，用户获取答案的等待时间并不会增加。

(Note that chain-of-thought prompting can also be combined with this technique, but more on that in a later section.)

（注意，思维链提示也可以与该技术结合使用，但相关内容将在稍后的章节中介绍。）

Figure 4.5 The second inference-time method, self-consistency sampling, generates multiple answers and selects the most frequent one. This method relies on temperature scaling, covered in this section, which influences how the model samples its next token.
图4.5 第二种推理时方法——自洽采样——会生成多个答案，并选择出现频率最高的一个。该方法依赖于本节将介绍的温度缩放技术，而温度缩放会影响模型采样下一个标记的方式。

The self-consistency technique, illustrated in figure 4.5 and covered in this chapter, is also called self-consistency sampling and was formally described in the Google Research paper Self-Consistency Improves Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Language Models (https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.11171).

自洽技术，如图4.5所示并在本章中介绍，也称为自洽采样，最早由谷歌研究院在论文《自洽性提升语言模型的思维链推理能力》（https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.11171）中正式提出。

Before implementing self-consistency sampling (step 5 in figure 4.5), we first need to extend the text generation function so that it can produce multiple different answers for the same prompt. To achieve this, we will implement two techniques, temperature scaling (step 3) and top-p filtering (step 4), which allow the model to sample different responses.

在实施自洽采样（图4.5中的步骤5）之前，我们首先需要扩展文本生成函数，使其能够针对同一个提示生成多个不同的答案。为此，我们将采用两种技术：温度缩放（步骤3）和top-p过滤（步骤4），它们能够让模型采样出不同的响应。

Temperature scaling is the main focus of this section, because it becomes one of the key controls for output diversity in the rest of this chapter and also forms the basis for the top-p filtering method that follows. Before we get to temperature scaling, the next subsection provides a brief overview of how the next token is sampled in an LLM.

本节的重点是温度缩放，因为它将成为本章后续部分控制输出多样性的关键机制之一，并且也是接下来介绍的 top-p 过滤方法的基础。在讨论温度缩放之前，下一小节将简要概述大型语言模型中如何采样下一个标记。

These low-level sampling controls may seem technical in isolation, but they are exactly what lets us generate diverse candidate answers for self-consistency later in this chapter.

这些低级别的采样控制单独来看可能显得较为技术性，但正是它们使得我们能够在本章稍后根据自我一致性机制生成多样化的候选答案。

4.4.1 Understanding the process of selecting the next token

4.4.1 理解选择下一个标记的过程

This subsection gives a closer look at the text generation process we implemented so far and explains how the next-token selection process works under the hood. This information will help you understand the motivation behind temperature scaling.

本小节将深入探讨我们目前实现的文本生成过程，并详细说明在底层如何进行下一个词元的选取。这些内容有助于你理解温度缩放背后的动机。

For instance, suppose we have the following simple prompt:

例如，假设我们有以下简单的提示：

ex_prompt = "The capital of Germany is"
 
response = generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
    model, tokenizer, ex_prompt, device,
    max_new_tokens=1, verbose=True
)
ex_prompt = "德国的首都是" response = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( model, tokenizer, ex_prompt, device, max_new_tokens=1, verbose=True )

The model's response is " Berlin".

模型的回答是“柏林”。

While this looks relatively simple, there are multiple steps happening under the hood, as illustrated in figure 4.6.

虽然这看起来相对简单，但在后台却涉及多个步骤，如图4.6所示。

Figure 4.6 How an LLM generates the next token. As in the other process diagrams in this book, the flow runs from bottom to top. The model converts the input into token IDs, computes scores for all possible next tokens, and selects the one with the highest score as the next output.
图4.6 大语言模型如何生成下一个标记。与本书中的其他流程图一样，流程方向是从下往上。模型首先将输入转换为标记ID，然后为所有可能的下一个标记计算得分，并选择得分最高的标记作为下一个输出。

When generating text, as discussed in chapter 2, the inputs are first converted into token IDs:

在生成文本时，如第2章所述，输入首先会被转换为标记ID：

input_token_ids = torch.tensor(
    tokenizer.encode(ex_prompt), device=device
).unsqueeze(0)
print(input_token_ids)
input_token_ids = torch.tensor( tokenizer.encode(ex_prompt), device=device ).unsqueeze(0) print(input_token_ids)

In this case, the token IDs are

在这种情况下，标记 ID 是

tensor([[ 785, 6722,  315, 9856,  374]])
张量([[ 785, 6722, 315, 9856, 374]])

In the second step (step 2 in figure 4.6), we get the scores for the output token we want to generate. These model output scores are also called logits. Note that an LLM generates one output token for each input token, but we are only interested in the last token, which we select via the [:, -1] tensor indexing. This last token corresponds to the token we want to generate:

在第二步（图4.6中的步骤2）中，我们得到想要生成的输出标记的得分。这些模型输出得分也称为 logits。请注意，大型语言模型会为每个输入标记生成一个输出标记，但我们只关心最后一个标记，通过 [:, -1] 张量索引来选取它。这个最后一个标记就是我们想要生成的标记：

with torch.inference_mode():
    next_token_logits = model(input_token_ids)[:, -1]
print(next_token_logits.shape)
with torch.inference_mode(): next_token_logits = model(input_token_ids)[:, -1] print(next_token_logits.shape)

The printed output shape is [1, 151936], where 151936 is the vocabulary size of this tokenizer and model. The vocabulary size contains all the unique tokens the tokenizer can handle and the LLM can generate.

打印输出的形状为 [1, 151936]，其中 151936 是该分词器和模型的词汇表大小。词汇表大小包含了分词器能够处理以及大语言模型能够生成的所有唯一标记。

To actually obtain the next generated token (here: " Berlin"), we have to find a vocabulary entry that is associated with the largest score (step 3 in figure 4.6):

为了真正获取下一个生成的标记（此处为“柏林”），我们必须找到与最大得分相关联的词汇表条目（图4.6中的步骤3）：

max_token_id = torch.argmax(next_token_logits)
print(f"Token ID: {max_token_id}")
print(f"Decoded token: '{tokenizer.decode([max_token_id])}'")
max_token_id = torch.argmax(next_token_logits) print(f"Token ID: {max_token_id}") print(f"解码后的标记: '{tokenizer.decode([max_token_id])}'")

The output is:

输出是：

Token ID: 19846
Decoded token: ' Berlin'
令牌ID：19846 解码后的令牌：'柏林'

Above, we covered the three main steps in generating the next token. Before we go to the next section, let us take a closer look at the score distribution of the next_token_logits tensor we passed into torch.argmax function to obtain the token IDs, and plot them in matplotlib:

上面我们介绍了生成下一个标记的三个主要步骤。在进入下一节之前，让我们更仔细地看看传递给 torch.argmax 函数以获取标记 ID 的 next_token_logits 张量的得分分布，并使用 matplotlib 将其绘制成图：

Listing 4.3 Plotting the next-token logit scores
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 
def plot_scores_bar(
    next_token_logits, start=19_800, end=19_900,
    arrow=True, ylabel="Logit value"
):
    x = torch.arange(start, end)  #A
    logits_section = next_token_logits[0, start:end].float().cpu() #B
 
    plt.bar(x, logits_section)  #C
    plt.xlabel("Vocabulary index")
    plt.ylabel(ylabel)
 
    if arrow:  #D
        max_idx = torch.argmax(logits_section)
        plt.annotate(
            "Berlin",
            xy=(x[max_idx], logits_section[max_idx]),
            xytext=(x[max_idx] - 25, logits_section[max_idx] - 2),
            arrowprops={
                "facecolor": "black", "arrowstyle": "->", "lw": 1.5
            },
            fontsize=10,
        )
 
    plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
 
plot_scores_bar(next_token_logits)
#A Select vocabulary subsection
#B .cpu() is a shortcut for to(torch.device("cpu"))
#C Plot the logits (scores) within the selected range
#D Draw an arrow to highlight the largest score
#A 选择词汇子部分 #B .cpu() 是 to(torch.device("cpu")) 的快捷方式 #C 绘制选定范围内的 logits（得分） #D 画一个箭头以突出显示最大得分

Note that we restrict the plot to the 100 vocabulary index tokens between 19,800 and 19,900, rather than plotting the scores for all 151,936 entries, which would make the plot too crowded. (I selected this specific range such that it contains the entry with the highest score.) The resulting plot is shown in figure 4.7.

请注意，我们仅将绘图范围限定在词汇表中索引介于19,800至19,900之间的100个词项，而非绘制全部151,936个条目的得分，因为那样会使图表过于拥挤。（我选择这一特定范围，是为了确保其中包含得分最高的那个词项。）最终的绘图结果如图4.7所示。

Figure 4.7 Example of next-token logits for a 100-token slice of a language model's much larger vocabulary. Each bar represents one possible token's score within this slice, with "Berlin" having the highest logit value and being selected as the next token.
图4.7 语言模型庞大词汇表中100个标记片段的下一个标记 logits 示例。每个柱状条代表该片段中一个可能标记的得分，“Berlin”的 logits 值最高，因此被选为下一个标记。

The plot in figure 4.7 shows all 100 logit values (scores) for vocabulary indices 19,800-19,899. The values range approximately from -8 to 20, where 20 corresponds to the vocabulary index for the token " Berlin".

图4.7中的散点图展示了词汇索引19,800至19,899对应的全部100个逻辑斯蒂回归值（得分）。这些值的范围大致在-8到20之间，其中20对应于标记“Berlin”的词汇索引。

4.4.2 Rescaling token scores (logits) via a temperature parameter

4.4.2 通过温度参数对令牌得分（logits）进行重新缩放

Now that we have walked through how the model selects its next token, we can introduce the concept of temperature. Temperature, or rather a chosen temperature parameter, changes how sharp or spread out the logits (token scores) are, which in turn affects how the next token is selected.

既然我们已经了解了模型是如何选择下一个标记的，接下来就可以引入“温度”这一概念。温度——更准确地说，是所选定的温度参数——会改变 logits（标记得分）的尖锐程度或分布范围，进而影响下一个标记的选取方式。

As shown in figure 4.8, this section focuses on rescaling the next-token logits with a temperature parameter before using them for sampling. Rescaling here means adjusting the magnitude of the scores so the sampling step becomes more or less sensitive to the score differences.

如图4.8所示，本节重点在于在用于采样之前，先通过温度参数对下一个标记的 logits 进行重新缩放。这里的重新缩放是指调整得分的幅度，从而使采样步骤对得分差异的敏感度或高或低。

Figure 4.8 In this section, we implement the core part of temperature scaling (step 3.2), which adjusts the next-token scores. This allows us to control how confidently the model selects its next token in later steps.
图4.8 在本节中，我们实现了温度缩放的核心部分（步骤3.2），即对下一个词的得分进行调整。这使我们能够在后续步骤中控制模型对其下一个词的选择置信度。

The code for implementing the temperature rescaling step, step 3.2 in figure 4.8, is relatively short and simple, as shown in listing 4.4 below.

实现温度重缩放步骤（图4.8中的步骤3.2）的代码相对简短且简单，如下面的列表4.4所示。

Listing 4.4 Rescaling next-token scores via temperature scaling
def scale_logits_by_temperature(logits, temperature):
    if temperature <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Temperature must be positive")
    return logits / temperature
def 缩放 logits 以温度： 如果 温度 <= 0: 引发 ValueError("温度必须为正数") 返回 logits / 温度

In essence, the code in listing 4.4 rescales the logit values before converting them to probabilities in the next section.

本质上，清单4.4中的代码在下一节将logit值转换为概率之前，先对它们进行重新缩放。

In practice, temperature values are expected to be positive numbers. A temperature of 1.0 means no change, since dividing a number by 1 is the number itself.

在实际应用中，温度值通常为正数。温度值为1.0时表示没有变化，因为任何数除以1都等于其本身。

We will add additional temperature scaling safeguards later when we add temperature scaling to our text generation function.

我们将在为文本生成函数添加温度缩放功能时，后续再增加额外的温度缩放保护措施。

For all other values, the logits are divided by the temperature. A temperature lower than 1.0 makes the distribution sharper (which will make the model more confident when we select the next token in the upcoming sections). Temperatures higher than 1.0 flatten the logits, which can make the sampling (step 3.4 in figure 4.8) more diverse. In other words, higher temperatures reduce the probability gap between the top token and lower-ranked tokens, which increases the chance that sampling will pick a non-maximum token.

对于其他所有值，logits 会除以温度。温度低于 1.0 时，分布会变得更尖锐（这将在后续章节中选择下一个标记时使模型更加自信）。温度高于 1.0 时，logits 会被拉平，从而使采样过程（图 4.8 中的步骤 3.4）更加多样化。换句话说，较高的温度会缩小最高概率标记与低排名标记之间的概率差距，从而增加采样选中非最高概率标记的可能性。

Let's see this scale_logits_by_temperature function in action and try it out with relatively extreme temperature values 0.5 and 5.0 for a stronger effect:

让我们来看看这个 scale_logits_by_temperature 函数的实际效果，并尝试使用相对极端的温度值 0.5 和 5.0，以获得更明显的效果：

Listing 4.5 Plotting the temperature-rescaled logits
def plot_logits_with_temperature(
    next_token_logits, start=19_800, end=19_900,
    temps=(0.5, 5.0),
):
    x = torch.arange(start, end)
    logits_orig = next_token_logits[0, start:end].float().cpu()
 
    logits_scaled = [   #A
        scale_logits_by_temperature(logits_orig, T) for T in temps #A
    ]  #A
 
    plt.plot(x, logits_orig, label="Original logits", lw=2)  #B
    plt.plot(                                                #B
        x, logits_scaled[0],                                 #B
        label=f"T={temps[0]} (sharper)", ls="--", lw=1       #B
    )                                                        #B
    plt.plot(                                                #B
        x, logits_scaled[1],                                 #B
        label=f"T={temps[1]} (flatter)", ls=":", lw=3        #B
    )                                                        #B
 
    # Highlight max logit
    max_idx = torch.argmax(logits_orig)                     #C
    plt.annotate(                                           #C
        "Berlin",
        xy=(x[max_idx], logits_orig[max_idx]),
        xytext=(x[max_idx] - 25, logits_orig[max_idx] + 2),
        arrowprops={"facecolor": "black", "arrowstyle": "->", "lw": 1.5},
        fontsize=12,
    )
 
    plt.xlabel("Vocabulary index")
    plt.ylabel("Logit value")
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
 
plot_logits_with_temperature(
    next_token_logits,
    temps=(0.5, 5.0)                                        #D
)
#A Apply temperature scaling
#B Plot the logits (scores) within the selected range
#C Draw an arrow to highlight the largest score
#D Run the rescaling and plotting with temperatures 0.5 and 5
#A 应用温度缩放 #B 绘制选定范围内的 logits（得分） #C 画一条箭头以突出显示最大得分 #D 使用温度 0.5 和 5 运行重新缩放和绘图操作

As shown in the plot in figure 4.9, the larger temperature (5.0) yields a much flatter score distribution, whereas the smaller temperature (0.5) yields a much sharper one.

如图4.9所示，较高的温度（5.0）会导致得分分布更加平缓，而较低的温度（0.5）则会使得分分布更为尖锐。

Figure 4.9 The effect of temperature scaling on logits. Lower temperatures make the distribution sharper, while higher temperatures flatten it. (Please note that this visualization is shown as a line plot for readability, though a bar plot would more accurately represent the discrete vocabulary scores.)
图4.9 温度缩放对 logits 的影响。较低的温度会使分布更加尖锐，而较高的温度则使其更加平缓。（请注意，为了便于阅读，此处以折线图展示该可视化效果，但实际上使用柱状图更能准确地反映离散词汇得分。）

Note that the plotting code in listing 4.5 above looks very similar to the plotting code we used in the previous section (listing 4.3). In addition to applying the temperature scaling, we now use a line plot (plt.plot) instead of a bar plot (plt.bar). While a bar plot is technically a better choice for the discrete vocabulary indices on the x-axis, the line plot makes it easier to visualize and compare the rescaled logits in this case.

请注意，上述代码清单 4.5 中的绘图代码与我们在前一节使用的绘图代码（代码清单 4.3）非常相似。除了应用温度缩放之外，我们现在使用折线图（plt.plot）而不是柱状图（plt.bar）。虽然从技术上讲，对于 x 轴上的离散词汇索引，柱状图是更合适的选择，但在这种情况下，折线图能够更直观地展示和比较经过缩放后的 logits。

The important point is not the absolute height of one logit by itself, but how the gaps between logits change. If a token such as "Berlin" stands out more strongly than the alternatives, it will become more likely to be selected later. If the gaps shrink, lower-ranked tokens become more likely to be selected compared to before. The next section illustrates this by converting the logits into probabilities.

关键不在于某个 logits 值本身的绝对大小，而在于各 logits 之间的差距如何变化。如果像“柏林”这样的标记相较于其他候选标记显得更加突出，那么它在后续被选中的概率就会更高。反之，如果这些差距缩小，排名较低的标记相对于之前就有更大的被选中可能性。下一节将通过把 logits 转换为概率来具体说明这一点。

Why temperature?
为什么是温度？

The term temperature comes from physics, where temperature controls how much randomness or movement there is in a system. In LLMs, we use the same idea to control how confidently or creatively the model chooses its next token, as we will see in the next two sections.

“温度”这一术语源自物理学，在物理学中，温度决定了系统中随机性或运动的大小。在大型语言模型中，我们沿用这一概念来控制模型在选择下一个词元时的置信度与创造性，这一点将在接下来的两节中详细说明。

4.4.3 Sampling the next token from a probability distribution

4.4.3 从概率分布中采样下一个标记

The previous section rescaled the logit values using different temperature values. The purpose of this is that it lets us (later) influence how the model selects the next token.

前一节通过使用不同的温度值对 logits 值进行了缩放。这样做的目的是，让我们（在后续步骤中）能够控制模型如何选择下一个标记。

Before we get to the next-token sampling portion in the next section, this section adds one more intermediate step: converting the rescaled logits into probability scores, as shown in figure 4.10.

在进入下一节的下一个标记采样部分之前，本节增加了一个中间步骤：将重新缩放的 logits 转换为概率分数，如图 4.10 所示。

Figure 4.10 Overview of the sampling process for generating tokens. In this section, we focus on steps 3.3 and 3.4, where the next-token scores are converted into a probability distribution, and the next token is sampled based on that distribution.
图4.10 生成标记的采样过程概览。在本节中，我们重点介绍步骤3.3和3.4：将下一个标记的得分转换为概率分布，并根据该分布采样得到下一个标记。

To demonstrate how rescaled logits are converted into probability scores, as described in step 3.3 of figure 4.10, we will use a temperature of 5.0. This makes it easier to visualize the resulting probabilities in a plot. The " Berlin" token, for example, has such a high logit value that it would otherwise dominate the scale and make it difficult to see the probabilities of the surrounding tokens.

为了演示如图4.10步骤3.3所述的重新缩放后的 logits 如何转换为概率分数，我们将使用温度参数 5.0。这样可以更直观地在图表中展示生成的概率分布。“Berlin”这个标记的 logits 值非常高，如果不进行温度缩放，它会完全占据概率尺度，导致周围其他标记的概率难以辨认。

The conversion from rescaled logits to probability scores can be done with a single function call, torch.softmax, as shown in listing 4.6 below.

将重新缩放的 logits 转换为概率分数，只需调用一个函数——torch.softmax——即可，如下面的代码清单 4.6 所示。

Listing 4.6 Sampling the next-token from a probability distribution
rescaled_logits = scale_logits_by_temperature(next_token_logits, 5.0)  #A
 
next_token_probas = torch.softmax(  #B
    rescaled_logits, dim=-1
)
#A Step 3.2: Rescale next-token scores
#B Step 3.3 Convert rescaled logits into probability scores
#A 步骤 3.2：对下一个标记的得分进行缩放 #B 步骤 3.3 将缩放后的 logits 转换为概率得分

The torch.softmax function in listing 4.6 normalizes the logit values into values in the range between 0 and 1, and such that the values sum to 1, which we can confirm via the following code:

清单 4.6 中的 torch.softmax 函数将 logits 值归一化为 0 到 1 之间的值，并且这些值的总和等于 1。我们可以通过以下代码来验证这一点：

print("Probability sum:", torch.sum(next_token_probas))
print("概率之和:", torch.sum(next_token_probas))

Additionally, let's visualize the converted scores by reusing the plot_scores_bar function from listing 4.3 earlier:

此外，让我们通过复用前面列表 4.3 中的 plot_scores_bar 函数来可视化转换后的分数：

plot_scores_bar(
    next_token_probas, arrow=False, ylabel="Probability value"
)
绘制得分条形图( 下一个标记的概率分布, 箭头=False, y轴标签="概率值" )

The resulting plot, now with the probability values on the y-axis, is shown in figure 4.11.

所得的图表，现将概率值置于纵轴，如图4.11所示。

Figure 4.11 Token probabilities obtained by applying the softmax function to the rescaled logits. The token of the highest probability (corresponding to " Berlin", but with the label omitted for code simplicity) is selected as the next output.
图4.11 通过对重新缩放的 logits 应用 softmax 函数得到的各个标记概率。概率最高的标记（对应“Berlin”，但为简化代码省略了标签）被选作下一个输出。

In the plot in figure 4.11, we can see that the token ID 19,846 (" Berlin") has the highest value in this selected vocabulary range. The probability is 0.0003, which we can confirm via the following code:

在图4.11的图表中，我们可以看到，在这个选定的词汇范围内，标记ID 19,846（“Berlin”）具有最高值。其概率为0.0003，我们可以通过以下代码加以确认：

print("Token ID 19,846 probability:", next_token_probas[:, 19846])
print("标记ID 19,846 的概率：", next_token_probas[:, 19846])

Note that while this 0.0003 value is relatively small, there is no other value larger than this outside the selected vocabulary range in this plot. For instance, using the following code, we can confirm that 0.0003 is indeed the largest value:

请注意，虽然这个 0.0003 的值相对较小，但在该图所选词汇范围内，没有其他比它更大的值。例如，通过以下代码，我们可以确认 0.0003 确实是最大的值：

print("Highest probability:", max(next_token_probas.squeeze(0)))
print("最高概率:", max(next_token_probas.squeeze(0)))

We can interpret this score as the model's confidence. This means that the model is more confident in " Berlin" (19,846) as the next token than in other tokens.

我们可以将这个分数理解为模型的置信度。这意味着模型对“Berlin”（19,846）作为下一个标记的预测，比对其他标记的预测更加自信。

The reason the value is so small is that we are using a large temperature, which makes it easier to plot this value next to the other token values. If we change the temperature from 5 to 0.5, the probability score increases from 0.0003 to 0.3398, and the probability scores of the other tokens will be even closer to 0.

之所以这个值这么小，是因为我们使用了一个较大的温度值，这样便于将该值与其他标记的概率值并列绘制出来。如果我们将温度从 5 改为 0.5，该概率得分就会从 0.0003 提升至 0.3398，而其他标记的概率得分则会更加接近于 0。

The softmax function under the hood
softmax 函数的内部实现

The softmax function converts a vector of raw scores (logits) into a probability distribution where each value lies between 0 and 1, and all values sum to 1. This conversion makes it easier to interpret them and sample from them later.

Softmax函数将一个原始得分向量（logits）转换为一个概率分布，其中每个值介于0和1之间，且所有值之和等于1。这种转换使得这些值更易于解释，并便于后续从中进行采样。

If you are familiar with mathematical notation, the formula behind the softmax function is

如果你熟悉数学符号，softmax 函数背后的公式是：

softmax(zᵢ) = exp(zᵢ) / Σⱼ exp(zⱼ)

Here, z is a a vector of real-valued inputs

这里，z 是一个实数值输入的向量。

z = [z₁, z₂, …, zₙ],

where

哪里

  • n is the number of elements in the vector,
  • n 是向量中元素的个数，
  • i is the index of the current element (1 ≤ i ≤ n),
  • i 是当前元素的索引（1 ≤ i ≤ n），
  • j is the index used to sum over all elements (1 ≤ j ≤ n),
  • j 是用于对所有元素求和的索引（1 ≤ j ≤ n），

This produces a normalized probability for each element zᵢ, such that

这为每个元素 zᵢ 生成一个归一化的概率，使得

Σᵢ softmax(zᵢ) = 1

In code, the softmax function can be implemented with a simple 3-liner:

在代码中，softmax 函数可以用简单的三行代码实现：

def softmax_with_temperature(logits, temperature):
    scaled_logits = logits / temperature
    return torch.softmax(scaled_logits, dim=0)
def softmax_with_temperature(logits, temperature): scaled_logits = logits / temperature return torch.softmax(scaled_logits, dim=0)

In practice, we prefer the torch.softmax function because it has some additional numerical stability improvements to handle very small and very large values more reliably.

在实际应用中，我们更倾向于使用 torch.softmax 函数，因为它在数值稳定性方面做了一些改进，能够更可靠地处理非常小和非常大的值。

The purpose of converting the logits into these probability scores is that the probability scores are somewhat more interpretable, and we can now sample from them using a torch.multinomial function.

将 logits 转换为这些概率分数的目的在于，概率分数更具可解释性，我们现在可以使用 torch.multinomial 函数从这些概率中进行采样。

For instance, if we draw one sample from this probability distribution, we have a 0.03% chance of getting " Berlin" with our temperature setting of 5.0 (and a 33.98% chance of getting " Berlin" with a temperature of 0.5).

例如，如果我们从该概率分布中抽取一个样本，在温度设置为5.0的情况下，得到“柏林”的概率是0.03%（而在温度设置为0.5的情况下，得到“柏林”的概率则是33.98%）。

The sampling process, corresponding to step 3.4 in the figure at the beginning of this section, can be implemented as follows:

采样过程，对应于本节开头图中的步骤3.4，可以按如下方式实现：

torch.manual_seed(123)
print(
    "Sampled token:",
    torch.multinomial(next_token_probas.cpu(), num_samples=1)
)
torch.manual_seed(123) print( "采样得到的标记：", torch.multinomial(next_token_probas.cpu(), num_samples=1) )

This code returns token ID 65,094, which corresponds to the word " mistress". Note that the word doesn't make sense in our context, "The capital of Germany is", and it was selected randomly in this case and influenced by the high-temperature setting, which encourages tokens other than " Berlin" to be sampled.

这段代码返回的标记 ID 是 65,094，它对应于单词“mistress”。请注意，在我们的上下文中，“德国的首都是”这句话里，这个词并不合理。在本例中，它只是被随机选中的，并且受到高温参数设置的影响——该设置会促使模型更多地采样非“Berlin”的其他标记。

The torch.multinomial function samples the vocabulary indices proportional to their probabilities. In other words, vocabulary indices with higher probabilities are more likely to be sampled. If we repeated the sampling a very large number of times, we would sample the vocabulary index corresponding to the token " Berlin" with 0.03% probability, given a temperature of 5.

torch.multinomial 函数会根据词汇表中各个索引的概率分布进行采样。也就是说，概率较高的词汇索引被采样的可能性更大。如果重复进行大量次采样，在温度设置为 5 的情况下，我们大约有 0.03% 的概率会采样到与标记“Berlin”对应的词汇索引。

Before we look at some additional examples, note that we specified a random seed above to make the code in this chapter reproducible. The torch.multinomial() function may still yield different results on "cuda" and "mps" devices, and may even crash when we draw larger numbers of samples (I observed this issue in PyTorch 2.9 on both "cuda" and "mps" devices), which is why we run the sampling on the CPU via .cpu().

在查看更多示例之前，请注意，我们在上面设置了随机种子，以使本章的代码具有可复现性。不过，torch.multinomial() 函数在 “cuda” 和 “mps” 设备上仍可能产生不同的结果，甚至在抽取较大数量的样本时可能会崩溃（我在 PyTorch 2.9 的 “cuda” 和 “mps” 设备上都观察到了这一问题）。因此，我们通过 .cpu() 将采样操作放在 CPU 上执行。

Let's now sample more next-token candidates to get a more representative sample.

现在让我们采样更多下一个标记的候选，以获得更具代表性的样本。

Listing 4.7 Sampling multiple next-token candidates
def count_samples(probas, num_samples=1000, threshold=1, tokenizer=None):
    samples = torch.multinomial(  #A
        probas.cpu(), num_samples=num_samples, replacement=True
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(samples.squeeze(0), minlength=1)  #B
    
    for i, c in enumerate(counts):
        if c > threshold:   #C
            if tokenizer is None:
                print(f"Vocab index {i}: {c.item()}x")
            else:
                print(f"'{tokenizer.decode([i])}': {c.item()}x")
#A Draw samples according to probabilities
#B Count how often each index was selected
#C Print frequently sampled vocabulary indices (entries)
#A 按概率抽取样本 #B 统计每个索引被选中的次数 #C 打印频繁被采样的词汇索引（条目）

This count_samples function in listing 4.7 samples token indices from a probability distribution and counts how often each token is drawn. It uses torch.multinomial to randomly select num_samples indices proportional to their probabilities. The replacement=True setting allows us to draw the same token multiple times.

列表 4.7 中的 count_samples 函数从概率分布中采样标记索引，并统计每个标记被抽中的次数。它使用 torch.multinomial 根据各标记的概率按比例随机选择 num_samples 个索引。replacement=True 参数允许同一个标记被多次抽中。

Then, torch.bincount counts how often each index appears. Finally, it prints only tokens that occur more than a specified threshold, so that it doesn't clutter the output with more infrequently drawn tokens.

然后，torch.bincount 统计每个索引出现的次数。最后，它只打印出现次数超过指定阈值的标记，从而避免输出中充斥着出现频率较低的标记。

Multinomial sampling
多项式采样

Multinomial sampling is the procedure used to pick the next token given a probability distribution over the vocabulary, like the softmax probability scores. In multinomial sampling, instead of always selecting the most likely token (known as greedy decoding), we draw one token at random, where tokens with higher probability are more likely to be selected. This randomness is important for generating diverse responses, which we later use in self-consistency.

多项式采样是在给定词汇表上的概率分布（例如通过 softmax 计算得到的概率分数）时，用于选择下一个标记的过程。与总是选择概率最高的标记（即贪婪解码）不同，多项式采样会根据概率分布随机抽取一个标记，其中概率较高的标记被选中的可能性更大。这种随机性对于生成多样化的响应至关重要，而我们随后会将这些多样性用于自一致性方法中。

To illustrate it further we can think of the probability scores as a set of weighted choices. For example, a token with probability 0.40 is four times as likely to appear as one with probability 0.10, but both remain possible outcomes.

为了进一步说明，我们可以把概率分数看作一组带权重的选择。例如，一个概率为0.40的标记，其出现的概率是概率为0.10的标记的四倍，但两者仍然是可能的结果。

Suppose the model assigns the following probabilities:

假设模型分配了以下概率：

  • "Berlin": 0.70
  • “柏林”：0.70
  • "Munich": 0.20
  • “慕尼黑”：0.20
  • "Hamburg": 0.10
  • “汉堡”: 0.10

Greedy decoding would always return "Berlin."

贪婪解码总是会返回“柏林”。

Multinomial sampling instead draws one token according to these weights. Across a very large number of draws, "Berlin" will appear most often (70% of the time), "Munich" sometimes (20% of the time), and "Hamburg" only occasionally (10% of the time).

多项式采样则是根据这些权重随机抽取一个词元。在进行大量采样时，“柏林”会出现的次数最多（70% 的时间），“慕尼黑”偶尔会出现（20% 的时间），而“汉堡”则非常少见（10% 的时间）。

This variability is what allows us to generate multiple candidate answers for self-consistency in later sections.

正是这种多样性，使得我们能够在后续章节中为自洽性生成多个候选答案。

Please note that the count_samples function is meant for illustration only. It draws many samples from the distribution so you can see how often each token is selected. In real text generation we only draw one token at a time, but taking a large number of samples here makes the underlying probabilities easier to visualize and understand.

请注意，count_samples 函数仅用于演示目的。它从分布中抽取大量样本，以便您可以看到每个标记被选中的频率。在实际的文本生成过程中，我们每次只抽取一个标记；而在这里抽取大量样本，是为了更直观地展示和理解背后的概率分布。

First, let's run the count_samples function on the probability scores that we obtained by applying a temperature of 5:

首先，让我们对我们通过设置温度为5得到的概率分数运行count_samples函数：

torch.manual_seed(123)
count_samples(next_token_probas, tokenizer=tokenizer)
torch.manual_seed(123) 统计样本数量(next_token_probas, tokenizer=tokenizer)

The output is as follows:

输出如下：

'}': 2x
' </': 2x
' represent': 2x
' Inf': 2x
'()*': 2x
' beside': 2x
' Kob': 2x
'�': 2x
'}': 2倍 ' </': 2倍 ' represent': 2倍 ' Inf': 2倍 '()*': 2倍 ' beside': 2倍 ' Kob': 2倍 '': 2倍

As we can see, even though the default sample size is 1000, none of the sampled tokens appear more than 2 times. Also, these are all nonsense tokens in the context of the "The capital of Germany is" query. The reason for these nonsensical results is that we used a temperature value that is much too high.

正如我们所见，尽管默认的样本数量是1000，但没有任何一个采样得到的标记出现超过2次。此外，在“德国的首都是”这个查询的上下文中，这些标记都毫无意义。产生这种荒谬结果的原因在于，我们使用的温度参数值过高。

Let's try a lower temperature value of 0.35, which makes the score distribution sharper, and which makes it more likely to select a meaningful next token:

我们尝试使用较低的温度值 0.35，这会使得分分布更加尖锐，从而更有可能选择一个有意义的下一个标记：

torch.manual_seed(123)
probas_lowT = torch.softmax(
    scale_logits_by_temperature(next_token_logits, 0.35), dim=-1
)
torch.manual_seed(123) probabilities_lowT = torch.softmax( scale_logits_by_temperature(next_token_logits, 0.35), dim=-1 )

In this case, we see the following output:

在这种情况下，我们看到以下输出：

' __': 158x
' Berlin': 435x
' ____': 169x
' ______': 209x
' Munich': 3x
' Hamburg': 3x
' _____': 18x
' __': 158次 ' 柏林': 435次 ' ____': 169次 ' ______': 209次 ' 慕尼黑': 3次 ' 汉堡': 3次 ' _____': 18次

The output makes a lot more sense as next-token candidates for our "The capital of Germany is" query. Out of the 1000 samples, the token " Berlin" was drawn 435 times. You can check via print(probas_lowT[0, 19_846]) that the probability of drawing this token is approximately 42% given the temperature value 0.35. To make it even more likely that " Berlin" is sampled, we could further reduce the temperature.

对于我们的查询“德国的首都是”，输出作为下一个候选词显得合理得多。在1000个样本中，“柏林”这个标记被抽中了435次。你可以通过执行 print(probas_lowT[0, 19_846]) 来验证，在温度值为0.35的情况下，抽中该标记的概率约为42%。为了让“柏林”更有可能被采样，我们还可以进一步降低温度。

Notice that some of the other rarer candidates also make sense, for example, both " Munich" and " Hamburg" are big cities in Germany, so they are not completely unrelated to the query. The underscore responses (" ____") are likely due to the model having seen text in the form of a quiz with a placeholder, e.g., "The capital of Germany is ____".

请注意，其他一些较为罕见的候选词也合乎情理，例如，“慕尼黑”和“汉堡”都是德国的大城市，因此与查询并不完全无关。下划线形式的回复（“____”）很可能是由于模型之前见过带有占位符的测验类文本，比如“德国的首都是____”。

You may wonder, if " Berlin" is the correct answer, what's the point in making the model occasionally give the wrong answer by adding this temperature-rescaling and multinomial sampling?

你可能会疑惑：既然“柏林”才是正确答案，那么通过引入温度缩放和多项式采样，让模型偶尔给出错误答案，究竟有什么意义呢？

In general, for different kinds of queries, introducing randomness during sampling helps the model explore alternative responses instead of always choosing the single most likely token. This variability can be useful for creative or open-ended tasks, where there may be multiple valid completions.

一般来说，对于不同类型的查询，在采样过程中引入随机性有助于模型探索多种可能的响应，而不是每次都选择概率最高的单个词。这种多样性在创意性或开放性任务中尤为有用，因为这类任务往往存在多个合理的完成方式。

Specifically, in reasoning tasks, we can leverage this sampling diversity through techniques such as self-consistency (section 4.6), which generate multiple candidate answers and compare them to improve answer accuracy.

具体而言，在推理任务中，我们可以通过自一致性等技术（第4.6节）来利用这种采样多样性：生成多个候选答案并进行比较，以提高答案的准确性。

4.4.4 Adding temperature scaling to the text generation function

4.4.4 在文本生成函数中加入温度缩放

Before we move to the next section and introduce another improvement to the text generation process by adding a token-probability selection filter, let's add the temperature scaling modification to the text generation function so we can use it more readily when generating new tokens via the model./

在进入下一节、介绍通过添加令牌概率选择过滤器来进一步改进文本生成过程之前，我们先将温度缩放这一修改应用到文本生成函数中，以便在通过模型生成新令牌时更方便地使用它。

Listing 4.8 Text generation with temperature scaling
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import KVCache
 
@torch.inference_mode()
def generate_text_temp_stream_cache(
    model,
    token_ids,
    max_new_tokens,
    eos_token_id=None,
    temperature=0.
):
    model.eval()
    cache = KVCache(n_layers=model.cfg["n_layers"])
    model.reset_kv_cache()
 
    out = model(token_ids, cache=cache)[:, -1]  #A
    for _ in range(max_new_tokens):
 
        ########################################
        # NEW:
        orig_device = token_ids.device
 
        if temperature is None or temperature == 1.0:
            next_token = torch.argmax(out, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
 
        else: 
            logits = scale_logits_by_temperature(out, temperature)  #B
            probas = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)  #C
            next_token = torch.multinomial(probas.cpu(), num_samples=1)  #D
            next_token = next_token.to(orig_device)
            
        #########################################
        if (eos_token_id is not None
                and torch.all(next_token == eos_token_id)):
            break
 
        yield next_token
        out = model(next_token, cache=cache)[:, -1]
#A Step 3.1: Get logits
#B Step 3.2: Apply temperature scaling on logits
#C Step 3.3: Convert to probabilities
#D Step 3.4: Sample token according to probabilities
#A 步骤 3.1：获取 logits #B 步骤 3.2：对 logits 应用温度缩放 #C 步骤 3.3：转换为概率 #D 步骤 3.4：根据概率采样 token

The generate_text_temp_stream_cache in listing 4.8 is similar to the generate_text_stream_cache function from the chapter 2 exercises, which we also used in chapter 3. What's new is that we have now inserted the temperature rescaling and sampling. The new parts are below the # New comment indicator in the code.

清单4.8中的generate_text_temp_stream_cache函数与第2章习题中的generate_text_stream_cache函数类似，我们也在第3章中使用过它。新的是，我们现在加入了温度重缩放和采样步骤。新增的部分位于代码中# New comment指示符下方。

torch.manual_seed(123)
response = generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
    model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
    max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=True,
    generate_func=generate_text_temp_stream_cache,  #A
    temperature=1.1
)
#A Use the new temperature scaling-based text generation function
#A 使用基于新温度缩放的文本生成函数

The output is \boxed{$x = \frac{90}{7}$}. The correct answer is 83, so the model is still wrong, but this was more meant as a demonstration that we can tweak the answer by using temperature scaling and sampling.

输出为 \boxed{$x = \frac{90}{7}$}。正确答案是 83，因此该模型仍然存在误差。不过，此处更主要的是展示：通过温度缩放和采样技术，我们可以对模型的输出进行微调。

Choosing temperature settings
选择温度设置

In practice, temperature selection depends on the goal. A temperature of 0.0 corresponds to greedy decoding, where we always pick the highest-probability token. Small nonzero values such as 0.3-0.8 are often useful when we want a bit more diversity without making the output too erratic. Much higher values make the model explore more broadly, which can be useful for creative generation or broad search, but often hurts reliability on tasks where we want the single most likely answer.

在实际应用中，温度参数的选择取决于具体目标。温度设为0.0时，等同于贪婪解码，即每次都会选择概率最高的词元。当希望生成结果更具多样性，同时又不至于过于随机时，使用0.3至0.8之间的较小非零值通常较为有效。而将温度设置得更高，则会让模型进行更广泛的探索，这在创意性生成或广度搜索任务中很有用，但在需要给出最可能答案的任务上，往往会影响输出的可靠性。

In the next section, we will learn how to improve the sampling process.

在下一节中，我们将学习如何改进采样过程。

4.5 Balancing diversity and coherence with top-p sampling

4.5 使用top-p采样在多样性和连贯性之间取得平衡

In the previous section, we saw how temperature scaling and sampling (via torch.multinomial) can increase the diversity of the LLM responses, for better or for worse. Specifically, we saw that using the approach described in the previous section, we may end up sampling "weird" tokens that are unrelated to the user query.

在上一节中，我们探讨了温度缩放和采样（通过 torch.multinomial）如何在好坏参半的情况下提升大语言模型回复的多样性。具体而言，我们看到，采用上一节介绍的方法，可能会采样到与用户问题毫不相关的“奇怪”令牌。

In this section, we improve the sampling process by adding a top-p filter (figure 4.12) such that very low-confidence tokens are not sampled by accident. The top-p sampling process described in this section is also known as nucleus sampling.

在本节中，我们通过添加一个 top-p 过滤器（图 4.12）来改进采样过程，从而避免意外采样到置信度极低的词元。本节所描述的 top-p 采样过程也被称为核采样。

Figure 4.12 Overview of the top-p filtering process. The filter keeps only the highest-probability tokens by sorting them, applying a cumulative cutoff, selecting the top-p subset, and renormalizing the result.
图4.12　top-p过滤过程概述。该过滤器通过对概率进行排序、应用累积截断、选择top-p子集并对结果进行归一化，仅保留概率最高的标记。

Figure 4.12 summarizes the four steps that make up the top-p filter: sorting the token probabilities (4.1), computing their cumulative sum (4.2), selecting the subset that satisfies the top-p cutoff (4.3), and renormalizing the remaining probabilities so that they again form a valid distribution (4.4).

图4.12总结了构成top-p滤波的四个步骤：对词元概率进行排序（4.1），计算其累积和（4.2），选取满足top-p截断条件的子集（4.3），以及对剩余概率进行归一化，使其重新构成一个有效的概率分布（4.4）。

The renormalization step is necessary because, once we remove all low-probability tokens, the remaining probabilities no longer sum to one. To sample correctly, we rescale these remaining values so they represent a proper probability distribution.

归一化步骤是必要的，因为一旦我们移除所有低概率的标记，剩余标记的概率之和将不再等于1。为了正确地进行采样，我们需要对这些剩余值进行重新缩放，使其构成一个合法的概率分布。

Having outlined the full top-p filtering pipeline in figure 4.12, the next subsections walk through each step in detail. We will start with a brief recap of temperature scaling and then implement steps 4.1 to 4.4 that are shown in figure 4.12.

在图4.12中已经概述了完整的top-p采样流程，接下来的几个小节将详细讲解每一步。我们首先简要回顾温度缩放，然后实现图4.12所示的步骤4.1至4.4。

4.5.1 Selecting a subset of top-p tokens

4.5.1 选择 top-p 个 token 的子集

In this section, we implement the top-p filter illustrated in figure 4.12 that we will use to improve the text generation function, which we plan to use for self-consistency sampling.

在本节中，我们实现了图4.12所示的top-p过滤器，用于改进文本生成函数，并计划将其应用于自一致性采样。

Note
注意

The purpose of top-p filtering in this section is to drop low-probability tokens so that only the most plausible options remain during sampling. This reduces the chance of producing tokens that do not fit the context.

本节中使用 top-p 过滤的目的，是将概率较低的词元剔除，从而在采样过程中仅保留最合理的候选词元。这样可以降低生成与上下文不符词元的可能性。

Before we implement the top-p filter, let us briefly recap the temperature-scaling and sampling process with a simpler toy dataset, which makes it easier to illustrate the process. For instance, let's assume the model's and tokenizer's vocabularies have only 10 entries, rather than 151,936.

在我们实施 top-p 过滤器之前，不妨先用一个更简单的玩具数据集来简要回顾一下温度缩放和采样过程，这样可以更直观地展示整个流程。例如，假设模型和分词器的词汇表只有 10 个条目，而不是 151,936 个。

Listing 4.9 Recap of temperature scaling and sampling with toy data
toy_logits = torch.tensor(  #A
    [-0.7, -3.0, 0.1, -1.2, 2.0, -1.0, -0.5, -2.0, 0.3, 1.5]
)
 
toy_logits_scaled = scale_logits_by_temperature(toy_logits, 1.0)  #B
toy_probas = torch.softmax(toy_logits_scaled, dim=-1)   #C
 
plt.bar(  #D
    torch.arange(len(toy_probas)), toy_probas,
    alpha=0.5

plt.ylim([0, 1])
plt.xlabel("Vocabulary index")
plt.ylabel("Probability")

#C Step 3.3: Convert to probabilities

#A 步骤 3.1：获取 logits（此处使用 10 个 token 的示例 logits） #B 步骤 3.2：应用温度缩放（我们使用 1.0 作为占位符） #C 步骤 3.3：转换为概率 #D 绘制条形图显示概率

Please note that the toy_logits variable holds the example values that we would get for the next-token logit scores via the model(token_ids, cache=cache)[:, -1] call in the previous section, assuming that the vocabulary size is 10. The resulting plot is shown in figure 4.13.

请注意，变量 toy_logits 存储的是我们在上一节中通过模型(token_ids, cache=cache)[:, -1] 调用所得到的下一个标记对数几率分数的示例值，假设词汇表大小为 10。结果绘图如图 4.13 所示。

Figure 4.13 Example of token probabilities before top-p filtering. The distribution includes many low-probability tokens, which will later be truncated by applying a cumulative probability threshold.
图4.13 顶-p过滤前的词元概率示例。该分布包含大量低概率词元，后续将通过应用累积概率阈值对其进行截断。

The bar plot in figure 4.13 shows the next-token logit scores after rescaling them to a probability score. So far, this is a recap of the previous section. Next, we will add the first two top-p filtering steps (steps 4.1 and 4.2) illustrated in figure 4.12. This involves sorting the probability scores in descending order and computing the cumulative sum.

图4.13中的柱状图展示了将下一个标记的 logits 分数重新缩放为概率分数后的结果。到目前为止，这不过是前一节内容的回顾。接下来，我们将加入图4.12中所示的前两步 top-p 过滤步骤（步骤4.1和4.2）。这包括按概率分数降序排序，并计算累积和。

Listing 4.10 Compute cumulative probability sum
sorted_probas, sorted_idx = torch.sort(toy_probas, descending=True)  #A
cumsum = torch.cumsum(sorted_probas, dim=-1)  #B
 
plt.bar(
    torch.arange(len(sorted_probas)), sorted_probas, 
        alpha=0.5
)
plt.step(
    torch.arange(len(cumsum)), cumsum, 
    where="mid", color="C1", label="Cumulative sum"
)
 
plt.ylim([0, 1])
plt.xlabel("Token rank (sorted by probability)")
plt.ylabel("Probability")
plt.show()
#A Step 4.1: Sort by descending probability
#B Step 4.2: Compute cumulative sum
#A 第4.1步：按概率降序排序 #B 第4.2步：计算累积和

The torch.cumsum function used in listing 4.10 above computes the cumulative sum of elements along a given dimension. In this example, it takes the sorted token probabilities and adds them up step by step, so each position in torch.cumsum represents the total probability accumulated up to that token.

上述代码清单 4.10 中使用的 torch.cumsum 函数用于计算给定维度上元素的累积和。在本例中，它对已排序的标记概率逐项累加，因此 torch.cumsum 中的每个位置都表示截至该标记为止的累计概率总和。

For instance, the first element equals the highest probability, the second equals the sum of the top two, and so on, until the final value reaches 1. This is best explained by looking at the cumulative step plot, produced by the code in listing 4.10 and shown in figure 4.14.

例如，第一个元素等于最高概率，第二个元素等于前两个最高概率之和，依此类推，直到最后一个值达到 1。这一点通过累积阶梯图可以得到最直观的解释，该图由清单 4.10 中的代码生成，并如图 4.14 所示。

Figure 4.14 Visualization of sorted token probabilities and their cumulative sum. This step prepares for top-p filtering by showing how probabilities accumulate when ordered from highest to lowest, which helps determine where to set the cutoff threshold.
图4.14 排序后的令牌概率及其累积和的可视化。这一步通过展示从高到低排序时概率的累积过程，为top-p采样过滤做准备，有助于确定截断阈值的位置。

Now that we have the cumulative probability sum, we can implement the core top-p filtering step. The "p" in top-p stands for probability, and top-p can be translated to "keep the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability stays below or equal to p." A simple code implementation of top-p filtering may look as follows:

现在我们已经有了累积概率之和，就可以实现核心的 top-p 过滤步骤了。“p”代表概率，top-p 的含义是“保留累积概率不超过或等于 p 的最小词元集合”。top-p 过滤的一种简单代码实现可能如下：

Listing 4.11 A simple-top-p filtering rule
top_p = 0.8
keep_mask = cumsum <= top_p
n_kept = torch.sum(keep_mask).item()
print("Cumulative sum:", cumsum)
print("Tokens kept:", n_kept)
top_p = 0.8 keep_mask = 累积和 <= top_p n_kept = torch.sum(keep_mask).item() print("累积和:", 累积和) print("保留的标记数:", n_kept)

In code, this is implemented as keep_mask = cumsum <= top_p, which marks all tokens whose cumulative probability mass does not yet exceed the threshold p (here, defined via top_p=0.8). The number of retained tokens is then computed and assigned to the variable n_kept. The output is

在代码中，这被实现为 keep_mask = cumsum <= top_p，它会标记出累积概率质量尚未超过阈值 p 的所有词元（此处通过 top_p=0.8 定义）。随后计算保留的词元数量，并将其赋值给变量 n_kept。输出是

Cumulative sum: tensor([0.4538, 0.7290, 0.8119, 0.8798,
0.9170, 0.9475, 0.9701, 0.9886, 0.9969, 1.0000])
Tokens kept: 2
累计和：tensor([0.4538, 0.7290, 0.8119, 0.8798, 0.9170, 0.9475, 0.9701, 0.9886, 0.9969, 1.0000]) 保留的标记数：2

Looking at the returned cumulative probabilities, the second entry (0.7290) is just below the top-p threshold of 0.8, and the third entry (0.8119) exceeds it, which is why only the first 2 tokens are kept.

从返回的累积概率来看，第二个条目（0.7290）略低于 top-p 阈值 0.8，而第三个条目（0.8119）则超过了该阈值，因此只保留了前两个 token。

Now, a more common variant of top-p filtering includes the token that exceeds the threshold:

现在，一种更常见的 top-p 过滤变体包括超出阈值的那一个 token：

Listing 4.12 A common top-p filtering variant
keep_mask = (cumsum - sorted_probas) < top_p
n_kept = keep_mask.sum().item()
print("Tokens kept:", n_kept)
keep_mask = (cumsum - sorted_probas) < top_pn_kept = keep_mask.sum().item()print("保留的标记数：", n_kept)

This code now returns 3 as the number of tokens kept. This follows the definition of top-p filtering that the smallest set of tokens is kept such that the cumulative probability mass is at least p.

这段代码现在返回 3，表示保留的标记数量。这符合 top-p 过滤的定义：只保留使累积概率质量至少为 p 的最小标记集合。

Let's illustrate this top filtering with a plot using the code below.

让我们用下面的代码绘制一张图来说明这种顶级过滤。

    color="darkorange", label="Cumulative sum"

plt.ylim(0, 1.05)
