表5.1 不同自我精炼方法在MATH-500任务上的准确率 方法 评分 迭代次数 模型 准确率 时间 1 基线（第3章） - - 基础模型 15.2% 10.1分钟 2 自我精炼 无 1 基础模型 25.0% 84.8分钟 3 自我精炼 无 2 基础模型 22.0% 165.4分钟 4 自我精炼 启发式 1 基础模型 21.6% 84.7分钟 5 自我精炼 启发式 2 基础模型 20.8% 151.4分钟 6 自我精炼 平均对数似然 1 基础模型 21.4% 85.3分钟 7 自我精炼 平均对数似然 2 基础模型 22.0% 165.3分钟 8 基线（第3章） - - 推理模型 48.2% 182.1分钟 9 自我精炼 无 1 推理模型 56.6% 498.8分钟 10 自我精炼 启发式 1 推理模型 57.8% 498.6分钟 11 自我精炼 平均对数似然 1 推理模型 48.4% 499.7分钟

The accuracy values shown in table 5.1 were computed on all 500 samples in the MATH-500 test set using a "cuda" GPU (DGX Spark).

表5.1中所示的准确率是在MATH-500测试集的全部500个样本上，使用“cuda”GPU（DGX Spark）计算得出的。

As we can see in table 5.1, self-refinement improves the performance over the base model (rows 1-7). The improvement is only very moderate, with the best accuracy being achieved when no scoring is used in self-refinement. This means that both the heuristic score and average logprob score can sometimes lead to incorrect answers being accepted over the initial correct answer.

由表5.1可知，自精炼能够提升模型性能，优于基础模型（第1至7行）。然而，这种提升非常有限；在自精炼过程中不使用任何评分机制时，模型的准确率最高。这表明，无论是启发式评分还是平均对数似然分数，有时都可能导致错误的答案被采纳，而初始正确的答案却被舍弃。

Note that when adding "Explain step by step." chain-of-thought for both the base model and the self-refinement, the model failed to improve over the base model (results not shown).

需要注意的是，当为基础模型和自精炼过程都添加“逐步解释”的思维链时，模型性能并未优于基础模型（结果未展示）。

Looking at the reasoning model results (rows 8-11), we can see that the combination of self-refinement and heuristic scoring improved the answer accuracy by almost 10%. (As explained in chapter 3, the "reasoning" model can be used by changing which_model="base" to which_model="reasoning" in the load_model_and_tokenizer in section 5.2.)

从推理模型的结果（第8至11行）可以看出，自我精炼与启发式评分相结合的方法将答案准确率提升了近10%。（如第3章所述，通过将5.2节中load_model_and_tokenizer函数里的which_model参数由“base”改为“reasoning”，即可使用“推理”模型。）

In both cases, it seems that the average logprob scoring results in worse performance than no scorer or the heuristic scorer. This is likely because the average logprob score is more closely related to how natural or expected an answer looks under the model than to whether the answer is actually correct. As a result, it can favor answers that are fluent, familiar, or syntactically clean even when they are semantically wrong. Or, in other words, the logprob criterion can unintentionally select confident mistakes, whereas the heuristic score is more focused on the format and structure of the answer.

在这两种情况下，平均对数概率评分似乎都导致比不使用评分器或使用启发式评分器更差的性能。这很可能是因为平均对数概率评分与答案在模型视角下显得多自然、多符合预期更为相关，而非与答案是否真正正确相关。因此，它可能会倾向于选择那些流畅、熟悉或句法上整洁但语义上错误的答案。换言之，对数概率准则可能会无意中选出那些看似自信却实则错误的答案，而启发式评分则更关注答案的格式和结构。

At this point, it seems we spent a lot of time discussing the average logprob scoring concept. Logprob scoring is a fundamental concept when working with LLMs, and it will come handy in the upcoming chapters when we implement the reinforcement learning training procedure.

到目前为止，我们似乎花了大量时间讨论平均对数概率评分这一概念。对数概率评分是使用大语言模型时的一个基础概念，在接下来的章节中，当我们实现强化学习训练流程时，它将派上用场。

Comparing these results in table 5.1 with those from the previous chapter (table 4.1), we also observe that self-refinement is less effective than self-consistency for this model on this math task. Self-consistency remains widely used because it works well in practice, despite its simplicity.

将表5.1中的这些结果与前一章的结果（表4.1）进行比较，我们同样发现，在该数学任务上，对于此模型而言，自我精炼的效果不如自洽性方法。尽管自洽性方法非常简单，但在实践中表现良好，因此至今仍被广泛使用。

Another method we have not explored in this chapter is self-refinement with an external model in an LLM-as-a-judge setup similar to what's described in appendix F in section F.5. For instance, instead of using the heuristic score or average logprob, we use a second LLM to compute a score and to write the critique.

本章尚未探讨的另一种方法是在“LLM作为裁判”的设置下，借助外部模型进行自我精炼，这与附录F第F.5节中描述的方法类似。例如，我们不使用启发式评分或平均对数概率，而是利用第二台LLM来计算评分并撰写评语。

In November 2025, with DeepSeekMath-V2, the DeepSeek team demonstrated that self-refinement with a second LLM can be very successful, leading to gold-level performance in several math competitions. Specifically, the DeepSeek team proposed a new method in which they trained a second LLM to be a good critique model and further trained their base model to become a better math problem solver in the context of self-refinement (in contrast, in this chapter, we applied self-refinement without any additional training).

2025年11月，DeepSeek团队借助DeepSeekMath-V2证明，利用第二款大语言模型进行自我精炼能够取得非常显著的效果，在多项数学竞赛中达到了金牌级别的表现。具体而言，DeepSeek团队提出了一种新方法：他们首先训练出一款优秀的评鉴模型，随后在自我精炼的框架下进一步优化基础模型，使其成为更出色的数学解题者（相比之下，在本章中，我们采用的是未经任何额外训练的自我精炼方法）。

Speaking of inference and training, this chapter concludes the inference scaling without additional training (figure 5.22). In the next chapter, we begin covering training techniques that update the model weights to become better at reasoning tasks.

说到推理和训练，本章首先介绍了无需额外训练的推理规模扩展方法（图5.22）。在下一章中，我们将开始探讨通过更新模型权重来提升其推理能力的训练技术。

Figure 5.22 Overview of the book's progression from basic LLM usage to inference-time reasoning methods and finally to training-based techniques. This chapter concludes the inference-scaling methods without additional training, and the next chapters introduce approaches that update model weights to further improve reasoning performance.
图5.22 本书内容脉络概览：从大语言模型的基本用法，逐步过渡到推理时的推理方法，最后深入探讨基于训练的技术。本章总结了无需额外训练的推理规模扩展方法，而接下来几章将介绍通过更新模型权重来进一步提升推理性能的方法。

5.9 Summary

5.9 总结

  • Self-refinement extends the inference-time scaling ideas from the previous chapter by iteratively critiquing and improving a single answer instead of relying on multiple independent samples as in self-consistency.
  • 自我精炼通过迭代地批判和改进单个答案，扩展了前一章中关于推理时规模扩展的思想；而自洽性方法则依赖于多个独立的样本。
  • A simple rule-based scoring function ranks model outputs by rewarding extractable final answers and shorter, more economical completions.
  • 一种简单的基于规则的评分函数通过奖励可提取的最终答案以及更短、更简洁的完成内容，对模型输出进行排序。
  • Next-token scoring quantifies model confidence by converting logits into normalized probabilities and combining these into a sequence-level likelihood.
  • 下一步标记评分通过将 logits 转换为归一化概率，并将这些概率组合成序列级别的似然值，来量化模型的置信度。
  • Log-probabilities replace raw probabilities to avoid numerical underflow and to turn products over many tokens into stable sums and averages.
  • 对数概率取代原始概率，以避免数值下溢，并将多个标记上的概率乘积转化为稳定的求和与平均值。
  • These scoring functions are more generally useful beyond self-refinement, for example, for breaking ties in self-consistency or implementing Best-of-N selection strategies.
  • 这些打分函数的应用范围并不局限于自迭代优化，还可用于在自我一致性方法中打破平局，或实现“最佳N选”策略。
  • The self-refinement procedure consists of three stages: generating an initial draft, producing a short critique and fix plan, and generating a revised answer.
  • 自我完善过程包括三个阶段：生成初始草稿、撰写简短的评析与修改方案，以及生成修订后的答案。
  • A reusable refinement function automates the self-refinement workflow with multiple iterations (refinement rounds), and it can use a score-based acceptance to keep only revisions that do not degrade a computed answer score using one of the scoring functions we developed earlier.
  • 一个可重用的优化函数能够自动化多轮迭代的自我优化工作流，并且可以基于评分的接受准则，仅保留那些不会降低由我们先前开发的某一评分函数计算出的答案得分的修订版本。

6 Training reasoning models with reinforcement learning

6 使用强化学习训练推理模型

This chapter covers

本章涵盖

  • The difference between reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR)
  • 人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）之间的区别
  • Training reasoning LLMs as a reinforcement learning problem with task-correctness rewards
  • 将推理型大语言模型的训练建模为一个以任务正确性奖励为核心的强化学习问题
  • Sampling multiple responses per prompt to compute group-relative learning signals
  • 对每个提示采样多个响应，以计算群体相对学习信号。
  • Updating the LLM weights using group-based policy optimization for improved reasoning
  • 基于分组策略优化更新大语言模型权重以提升推理能力

Reasoning performance and answer accuracy can be improved by both increasing the inference compute budget and by specific model training methods. This chapter, as shown in figure 6.1, focuses on reinforcement learning, which is the most commonly used training method for reasoning models.

通过增加推理计算资源预算以及采用特定的模型训练方法，都可以提升推理性能和答案准确率。本章如图6.1所示，重点探讨强化学习——这是推理模型最常用的训练方法。

Figure 6.1 A mental model of the topics covered in this book. This chapter focuses on techniques that improve reasoning with additional training (stage 4). Specifically, this chapter covers reinforcement learning.
图6.1 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型。本章重点介绍通过额外训练（第4阶段）来提升推理能力的技术。具体而言，本章将讨论强化学习。

The next section provides a general introduction to reinforcement learning in the context of LLMs before discussing the two common reinforcement learning approaches used for LLMs.

下一节将在讨论用于大语言模型的两种常见强化学习方法之前，先对大语言模型背景下的强化学习进行概览性介绍。

6.1 Introduction to reinforcement learning for LLMs

6.1 大型语言模型的强化学习简介

Inference-time scaling and training-time scaling are two distinct approaches for improving the reasoning performance of large language models, as illustrated in figure 6.2. Inference-time scaling increases accuracy by spending more computation per generated answer, whereas training-time scaling improves accuracy by investing additional computation during training. This chapter focuses on training-time scaling.

如图6.2所示，推理时扩展和训练时扩展是提升大型语言模型推理性能的两种截然不同的方法。推理时扩展通过为每个生成的答案投入更多计算资源来提高准确性，而训练时扩展则是在训练过程中投入额外的计算资源以提升模型性能。本章将重点探讨训练时扩展。

Figure 6.2 Conceptual comparison of inference-time scaling and training-time scaling. Increasing compute at inference improves accuracy by spending more resources per answer generation, while increasing compute during training improves accuracy by investing more resources upfront.
图6.2 推理时扩展与训练时扩展的概念性对比。在推理阶段增加计算资源，可通过为每次答案生成投入更多资源来提升准确率；而在训练阶段增加计算资源，则可通过前期投入更多资源来提升模型的最终性能。

While figure 6.2 presents inference-time scaling and training-time scaling as separate concepts, in practice, they can be combined. For example, after improving a model's reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning (RL), which is the core focus of this chapter, inference-time scaling techniques such as those introduced in chapters 4 and 5 can be applied to further boost performance.

尽管图6.2将推理时扩展和训练时扩展视为两个独立的概念，但在实践中，二者可以结合使用。例如，在通过本章重点探讨的强化学习（RL）提升模型的推理能力之后，还可以应用第4章和第5章介绍的推理时扩展技术，以进一步提高性能。

RL is focused on how models learn from sequences of actions and their outcomes, with classic examples such as agents trained to play Chess, Go, or video games.

强化学习专注于研究模型如何从一系列动作及其结果中学习，经典案例包括训练智能体来下国际象棋、围棋或玩电子游戏。

While RL for LLMs builds on this literature, it differs in important ways and often resembles familiar LLM training techniques. Since this book focuses on language models, we do not cover RL in general but instead focus on how RL is applied in LLM training.

尽管针对大型语言模型的强化学习借鉴了相关研究文献，但在关键方面仍存在显著差异，并且常常与熟悉的大型语言模型训练方法颇为相似。鉴于本书专注于语言模型，我们不会全面探讨强化学习的一般理论，而是将重点放在强化学习如何应用于大型语言模型的训练上。

So what does RL mean in practice for LLMs? At a high level, RL is typically applied as a post-training stage on top of a pre-trained language model, sometimes after instruction fine-tuning. This setup is illustrated in figure 6.3.

那么，在实践中，强化学习对大型语言模型意味着什么呢？从宏观层面来看，强化学习通常被用作预训练语言模型之后的一个后训练阶段，有时甚至是在指令微调之后。这种架构如图6.3所示。

Figure 6.3 Common training stages for LLMs. The ordering of the reasoning training and preference tuning stages can vary, and some pipelines interleave reasoning and preference tuning rather than strictly sequencing them.
图6.3 大语言模型的常见训练阶段。推理训练和偏好微调阶段的先后顺序可以不同，有些训练流水线会将推理训练和偏好微调交替进行，而不是严格地按顺序执行。

There are two common RL stages for LLMs, reasoning training and preference tuning. As shown in figure 6.3, RL is usually applied after instruction fine-tuning, and preference tuning often follows reasoning training. As demonstrated by the DeepSeek team in their DeepSeek-R1 work, though, reasoning-focused RL can also be applied directly to the pre-trained base model, skipping both instruction fine-tuning and preference tuning.

LLM 中常见的强化学习阶段有两个：推理训练和偏好微调。如图 6.3 所示，强化学习通常在指令微调之后进行，而偏好微调则往往紧随推理训练之后。然而，DeepSeek 团队在其 DeepSeek-R1 工作中表明，以推理为重点的强化学习也可以直接应用于预训练的基础模型，从而跳过指令微调和偏好微调这两个步骤。

The resulting model is generally weaker in terms of reasoning accuracy than one that goes through the full training pipeline, but it still exhibits clear and robust reasoning behavior. More importantly, applying reasoning training directly to the base model avoids mixing the effects of multiple training stages, which makes it easier to attribute any observed improvements specifically to the reasoning training itself.

由此得到的模型，在推理准确性方面通常不如经过完整训练流程的模型，但它仍然表现出清晰且稳健的推理行为。更重要的是，直接在基础模型上开展推理训练，可以避免不同训练阶段效应的混杂，从而更容易将观察到的性能提升明确归因于推理训练本身。

Before getting further into the details of how RL is implemented for LLMs, it is useful to briefly compare RL with pre-training at a conceptual level. During pre-training, an LLM is trained to predict the next token in large amounts of text, and many of the model's core abilities and emergent behaviors (for example, answering knowledge-based questions and following simple instructions) already develop at this stage.

在深入探讨强化学习如何应用于大型语言模型之前，有必要从概念层面简要比较强化学习与预训练。在预训练阶段，大型语言模型被训练以预测大量文本中的下一个词元，而模型的许多核心能力及涌现性行为（例如回答基于知识的问题和执行简单指令）已在这一阶段初步形成。

Note that pre-training is the main focus of my earlier book, Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), but familiarity with that material is not required to follow this chapter or the rest of this book.

请注意，预训练是我 earlier book《从零开始构建大型语言模型》的重点内容，但阅读本章及本书其余部分并不需要事先熟悉那部分内容。

Applying RL on top of a pre-trained model is attractive because it lets us optimize whole outputs, such as answer correctness or preferences, rather than individual tokens and next-token prediction. In this sense, pre-training mainly builds knowledge, while RL shapes how the model uses that knowledge, including its reasoning behavior.

在预训练模型之上应用强化学习具有吸引力，因为它使我们能够优化整个输出，例如答案的正确性或用户偏好，而无需局限于单个词元或下一个词元的预测。从这个意义上说，预训练主要用于构建知识，而强化学习则塑造模型如何运用这些知识，包括其推理行为。

As shown in Figure 6.4, the next two subsections give a high-level overview of how RL is used in LLM training and set the context for the method used in this chapter.

如图6.4所示，接下来的两个小节将从高层次概述强化学习在大语言模型训练中的应用，并为本章所采用的方法奠定背景。

Figure 6.4 Roadmap of this chapter. After a brief introduction to reinforcement learning (RL) for LLMs in this section, we discuss the difference between two RL stages, RLHF and RLVR, in the next section. Then, we focus on implementing RLVR using the GRPO algorithm in the remainder of this chapter.
图6.4 本章路线图。在本节简要介绍用于大语言模型的强化学习（RL）之后，下一节将讨论RLHF和RLVR这两个强化学习阶段的区别。随后，在本章剩余部分，我们将重点探讨如何使用GRPO算法实现RLVR。

6.1.1 The original reinforcement learning pipeline with human feedback (RLHF)

6.1.1 带有人类反馈的原始强化学习流程（RLHF）

In 2022, the InstructGPT paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.02155) introduced reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), a training approach that uses human preference labels to modify model behavior.

2022年，InstructGPT论文（https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.02155）提出了基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），这是一种利用人类偏好标注来调整模型行为的训练方法。

In fact, RLHF was a key ingredient in transforming GPT-3 into the original model used in ChatGPT, which was arguably what made LLMs broadly popular in 2022.

事实上，RLHF是将GPT-3改造为ChatGPT所使用的原始模型的关键要素，而这一改造 arguably 使得大型语言模型在2022年广泛普及。

At a high level, RLHF is the most popular method to implement the preference tuning stage discussed in the previous section. Before RLHF, LLMs were primarily trained through pre-training and, in some cases, supervised fine-tuning, which are both based on next-token prediction objectives.

从宏观层面来看，RLHF 是实现前一节所讨论的偏好微调阶段最为流行的方法。在 RLHF 出现之前，大语言模型主要通过预训练以及在某些情况下的监督微调来进行训练，而这两种方法都以预测下一个词元为目标。

RLHF moved beyond this token-level optimization and optimizes models on the whole outputs (in this case, RLHF is optimizing for how humans rank and evaluate LLM outputs).

RLHF超越了这种基于 token 的优化，转而在整个输出层面进行模型优化（在这一场景中，RLHF 旨在优化人类对大语言模型输出的排序和评价）。

To make this more concrete, consider the following example. Suppose the prompt is: "I am looking to buy a laptop for programming and everyday use. What should I consider?"

为了使这一点更加具体，我们来看一个例子。假设提示是：“我打算买一台用于编程和日常使用的笔记本电脑，请问我应该考虑哪些因素？”

The model might generate two candidate responses:

该模型可能会生成两个候选回复：

  • Response A: "You should consider the CPU, RAM, storage, GPU, screen resolution, battery life, keyboard quality, port selection, thermal design, and price."
  • 回答A：“你应该考虑CPU、内存、存储、显卡、屏幕分辨率、电池续航、键盘质量、接口选择、散热设计以及价格。”
  • Response B: "For programming and everyday use, focus on a fast CPU, at least 16 GB of RAM, and an SSD with at least 256 GB storage. A comfortable keyboard and good battery life also matter. A GPU may only matter if you plan to train small LLMs locally."
  • 回答B：“对于编程和日常使用，应优先选择性能强劲的CPU、至少16 GB的内存，以及容量不低于256 GB的SSD。舒适的键盘和较长的电池续航也很重要。至于显卡，只有当你计划在本地训练小型大语言模型时才可能需要关注。”

Both responses mention relevant points, but a human data annotator might prefer response B because it is more concrete and specific to the use case stated in the prompt.

两种回答都提到了相关要点，但人类数据标注员可能会更倾向于选择回答B，因为它更加具体，且更贴合提示中所描述的用例。

In RLHF, such pairwise preferences are collected across many prompts and used to train the model to favor responses that humans consistently rank higher.

在RLHF中，会收集大量提示下的成对偏好，并以此训练模型，使其更倾向于生成人类一致认为更优的回复。

As shown in figure 6.5, RLHF has two main steps: (1) training a reward model (which is itself an LLM), and (2) using that reward model to score the target LLM outputs and fine-tune it.

如图6.5所示，RLHF包含两个主要步骤：(1) 训练一个奖励模型（该模型本身也是一个大语言模型），以及(2) 使用该奖励模型对目标大语言模型的输出进行打分，并对其进行微调。

Figure 6.5 Two-stage overview of reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF). First, a reward model is trained on human-ranked responses to assign a preference score to each. Second, the LLM is updated using these reward scores within an RL objective to encourage preferred responses and discourage less desirable ones.
图6.5 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的两阶段概览。首先，基于人类排序的响应训练一个奖励模型，为每条响应分配一个偏好得分。其次，在强化学习目标框架下，利用这些奖励得分更新大语言模型，以鼓励生成更受偏好的响应，同时抑制不太理想的响应。

The first step in RLHF is training a reward model, as illustrated in the top subpanel of figure 6.5. Here, we have the LLM generate multiple responses per prompt (for example, using the temperature scaling and top-p filtering approach explained in chapter 4), and ask human annotators to rank the answers from best to worst based on their human preference.

RLHF 的第一步是训练一个奖励模型，如图 6.5 的上部子图所示。在此过程中，我们让大语言模型针对每个提示生成多个回答（例如，采用第 4 章中介绍的温度缩放和 top-p 过滤方法），并请人工标注者根据其人类偏好，将这些回答从最佳到最差进行排序。

These human preferences are converted into training targets for the reward model using a statistical preference model that maps pairwise comparisons into relative quality scores. The reward model, which is usually a separate model initialized from a pretrained LLM, is trained to output a single-number (scalar) reward score to each response that reflects its perceived quality.

这些人类偏好通过一个统计偏好模型被转化为奖励模型的训练目标，该模型将成对比较映射为相对质量得分。奖励模型通常是一个从预训练大语言模型初始化的独立模型，其训练目标是为每个回复输出一个单数值（标量）奖励分数，以反映该回复的 perceived quality。

The motivation is that the reward model can automatically score new model outputs, which eliminates the need for human annotation at every training step.

其动机在于，奖励模型能够自动对新模型的输出进行打分，从而无需在每一步训练中都依赖人工标注。

The second step in RLHF trains the LLM on the reward scores the reward model assigns to each of the LLMs' answers (for example, a bad answer may receive a -2, and a good answer may receive a +2).

RLHF 的第二步是根据奖励模型为大语言模型的每一条回答所打的奖励分数来对大语言模型进行微调（例如，一条糟糕的回答可能获得 -2 分，而一条优秀的回答则可能获得 +2 分）。

We discuss RLHF here because it can be viewed as a precursor to reasoning-focused RL methods such as reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).

我们在此讨论 RLHF，是因为它可以被视为以推理为导向的强化学习方法（如可验证奖励强化学习，RLVR）的前身。

While the source of the training signal for RLHF and RLVR differs, the underlying structure of the pipeline (generating responses, scoring them, and updating the model via RL) is closely related.

尽管RLHF和RLVR的训练信号来源不同，但其管道的底层结构（生成响应、对响应进行打分、并通过强化学习更新模型）却高度相似。

6.1.2 From human feedback to verifiable rewards (RLVR)

6.1.2 从人类反馈到可验证奖励（RLVR）

RLHF can be fairly involved because it requires training an additional reward model, which is often a large LLM that is (also) expensive to train.

RLHF 可能相当复杂，因为它需要训练一个额外的奖励模型，而这个奖励模型通常是一个大型语言模型，训练成本同样高昂。

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) simplifies this setup by replacing the LLM reward model with verifiable rewards. Verifiable rewards are computed deterministically and without human annotation. For example, the math verifier introduced in chapter 3 is a verifiable reward generator for math problems.

可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通过用可验证奖励替代大语言模型奖励模型，简化了这一设置。可验证奖励是确定性地计算得出的，且无需人工标注。例如，第3章中介绍的数学验证器就是一个用于数学问题的可验证奖励生成器。

For example, given a math problem (and a correct solution), a math verifier automatically checks whether a generated solution's final answer matches the ground truth and assigns a corresponding reward (1 for correct, and 0 for incorrect responses).

例如，给定一道数学题（以及正确答案），数学验证器会自动检查生成的解法最终得出的答案是否与标准答案一致，并据此分配相应的奖励：答对得1分，答错得0分。

As a result, the two-step RLHF pipeline collapses into a single training loop in RLVR, which resembles step 2 in RLHF: the model generates responses, the verifier assigns rewards, and these rewards are used directly to update the model.

因此，RLVR 中的两步 RLHF 流程简化为一个单一的训练循环，其形式与 RLHF 的第二步相似：模型生成回复，校验器给出奖励，这些奖励直接用于更新模型。

This simplified RLVR training procedure is outlined in figure 6.6.

这种简化的RLVR训练流程如图6.6所示。

Figure 6.6 Overview of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). The LLM generates a response that is evaluated by a deterministic verifier, for example the math verifier from chapter 3, which assigns a correctness label used as a reward signal within an RL objective to update the model.
图6.6 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）概览。大型语言模型生成响应，该响应由一个确定性验证器进行评估——例如第3章中的数学验证器——验证器会为响应分配一个正确性标签，作为强化学习目标中的奖励信号，用于更新模型。

The popularity of RLVR can largely be traced to the success of DeepSeek-R1 in 2025 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948), which demonstrated that strong reasoning performance can be achieved without relying on human preference data or a learned reward model.

RLVR 的流行在很大程度上可归因于 DeepSeek-R1 在 2025 年取得的成功（https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12948），该研究证明，无需依赖人类偏好数据或训练好的奖励模型，同样可以实现强大的推理性能。

DeepSeek-R1 trained reasoning behavior using automatically verifiable rewards, including correctness checks for math problems (similar to our verifier in chapter 3) and code compilation and execution for code-related tasks.

DeepSeek-R1 采用可自动验证的奖励机制来训练其推理行为，其中包括针对数学问题的正确性检查（类似于第3章中的验证器）以及针对代码相关任务的代码编译与执行。

Code execution is outside the scope of this book, because it would require training the LLM in a secure execution environment. In practice, this means compiling and running model-generated code inside an isolated sandbox so it cannot access the host system, private files, or external services in unsafe ways, which makes the setup considerably more complex than solving math problems.

代码执行超出了本书的讨论范围，因为它需要在安全的执行环境中对大型语言模型进行训练。实际上，这意味着必须将模型生成的代码编译并在一个隔离的沙箱中运行，以防止其以不安全的方式访问宿主机系统、私有文件或外部服务。这种设置的复杂性远高于单纯解决数学问题。

Either way, the idea behind verifying math tasks (checking whether an answer is correct, as a binary label) and code compilation (checking whether code compiles, also as a binary label) is similar, and the RLVR training algorithm would be identical.

无论哪种情况，验证数学任务（以二元标签形式判断答案是否正确）和代码编译（同样以二元标签形式判断代码能否通过编译）背后的思想是相似的，因此 RLVR 训练算法也将完全相同。

To summarize, RLVR offers several practical advantages over RLHF. It removes the need to train and maintain a separate reward model, which is often comparable in size and cost to the base LLM. RLVR requires access to reliable verification signals, which restricts it to certain domains, for example, math and code.)

综上所述，RLVR相比RLHF具有多项实用优势。它无需训练和维护单独的奖励模型，而这种奖励模型的规模和训练成本往往与基础大语言模型不相上下。不过，RLVR需要可靠的验证信号作为输入，这使其应用范围受限，仅适用于某些特定领域，例如数学和编程。

Verifiable rewards are also deterministic and reproducible, meaning they produce the same result every time for the same output, which avoids the noise and inconsistency that arise in human preference annotations.

可验证的奖励同样是确定性和可复现的，即对于相同的输入，每次都会产生相同的结果，从而避免了在人类偏好标注中出现的噪声和不一致性。

Finally, RLVR scales naturally to large training sets, since, given a reference solution, rewards can be computed automatically for any number of model-generated answers without additional human labeling effort.

最后，RLVR 能够自然地扩展到大规模训练数据集，因为在给定参考答案的情况下，无需额外的人工标注，即可自动为任意数量的模型生成答案计算奖励。

6.2 Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards walkthrough using GRPO

6.2 使用 GRPO 的可验证奖励强化学习教程

Now that we have introduced the big picture and seen how RL fits within the overall development cycle of LLMs, we get to the concrete implementation. Specifically, we implement RLVR to train a reasoning model, as illustrated in the chapter roadmap in figure 6.7. This method is similar to DeepSeek-R1-Zero, but we apply it at a much smaller scale, on a smaller model with less data, since a comparable full training run would otherwise require several hundred thousand dollars in GPU compute.

既然我们已经介绍了全局概览，并了解了强化学习在大语言模型整个开发周期中的定位，接下来便进入具体的实现环节。具体而言，我们实现了 RLVR 方法来训练一个推理模型，如图 6.7 中的章节路线图所示。该方法与 DeepSeek-R1-Zero 类似，但我们将其应用于规模小得多的场景——即在参数量更少、数据量更有限的模型上进行训练，因为如果按照类似的完整训练规模来进行，仅 GPU 算力成本就将高达数十万美元。

Figure 6.7 After introducing the two main reinforcement learning approaches for LLMs, RLHF and RLVR, the remaining sections focus on implementing RLVR using the GRPO algorithm, from dataset loading to implementing the full training loop.
图6.7 在介绍了针对大语言模型的两种主要强化学习方法——RLHF和RLVR之后，剩余各节将重点探讨如何使用GRPO算法实现RLVR，内容涵盖从数据集加载到完整训练循环的实现。

Note that RLVR defines the overall training setup, namely, using automatically verifiable rewards. In addition, we need a concrete policy optimization algorithm that can be used within this RLVR framework to update the model weights and train the model. The term "policy" is an RL-specific jargon and refers, in this specific context, to the LLM we want to train.

需要注意的是，RLVR 定义了整体的训练框架，即使用可自动验证的奖励信号。此外，我们还需要一种具体的策略优化算法，能够在 RLVR 框架内用于更新模型权重并训练模型。“策略”是强化学习领域的专业术语，在此处特指我们想要训练的语言大模型。

Specifically, we will use the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) algorithm for policy optimization.

具体而言，我们将使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）算法进行策略优化。

In short, RLVR determines what learning signal is available, and GRPO determines how that signal is used to update the model weights.

简而言之，RLVR 决定可用的学习信号是什么，而 GRPO 决定如何利用该信号来更新模型权重。

Policy gradient algorithms
策略梯度算法

A widely used policy gradient algorithm for LLMs is proximal policy optimization (PPO), which was popularized in RLHF. In principle, the same algorithm could also be applied in an RLVR setting.

大语言模型中广泛使用的策略梯度算法是近端策略优化（PPO），该算法在RLHF中得到了普及。从原理上讲，同样的算法也可以应用于RLVR场景。

When training the DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models, the DeepSeek team opted for a simpler alternative, GRPO, which was originally introduced in their DeepSeekMath paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03300). GRPO is more resource-friendly than PPO because it does not require a separate value model to estimate a value function. Instead, GRPO derives its learning signal from relative comparisons within a group of sampled responses, which substantially reduces computational overhead.

在训练 DeepSeek-R1 推理模型时，DeepSeek 团队选择了一种更为简单的替代方案——GRPO，该方法最初在其 DeepSeekMath 论文（https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03300）中提出。与 PPO 相比，GRPO 对资源的需求更低，因为它无需单独的价值模型来估计价值函数。相反，GRPO 从一组采样回复之间的相对比较中获取学习信号，从而大幅降低计算开销。

Interested readers can find a more detailed side-by-side comparison of PPO and GRPO in my article The State of Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning (https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/the-state-of-llm-reasoning-model-training). In this chapter, we focus on implementing RLVR using GRPO, which is similar to what DeepSeek-R1 and other popular reasoning models use.

感兴趣的读者可以在我的文章《大型语言模型推理中的强化学习现状》（https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/the-state-of-llm-reasoning-model-training）中找到PPO与GRPO更为详细的对比分析。在本章中，我们重点介绍如何使用GRPO实现RLVR，这种方法与DeepSeek-R1及其他主流推理模型所采用的方案类似。

In the following chapter, we build on this foundation and introduce several practical extensions to GRPO that further improve training stability and the resulting reasoning performance.

在下一章中，我们在此基础上进一步拓展GRPO，并提出若干实用的改进方法，以进一步提升训练稳定性及最终的推理性能。

6.2.1 High-level GRPO intuition via a chef analogy

6.2.1 通过厨师类比理解高级GRPO直观概念

The technical details of the GRPO algorithm for RLVR can be a bit overwhelming at first, since it has many moving parts and a lot of domain-specific RL terminology. So, before we start with a concrete technical overview and implementation, it may be beneficial to introduce the idea and mechanics behind GRPO with an example.

针对 RLVR 的 GRPO 算法的技术细节起初可能会让人感到难以把握，因为它涉及众多组件，并且大量使用强化学习领域的专业术语。因此，在进入具体的技术概述和实现之前，不妨先通过一个示例来介绍 GRPO 的基本思想和运行机制，这将大有裨益。

Figure 6.8 introduces the technical terms and approach of GRPO using a chef analogy preparing a meal.

图6.8 以厨师准备餐食的类比，介绍了GRPO的技术术语和方法。

Figure 6.8 High-level overview of the GRPO algorithm for RLVR using a chef analogy. Multiple rollouts are generated and scored, relative advantages are computed, and a policy gradient objective with a KL-based regularization (loss) term is used to update the model parameters.
图6.8 基于厨师类比的RLVR GRPO算法高层概览。生成并评分多个轨迹，计算相对优势，并使用带有基于KL散度的正则化（损失）项的策略梯度目标来更新模型参数。

So, walking through the flowchart in figure 6.8, imagine we are a chef running a small food delivery service:

那么，沿着图6.8中的流程图一步步走下来，不妨设想我们是一位经营小型外卖服务的厨师：

  1. Each day, we receive a single customer request (the prompt) asking us to prepare a certain dish (for example, lasagna).
  2. 每天，我们都会收到一条客户订单（即提示），要求我们制作某道菜品（例如，千层面）。
  3. For that request, we cook our famous lasagna dish, but while doing so, we try out several different recipe variations (the rollouts).
  4. 针对那项订单，我们烹制招牌千层面，但在制作过程中，会尝试几种不同的做法（即试验性调整）。
  5. After preparing the recipes, we create multiple dishes (completions). Note in the LLM setting, a rollout refers to the entire generation process for a prompt, while the completion is the resulting output text. In practice, the two terms are often used interchangeably.
  6. 在准备好提示词后，我们会生成多个完成项（即多个输出文本）。需要注意的是，在大语言模型的语境中，“rollout”指的是针对某个提示词的整个生成过程，而“completion”则指最终生成的输出文本。但在实际应用中，这两个术语常常可以互换使用。
  7. Customers only give us feedback (the reward) after tasting the entire dish, not while it is being prepared. This means we judge the final result as a whole rather than individual cooking steps.
  8. 顾客通常是在品尝完整道菜之后才会给出反馈（即评价），而不是在菜肴制作过程中。这意味着我们是以整体的最终成品来评判，而非针对每一道烹饪步骤单独打分。
  9. We compare how the dishes performed relative to each other based on the customer feedback from stage 4. This helps us identify which recipe variations received higher rewards and which received lower rewards for this particular request.
  10. 我们根据第四阶段的顾客反馈，比较各菜品之间的表现差异。这有助于我们识别在该特定需求下，哪些菜谱变体获得了更高的评价，哪些则较低。
  11. For each completed dish, we also keep track of how typical it was of our current cooking style, that is, how closely it followed our usual techniques and ingredient choices (logprobs).
  12. 对于每一道完成的菜品，我们还会记录它与当前烹饪风格的契合度，即其在多大程度上遵循了我们惯常的烹饪技法和食材选择（对数概率）。
  13. Using relative feedback from stage 5 and how characteristic each dish was of our current cooking style from stage 6, we determine how to tweak the cooking style (policy gradient loss). Here, we want to reinforce choices that led to better dishes and reduce those that led to worse ones.
  14. 结合阶段5的相对反馈以及阶段6中每道菜对我们当前烹饪风格的典型性，我们确定如何调整烹饪风格（通过策略梯度损失）。在此过程中，我们希望强化那些带来更佳菜品的选择，同时弱化那些导致较差菜品的选择。
  15. At the same time, we consult our original cookbook from the past.
  16. 与此同时，我们翻阅过去那本原始食谱。
  17. We then apply a style-preservation penalty that encourages trying new recipe variations, but prevents overly drastic changes to our cooking style that could scare away existing customers.
  18. 随后，我们引入一项风格保持惩罚项，以鼓励尝试新的菜谱变体，同时避免对烹饪风格进行过于剧烈的改动，从而防止吓跑现有顾客。
  19. The preference-based adjustment and the cooking style-preservation penalty are combined into a single overall measure or decision (the overall loss) about how the cooking style should change. The goal here is to balance customer satisfaction with consistency.
  20. 将基于偏好的调整与烹饪风格保持惩罚合并为一个统一的综合指标或决策（即总体损失），用以确定烹饪风格应如何调整。其目标是在顾客满意度与一致性之间取得平衡。
  21. Finally, we update the cooking style (gradient-based model weight update) so that future dishes are more likely to satisfy customer preferences while still remaining close to the original cookbook.
  22. 最后，我们更新烹饪风格（基于梯度的模型权重更新），使得未来的菜品更符合顾客偏好，同时仍保持与原始菜谱的一致性。

Even though this is a relatively intuitive analogy, we can see that there are lots of components and moving parts in GRPO.

尽管这是一个相对直观的类比，但我们可以看出，GRPO 涉及众多组件和动态部分。

6.2.2 The high-level GRPO procedure

6.2.2 高级别GRPO流程

Following the chef analogy from the previous section, the flowchart in figure 6.9 provides a technical overview of the GRPO algorithm for RLVR using concrete values and numbers that we will compute when implementing GRPO step by step.

沿用前一节中的厨师类比，图6.9中的流程图以具体数值和数字为依据，提供了基于GRPO算法的RLVR技术概览；这些数值和数字将在我们逐步实现GRPO时进行计算。

Figure 6.9 Step-by-step GRPO update for RLVR. (1) A prompt is sampled and multiple rollouts are generated. (2) Each rollout is scored using a verifiable reward. (3) Group-relative advantages are computed from these rewards. (4) The log-probability of each rollout under the current model is calculated. (5) Advantages and log-probabilities are combined to form the policy gradient loss. (6) A KL regularization term against a reference model is added, and the resulting total loss is used to update the model parameters.
图6.9 RLVR的GRPO逐步更新过程。(1) 采样一个提示，并生成多个轨迹。(2) 使用可验证的奖励对每条轨迹进行打分。(3) 根据这些奖励计算群体相对优势。(4) 计算当前模型下每条轨迹的日志概率。(5) 将优势和日志概率结合，构成策略梯度损失。(6) 添加针对参考模型的KL正则化项，以得到的总损失来更新模型参数。

The GRPO outline in figure 6.9 contains many technical components, and at first glance, it may look overwhelming. We will start by implementing a simplified version of GRPO that omits the KL loss term shown on the right side of the figure.

图6.9中的GRPO框架包含许多技术组件，初看之下可能会让人感到难以驾驭。我们首先实现一个简化的GRPO版本，该版本省略了图右侧所示的KL散度损失项。

In chapter 7, we will add this missing KL loss term for completeness. While the KL loss is part of the original GRPO formulation, it is not strictly essential. In fact, many LLM developers omit it in practice, as doing so both simplifies implementation and can sometimes improve modeling performance.

在第7章中，为了完整性，我们将添加这一缺失的KL散度损失项。尽管KL散度损失是原始GRPO框架的一部分，但它并非严格必需。事实上，许多大模型开发者在实践中会将其省略，因为这样做既能简化实现，有时还能提升模型性能。

Note
注意

Readers experienced with GRPO or other policy gradient methods may wonder about the use of clipped policy ratios; these are covered in the upcoming chapter.

熟悉 GRPO 或其他策略梯度方法的读者可能会对使用截断策略比率感到疑惑；相关内容将在下一章中介绍。

If this overview, shown in figure 6.9, feels complicated on first reading, don’t worry. We will build up the algorithm step by step. For now, it is best to treat figure 6.9 as a high-level roadmap that helps orient us as we work through the individual pieces.

如果这份概述（如图6.9所示）在初次阅读时显得较为复杂，也不必担心。我们将逐步构建该算法。目前，最好将图6.9视为一张高层次的路线图，帮助我们在逐一处理各个组成部分时明确方向。

6.3 Loading a pre-trained model

6.3 加载预训练模型

Similar to previous chapters, we begin by loading the pre-trained model (see stage 5 in figure 6.10), which we will then use to generate the rollouts (answers to a given prompt) we need for GRPO.

与前几章类似，我们首先加载预训练模型（参见图6.10中的阶段5），随后将利用该模型生成GRPO所需的轨迹样本（即给定提示下的回答）。

Figure 6.10 In stage 5, we load the pre-trained model (this section) and dataset (next section) that we will use for the model training.
图6.10 在第5步中，我们加载用于模型训练的预训练模型（本节）和数据集（下一节）。

Listing 6.1 is the same code we’ve used previously for loading the tokenizer and base model.

清单6.1是我们之前用于加载分词器和基础模型的相同代码。

Next, to ensure that the model is loaded correctly, let's use it together with the temperature and top-p sampler code from chapter 4 on a simple math prompt:

6.4 Loading a MATH training subset

6.4 加载 MATH 训练子集

Next, we load the dataset that we will use when training the model with GRPO.

接下来，我们加载将在使用 GRPO 训练模型时使用的数据集。

We use a non-overlapping training subset derived from the original MATH dataset, which means that all MATH-500 evaluation problems are explicitly excluded from the training data. This prevents data leakage and ensures a clean separation between training and evaluation, as illustrated in figure 6.11.

我们使用从原始 MATH 数据集派生的一个不重叠的训练子集，这意味着所有的 MATH-500 评估题目都被明确地排除在训练数据之外。这样做可以防止数据泄露，并确保训练与评估之间有清晰的分离，如图 6.11 所示。

Note
注意

For details on how this dataset was constructed, see https://github.com/rasbt/math_full_minus_math500.

有关该数据集如何构建的详细信息，请参阅 https://github.com/rasbt/math_full_minus_math500。

Figure 6.11 Structure and split of the MATH dataset. The full dataset contains about 12,500 problems that are divided into a 500-problem test set (MATH-500), which we used for model evaluation in chapter 3. A non-overlapping set of 12,000 problems is used for training in this chapter.
图6.11 MATH数据集的结构与划分。完整数据集包含约12,500道题目，被划分为一个500道题的测试集（MATH-500），我们在第3章中将其用于模型评估。本章则使用一个不重叠的12,000道题训练集进行训练。

To load the 12,000 math problems from the MATH training set depicted in figure 6.11, we define the following load_math_train function in listing 6.3, which is similar to the load_math500_test function in chapter 3, except that we specify a different file path.

为了加载图6.11中所示的MATH训练集中的12,000道数学题，我们在清单6.3中定义了如下load_math_train函数。该函数与第3章中的load_math500_test函数类似，唯一的区别是文件路径不同。

Listing 6.3 Loading the MATH training set
import json
import requests
from pathlib import Path
 
def load_math_train(local_path="math_train.json", save_copy=True):
    local_path = Path(local_path)
 
    url = (
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rasbt/"
        "math_full_minus_math500/refs/heads/main/"
        "math_full_minus_math500.json"
    )
    backup_url = (  #A
        "https://f001.backblazeb2.com/file/reasoning-from-scratch/"
        "MATH/math_full_minus_math500.json"
    )
 
    if local_path.exists():   #B
        with local_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    else:
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
            r.raise_for_status()
        except requests.RequestException:
            print("Using backup URL.")
            r = requests.get(backup_url, timeout=30)
            r.raise_for_status()
 
        data = r.json()
 
        if save_copy:  #C
            with local_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
 
    return data
#A Alternative URL in case the GitHub-hosted file is unavailable
#B Load from local file if already downloaded
#C Optionally cache a local copy for future runs
#A 当 GitHub 托管的文件不可用时使用的备用 URL #B 如果文件已下载，则从本地文件加载 #C 可选地缓存一份本地副本，以供后续运行使用

The above code should print "Dataset size: 12000" to indicate that the dataset was loaded correctly.

上述代码应输出“数据集大小：12000”，以表明数据集已正确加载。

Next, we can also print one of the 12,000 entries to get an idea of the dataset structure. For this, we use the pprint function from the pprint standard library, as it provides nicer formatting for dictionary entries compared to the regular print function:

接下来，我们也可以打印其中的一条记录，以了解数据集的结构。为此，我们使用 pprint 标准库中的 pprint 函数，因为它比普通的 print 函数能更好地格式化字典条目：

from pprint import pprint
pprint(math_train[4])
从 pprint 导入 pprint pprint(数学训练[4])

The resulting entry (index 4 corresponds to the fifth entry in the dataset) is shown below:

得到的条目（索引 4 对应数据集中的第五条）如下所示：

{
    "answer": "6",
    "level": "Level 3",
    "problem": (
        "Sam is hired for a 20-day period. On days that he "
        "works, he earns $\\$60. For each day that he does "
        "not work, $\\$30 is subtracted from his earnings. "
        "At the end of the 20-day period, he received "
        "$\\$660. How many days did he not work?"
    ),
    "solution": (
        "Call $x$ the number of days Sam works and $y$ the "
        "number of days he does not... Thus, Sam did not "
        "work for $\\boxed{6}$ days."
    ),
    "type": "Algebra",
    "unique_id": 4,
}
{ "answer": "6", "level": "Level 3", "problem": ( "萨姆被雇佣工作20天。他每天工作的收入是60美元，而每缺勤一天，他的收入就会减少30美元。20天结束后，他总共得到了660美元。那么萨姆有多少天没有工作呢？" ), "solution": ( "设萨姆工作的天数为x，不工作的天数为y……因此，萨姆没有工作了\\boxed{6}天。" ), "type": "代数", "unique_id": 4 }

As we can see, each dataset example is stored as a dictionary with several fields. For training, the relevant fields are "problem", which serves as the prompt, and "answer", which is the target we verify the model's output against using the math verifier.

正如我们所见，每个数据集样本都以字典形式存储，包含多个字段。在训练过程中，相关字段是“problem”，它用作提示；以及“answer”，它是目标值，我们会使用数学校验器来对比模型的输出，以验证其正确性。

The dataset also includes a full worked solution in the "solution" field. While such step-by-step solutions could in principle be used to evaluate intermediate reasoning steps, doing so would unnecessarily constrain the model and risk overfitting to a specific solution and style. Instead, we want to allow the model to explore the solution space more freely.

该数据集还包含一个完整的求解过程，位于“solution”字段中。从理论上讲，这类分步求解过程可用于评估中间推理步骤，但这样做会不必要地限制模型，并有导致模型过拟合特定解法和风格的风险。相反，我们希望让模型能够更自由地探索解空间。

6.5 Sampling rollouts

6.5 抽样发布

After setting up the pre-trained base model and loading the dataset we are now ready to implement the GRPO stages, as illustrated in figure 6.12.

在搭建好预训练的基础模型并加载数据集之后，我们现在可以开始实现 GRPO 各个阶段，如图 6.12 所示。

Figure 6.12 After outlining the RLVR method and GRPO algorithm, the following sections implement the individual GRPO stages that we need to train the LLM via verifiable rewards on the MATH dataset.
图6.12 在概述了RLVR方法和GRPO算法之后，接下来的各节将实现GRPO的各个阶段，以便我们能够在MATH数据集上利用可验证奖励来训练大语言模型。

Before we begin, figure 6.13 revisits the GRPO overview introduced earlier, but in a simplified form that omits the KL loss term, short for Kullback-Leibler divergence loss, which we will add in the next chapter. We can think of it as a penalty term that discourages the updated model from drifting too far away from a reference model. For now, figure 6.13 serves as a simplified roadmap that we will refer back to as we step through the algorithm's components.

在开始之前，图6.13重新回顾了先前介绍的GRPO概览，但以一种简化的形式呈现，省略了KL损失项——即Kullback-Leibler散度损失。该损失项将在下一章中加入。我们可以将其视为一个惩罚项，用以防止更新后的模型偏离参考模型过远。目前，图6.13充当一份简化的路线图，我们在逐步讲解算法各组成部分时会经常参考它。

Figure 6.13 Step-by-step GRPO update for RLVR (without KL loss term). We begin by prompting the LLM to generate the different rollouts.
图6.13 RLVR的GRPO逐步更新过程（不包含KL散度项）。我们首先提示大语言模型生成不同的轨迹。

As shown in figure 6.13, we first use the LLM to generate multiple rollouts. Here, "rollout" is a reinforcement learning term that simply refers to a complete answer generated by the model for a given prompt.

如图6.13所示，我们首先使用大语言模型生成多个 rollout。其中，“rollout”是强化学习中的一个术语，指模型针对给定提示生成的完整回答。

We could reuse the generate_text_stream_concat_flex function from listing 6.2 to generate the rollouts. When we defined that function earlier, though, we decorated it with @inference_mode, which disables several PyTorch features for efficiency. Since we will later perform a backward pass, this makes the function incompatible with our training setup. (Here, "backward pass" refers to the step where PyTorch computes gradients from the loss so that the optimizer can update the model weights.) Instead, we need to use the @torch.no_grad decorator, which disables gradient tracking for the forward pass without switching PyTorch into inference-only mode.

我们可以复用清单6.2中的generate_text_stream_concat_flex函数来生成轨迹。然而，我们在之前定义该函数时，为其添加了@inference_mode装饰器，以关闭PyTorch的多项功能来提升效率。由于我们后续还需要执行反向传播，这使得该函数与我们的训练流程不兼容。（此处的“反向传播”是指PyTorch根据损失计算梯度，以便优化器更新模型权重的步骤。）因此，我们需要改用@torch.no_grad装饰器，它会在前向传播过程中禁用梯度追踪，而不会将PyTorch切换到仅推理模式。

Let’s rewrite the function in a more compact form and call it sample_response. Importantly, this function generates text identical to generate_text_stream_concat_flex(..., generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache). We can verify this by observing that, with the same random_seed, temperature, and top_p settings, both functions produce identical generated responses.

让我们将该函数重写为更简洁的形式，并将其命名为 sample_response。值得注意的是，此函数生成的文本与 generate_text_stream_concat_flex(..., generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache) 完全相同。我们可以通过观察发现：在使用相同的 random_seed、temperature 和 top_p 设置时，这两个函数会生成完全一致的响应。

Listing 6.4 Defining the rollout generation function
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import KVCache
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch04 import top_p_filter
 
 
@torch.no_grad()
def sample_response(
    model,
    tokenizer,
    prompt,
    device,
    max_new_tokens=512,
    temperature=0.8,
    top_p=0.9,
):
    input_ids = torch.tensor(
        tokenizer.encode(prompt),
        device=device
        )
 
    cache = KVCache(n_layers=model.cfg["n_layers"])  #A
    model.reset_kv_cache()
    logits = model(input_ids.unsqueeze(0), cache=cache)[:, -1]
 
    generated = []
    for _ in range(max_new_tokens):
        if temperature and temperature != 1.0:  #B
            logits = logits / temperature
 
        probas = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probas = top_p_filter(probas, top_p)  #C
        next_token = torch.multinomial(
            probas.cpu(), num_samples=1
        ).to(device)
 
        token_id = next_token.item()
        generated.append(token_id)
 
        if (
            tokenizer.eos_token_id is not None
            and token_id == tokenizer.eos_token_id
        ):
            break
 
        logits = model(next_token, cache=cache)[:, -1]
 
    full_token_ids = torch.cat(
        [input_ids,
         torch.tensor(generated, device=device, dtype=input_ids.dtype),]
    )
    return full_token_ids, input_ids.numel(), tokenizer.decode(generated)
#A Cache past keys and values for efficient generation as introduced in chapter 2
#B Apply temperature scaling from chapter 4
#C Apply top-p filter from chapter 4
#A 缓存过去的键和值，以提高生成效率，如第2章所述 #B 应用第4章介绍的温度缩放 #C 应用第4章介绍的top-p滤波

Note that the function now also returns the token IDs of the prompt plus answer tokens and the number of tokens (input_ids.numel()) next to the answer text (tokenizer.decode(generated)). Returning these allows us to simplify several downstream functions later on.

请注意，该函数现在除了返回回答文本（tokenizer.decode(generated)）外，还返回提示 token IDs 与回答 token IDs 的拼接结果，以及 token 总数（input_ids.numel()）。返回这些信息有助于我们在后续的多个下游函数中简化实现。

Otherwise, there is nothing new here. The code is simply a leaner version of what we have been developing previously; it combines the generate_text_basic_stream_cache function from chapter 2 with temperature and top-p sampling from chapter 4 directly.

除此之外，这里并没有什么新内容。这段代码只是我们之前开发的代码的精简版：它直接将第2章中的generate_text_basic_stream_cache函数与第4章中的温度采样和top-p采样结合起来。

Next, we call the function on an example prompt similar to listing 6.2.

接下来，我们在一个类似于清单6.2的示例提示上调用该函数。

Listing 6.5 Generating rollouts with temperature scaling and top-p sampling
torch.manual_seed(0)
 
raw_prompt = (
    "Half the value of $3x-9$ is $x+37$. "
    "What is the value of $x$?"
)
prompt = render_prompt(raw_prompt)
 
token_ids, prompt_len, answer_text = sample_response(
            model=model,
            tokenizer=tokenizer,
            prompt=prompt,
            device=device,
            max_new_tokens=512,
            temperature=0.9,
            top_p=0.9,
        )
 
print(answer_text)
torch.manual_seed(0) raw_prompt = ( "3x-9的值的一半是x+37。" "x的值是多少？" ) prompt = render_prompt(raw_prompt) token_ids, prompt_len, answer_text = sample_response( model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, prompt=prompt, device=device, max_new_tokens=512, temperature=0.9, top_p=0.9, ) print(answer_text)

Before, the generate_text_stream_concat_flex sampling function returned " \boxed{58}". Now, the sample_response function explicitly includes the end-of-sequence token in its response: " \boxed{58}<|endoftext|>". Including this <|endoftext|> token is theoretically not necessary, but it prevents the model from unlearning to generate end-of-sequence tokens in very long training runs.

此前，generate_text_stream_concat_flex 采样函数返回的是“ \boxed{58}”。现在，sample_response 函数在其响应中显式地包含了序列结束标记：“ \boxed{58}<|endoftext|>”。从理论上讲，包含这个 <|endoftext|> 标记并非必要，但它可以防止模型在极长的训练过程中逐渐丧失生成序列结束标记的能力。

Next, we could call sample_response multiple times to generate different rollouts, which we will indeed do later when implementing the full training loop. For now, to keep the GRPO walkthrough example simple and to make it easier to follow the step-by-step GRPO outline from figure 6.13, we instead assume that the model produced the following four short responses:

接下来，我们可以多次调用 sample_response 来生成不同的 rollout，这正是我们在实现完整训练循环时会做的事情。不过，为了使 GRPO 演示示例保持简单，并便于跟随图 6.13 中的 GRPO 步骤式概览，我们暂且假设模型生成了以下四条简短回复：

rollouts = [
    r"\boxed{83}",
    r"The correct answer is \boxed{83}",
    r"The final answer is 83",
    r"We get \boxed{38}",
]
rollouts = [ r"\boxed{83}", r"正确答案是 \boxed{83}", r"最终答案是 83", r"我们得到 \boxed{38}", ]

6.6 Calculating rewards

6.6 奖励计算

The second stage of the GRPO procedure involves computing rewards for each rollout, as shown in figure 6.14.

GRPO 算法的第二步是为每次轨迹回放计算奖励，如图 6.14 所示。

Figure 6.14 The second stage in the GRPO pipeline computes the rewards for each rollout the LLM generated in the previous section.
图6.14 GRPO流水线的第二步计算LLM在上一节中生成的每条轨迹的奖励。

The rewards are computed using the math verifier from chapter 3 and are primarily based on answer correctness. By setting fallback=None in the reward_rlvr function in listing 6.6, we also include an implicit format constraint. For instance, an answer only receives a reward of 1.0 if it is both correct and expressed in the required \boxed{} format.

奖励是通过第3章中的数学验证器计算的，主要依据答案的正确性。通过在清单6.6中的reward_rlvr函数中将fallback设置为None，我们还隐式地引入了一个格式约束。例如，只有当答案既正确又采用所需的\boxed{}格式时，才会获得1.0的奖励。

Listing 6.6 Implementing the reward function
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    extract_final_candidate, grade_answer
)
 
def reward_rlvr(answer_text, ground_truth):
    extracted = extract_final_candidate(
        answer_text, fallback=None  #A
    )
    if not extracted:
        return 0.0
    correct = grade_answer(extracted, ground_truth)
    return float(correct)
#A fallback=None requires \boxed{} format to return an extracted answer
#如果 fallback=None，则需要使用 \boxed{} 格式来返回提取的答案

Since the model receives a non-zero reward only if it answers correctly and writes the final answer in the \boxed{} format, we encourage it to learn to produce correct and properly formatted answers.

由于该模型仅在回答正确且将最终答案以 \boxed{} 格式写出时才会获得非零奖励，因此我们鼓励它学习生成正确且格式规范的答案。

Let's give the reward_rlvr function a try and apply it to the rollouts.

让我们试一试 reward_rlvr 函数，并将其应用到模拟轨迹上。

Listing 6.7 Applying the reward function to all rollouts
rollout_rewards = []
 
for answer in rollouts:
    reward = reward_rlvr(answer_text=answer, ground_truth="83")
    print(f"Answer: {answer!r}")
    print(f"Reward: {reward}\n")
    rollout_rewards.append(reward)
rollout_rewards = [] for answer in rollouts: reward = reward_rlvr(answer_text=answer, ground_truth="83") print(f"答案: {answer!r}") print(f"奖励: {reward}\n") rollout_rewards.append(reward)

The resulting outputs are as follows:

由此产生的输出如下：

Answer: '\\boxed{83}'
Reward: 1.0
 
Answer: 'The correct answer is \\boxed{83}'
Reward: 1.0
 
Answer: 'The final answer is 83'
Reward: 0.0
 
Answer: 'We get \\boxed{38}'
Reward: 0.0
答案：`\boxed{83}` 奖励：1.0 答案：‘正确答案是`\boxed{83}`’ 奖励：1.0 答案：‘最终答案是83’ 奖励：0.0 答案：‘我们得到`\boxed{38}`’ 奖励：0.0

As shown above, the reward function works as intended and only provides a reward of 1.0 if the answer contains the correct result (83) and uses the \boxed{} format.

如上所示，奖励函数按预期工作：仅当答案包含正确结果（83）并采用 \boxed{} 格式时，才会给予 1.0 的奖励。

Note that the DeepSeek-R1 team also tried to use process reward models to score intermediate solution steps during training. These attempts were unsuccessful, and the researchers concluded that it is better to train only on final-answer correctness rewards, without intermediate rewards.

需要注意的是，DeepSeek-R1 团队也曾尝试在训练过程中使用过程奖励模型来对中间求解步骤进行打分。然而，这些尝试并未取得成功，研究者最终得出结论：仅基于最终答案正确性的奖励进行训练，而不引入中间奖励，效果更好。

Exercise 6.1: Adding format-aware reward shaping
练习 6.1：添加格式感知的奖励塑造

Extend the reward_rlvr function from this chapter so that it assigns partial credit based on output format. Specifically, modify the reward function so that it returns 1.0 if the model produces the correct answer in the required \boxed{} format, 0.5 if the answer is correct but not boxed, and 0.0 otherwise.

扩展本章中的 reward_rlvr 函数，使其根据输出格式给予部分奖励。具体来说，修改奖励函数：如果模型以要求的 \boxed{} 格式给出正确答案，则返回 1.0；如果答案正确但未使用 \boxed{} 括起来，则返回 0.5；否则返回 0.0。

6.7 Preparing learning signals from rollouts via advantages

6.7 通过优势函数从采样轨迹中构建学习信号

We now move on from rewards to the so-called advantages, as shown in figure 6.15. While rewards tell us how well each individual rollout performed, advantages capture how a rollout performed relative to other rollouts generated for the same prompt.

现在，我们从奖励转到所谓的优势函数，如图6.15所示。奖励告诉我们每一条轨迹的整体表现如何，而优势函数则衡量一条轨迹相对于同一提示下生成的其他轨迹的表现优劣。

Figure 6.15 The third GRPO stage computes the advantage values from the answer (rollout) correctness rewards.
图6.15 第三阶段的GRPO根据答案（rollout）的正确性奖励计算优势值。

The advantage values shown in figure 6.15 are computed by a simple formula:

图6.15中所示的优势值是通过一个简单的公式计算得出的：

Here

这里

  • 𝑟𝑖 denotes the reward of the i-th rollout,
  • 𝑟𝑖 表示第 𝑖 次采样的奖励，
  • 𝜇𝑟 is the mean reward across the group of rollouts,
  • 𝜇𝑟 是一组轨迹的平均奖励，
  • σ𝑟 is the corresponding standard deviation,
  • σ𝑟 是相应的标准差，
  • and ϵ is a small constant added for numerical stability to avoid zero-division errors.
  • 其中，ϵ 是为数值稳定性而添加的一个小常数，用于避免除以零的错误。

In code, we can implement the advantage calculation as follows:

在代码中，我们可以按如下方式实现优势值的计算：

Listing 6.8 Calculating advantages
rewards = torch.tensor(rollout_rewards, device=device)
advantages = (rewards - rewards.mean()) / (rewards.std() + 1e-4)
print(rewards)
print(advantages)
奖励 = torch.tensor(rollout_rewards, device=device) 优势 = (奖励 - 奖励.mean()) / (奖励.std() + 1e-4) print(奖励) print(优势)

The rewards, which we computed in the previous section, are [1., 1., 0., 0.], and the corresponding advantages are [0.8659, 0.8659, -0.8659, -0.8659].

我们在上一节中计算的奖励为 [1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0]，相应的优势为 [0.8659, 0.8659, -0.8659, -0.8659]。

These advantage values capture which responses performed better than average and which performed worse than average within the group.

这些优势值用于捕捉在该组内，哪些反应表现优于平均水平，哪些反应表现低于平均水平。

Note
注意

The "GR" (group relative) in GRPO refers to the fact that GRPO generates multiple answers (rollouts) per prompt, and compares them relative to each other to construct a learning signal.

GRPO 中的“GR”（group relative）指的是，GRPO 针对每个提示会生成多个回答（rollout），并基于这些回答之间的相对比较来构建学习信号。

You might still wonder what the point of converting rewards into advantages is. At a practical level, the advantage values directly scale the gradients during the policy update later.

你或许仍然会疑惑：将奖励转换为优势值的意义何在？从实践层面来看，优势值会在后续的策略更新过程中直接用于缩放梯度。

If the advantage is positive, the gradient increases the likelihood of the actions that produced that rollout. If it is negative, the gradient decreases their likelihood. Rollouts with advantage close to zero contribute very little.

如果优势值为正，梯度会增加产生该轨迹的动作的发生概率；如果优势值为负，梯度则会降低这些动作的发生概率。优势值接近于零的轨迹几乎不会对更新产生贡献。

Exercise 6.2: Zero-advantage cases
练习6.2：零优势情形

Modify the rollout rewards so that all rollouts receive the same reward (for example, force all rewards to 0.0 or all to 1.0). Run the advantage computation and verify that the resulting GRPO loss is zero. Why is this behavior desirable in group-relative policy optimization?

修改 rollout 的奖励，使得所有 rollout 都获得相同的奖励（例如，将所有奖励强制设为 0.0 或 1.0）。运行优势计算，并验证由此得到的 GRPO 损失是否为零。为什么在基于群体相对性的策略优化中，这种行为是可取的？

6.8 Scoring rollouts with sequence log-probabilities

6.8 使用序列对数概率进行评分展开

We calculated the rewards and advantages from the rewards. Now, we take a separate branch from the rollouts and compute their log-probabilities (logprobs), as shown in figure 6.16. Logprobs measure how likely the model considers each generated token under its current parameters, as discussed in the previous chapter.

我们已经计算了奖励以及基于这些奖励的优势值。接下来，我们从模拟展开中另辟一条分支，计算每个步骤的对数概率（logprobs），如图6.16所示。如前一章所述，对数概率用于衡量在当前模型参数下，模型认为每个生成的标记出现的可能性大小。

Figure 6.16 The fourth stage in the GRPO pipeline computes log-probabilities for each rollout, which is related to the logprob scorer we developed in the previous chapter.
图6.16 GRPO 流水线的第四步计算每个轨迹的日志概率，这与我们在前一章中开发的日志概率评分器相关。

As shown in figure 6.16, these logprobs, together with the advantages, form the core ingredients of the GRPO policy gradient loss, which we will implement later on.

如图6.16所示，这些对数概率与优势函数共同构成了GRPO策略梯度损失的核心组成部分，我们将在后续实现中使用它们。

Coming back to the logprobs, in the previous chapter we implemented an avg_logprob_answer function that computes the per-token logprobs for the model's answer tokens. These values, often referred to as token-level logprobs in the literature, are obtained by evaluating the likelihood that the model assigns to each generated token under its current parameters.

回到对数概率上来，在上一章中，我们实现了一个 avg_logprob_answer 函数，用于计算模型生成答案文本中每个标记的对数概率。这些值在相关文献中通常被称为标记级对数概率，它是通过评估模型在其当前参数下为每个生成的标记所分配的概率而得到的。

When averaged across the response, these values are often referred to as token-level logprobs and are commonly used for scoring LLM outputs. Averaging is preferred in this context because it provides length normalization, which makes the scores comparable across responses of different lengths.

在对响应进行平均后，这些值通常被称为标记级别的对数概率，并常用于对大语言模型的输出进行打分。在这种情况下，采用平均值更为合适，因为它能够实现长度归一化，从而使不同长度的响应之间的得分具有可比性。

Mathematical definition of token-level log-probabilities
标记级对数概率的数学定义

Mathematically, the token-level logprobs we computed in the previous chapter can be written as

从数学上看，我们在前一章计算的标记级别的对数概率可以写成：

Here

这里

  • 𝑦1, 𝑦2, ..., 𝑦𝑇 denote the tokens in the generated response of length T
  • 𝑦1, 𝑦2, ..., 𝑦𝑇 表示长度为 T 的生成响应中的各个标记。
  • 𝑦<𝑡 represents all previously generated tokens
  • 𝑦<𝑡 表示所有先前生成的标记。
  • x is the input prompt
  • x 是输入提示
  • W denotes the model's weight parameters.
  • W 表示模型的权重参数。

This expression is mathematically identical to the one used in the previous chapter; we simply switch from x to y to distinguish the generated output tokens from the input prompt for clarity.

该表达式在数学上与前一章使用的表达式完全相同；我们仅将变量从 x 改为 y，以清晰地区分生成的输出标记与输入提示。

For reference, the avg_logprob_answer function from the previous chapter is copied below, which we use to compute the logprobs for the previous prompt and answer_text for illustration purposes.

供参考，上一章中的 avg_logprob_answer 函数复制如下，我们将其用于计算先前提示和 answer_text 的对数概率，以作示例说明。

Listing 6.9 Computing token-level log-probabilities (similar to chapter 5)
@torch.inference_mode()
def avg_logprob_answer(model, tokenizer, prompt, answer, device="cpu"):
 
    prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
    answer_ids = tokenizer.encode(answer)
    full_ids = torch.tensor(prompt_ids + answer_ids, device=device)
 
    logits = model(full_ids.unsqueeze(0)).squeeze(0)
    logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
 
    start = len(prompt_ids) - 1
    end = full_ids.shape[0] - 1
 
    t_idx = torch.arange(start, end, device=device)
    next_tokens = full_ids[start + 1 : end + 1]
    next_token_logps = logprobs[t_idx, next_tokens]
 
    return torch.mean(next_token_logps).item()
 
 
avg_logprob_val = avg_logprob_answer(
                   model, tokenizer, 
                   prompt=prompt,
                   answer=answer_text,
                   device=device) 
print(avg_logprob_val)
@torch.inference_mode() def avg_logprob_answer(model, tokenizer, prompt, answer, device="cpu"): prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt) answer_ids = tokenizer.encode(answer) full_ids = torch.tensor(prompt_ids + answer_ids, device=device) logits = model(full_ids.unsqueeze(0)).squeeze(0) logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1) start = len(prompt_ids) - 1 end = full_ids.shape[0] - 1 t_idx = torch.arange(start, end, device=device) next_tokens = full_ids[start + 1 : end + 1] next_token_logps = logprobs[t_idx, next_tokens] return torch.mean(next_token_logps).item() avg_logprob_val = avg_logprob_answer( model, tokenizer, prompt=prompt, answer=answer_text, device=device) print(avg_logprob_val)

This returns -0.061279296875.

这会返回 -0.061279296875。

In GRPO we do not use averaged token-level logprobs. Instead, we work with sequence-level logprobs.

在 GRPO 中，我们不使用平均的标记级对数概率，而是直接使用序列级对数概率。

The reason is that GRPO assigns a single reward and advantage to each rollout, which applies to the entire generated response. Intuitively, logprob should reflect how likely the model was to generate the whole sequence, not an average per token.

原因在于，GRPO 为每一次采样轨迹分配单一的奖励和优势值，这一奖励和优势值适用于整个生成的响应。从直观上看，logprob 应当反映模型生成完整序列的可能性，而非每个 token 的平均概率。

We compute sequence-level logprobs by summing the logprobs of all generated tokens. (This sum corresponds to the log-likelihood of producing the full response under the current model parameters.)

我们通过将所有已生成标记的对数概率相加来计算序列级别的对数概率。（该求和对应于在当前模型参数下生成完整响应的对数似然。）

In contrast, averaging token-level logprobs normalizes by sequence length. While this normalization is useful for scoring and comparing responses of different lengths, it would unintentionally rescale the learning signal in policy optimization and cause longer and shorter responses to contribute unevenly to the update. (While this is not the intention of the original GRPO formulation, we will revisit token-level logprobs when improving the algorithm in the next chapter.)

相比之下，对标记级对数似然进行平均会按序列长度进行归一化。尽管这种归一化对于评分以及比较不同长度的回答很有用，但它会在策略优化过程中无意中重新缩放学习信号，导致较长和较短的回答对参数更新的贡献不均衡。（虽然这并非原始 GRPO 方法的本意，但我们将在下一章改进算法时重新讨论标记级对数似然。）

We can convert the token-level, length-normalized score into a sequence-level logprobs by dropping the averaging step and replacing torch.mean(next_token_logps) with torch.sum(next_token_logps) in the code in listing 6.9.

我们可以通过去掉平均步骤，并将列表6.9中的代码中 torch.mean(next_token_logps) 替换为 torch.sum(next_token_logps)，从而将基于标记级别的、经过长度归一化的得分转换为序列级别的对数概率。

The same result can also be obtained by multiplying the averaged logprob by the number of answer tokens, as long as the token count matches exactly:

只要标记数完全匹配，也可以通过将平均对数概率乘以答案标记的数量来得到相同的结果：

sequence_logprob_val = avg_logprob_val * (
    len(tokenizer.encode(answer_text))
)
print(sequence_logprob_val)
序列对数似然值 = 平均对数似然值 * ( len(tokenizer.encode(答案文本)) ) print(序列对数似然值)

This now returns -16.239013671875.

现在返回 -16.239013671875。

These sequence-level logprobs scale linearly with the sequence length T, which means that longer responses generally receive more negative logprob values. As a result, for two equally good answers, the optimization implicitly favors the shorter one, since it is cheaper in terms of likelihood. Summed logprobs therefore encourage the model to stop earlier unless producing a longer response is justified by a higher reward.

这些序列级别的对数概率随序列长度 T 呈线性增长，这意味着较长的响应通常会获得更负的对数概率值。因此，在两个质量相当的答案中，优化过程会隐式地偏好较短的答案，因为在似然度上它更为“经济”。由此可见，对数概率的累加会促使模型提前停止生成，除非生成更长的响应能够带来更高的奖励，从而证明其合理性。

So, as mentioned before, we can replace torch.mean with torch.sum in the function to obtain sequence-level logprobs. Since the function was run in inference mode in the previous chapter using the @torch.inference_mode() decorator, we need to redefine it (without the decorator) anyway so that PyTorch can track gradients.

因此，如前所述，我们可以在该函数中用 `torch.sum` 替代 `torch.mean`，从而得到序列级别的对数概率。由于在上一章中，该函数是在推理模式下运行的，并使用了 `@torch.inference_mode()` 装饰器，所以我们无论如何都需要重新定义它（去掉该装饰器），以便 PyTorch 能够跟踪梯度。

In addition, because sample_response from section 6.5 already returns the token_ids and prompt_len, we can simplify the implementation by dropping the explicit tokenization step and the construction of full_ids.

此外，由于第6.5节中的 sample_response 已经返回了 token_ids 和 prompt_len，我们可以通过省略显式的分词步骤以及 full_ids 的构建，来简化实现。

Listing 6.10 Computing sequence-level log-probabilities
def sequence_logprob_draft(model, token_ids, prompt_len):
    logits = model(token_ids.unsqueeze(0)).squeeze(0).float()
    logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
 
    start = prompt_len - 1         #A
    end = token_ids.shape[0] - 1   #A
 
    t_idx = torch.arange(start, end, device=token_ids.device)
    next_tokens = token_ids[start + 1 : end + 1]
    next_token_logps = logprobs[t_idx, next_tokens]
 
    return torch.sum(next_token_logps) #B
 
print(sequence_logprob_draft(model, token_ids, prompt_len))
#A Positions whose next-token probabilities we want to predict
#B Sum log-probabilities over the answer tokens
#A 我们想要预测其下一个标记概率的位置 #B 对答案标记的日志概率求和

This outputs:

这输出：

tensor(-16.2998, grad_fn=<SumBackward0>)
张量(-16.2998, grad_fn=<SumBackward0>)

First, the result is similar to the -16.2421875 we got earlier (the difference is due to floating-point behavior and rounding).

首先，结果与我们先前得到的 -16.2421875 类似（差异是由浮点数运算特性和舍入造成的）。

PyTorch internally builds a computation graph that records each differentiable operation applied to a tensor. The SumBackward0 entry shows that the summation of token log-probabilities is part of this graph, which means gradients can propagate back through the sequence-level log-probability to the model parameters.

PyTorch 在内部构建了一张计算图，用于记录对张量应用的每一个可微操作。SumBackward0 条目表明，标记对数概率的求和是该计算图的一部分，这意味着梯度可以沿着序列级别的对数概率反向传播到模型参数。

This is exactly what we need for policy optimization later, when we implement the training loop to update the model weights via a backward pass. The backward pass applies the backpropagation algorithm, which is the standard method used in deep learning to compute gradients and update neural network weights.

这正是我们在后续进行策略优化时所需要的——当我们将实现训练循环并通过反向传播来更新模型权重时。反向传播会应用反向传播算法，这是深度学习中用于计算梯度并更新神经网络权重的标准方法。

PyTorch computation graphs, gradients, and backpropagation
PyTorch 中的计算图、梯度与反向传播

As the model produces an output, PyTorch records each mathematical operation that leads from the model parameters to that output. This record is called the computation graph. When we later run the backward pass, PyTorch uses this graph to perform backpropagation, that is, computing gradients that describe how changes to the model parameters would affect the final result. If an operation is part of this graph, PyTorch can compute gradients through it during training.

当模型生成输出时，PyTorch 会记录从模型参数到该输出所经过的每一步数学运算。这一记录被称为计算图。在随后执行反向传播时，PyTorch 会利用该计算图来进行梯度计算，即确定模型参数的微小变化将如何影响最终结果。如果某个操作包含在计算图中，PyTorch 就可以在训练过程中通过它来计算相应的梯度。

It is not required to understand PyTorch's computation graphs for this chapter, but interested readers can read more about it in my tutorial at https://sebastianraschka.com/teaching/pytorch-1h/#3-seeing-models-as-computation-graphs.

本章并不需要理解 PyTorch 的计算图，但感兴趣的读者可以在我位于 https://sebastianraschka.com/teaching/pytorch-1h/#3-seeing-models-as-computation-graphs 的教程中进一步了解。

While this draft implementation is a fully working code implementation, we can simplify it a bit and make it more efficient for GPUs. In particular, we can avoid explicitly constructing index ranges and instead use torch.gather to directly select the logprob corresponding to the generated tokens. Listing 6.11 shows a more compact, optimized version of the same computation that produces identical results while being easier to read and faster to execute.

虽然这个实现草案已经是一个完全可用的代码实现，但我们仍可以对其进行一些简化，使其在 GPU 上运行得更加高效。具体来说，我们可以避免显式地构造索引范围，转而使用 torch.gather 直接选取与生成的标记相对应的对数概率。清单 6.11 展示了同一计算的更简洁、更优化的版本，它不仅产生完全相同的结果，而且更易于阅读、执行速度更快。

Listing 6.11 Optimized sequence-level log-probabilities code
def sequence_logprob(model, token_ids, prompt_len):
    logits = model(token_ids.unsqueeze(0)).squeeze(0).float()
    logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    selected = logprobs[:-1].gather(
        1, token_ids[1:].unsqueeze(-1)
    ).squeeze(-1)
    return torch.sum(selected[prompt_len - 1:])
 
print(sequence_logprob(model, token_ids, prompt_len))
def sequence_logprob(model, token_ids, prompt_len): logits = model(token_ids.unsqueeze(0)).squeeze(0).float() logprobs = torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1) selected = logprobs[:-1].gather( 1, token_ids[1:].unsqueeze(-1) ).squeeze(-1) return torch.sum(selected[prompt_len - 1:]) print(sequence_logprob(model, token_ids, prompt_len))

Similar to the previous code, this returns tensor(-16.2998, grad_fn=<SumBackward0>).

与之前的代码类似，这会返回 tensor(-16.2998, grad_fn=<SumBackward0>)。

Tip
提示

We could compute these logprobs directly in the sample_response function to improve efficiency by avoiding calling model(...) twice (in both the sample_response and sequence_logprob functions).

我们可以在 `sample_response` 函数中直接计算这些对数概率，以提高效率，避免在 `sample_response` 和 `sequence_logprob` 两个函数中分别调用 `model(...)` 两次。

Finally, with a robust and efficient sequence-level logprob function in place, we can calculate the respective logprobs of the four different rollouts.

最后，借助一个健壮且高效的序列级对数概率函数，我们可以计算四种不同展开路径各自的对数概率。

Answer:  \boxed{83}

答案：\boxed{83} 日志概率：-7.9243 答案：正确答案是\boxed{83} 日志概率：-20.1546 答案：最终答案是83 日志概率：-16.6130 答案：我们得到\boxed{38} 日志概率：-23.3677

As we can see, shorter and more concise answers receive higher (less negative) sequence-level logprobs than longer or more verbose responses. The exception is the last answer, which receives the lowest score. Note that this is the only answer that contains the incorrect numerical answer value (38 instead of 83), so this also makes intuitive sense.

正如我们所见，篇幅较短、更加简洁的回答在序列级对数似然得分上往往更高（即负值更小），而篇幅较长或过于冗长的回答则得分较低。唯一的例外是最后一个回答，其得分最低。需要注意的是，这是唯一一个包含错误数值答案（38而非83）的回答，因此这一结果也符合直觉。

Overall, this illustrates how summed logprobs naturally favor concise outputs, which is consistent with their role in GRPO when rewards and advantages are applied at the sequence level.

总的来说，这说明累加的对数概率自然倾向于生成简洁的输出，这与其在 GRPO 中的作用一致——即在序列级别上应用奖励和优势函数时。

6.9 From advantages to policy updates via the GRPO loss

6.9 通过GRPO损失从优势到政策更新

We now implement the fifth stage of the GRPO pipeline, where the previously computed advantages and logprobabs are combined into a policy gradient loss. We implement the subsequent weight update (stage six) later as part of the training loop, as shown in figure 6.17.

我们现在实现 GRPO 流水线的第五个阶段，在该阶段将先前计算的优势和对数概率结合成策略梯度损失。后续的权重更新（第六阶段）将在训练循环中稍后实现，如图 6.17 所示。

Figure 6.17 The fifth stage in the GRPO pipeline computes the policy gradient loss that we use to update the model. Stage number 6, the model weight update, will be implemented as part of the training loop later.
图6.17 GRPO流水线的第五步计算用于更新模型的策略梯度损失。第六步，即模型权重更新，将在稍后的训练循环中实现。

First, we convert the list of the rollout logprobs from the previous section into a PyTorch tensor. Then, we compute the policy gradient loss by multiplying each rollout's sequence-level logprob by its corresponding advantage, taking the mean across rollouts, and applying a negative sign. Regarding the negative sign, because PyTorch optimizers are defined to minimize a loss, objectives that are naturally written as maximization problems must be sign-flipped.

首先，我们将上一节中的回放轨迹对数概率列表转换为 PyTorch 张量。然后，通过将每个回放轨迹的序列级对数概率与其对应的优势相乘、在所有回放轨迹上取平均，并加上负号，来计算策略梯度损失。至于负号，这是因为 PyTorch 的优化器被定义为最小化损失，因此那些自然表述为最大化问题的目标需要取相反数。

Listing 6.13 Computing the policy gradient loss
logps = torch.stack(rollout_logps)
pg_loss =
-(advantages.detach() * logps).mean()
print(logps)
print(pg_loss)
logps = torch.stack(rollout_logps) pg_loss = -(advantages.detach() * logps).mean()print(logps)print(pg_loss)

This prints

这会打印

tensor([
-7.9243, -20.1546, -16.6130, -23.3677],
grad_fn=<StackBackward0>)
张量([ -7.9243, -20.1546, -16.6130, -23.3677]), grad_fn=<StackBackward0>)

for the logprobs, and the resulting policy gradient loss value is

对于对数概率，由此得到的策略梯度损失值是

tensor(-2.5764, grad_fn=<NegBackward0>)
张量(-2.5764, grad_fn=<NegBackward0>)

Note that we use .detach() on the advantages because they are treated as fixed learning signals during the policy update. This prevents gradients from flowing back through the advantage computation. This ensures that only the model parameters influencing the logprobs are updated.

请注意，我们在优势函数上使用了 `.detach()`，因为在策略更新过程中，优势函数被视为固定的学习信号。这样做可以阻止梯度通过优势函数的计算路径回传，从而确保只有影响对数概率的模型参数会被更新。

For instance, in policy gradient methods, we want to maximize the advantage-weighted logprob of the rollouts, since higher log-probabilities for high-advantage rollouts improve the policy.

例如，在策略梯度方法中，我们希望最大化基于优势函数加权的轨迹日志似然值，因为对于优势较大的轨迹，其更高的日志似然值能够更好地改进策略。

So, by multiplying this objective by −1, we convert the maximization problem into an equivalent minimization problem. Note that minimizing the negative objective produces the exact same parameter updates as maximizing the original one, but this way, it remains compatible with PyTorch's optimizer implementations.

因此，通过将该目标函数乘以 −1，我们可以把最大化问题转化为一个等价的最小化问题。需要注意的是，最小化负的目标函数所产生的参数更新与最大化原始目标函数时完全相同，但这样做的好处是，它仍然与 PyTorch 的优化器实现保持兼容。

Maximization versus minimization
最大化 versus 最小化

To illustrate the sign flipping further with a concrete example, suppose the objective we want to maximize is a simple scalar value 𝑓(𝑥) = 3.

为了通过一个具体的例子进一步说明符号反转，假设我们要最大化的目标是一个简单的标量值 𝑓(𝑥) = 3。

Under the maximization view, a larger value is better, so 3 is preferable to 2. PyTorch optimizers minimize, so they would try to reduce this value, which is the opposite of what we want.

在最大化视角下，数值越大越好，因此 3 比 2 更优。而 PyTorch 的优化器是用于最小化目标的，所以它们会试图降低这个值，这与我们的需求正好相反。

Now, suppose we flip the sign and define the loss as 𝐿(𝑥) = - 𝑓(𝑥) = -3.

现在，假设我们改变符号，将损失函数定义为 𝐿(𝑥) = -𝑓(𝑥) = -3。

Minimizing 𝐿(𝑥) is now is equivalent to maximizing 𝑓(𝑥). For instance, if 𝐿(𝑥) decreases from −2 to −3, 𝑓(𝑥) increases from 2 to 3.

现在，最小化 𝐿(𝑥) 等价于最大化 𝑓(𝑥)。例如，如果 𝐿(𝑥) 从 −2 减少到 −3，那么 𝑓(𝑥) 就从 2 增加到 3。

Mathematical definition of the policy gradient loss
策略梯度损失的数学定义

For readers who find it easier to follow the computations via mathematical notation, the policy gradient loss used in GRPO can be written as

对于更习惯于通过数学符号理解计算过程的读者，GRPO 中使用的策略梯度损失可以写成：

Here,

这里，

  • N denotes the number of rollouts,
  • N 表示模拟次数，
  • 𝑦𝑡(𝑖), …, 𝑦𝑇𝑖(𝑖) are the tokens of the i-th generated response of length 𝑇𝑖,
  • 𝑦𝑡(𝑖), …, 𝑦𝑇𝑖(𝑖) 是第 𝑖 个生成回复的标记，该回复的长度为 𝑇𝑖。
  • 𝑦<𝑡(𝑖) represents represents all previously generated tokens in that response,
  • 𝑦<𝑡(𝑖) 表示该响应中所有已生成的标记，
  • 𝑥(𝑖) is the corresponding input prompt,
  • 𝑥(𝑖) 是相应的输入提示，
  • And 𝐴𝑖 is the advantage of the full rollout.
  • 而 𝐴𝑖 是完整轨迹的优势。

The inner sum computes the sequence-level log-probability of a rollout, while the outer average computes the advantage-weighted log-probabilities across rollouts.

内层求和计算单条轨迹的序列级对数概率，而外层平均则计算所有轨迹的优势加权对数概率的平均值。

6.10 Putting everything together in a single GRPO function

6.10 将所有内容整合到一个 GRPO 函数中

We have now completed the most challenging parts of this chapter and walked through each GRPO stage in isolation.

我们现已完成本章中最具挑战性的部分，并单独逐个介绍了GRPO的各个阶段。

Next, we combine the five GRPO stages shown in figure 6.18 into a single compute_grpo_loss function, which we will later use as part of the full training loop.

接下来，我们将图6.18中所示的五个GRPO步骤合并为一个compute_grpo_loss函数，该函数稍后将作为完整训练循环的一部分使用。

(Note that here, the term stage refers to a conceptual component of the GRPO loss computation, based on how we walked through the GRPO algorithm step-by-step, not a training step in the outer optimization loop.)

（请注意，在此处，“阶段”一词指的是 GRPO 损失计算中的一个概念性组成部分，它是基于我们逐步讲解 GRPO 算法的方式而定义的，而非外层优化循环中的一个训练步骤。）

Figure 6.18 The complete GRPO workflow where (1) multiple rollouts are generated for a prompt, (2) assigned correctness rewards, (3) converted into group-relative advantages, and (4) combined with log probabilities to (5) compute the policy gradient loss. The loss gradients (6) will be computed and used to update the model in the next section.
图6.18 完整的GRPO工作流，其中：(1) 为给定提示生成多个展开序列；(2) 为每个展开序列分配正确性奖励；(3) 将这些奖励转换为群体相对优势；(4) 将群体相对优势与日志概率相结合，以(5) 计算策略梯度损失。随后将计算损失的梯度(6)，并在下一节中用于更新模型。

The compute_grpo_loss function that combines all the stages from figure 6.18 that we discussed previously is shown in listing 6.14 below.

我们将先前讨论的图6.18中的所有阶段组合在一起的compute_grpo_loss函数，如下面的列表6.14所示。

Listing 6.14 Combining all GRPO stages
def compute_grpo_loss(
    model,
    tokenizer,
    example,
    device,
    num_rollouts=2,
    max_new_tokens=256,
    temperature=0.8,
    top_p=0.9,
):
    assert num_rollouts >= 2
    roll_logps, roll_rewards, samples = [], [], []
    prompt = render_prompt(example["problem"])
 
    was_training = model.training
    model.eval()
 
    for _ in range(num_rollouts):
        #A
        token_ids, prompt_len, text = sample_response(
            model=model,
            tokenizer=tokenizer,
            prompt=prompt,
            device=device,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=top_p,
        )
        #B
        reward = reward_rlvr(text, example["answer"])
        #C
        logp = sequence_logprob(model, token_ids, prompt_len)
 
        roll_logps.append(logp)
        roll_rewards.append(reward)
        samples.append(
            {
                "text": text,
                "reward": reward,
                "gen_len": token_ids.numel() - prompt_len,
            }
        )
 
    if was_training:
        model.train()
    #D
    rewards = torch.tensor(roll_rewards, device=device)
    #E
    advantages = (rewards - rewards.mean()) / (rewards.std() + 1e-4)
    #F
    logps = torch.stack(roll_logps)
    #G
    pg_loss = -(advantages.detach() * logps).mean()
    loss = pg_loss  # In the next chapter we add a KL term here
 
    return {
        "loss": loss.item(),
        "pg_loss": pg_loss.item(),
        "rewards": roll_rewards,
        "advantages": advantages.detach().cpu().tolist(),
        "samples": samples,
        "loss_tensor": loss,
    }
#A Stage 1: generate rollouts
#B Stage 2.1: compute rewards
#C Stage 4.1: compute logprobs
#D Stage 2.2: collect all rewards
#E Stage 3: compute advantages
#F Stage 4.2: collect all logprobs
#G Stage 5: compute policy gradient loss
#A 第一阶段：生成轨迹 #B 第二阶段1：计算奖励 #C 第四阶段1：计算对数概率 #D 第二阶段2：收集所有奖励 #E 第三阶段：计算优势 #F 第四阶段2：收集所有对数概率 #G 第五阶段：计算策略梯度损失

The compute_grpo_loss function is relatively self-explanatory as it follows the exact stages we implemented manually in the previous sections. Note, though, that after stage 1, the code proceeds directly to stages 2 and 4, rather than stages 3 and 4. This is purely an implementation choice that simplifies the code structure by avoiding the need for multiple nested for-loops while preserving the same logical sequence of operations.

compute_grpo_loss 函数相对直观易懂，因为它严格按照我们在前面各节中手动实现的步骤来执行。需要注意的是，在第 1 阶段之后，代码直接进入第 2 和第 4 阶段，而不是先执行第 3 阶段再执行第 4 阶段。这仅仅是一种实现上的选择，旨在通过避免使用多层嵌套的 for 循环来简化代码结构，同时保持相同的逻辑操作顺序。

Also note that the pg_loss (policy gradient loss) is identical to the overall loss in our examples. This is because we intentionally omit the KL loss term here and add it later in chapter 7 for completeness. As discussed earlier, GRPO is often reported to perform better on math problems when the KL loss term is omitted, which is why we adopt this simplified objective at this stage.

另外请注意，pg_loss（策略梯度损失）在我们的示例中与总损失完全相同。这是因为我们在此处有意省略了KL散度项，并将在第7章中为了完整性将其加入。如前所述，当省略KL散度项时，GRPO在数学问题上的表现往往更好，这也是我们在当前阶段采用这种简化目标函数的原因。

Next, let's try the new compute_grpo_loss function on an example from the MATH training dataset to ensure that it works. Here, we sample only a small number of rollouts (num_rollouts=2) and generate a relatively small number of tokens (max_new_tokens=256) for testing purposes. It may still take several seconds until you see the function return the results.

接下来，我们将在 MATH 训练数据集的一个示例上尝试新的 compute_grpo_loss 函数，以确保其正常工作。这里，我们仅采样少量轨迹（num_rollouts=2），并生成相对较少的标记（max_new_tokens=256），用于测试目的。您可能仍需要等待几秒钟，才能看到该函数返回结果。
