注意：由于运行这些实验可能消耗大量资源，参考结果已提供在附录B中。

7.6.3 More GRPO modifications, tips, and tricks

7.6.3 更多GRPO修改、技巧和窍门

Previously, we implemented a version of GRPO without KL loss term and clipped policy ratios, and format reward for introductory purposes. Then, we added these additional concepts to get a solid foundation and understanding of the original GRPO algorithm, which underlies most of the modern reasoning training frameworks. Figure 7.21 briefly shows this next step which is additional modifications, tips, and tricks.

此前，我们实现了一个不包含KL散度正则化项和策略比例裁剪的GRPO版本，并为了介绍性目的对奖励进行了格式化处理。随后，我们引入了这些额外的概念，以奠定坚实的基础并深入理解原始的GRPO算法——该算法是当前大多数现代推理训练框架的核心。图7.21简要展示了这一步骤，即进一步的修改、技巧与窍门。

Figure 7.21 This last section in this chapter outlines some additional GRPO modifications that emerged in recent months.
图7.21 本章的最后一节概述了近几个月来出现的一些GRPO的额外修改。

As far as RLVR with GRPO goes, we learned that there are many knobs to tune. Besides changing the basic settings such as the learning rate, maximum response length, prompt format, and so on, there is a near infinite number of settings and modifications to try, where exploring a single modification or a small handful of modifications thoroughly can be a whole month- or year-long research project for a small research team.

就带有GRPO的RLVR而言，我们了解到其中有大量超参数需要调优。除了调整学习率、最大响应长度、提示格式等基本设置外，还有几乎无穷无尽的配置选项和修改方式可供尝试。即使只是深入探索一项或少数几项修改，对于一个小型研究团队来说，也可能是一项耗时一个月甚至一年的研究工作。

It is expected that algorithms keep changing and evolving. It is important, though, to understand the fundamentals and general idea behind it to also understand and appreciate these improvements.

可以预见，算法会不断变化和发展。然而，重要的是要理解其基本原理和总体思路，这样才能更好地理解和欣赏这些改进。

In the months following the success of DeepSeek-R1, many researchers proposed changes to the original GRPO algorithm that improved both training stability and final performance. To provide a taste of several suggested improvements, below is a selection from DAPO, Dr. GRPO, DeepSeek-V3.2, and others (you can find a full list of references and links in appendix A):

在DeepSeek-R1取得成功后的几个月里，许多研究者对最初的GRPO算法提出了改进，这些改进既提升了训练稳定性，又提高了最终性能。为了让大家初步了解其中几项建议的优化方法，下面摘录了来自DAPO、Dr. GRPO、DeepSeek-V3.2等模型的相关内容（完整的参考文献和链接列表请参见附录A）：

  1. Zero gradient signal filtering (DAPO)
  2. 零梯度信号滤波（DAPO）
  3. Active sampling (DAPO)
  4. 主动采样（DAPO）
  5. Switch from sequence- to token-level loss (DAPO)
  6. 从序列级损失切换到标记级损失（DAPO）
  7. No KL loss (DAPO and Dr. GRPO)
  8. 无KL损失（DAPO和GRPO博士）
  9. Clip higher (DAPO)
  10. 剪辑更高（DAPO）
  11. Truncated importance sampling (VERL)
  12. 截断重要性采样 (VERL)
  13. No standard deviation normalization (Dr. GRPO)
  14. 无标准差归一化（GRPO博士）
  15. KL tuning with domain-specific KL strengths; zero for math (DeepSeek-V3.2)
  16. 使用领域特定的KL强度进行KL微调；数学领域设为零（DeepSeek-V3.2）
  17. Reweighted KL (DeepSeek-V3.2)
  18. 重加权KL（DeepSeek-V3.2）
  19. Off-policy sequence masking (DeepSeek-V3.2)
  20. 离策略序列掩码（DeepSeek-V3.2）
  21. Keep sampling mask for top-p / top-k (DeepSeek-V3.2)
  22. 为 top-p / top-k 继续采样掩码（DeepSeek-V3.2）
  23. Keep original GRPO advantage normalization (DeepSeek-V3.2)
  24. 保留原始 GRPO 优势归一化（DeepSeek-V3.2）
  25. Per-reward group-wise normalization before aggregation (GDPO)
  26. 在聚合之前按奖励分组进行归一化（GDPO）
  27. Sequence-level importance sampling and clipping (GSPO)
  28. 序列级重要性采样与截断（GSPO）
  29. Clip importance-sampling weights rather than token updates (CISPO)
  30. 对重要性采样权重进行裁剪，而非对令牌更新进行裁剪（CISPO）

Given the already substantial length here, detailed explanations, code examples, and training run results concerning those modifications are outside the scope of this chapter. If you’re interested, you can find these in the supplementary materials at https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/ch07/03_rlvr_grpo_scripts_advanced.

鉴于此处篇幅已较长，有关这些修改的详细说明、代码示例以及训练运行结果超出了本章的讨论范围。如果您感兴趣，可在补充资料中找到相关内容，地址为：https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/ch07/03_rlvr_grpo_scripts_advanced。

7.7 Summary

7.7 总结

  • Training reasoning models with GRPO can become unstable over longer runs, even when the implementation is correct and rewards initially improve.
  • 使用GRPO训练推理模型在长时间运行过程中可能会变得不稳定，即便实现无误且奖励最初呈现上升趋势。
  • Interpreting GRPO training requires tracking multiple metrics jointly (average rewards, response length, evaluation accuracy, advantage statistics, and entropy)
    • Basic metrics such as loss mainly serve as sanity checks in GRPO and should not be over-interpreted in isolation.
    • 诸如损失之类的基本指标在GRPO中主要用作合理性检查，不应单独过度解读。
    • Advantage statistics provide useful diagnostics: the mean should remain near zero by design, while the standard deviation reflects the strength and stability of the learning signal.
    • 优势统计量提供了有用的诊断信息：按设计，其均值应保持在零附近；而标准差则反映了学习信号的强度和稳定性。
    • Entropy measures how uncertain the model is during generation. Very low entropy can signal collapse, and very large entropy can indicate unstable updates and randomness in the model responses.
    • 熵用于衡量模型在生成过程中的不确定性。熵值过低可能表明模型出现坍缩，而熵值过高则可能意味着更新不稳定以及模型输出的随机性较强。
  • Clipped policy ratios limit how much the policy can change between updates and can substantially improve training stability over longer runs.
  • 裁剪策略比率限制了策略在两次更新之间的变化幅度，在较长的训练过程中能够显著提升训练稳定性。
  • Adding a KL divergence term constrains long-term drift from a reference model but can destabilize training when rewards collapse.
  • 加入KL散度项可以约束模型长期偏离参考模型，但在奖励信号坍塌时会导致训练不稳定。
  • For math reasoning tasks, several recent systems report better stability and performance by omitting the KL term altogether.
  • 对于数学推理任务，近期的一些系统通过完全省略KL散度项，报告了更高的稳定性和性能。
  • Auxiliary format rewards can improve the response structure, such as encouraging the use of <think> and </think> tokens.
  • 辅助格式奖励可以优化响应结构，例如鼓励使用<think>和</think>标记。
  • Beyond the original GRPO algorithm, many recent extensions modify advantage normalization, importance sampling, clipping strategies, and KL handling to improve stability and efficiency.
  • 除了最初的GRPO算法之外，近年来涌现出许多改进方法，它们通过调整优势函数的归一化、重要性采样、截断策略以及KL散度的处理方式，来提升算法的稳定性和效率。

8 Distilling reasoning models for efficient reasoning

8 用于高效推理的推理模型提炼

This chapter covers

本章涵盖

  • Hard and soft distillation for reasoning models
  • 推理模型中的硬蒸馏与软蒸馏
  • Creating and preparing a teacher-generated reasoning dataset
  • 创建和准备教师生成的推理数据集
  • Training and evaluating a distilled student model using cross-entropy loss
  • 使用交叉熵损失训练和评估蒸馏后的学生模型

Reasoning performance can be improved not only through inference-time scaling and reinforcement learning, but also through distillation. In distillation, a smaller student model is trained on reasoning traces and answers generated by a larger teacher model. As shown in the overview in figure 8.1, this chapter focuses on this training-time technique.

推理性能不仅可以通过推理时的规模扩展和强化学习来提升，还可以通过知识蒸馏来改善。在知识蒸馏中，一个较小的学生模型会基于由较大教师模型生成的推理轨迹和答案进行训练。如图8.1的概览所示，本章将重点探讨这一训练阶段的技术。

Figure 8.1 A mental model of the topics covered in this book. This chapter focuses on distillation, where a smaller student model is trained on reasoning traces generated by a larger teacher model.
图8.1 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型。本章重点介绍知识蒸馏，即利用大型教师模型生成的推理轨迹来训练一个较小的学生模型。

First, we’ll take a look at a general introduction to model distillation before discussing the individual steps shown in figure 8.1 in more detail.

首先，我们将在详细讨论图8.1中所示的各个步骤之前，先对模型蒸馏进行概览介绍。

8.1 Introduction to model distillation for reasoning tasks

8.1 推理任务中的模型蒸馏简介

Model distillation means training a smaller LLM, the student, on outputs produced by a larger LLM, the teacher. For reasoning models, these outputs usually include not only the final answer but also the intermediate reasoning trace that leads to it.

模型蒸馏是指利用一个更大的语言模型（教师模型）产生的输出来训练一个较小的语言模型（学生模型）。对于推理类模型，这些输出通常不仅包括最终答案，还包括通向该答案的中间推理轨迹。

Distillation is especially relevant because the strongest reasoning models are often too large and expensive to work with directly. For example, DeepSeek-R1 has 671-billion-parameters. Systems at that scale are expensive to develop, expensive to deploy, and far outside what most practitioners can run on local hardware.

知识蒸馏尤为重要，因为目前性能最强的推理模型往往规模过大、成本过高，难以直接使用。例如，DeepSeek-R1 拥有 6710 亿个参数。如此规模的系统不仅研发成本高昂、部署难度大，而且远远超出了大多数研究者和工程师在本地硬件上所能运行的能力范围。

This chapter is meant to show the same general production pattern at a smaller scale. The team behind DeepSeek-R1 created smaller model variants by distilling the 671-billion-parameter teacher model. We follow the same basic idea here, but at a scale that is practical for this book.

本章旨在以更小的规模展示相同的通用生成模式。DeepSeek-R1 团队通过知识蒸馏，从参数量达 6710 亿的教师模型中提炼出了一系列较小的模型版本。我们在此沿用了同样的基本思路，但将模型规模调整至更适合本书实践的水平。

Throughout this book, we deliberately worked with small models rather than training a very large LLM from scratch. But the workflow in this chapter is still the same. We use a stronger teacher to generate reasoning traces, and then train a smaller student to reproduce them. In our setup, this distillation stage also takes only a fraction of the time. Here, the distillation training run takes about 3 hours on a DGX Spark using about 15 GB of RAM, whereas even a few GRPO rounds in chapter 6 took around 12 hours and about 70 GB of RAM on the same hardware.

在整本书中，我们有意使用小型模型，而非从头训练一个超大规模的语言模型。不过，本章的工作流程仍然相同：我们借助性能更强的教师模型生成推理轨迹，再训练一个较小的学生模型来复现这些轨迹。在我们的设置下，这一蒸馏阶段所需的时间也仅为前者的极小部分。具体而言，在一台配备约15 GB内存的DGX Spark上，本次蒸馏训练仅需约3小时；而在第6章中，仅仅几轮GRPO训练就在同一硬件上耗时约12小时、占用约70 GB内存。

Distillation can also be more effective than training a small model with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) from scratch. For example, the DeepSeek-R1 paper reported that its smaller distilled variants outperformed comparable models trained with reinforcement learning alone. In that setup, the largest DeepSeek-R1 model, with 671 billion parameters, acted as the teacher and generated the supervision used to train smaller student models.

知识蒸馏有时甚至比从头开始使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练小型模型更为有效。例如，《DeepSeek-R1》论文报告称，其经过知识蒸馏得到的小型版本在性能上超越了仅通过强化学习训练的同类模型。在该设置中，参数量达6710亿的大型DeepSeek-R1模型充当教师模型，生成用于训练小型学生模型的监督信号。

There are two main types of distillation: hard distillation and soft distillation. In hard distillation, the student is trained on text generated by the teacher, so the teacher's tokens are treated as the targets. In soft distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher's probability distribution over the vocabulary by minimizing the KL divergence, a measure of how different two probability distributions are. These two approaches are illustrated in figure 8.2.

蒸馏主要有两种类型：硬蒸馏和软蒸馏。在硬蒸馏中，学生模型以教师模型生成的文本作为训练数据，因此教师模型的标记被视为目标。而在软蒸馏中，学生模型通过最小化KL散度来学习匹配教师模型对词汇表的概率分布；KL散度是一种衡量两个概率分布之间差异程度的指标。这两种方法如图8.2所示。

Figure 8.2 Hard distillation trains the student on teacher-generated tokens, soft distillation trains the student on the teacher's full output distribution.
图8.2 硬蒸馏让学生学习教师生成的标记，而软蒸馏则让学生学习教师的完整输出分布。

As illustrated in figure 8.2, one option is pure hard distillation. Here, we use only the teacher-generated text as the training target.

如图8.2所示，一种选择是纯硬蒸馏。在这种方法中，我们仅将教师模型生成的文本作为训练目标。

For those familiar with the typical LLM training pipeline, which is covered in more detail in my other book, Build A Large Language Model (From Scratch), hard distillation is just supervised fine-tuning on synthetic data.

对于熟悉典型大语言模型训练流水线的人来说——这一内容在我另一本书《从零开始构建大型语言模型》中有更详细的介绍——硬知识蒸馏实际上就是在合成数据上进行的监督微调。

This is also the setup used for the smaller DeepSeek-R1 distilled models. A large teacher model generates reasoning traces and answers, and the student model is fine-tuned to reproduce them.

这也是用于较小的 DeepSeek-R1 精馏模型的训练方案。一个大型教师模型会生成推理轨迹和答案，而学生模型则经过微调，以复现这些推理轨迹和答案。

According to the DeepSeek-R1 paper, for small models, this distillation approach can result in higher accuracy than training with reinforcement learning.

根据DeepSeek-R1论文，对于小型模型，这种知识蒸馏方法能够带来比强化学习训练更高的准确率。

The main practical advantage of hard distillation is that we only need access to the teacher's generated text, not its logits.

硬蒸馏的主要实际优势在于，我们只需访问教师模型生成的文本，而无需其 logits。

The second option is pure soft distillation. Instead of matching only the teacher's chosen tokens, the student is trained to match the teacher's full output distribution of each token over the whole vocabulary. This gives the student richer information about which alternative tokens the teacher considered plausible, but it requires access to teacher logits or log-probabilities at training time.

第二种方法是纯软蒸馏。与仅匹配教师模型所选的那些标记不同，学生模型被训练为匹配教师模型在所有标记上的完整输出分布。这样，学生可以获得更丰富的信息，了解教师认为哪些替代标记是合理的；不过，这种方法需要在训练时能够访问教师模型的 logits 或对数概率。

A third option combines hard and soft distillation. This is the classic knowledge-distillation setup popularized earlier in computer vision, for example in the paper Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network. In this case, we train on the teacher's actual output tokens while also encouraging the student to match the teacher's full distribution.

第三种方法结合了硬蒸馏和软蒸馏。这是经典的知识蒸馏框架，最早在计算机视觉领域得到推广，例如在论文《Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network》中就有提及。在这种情况下，我们在训练学生模型时，既使用教师模型的真实输出标记，又鼓励学生模型拟合教师模型的完整输出分布。

In practice, hard distillation is much more common for LLMs. One reason is that full teacher logits are usually inaccessible. Proprietary systems such as ChatGPT or Claude may expose generated text, but they generally do not expose the full vocabulary distribution needed for classical soft distillation.

在实践中，针对大语言模型，硬蒸馏更为常见。原因之一在于，教师模型的完整 logits 通常不可获取。诸如 ChatGPT 或 Claude 等专有系统可能会公开生成的文本，但一般不会公开经典软蒸馏所需的完整词汇表分布。

Caution
注意

Reusing generated text for distillation may be restricted by provider-specific usage policies, including the OpenAI and Anthropic Terms of Service, so these should be reviewed carefully in practice before using such outputs for training.

将生成的文本用于知识蒸馏可能会受到各服务商特定使用政策的限制，包括 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的服务条款。因此，在将此类输出用于训练之前，务必仔细审阅这些政策。

Even when logits are available, soft distillation is more cumbersome. The student and teacher usually require the same tokenizers so that their vocabulary distributions line up, which makes this approach easier within the same model family. It is also much more expensive to store and use full token distributions for long reasoning traces. By comparison, storing plain text outputs is cheap and simple.

即使 logits 可用，软蒸馏仍然更加繁琐。通常情况下，学生模型和教师模型需要使用相同的分词器，以便它们的词汇分布能够对齐，这使得该方法在同一模型家族内更为便捷。此外，为较长的推理轨迹存储和使用完整的 token 分布也成本高昂。相比之下，存储纯文本输出则既经济又简单。

Here, we focus on hard distillation in the style of DeepSeek-R1 because it is the more practical setup for most readers. The chapter steps are summarized in figure 8.3.

在此，我们重点介绍DeepSeek-R1风格的硬知识蒸馏，因为它对大多数读者而言更为实用。本章的步骤总结于图8.3。

Figure 8.3 The chapter has four main steps: (1) distillation introduction and overview; (2) dataset preparation (steps 2a-2c); (3) training via distillation (steps 3a-3c); and (4) evaluation.
图8.3 本章包含四个主要步骤：(1) 知识蒸馏简介与概述；(2) 数据集准备（步骤2a–2c）；(3) 通过知识蒸馏进行训练（步骤3a–3c）；以及(4) 评估。

With this overview in place, we can now move from the high-level ideas behind distillation to the practical steps required to implement it. In the next section, we begin by preparing a dataset for distillation, which serves as the foundation for training the student model.

有了这一概述作为基础，我们现在可以从知识蒸馏的高层次理念转向其实现所需的实践步骤。在下一节中，我们首先将准备用于知识蒸馏的数据集，这将作为训练学生模型的基础。

8.2 Generating a dataset for reasoning distillation

8.2 生成用于推理蒸馏的数据集

The first practical step is to create a dataset for training the student model. For us, the student is again the Qwen3 0.6B base model that we used throughout the earlier chapters.

第一步是创建用于训练学生模型的数据集。对我们而言，学生模型依然是我们在前面各章中一直使用的通义千问3 0.6B基础模型。

To build the dataset, we use the 12,000 math problems from the MATH split that do not overlap with the MATH-500 evaluation set. These are the same 12,000 problems that we used in chapters 6 and 7 for RLVR. Instead of sampling multiple student responses and computing rewards, we now feed these problems to an existing reasoning model, DeepSeek-R1 (the teacher model), and collect its responses as training targets. This setup is illustrated in figure 8.4.

为了构建数据集，我们使用了MATH数据集划分中的12,000道数学题，这些题目与MATH-500评估集不重叠。这12,000道题目与我们在第6章和第7章中用于RLVR的那12,000道题目相同。不同的是，我们不再采样多个学生作答并计算奖励，而是将这些题目输入到一个现有的推理模型——DeepSeek-R1（教师模型）——并将其输出作为训练目标。这一设置如图8.4所示。

Figure 8.4 Distillation setup used in this chapter. We use the 12,000 non-overlapping MATH training problems to obtain synthetic solutions from DeepSeek-R1 and later evaluate the distilled Qwen3 student on the separate MATH-500 test set.
图8.4 本章使用的蒸馏实验装置。我们使用12,000个互不重叠的MATH训练样本，从DeepSeek-R1模型中生成合成解，随后在独立的MATH-500测试集上评估经过蒸馏得到的Qwen3学生模型。

In the RLVR setup in chapters 6 and 7, we trained the Qwen3 base model to produce the correct solution and then used a verifier to compare the model's final answer against the reference answer. The verifier produced the reward signal.

在第6章和第7章的RLVR设置中，我们首先训练Qwen3基础模型生成正确答案，然后使用验证器将模型的最终答案与参考答案进行对比。验证器负责生成奖励信号。

In distillation, the supervision is more direct. Instead of comparing the student's answer against the reference solution with a reward function, we compare the student's generated tokens against the teacher's generated tokens, as shown in figure 8.4. In other words, the teacher's response becomes the target sequence. This comparison with RLVR is illustrated in more detail in figure 8.5.

在蒸馏过程中，监督方式更为直接。与使用奖励函数将学生模型的输出与参考答案进行对比不同，我们直接将学生模型生成的标记序列与教师模型生成的标记序列进行对比，如图8.4所示。换言之，教师模型的响应即为目标序列。这种对比方式在RLVR框架下的具体实现如图8.5所示。

Figure 8.5 In RLVR, the generated answer is compared against the ground-truth reference solution (top subpanel), whereas in distillation the student answer is compared against the teacher-generated solution (bottom subpanel).
图8.5 在RLVR中，生成的答案与真实参考答案进行比较（上子图）；而在知识蒸馏中，学生模型生成的答案则与教师模型生成的答案进行比较（下子图）。

A practical advantage of distillation is that we can generate the teacher dataset ahead of time before training the student.

蒸馏的一个实际优势在于，我们可以在训练学生模型之前，提前生成教师数据集。

Because generating teacher answers for all 12,000 math problems can be time- and resource-intensive, I created this dataset ahead of time using the 671-billion-parameter DeepSeek-R1 model hosted via OpenRouter.

由于为全部12,000道数学题生成教师答案会耗费大量时间和资源，我事先使用通过OpenRouter托管的6710亿参数DeepSeek-R1模型创建了该数据集。

The full data generation cost was approximately $50 in API usage. Next, we simply load this pre-generated dataset, so you do not need to generate it yourself to follow along. If you are curious about the data-generation process, the code and usage instructions are available in the supplementary materials at https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/ch08/02_generate_distillation_data.

完整的数据生成成本约为50美元的API调用费用。接下来，我们直接加载这个预先生成的数据集，因此您无需自行生成数据即可跟随本教程操作。如果您对数据生成过程感兴趣，相关代码和使用说明已发布在附录资料中，地址为：https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/ch08/02_generate_distillation_data。

8.3 Loading the MATH training dataset for distillation

8.3 加载用于知识蒸馏的 MATH 训练数据集

We now load the distilled MATH dataset generated by DeepSeek-R1 in the previous step. Each example contains a math problem together with a reasoning trace and final answer that we can use as the target for supervised fine-tuning. This step is highlighted in figure 8.6.

现在，我们加载在上一步中由 DeepSeek-R1 生成的蒸馏版 MATH 数据集。每个样本都包含一道数学题、相应的推理过程以及最终答案，我们可以将这些作为监督微调的目标。这一步在图 8.6 中有重点标注。

Figure 8.6 Chapter overview with the current section highlighted. Here, we load the DeepSeek-R1-generated dataset from a JSON file before preparing it for training.
图8.6 章节概览，当前章节已高亮显示。在此，我们从JSON文件中加载DeepSeek-R1生成的数据集，然后再将其准备用于训练。

I made the dataset available via the Hugging Face Hub rather than GitHub because the JSON file is approximately 107 MB, which exceeds GitHub's 100 MB file size limit: https://huggingface.co/datasets/rasbt/math_distill. The following helper function downloads the selected partition if it is not already cached locally and returns it as a Python object.

我将数据集发布在 Hugging Face Hub 上，而不是 GitHub 上，原因是 JSON 文件大小约为 107 MB，超过了 GitHub 100 MB 的文件大小限制：https://huggingface.co/datasets/rasbt/math_distill。以下辅助函数会在所选分区尚未本地缓存时将其下载下来，并以 Python 对象的形式返回。

Listing 8.1 Loading the distilled MATH training split
import json
import requests
from pathlib import Path
 
 
def load_distill_data(
    local_path=None,
    partition="deepseek-r1-math-train",
    save_copy=True,
):
 
    if local_path is None:
        local_path = f"{partition}.json"
    local_path = Path(local_path)
 
    url = (
        "https://huggingface.co/datasets/rasbt/math_distill"
        "/resolve/main/data/"
        f"{partition}.json"
    )
    backup_url = (
        "https://f001.backblazeb2.com/file/reasoning-from-scratch/"
        f"MATH/{partition}.json"
    )
 
    if local_path.exists(): #A
        with local_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
 
        size_kb = local_path.stat().st_size / 1e3
        print(f"{local_path}: {size_kb:.1f} KB (cached)")
        return data
 
    assert partition in (
        "deepseek-r1-math-train",
        "deepseek-r1-math500",
        "qwen3-235b-a22b-math-train",
        "qwen3-235b-a22b-math500",
    )
 
    try:  #B
        r = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
    except requests.RequestException:
        print("Using backup URL.")
        r = requests.get(backup_url, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
 
    data = r.json()
 
    if save_copy:  #C
        with local_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
 
        size_kb = local_path.stat().st_size / 1e3
        print(f"{local_path}: {size_kb:.1f} KB")
 
    return data
#A Reuse a cached copy if the dataset was already downloaded
#B Try downloading from Hugging Face first
#C Save a local copy so later runs can skip the download
#A 如果数据集已经下载过，就复用缓存的副本 #B 先尝试从 Hugging Face 下载 #C 保存本地副本，以便后续运行时跳过下载

The output is:

输出是：

deepseek-r1-math-train.json: 107538.0 KB
Dataset size: 12000
deepseek-r1-math-train.json: 107538.0 KB 数据集大小：12000

Next, let's inspect one of the training examples to understand the dataset structure and see exactly what fields the teacher-generated data contains. For this, we pick one of the training examples (the fifth one) for illustration purposes:

接下来，让我们检查其中一个训练样本，以了解数据集的结构，并查看教师生成的数据具体包含哪些字段。为此，我们选取第5个训练样本作为示例：

from pprint import pprint
pprint(math_train[4])
从 pprint 导入 pprint pprint(数学训练[4])

The printed output is as follows:

打印输出如下：

{'gtruth_answer': '6',
 'message_content': 'Sam worked \\( x \\) days and did...'
 'message_thinking': "Okay, let's see. Sam was hired for 20 days...'
 'problem': 'Sam is hired for a 20-day period...'
}
{ 'gtruth_answer': '6', 'message_content': '萨姆工作了 \\( x \\) 天，并且做了...', 'message_thinking': '好的，我们来看看。萨姆被雇佣了20天...', 'problem': '萨姆被雇佣了一个20天的期限...' }

Each dataset entry contains the math problem itself (problem), the ground-truth answer (gtruth_answer), the teacher's reasoning trace in message_thinking, and the final answer in message_content.

每个数据集条目包含数学题目本身（problem）、真实答案（gtruth_answer）、教师的解题思路记录（message_thinking）以及最终答案（message_content）。

For distillation, the two most important fields are the reasoning trace and the final answer, because together they form the target text that the student should learn to reproduce.

对于知识蒸馏而言，两个最重要的环节是推理轨迹和最终答案，因为二者共同构成了学生应当学会复现的目标文本。

The format_distilled_answer function in listing 8.2 combines these two fields into a single training target by placing the reasoning trace inside <think>...</think> tags and then appending the final answer.

清单 8.2 中的 format_distilled_answer 函数通过将推理轨迹置于 <think>…</think> 标签内，再在其后附加最终答案，从而将这两个字段合并为一个单一的训练目标。

Listing 8.2 Formatting teacher responses for distillation
def format_distilled_answer(entry):
    content = str(entry["message_content"]).strip()
    if not content:
        raise ValueError("Missing non-empty 'message_content' field.")
 
    thinking = str(entry["message_thinking"]).strip()
    return f"<think>{thinking}</think>\n\n{content}"
 
print(format_distilled_answer(math_train[4]))
def format_distilled_answer(entry): content = str(entry["message_content"]).strip() if not content: raise ValueError("缺少非空的 'message_content' 字段。") thinking = str(entry["message_thinking"]).strip() return f"<think>{thinking}</think>\n\n{content}" print(format_distilled_answer(math_train[4]))

The printed output is:

打印输出是：

<think>Okay, let's see. Sam was hired for 20 days. Each day he works, he earns $60...So answer is 6 days not worked.</think>
Sam worked \( x \) days and did not work \( y \) days. We know:...
Sam did not work \(\boxed{6}\) days.
<思考>好吧，我们来看一下。萨姆被雇用了20天。他每天工作能赚60美元……所以答案是没工作的6天。</思考> 萨姆工作了 \( x \) 天，没工作了 \( y \) 天。我们知道：…… 萨姆没工作 \(\boxed{6}\) 天。

As discussed in the previous chapter, the <think></think> tokens are optional. They are not required for distillation itself, though they can be useful for clearly separating the reasoning trace from the final answer.

如前一章所述，<think>标记是可选的。它们对于蒸馏过程本身并不是必需的，但可以帮助清晰地将推理轨迹与最终答案区分开来。

This separation becomes helpful when implementing user interfaces that hide the verbose reasoning trace from end users. Some systems, including products such as ChatGPT, may display only the final answer while hiding portions of the internal reasoning. Teaching the model to use explicit <think> tags makes these traces easier to parse and handle.

这种分离在实现用户界面时非常有用，因为它可以向最终用户隐藏冗长的推理轨迹。一些系统，包括ChatGPT等产品，可能只显示最终答案，而隐藏内部推理的其他部分。通过训练模型使用显式的<think>标签，可以使这些推理轨迹更易于解析和处理。

Since the dataset also contains ground-truth labels, we can measure how accurate the teacher model was on this set. For convenience, we use the evaluate_json.py script from the supplementary materials of chapter 3, which compares generated answers against the reference answers using the verifier implemented in that chapter. 8.4 Building training examples

8.4 构建训练样本

Next, we convert the raw dataset entries into training examples that can be consumed by the model. At a high level, this means formatting the prompts and answers consistently, tokenizing them, and storing the resulting token IDs together with the prompt length. The overall preprocessing stage is highlighted in figure 8.7.

接下来，我们将原始数据集中的条目转换为模型可以使用的训练样本。从高层次来看，这包括对提示和答案进行统一的格式化、对其进行分词（tokenization），并将得到的标记ID连同提示长度一起存储起来。整个预处理阶段如图8.7所示。

Figure 8.7 Bringing the loaded dataset into a format suitable for model training by understanding the tokenizer, tokenizing the examples, and filtering and splitting the dataset.
图8.7 通过理解分词器、对示例进行分词以及对数据集进行过滤和拆分，将加载的数据集转换为适合模型训练的格式。

Most of the work here is straightforward preprocessing. In the RLVR chapters, we performed similar preparation on the fly because each training example was sampled once and then discarded. Distillation is different, and we usually loop over the same examples for multiple training epochs. It is therefore more efficient to format and tokenize the dataset once, store the processed examples, and reuse them during training. This is also one reason distillation is often easier to iterate on than RLVR once the teacher data has been collected.

这里的大部分工作都是简单的预处理。在 RLVR 章节中，我们是在训练过程中实时进行类似的准备工作，因为每个训练样本只被采样一次，用完即丢。而知识蒸馏则不同：我们通常会在多个训练轮次中反复使用相同的样本。因此，事先对数据集进行一次格式化和分词处理，将处理后的样本保存下来，在训练时重复使用，效率更高。这也是为什么在收集到教师模型的数据之后，知识蒸馏往往比 RLVR 更容易迭代的一个原因。

What are training epochs?
什么是训练轮次？

Training epoch, or epoch for short, is a classical machine learning and deep learning term. An epoch is one complete pass through the full training dataset. For example, if we train for three epochs, the model sees each training example three times, usually in a different order each time. Multiple epochs help the model gradually improve by revisiting the same data more than once.

训练轮次，简称“轮次”，是机器学习和深度学习中的一个经典术语。一轮次是指模型完整地遍历一次整个训练数据集。例如，如果我们进行三轮次的训练，那么模型会看到每个训练样本三次，而且每次的顺序通常不同。多轮次训练有助于模型通过多次重复使用相同的数据逐步提升性能。

8.4.1 Loading and understanding the tokenizer

8.4.1 加载和理解分词器

We begin with the tokenizer. Here, we use the Qwen3 reasoning tokenizer because it supports the <think>...</think> tokens introduced in chapter 7.

我们从分词器开始。这里我们使用通义千问3的推理分词器，因为它支持第7章中引入的<think>…</think>标记。

Listing 8.3 Loading the Qwen3 reasoning tokenizer
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import (
    download_qwen3_small,
    Qwen3Tokenizer,
)
 
 
def load_reasoning_tokenizer(local_dir="qwen3"):
    download_qwen3_small(
        kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir=local_dir
    )
 
    tokenizer_path = Path(local_dir) / "tokenizer-reasoning.json"
    tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(
        tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path,
        apply_chat_template=True,
        add_generation_prompt=True,
        add_thinking=True,
    )
 
    return tokenizer
 
tokenizer = load_reasoning_tokenizer()
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import ( download_qwen3_small, Qwen3Tokenizer, ) def load_reasoning_tokenizer(local_dir="qwen3"): download_qwen3_small( kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir=local_dir ) tokenizer_path = Path(local_dir) / "tokenizer-reasoning.json" tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer( tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path, apply_chat_template=True, add_generation_prompt=True, add_thinking=True, ) return tokenizer tokenizer = load_reasoning_tokenizer()

We set apply_chat_template=True and add_generation_prompt=True so that the tokenizer applies the same style of prompt formatting used by Qwen3's chat and reasoning models. The example below shows the additional wrapper tokens that are inserted automatically.

我们设置 apply_chat_template=True 和 add_generation_prompt=True，以便分词器应用与通义千问3的对话和推理模型相同的提示格式化风格。下面的示例展示了自动插入的额外包装标记。

prompt = "Sam is hired for a 20-day period..."
prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
decoded_prompt = tokenizer.decode(prompt_ids)
print(decoded_prompt)
prompt = "萨姆被雇佣了20天……" prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt) decoded_prompt = tokenizer.decode(prompt_ids) print(decoded_prompt)

The formatted text is as follows:

格式化后的文本如下：

<|im_start|>user
Sam is hired for a 20-day period...<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
萨姆被雇佣了20天……

In particular, <|im_start|>user marks the start of the user prompt, <|im_end|> marks the end of the prompt, and <|im_start|>assistant marks the start of the model response. This chat-style wrapping is optional, but it is a common convention for instruction and chat fine-tuning.

具体而言，<|im_start|>user 标记用户提示的开始，<|im_end|> 标记提示的结束，而 <|im_start|>assistant 则标记模型响应的开始。这种对话风格的包裹是可选的，但它是指令微调和对话微调中常见的约定。

For the target answer, we disable this wrapping by setting chat_wrapped=False. Otherwise, both the prompt and the answer would introduce their own assistant-start tokens, which is not what we want when concatenating them into a single training sequence:

对于目标答案，我们通过将 chat_wrapped 设置为 False 来禁用这种包裹机制。否则，提示和答案都会各自引入自己的助手起始标记，在将它们拼接成单个训练序列时，这并不是我们希望看到的：

answer = (
    "<think>Okay, let me try to solve "
    "this problem...</think> \\boxed{4}"
)
answer_ids = tokenizer.encode(answer, chat_wrapped=False)
decoded_answer = tokenizer.decode(answer_ids)
print(decoded_answer)
答案 = ( "<think>好吧，让我试着解一下这个题目……</think> \\boxed{4}" ) 答案的token IDs = tokenizer.encode(答案, chat_wrapped=False) 解码后的答案 = tokenizer.decode(答案的token IDs) print(解码后的答案)

As shown, the chat_wrapped=False setting suppressed the chat template for the answer tokens:

如图所示，chat_wrapped=False 设置抑制了答案标记的聊天模板：

<think>Okay, let me try to solve this problem...</think> \boxed{4}
<思考>好吧，让我试着解决这个问题……</思考> \boxed{4}

For training, we need the full sequence of token IDs: the wrapped prompt, followed by the teacher answer, followed by an end-of-sequence token. This is the sequence the model will see during next-token prediction:

在训练时，我们需要完整的 token ID 序列：先是一个被包装好的提示，后面跟着教师提供的答案，最后再接一个序列结束标记。这就是模型在进行下一个 token 预测时会看到的序列：

token_ids = prompt_ids + answer_ids + [tokenizer.eos_token_id]
decoded_token_ids = tokenizer.decode(token_ids)
print(decoded_token_ids)
token_ids = prompt_ids + answer_ids + [tokenizer.eos_token_id]decoded_token_ids = tokenizer.decode(token_ids)print(decoded_token_ids)

The formatted string looks like as follows:

格式化后的字符串如下所示：

<|im_start|>user
Sam is hired for a 20-day period...<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>Okay, let me try to solve this problem...</think>\boxed{4}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user 萨姆被雇佣了20天……<|im_end|> <|im_start|>assistant<|im_end|>

It is worth emphasizing that the reasoning tokenizer is mainly convenient because it already includes the <think></think> tokens. But in principle, we could also use the base tokenizer. Likewise, the chat template is not strictly required. We keep it here because it matches the formatting used by Qwen3's own reasoning models and helps keep the training and evaluation setup consistent.

值得强调的是，推理分词器主要方便之处在于它已经内置了<think> </think>标记。但原则上，我们也可以使用基础分词器。同样地，聊天模板也并非严格必需。我们在此保留它，是因为其格式与通义千问3系列自有推理模型所使用的格式一致，有助于保持训练和评估设置的一致性。

If you later evaluate the model with the scripts from earlier chapters, remember to use --which_model "reasoning" setting so that the evaluation uses the same tokenizer variant.

如果您稍后使用前面章节中的脚本对模型进行评估，请记得使用 --which_model "reasoning" 参数，以确保评估使用相同的分词器版本。

8.4.2 Formatting and tokenizing the dataset

8.4.2 数据集的格式化和分词

After loading and understanding the tokenizer, we can now apply the formatting and tokenization steps to the whole dataset. This transition is highlighted in figure 8.8.

在加载并理解分词器后，我们现在可以将格式化和分词步骤应用到整个数据集上。这一转换在图8.8中得到了突出展示。

Figure 8.8 With the tokenizer step complete, we now move on to apply the formatting and tokenization steps to the whole dataset.
图8.8 在分词步骤完成后，我们现在继续将格式化和分词步骤应用于整个数据集。

With the tokenizer in place, we can now apply the formatting and tokenization steps consistently across the whole dataset via a build_examples function. The full formatting and tokenization pipeline for a single training sample is illustrated in figure 8.9.

有了分词器之后，我们现在可以通过一个 build_examples 函数，在整个数据集上一致地应用格式化和分词步骤。单个训练样本的完整格式化与分词流水线如图 8.9 所示。

Figure 8.9 Example of the tokenization pipeline for one training sample. The math problem is rendered into the chat prompt format, the teacher reasoning trace and final answer are combined via format_distilled_answer, and both parts are concatenated into one token sequence.
图8.9 一个训练样本的分词流水线示例。数学题目被转换为聊天提示格式，教师的推理过程和最终答案通过 format_distilled_answer 函数合并，然后将这两部分拼接成一个完整的标记序列。

As shown in figure 8.9, the build_examples function follows three steps. First, it renders and tokenizes the prompt. Second, it formats and tokenizes the teacher answer. Third, it concatenates both parts and records the prompt length so that we can later compute the loss only on the answer tokens. Listing 8.4 shows how to implement that in code.

如图8.9所示，build_examples 函数分为三个步骤。首先，它对提示进行渲染并分词；其次，对教师答案进行格式化并分词；最后，将这两部分拼接起来，并记录提示的长度，以便后续仅在答案标记上计算损失。清单8.4展示了如何用代码实现这一过程。

Listing 8.4 Building and inspecting tokenized distillation examples
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import render_prompt
 
 
def build_examples(data, tokenizer):
    examples = []
    skipped = 0
 
    for entry in data:
        try:
            #A
            prompt = render_prompt(entry["problem"])
            prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
 
            #B
            target_answer = format_distilled_answer(entry)
            answer_ids = tokenizer.encode(
                target_answer, chat_wrapped=False
            )
 
            #C
            token_ids = (
                prompt_ids + answer_ids + [tokenizer.eos_token_id]
            )
 
            if len(token_ids) < 2:
                skipped += 1
                continue
 
            #D
            examples.append({
                "token_ids": token_ids,
                "prompt_len": len(prompt_ids),
            })
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            #E
            skipped += 1
 
    return examples, skipped
 
 
examples, skipped = build_examples(math_train, tokenizer)
 
print("Number of examples:", len(examples))
print("Number of skipped examples:", skipped)
#A Step 1: Render the problem in the chat format
#B Step 2: Tokenize the teacher reasoning trace and final answer
#C Step 3: Combine prompt and answer for training
#D Store prompt length so we can ignore prompt tokens in the loss later
#E Skip misformatted examples
#A 第1步：将问题渲染成聊天格式 #B 第2步：对教师的推理过程和最终答案进行分词 #C 第3步：将提示和答案合并用于训练 #D 存储提示的长度，以便后续在损失计算中忽略提示部分的标记 #E 跳过格式错误的示例

Number of skipped examples: 0
示例数量：12000 跳过示例数量：0

print(tokenizer.decode(examples[4]["token_ids"]))

You are a helpful math assistant.
Answer the question and write the final result on a new line as:
\boxed{ANSWER}
 
Question:
Sam is hired for a 20-day period...
 
Answer:<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>Okay, let's see. Sam was hired for 20 days.... So answer is 6 days not worked.</think>
...Sam did not work \(\boxed{6}\) days.<|im_end|>
<think>好，我们来看一下。萨姆被雇佣了20天……所以没有工作的天数是6天。</think> …萨姆没有工作\(\boxed{6}\)天。<|im_end|>

Looking at the output above, we can confirm that it checks all the formatting requirements. For instance, it uses the chat template correctly, and the answer's reasoning trace is correctly enclosed in <think></think> tags. Finally, the answer ends with an end-of-sequence token, <|im_end|>.

从上述输出可以看出，它确实符合所有的格式要求。例如，正确地使用了聊天模板，并且答案的推理过程被恰当地包裹在<think></think>标签中。最后，答案以序列结束标记<|im_end|>结尾。

8.4.3 Filtering and splitting the dataset

8.4.3 数据集的筛选与拆分

Once the examples are tokenized, we still need to filter long sequences and split the dataset into training and validation subsets. This step is highlighted in figure 8.10.

在对示例进行分词之后，我们仍然需要过滤掉过长的序列，并将数据集划分为训练集和验证集。这一步骤在图8.10中进行了重点展示。

Figure 8.10 After tokenization, we filter out long sequences and split the remaining examples into training and validation subsets.
图8.10 分词后，我们过滤掉过长的序列，并将剩余的样本划分为训练集和验证集。

After tokenization, it is useful to inspect the sequence lengths. This tells us how long the examples are on average, which samples are extreme outliers, and how aggressive our filtering needs to be. We then remove examples above the chosen maximum length, shuffle the remaining data with a fixed random seed, and split off a small validation set.

分词之后，检查序列长度很有帮助。这能让我们了解样本的平均长度、哪些样本是极端异常值，以及我们需要多大程度地进行过滤。随后，我们移除超过所选最大长度的样本，使用固定的随机种子对剩余数据进行打乱，并从中划分出一个小规模的验证集。

Let's begin with analyzing the sequence lengths via listing 8.5.

让我们从通过列表8.5分析序列长度开始。

Listing 8.5 Computing lengths and filtering long examples
def compute_length(examples, answer_only=False):
    lengths = []
    for ex in examples:
        total = len(ex["token_ids"])
        length = total - ex["prompt_len"] if answer_only else total
        lengths.append(length)
 
    avg_len = round(sum(lengths) / len(lengths))
 
    shortest_len = min(lengths)
    longest_len = max(lengths)
    shortest_idx = lengths.index(shortest_len)
    longest_idx = lengths.index(longest_len)
 
    print(f"Average: {avg_len} tokens")
    print(f"Shortest: {shortest_len} tokens (index {shortest_idx})")
    print(f"Longest: {longest_len} tokens (index {longest_idx})")
 
compute_length(examples)
def compute_length(examples, answer_only=False): lengths = [] for ex in examples: total = len(ex["token_ids"]) length = total - ex["prompt_len"] if answer_only else total lengths.append(length) avg_len = round(sum(lengths) / len(lengths)) shortest_len = min(lengths) longest_len = max(lengths) shortest_idx = lengths.index(shortest_len) longest_idx = lengths.index(longest_len) print(f"平均：{avg_len} 个 token") print(f"最短：{shortest_len} 个 token（索引 {shortest_idx}）") print(f"最长：{longest_len} 个 token（索引 {longest_idx}）") compute_length(examples)

正如我们所见，平均响应长度为2,946个标记，这在推理模型中属于正常范围。不过，也存在一些异常值。例如，最长的回复长达42,005个标记，明显过长。索引位置（第10846位和第2529位）分别表示数据集中最短和最长示例在数据集中的位置，以便我们后续检查。

To keep the computational costs reasonable for this distillation example, we filter the dataset to include only dataset entries of up to 2,048 tokens, using the code in listing 8.6. In practice, controlling the sequence length is one of the main steps that makes distillation feasible on smaller hardware.

为了使这个知识蒸馏示例的计算开销保持在合理范围内，我们按照清单 8.6 中的代码，对数据集进行过滤，只保留长度不超过 2,048 个标记的数据条目。在实际应用中，控制序列长度是使知识蒸馏能够在资源有限的硬件上可行的关键步骤之一。

Listing 8.6 Filtering long examples
def filter_examples_by_max_len(examples, max_len=2048):
    filtered_examples = [
        s for s in examples
        if len(s["token_ids"]) <= max_len
    ]
 
    print("Original:", len(examples))
    print("Filtered:", len(filtered_examples))
    print("Removed:", len(examples) - len(filtered_examples))
 
    return filtered_examples
 
 
filtered_examples = filter_examples_by_max_len(examples, max_len=2048)
def filter_examples_by_max_len(examples, max_len=2048): filtered_examples = [ s for s in examples if len(s["token_ids"]) <= max_len ] print("原始数据量:", len(examples)) print("过滤后数据量:", len(filtered_examples)) print("被移除数据量:", len(examples) - len(filtered_examples)) return filtered_examples filtered_examples = filter_examples_by_max_len(examples, max_len=2048)

训练样本数量：6670 验证样本数量：25

Note that we keep the validation set purposefully small so that we don't unnecessarily slow down the training loop. In addition, after the training is completed, we will also use the 500 samples of the MATH-500 set to evaluate the performance of the model.

请注意，我们特意将验证集保持得较小，以避免不必要地拖慢训练循环。此外，在训练完成后，我们还将使用 MATH-500 数据集中的 500 个样本对模型的性能进行评估。

Exercise 8.1: Training and validation set lengths
练习 8.1：训练集和验证集的长度

Apply the compute_length function to the new train_examples and val_examples partitions to check whether they are balanced based on the sample lengths.

将 compute_length 函数应用于新的 train_examples 和 val_examples 分区，以根据样本长度检查它们是否平衡。

8.5 Loading a pre-trained model

8.5 加载预训练模型

With the dataset preparation complete, we can turn to the actual distillation training. We begin by loading the pre-trained Qwen3 base model, as shown in figure 8.11.

数据集准备完成后，我们可以进入正式的蒸馏训练环节。首先，我们加载预训练的Qwen3基础模型，如图8.11所示。

Figure 8.11 With the dataset preparation complete, we begin the distillation training by loading the pre-trained Qwen3 base model.
图8.11 数据集准备完成后，我们通过加载预训练的Qwen3基础模型来开始知识蒸馏训练。

We start from the pre-trained Qwen3 base model, not from an RL-trained model, because distillation itself is the training stage we want to study here. This keeps the setup clean and makes it easier to attribute any improvement to the distilled reasoning traces. It also mirrors a common practical setup where a general base model is adapted later using teacher-generated data.

我们从预训练的Qwen3基础模型入手，而非从经过强化学习训练的模型开始，这是因为蒸馏本身正是我们在此研究的训练阶段。这样做可以使实验设置更加简洁，并更易于将任何性能提升归因于蒸馏得到的推理轨迹。此外，这也符合实际应用中的常见做法：先使用通用的基础模型，再通过教师模型生成的数据对其进行后续适配。

Listing 8.8 Loading the Qwen3 base model for distillation
import torch
 
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    load_model_and_tokenizer,

device = get_device()
 
model, _ = load_model_and_tokenizer(
    which_model="base",
    device=device,
    use_compile=False,

import torch from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import ( load_model_and_tokenizer, ) device = get_device() model, _ = load_model_and_tokenizer( which_model="base", device=device, use_compile=False, )

Note that we can ignore the loaded base tokenizer in listing 8.8, since we will be using the tokenizer with <think></think> token support we loaded previously in section 8.4.1.

请注意，我们可以忽略清单 8.8 中加载的基础分词器，因为我们将在 8.4.1 节中之前加载的、支持 <think></think> 标记的分词器。

8.6 Computing the training and validation losses

8.6 计算训练损失和验证损失

Next, we implement the cross-entropy loss that serves as the training signal during distillation when we implement the training loop later. We will also reuse the same computation on the validation set to monitor progress during training.

接下来，我们实现交叉熵损失函数，它将在后续的训练循环中作为知识蒸馏过程中的训练信号。我们还会在验证集上复用相同的计算，以监控训练过程中的进展。

Readers with a deep-learning background may already know cross-entropy from classification tasks. The idea is the same here, except that the target class we want to predict at each position is the next token in the teacher-generated sequence.

具有深度学习背景的读者可能已经在分类任务中接触过交叉熵。这里的思路与此相同，只不过我们在每个位置上要预测的目标类别是教师模型生成的序列中的下一个标记。

We can connect this loss directly to the log-probability computations from chapters 5 and 6. As discussed there, log-probability measures how much probability the model assigns to the correct next token. Higher log-probability means the model is more confident in the correct token, and lower log-probability means the opposite. Re-using the "The capital of Germany is Berlin" example from previous chapters, this is recapped in figure 8.12.

我们可以将这一损失直接与第5章和第6章中的对数概率计算联系起来。正如那里所讨论的，对数概率用于衡量模型为正确的下一个标记分配的概率大小。较高的对数概率意味着模型对正确标记更有信心，而较低的对数概率则相反。沿用前几章中“德国的首都是柏林”这个例子，图8.12对此进行了回顾。

Figure 8.12 Illustration of token and sequence log-probabilities. The log-probabilities of the correct next tokens are summed to obtain the sequence log-probability, which is the basis for the cross-entropy loss used later in this chapter.
图8.12 令牌与序列对数概率示意图。将正确下一个令牌的对数概率相加，即可得到序列对数概率，而序列对数概率正是本章后续所用交叉熵损失的基础。

Cross-entropy is simply the negative average of these token log-probabilities shown in figure 8.12. For instance, if -16.6250 is the log-probability, the negative log-probability is 16.6250, the negative average log-probability is 16.6250/5 = 3.325. Note that the 5 is there because the sequence has 5 target predictions whose log-probabilities are being averaged: "The", "capital", "of", "Germany", "is", and "Berlin".

交叉熵 simply 就是图 8.12 中所示这些 token 对数概率的负平均值。例如，如果某个对数概率是 -16.6250，则其负值为 16.6250；而负的平均对数概率就是 16.6250 ÷ 5 = 3.325。请注意，分母之所以是 5，是因为该序列有 5 个目标预测，它们的对数概率被取了平均：分别是“The”、“capital”、“of”、“Germany”、“is”和“Berlin”。

The cross-entropy is also 3.325. (Similar to log-probability, the closer the value is to 0, the better, since the model is more confident in the correct target token.)

交叉熵同样是3.325。（与对数概率类似，值越接近0越好，因为这表明模型对正确的目标词元越有信心。）

The sequence_logprob function from chapter 6 performs exactly this computation shown in figure 8.12, which makes it a useful starting point for understanding how the distillation loss works. In this case, we use the training example at index position 5730, because it's the shortest example in train_examples, which we can determine via compute_length(train_examples), and thus computes a bit more quickly than the other examples:

第6章中的sequence_logprob函数执行的就是图8.12所示的计算，这使得它成为理解蒸馏损失工作原理的一个有用起点。在本例中，我们使用索引位置为5730的训练样本，因为它也是train_examples中最短的样本——我们可以通过compute_length(train_examples)来确定这一点——因此，它的计算速度比其他样本稍快：

token_ids = train_examples[5730]["token_ids"]
prompt_len = train_examples[5730]["prompt_len"]
token_ids = train_examples[5730]["token_ids"] prompt_len = train_examples[5730]["prompt_len"]

Instead of reporting the summed log-probabilities returned by sequence_logprob, we average them over the number of answer tokens. The reason is that summed log-probabilities grow with sequence length, so they are not directly comparable across examples with shorter or longer answers. By dividing by the number of answer tokens, we obtain a per-token quantity, which matches the form used by cross-entropy loss. We compute the number of answer tokens by subtracting prompt_len from the total sequence length:

我们没有报告 sequence_logprob 返回的对数概率之和，而是将其除以答案标记的数量取平均。原因是，对数概率之和会随着序列长度的增加而增大，因此在答案长短不同的样本之间无法直接比较。通过除以答案标记的数量，我们得到每个标记的值，这与交叉熵损失所采用的形式一致。答案标记的数量可以通过从总序列长度中减去提示长度 prompt_len 来计算：

Listing 8.9 Computing average negative log-probabilities
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch06 import sequence_logprob
 
tok = torch.tensor(token_ids, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
 
with torch.no_grad():
    seq_logprob = sequence_logprob(model, tok, prompt_len)
    num_answer_tokens = tok.numel() - prompt_len
    avg_logprob = -seq_logprob / num_answer_tokens
print(f"Average logprob: {avg_logprob:.2f}")
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch06 的 sequence_logprob tok = torch.tensor(token_ids, dtype=torch.long, device=device) with torch.no_grad(): seq_logprob = sequence_logprob(model, tok, prompt_len) num_answer_tokens = tok.numel() - prompt_len avg_logprob = -seq_logprob / num_answer_tokens print(f"平均对数概率：{avg_logprob:.2f}")

The resulting negative average log-probability is 1.68.

所得的平均负对数概率为1.68。

Now, we can compute the same quantity using PyTorch's cross_entropy function. Although the function is usually introduced for classification, it is a natural choice here. For instance, the model logits provide the predicted class distribution over the vocabulary, and the target sequence provides the correct class label at each position.

现在，我们可以使用 PyTorch 的 cross_entropy 函数来计算相同的量。尽管该函数通常用于分类任务，但在这里也是一个自然的选择。例如，模型的 logits 提供了词汇表上各个词的预测概率分布，而目标序列则给出了每个位置的正确类别标签。

As in the previous average-logprob calculation, we compute the loss only over the answer tokens and ignore the prompt tokens (the prompt is the context provided as input, and it is not something we want the model to be penalized for reproducing). This is illustrated in figure 8.13.

与之前的平均对数概率计算一样，我们仅在答案标记上计算损失，而忽略提示标记（提示是作为输入提供的上下文，我们并不希望模型因重现提示而受到惩罚）。这一点在图8.13中有所展示。

Figure 8.13 Input for the cross-entropy loss over the answer tokens. The model receives the prompt and answer shifted by one token as input, and the answer-token logits are compared against the reference answer tokens.
图8.13 用于答案标记的交叉熵损失的输入。模型接收提示和向后偏移一个标记的答案作为输入，并将答案标记的 logits 与参考答案标记进行比较。

During distillation, we want the student to learn the teacher's reasoning trace and final answer conditioned on the prompt, so, as shown in figure 8.13, we discard the logits and targets that correspond only to the prompt portion of the sequence when computing the cross-entropy in listing 8.10:

在蒸馏过程中，我们希望学生能够学习到教师在给定提示下的推理轨迹和最终答案。因此，如图8.13所示，在清单8.10中计算交叉熵时，我们会丢弃仅对应于序列中提示部分的 logits 和目标：

Listing 8.10 Computing cross-entropy loss directly
#A
input_ids = tok[:-1].unsqueeze(0)
target_ids = tok[1:]
logits = model(input_ids).squeeze(0)
 
#B
first_answer_logit_idx = max(prompt_len - 1, 0)
answer_logits = logits[first_answer_logit_idx:]
answer_targets = target_ids[first_answer_logit_idx:]
 
#C
with torch.no_grad():
    ce_mean_direct = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
        answer_logits, answer_targets
    )
print(f"Cross-entropy: {ce_mean_direct:.2f}")
#A Shift the sequence by one token so each input predicts the next token target
#B Drop the prompt positions so the loss only covers the teacher answer
#C Compute cross-entropy loss
#A 将序列整体右移一个标记，使每个输入预测下一个标记的目标 #B 去掉提示部分的位置，使损失只计算教师答案部分 #C 计算交叉熵损失

The resulting cross-entropy loss is 1.68, which is similar to listing 8.9, when we used the sequence_logprob function. In other words, cross_entropy is implementing the same core calculation in a more optimized way. For training, we therefore use the built-in cross_entropy function rather than our custom log-probability function.

得到的交叉熵损失为1.68，这与使用sequence_logprob函数时的示例8.9结果相近。换句话说，cross_entropy以更优化的方式实现了相同的核心计算。因此，在训练过程中，我们通常会使用内置的cross_entropy函数，而不是自己编写的对数概率函数。

The compute_example_loss helper in listing 8.11 below wraps this logic into a convenient function that calculates the answer-only loss for a single example. "Answer-only loss" means the training loss is computed only on the teacher's answer tokens, not on the prompt tokens.

下面的代码清单 8.11 中的 compute_example_loss 辅助函数将这一逻辑封装成一个便捷的函数，用于计算单个示例的答案专用损失。“答案专用损失”是指训练损失仅在教师模型生成的答案标记上计算，而不包括提示标记。

We focus on the answer-only loss because the prompt is already given. And the model's job in distillation is not to learn to reconstruct the input instruction. Its job is to produce the target answer conditioned on that instruction. So we use the prompt as context, but we do not penalize the model for prompt-token predictions.

我们专注于仅计算答案的损失，因为提示已经给定。模型在知识蒸馏中的任务并不是学习重建输入指令，而是根据该指令生成目标答案。因此，我们将提示作为上下文，但不会对模型预测提示中的各个标记施加惩罚。

Now, let's put it all together into a function that applies the whole logic, from target preparation to cross entropy computation, on a given training example in listing 8.11:

现在，让我们将所有步骤整合到一个函数中，该函数针对给定的训练样本，从目标变量的准备到交叉熵的计算，完整地实现整个逻辑，如代码清单 8.11 所示：

Listing 8.11 Defining the loss for one distillation example
def compute_example_loss(model, example, device):
    token_ids = example["token_ids"]
    prompt_len = example["prompt_len"]
 
    #A
    input_ids = torch.tensor(
        token_ids[:-1], dtype=torch.long, device=device
    ).unsqueeze(0)
    target_ids = torch.tensor(
        token_ids[1:], dtype=torch.long, device=device
    )
 
    logits = model(input_ids).squeeze(0)
 
    #B
    answer_start = max(prompt_len - 1, 0)
    answer_logits = logits[answer_start:]
    answer_targets = target_ids[answer_start:]
 
    #C
    loss = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
        answer_logits, answer_targets
    )
    return loss
 
#D
with torch.no_grad():
    loss = compute_example_loss(
        model, train_examples[5730], device
    )
 
print(f"Loss: {loss:.2f}")
#A Create input-target pairs that are shifted by one token
#B Ignore prompt tokens so the loss is computed on the distilled answer only
#C Compute cross-entropy loss
#D Use to verify that the helper returns the same loss as before
#A 创建输入-目标对，其中目标序列比输入序列整体右移一个标记 #B 忽略提示部分的标记，以便仅在提炼后的答案上计算损失 #C 计算交叉熵损失 #D 用于验证辅助函数返回的损失与之前相同

The resulting loss is 1.68 again, which indicates that the function in listing 8.11 works as intended.

得到的损失值再次为 1.68，这表明清单 8.11 中的函数按预期工作。

Batching
批处理

It is also possible to process multiple examples in parallel by batching them together. We omit batching here to keep the implementation compact and the resource requirements lower. Appendix E discusses batching and throughput-oriented execution in more detail for the loss computation and training in general.

也可以通过将多个样本批处理在一起，实现并行处理。为了保持实现的简洁性和较低的资源需求，我们在此省略了批处理。附录E将更详细地讨论批处理以及面向吞吐量的执行方式，尤其是在损失计算和整体训练过程中。

Next, we define a small wrapper that iteratively computes the average loss across multiple examples. This will be useful both for quick sanity checks and for tracking the validation loss during training.

接下来，我们定义一个小型封装函数，用于迭代地计算多个样本的平均损失。这在快速进行合理性检查以及在训练过程中跟踪验证损失时都非常有用。

Listing 8.12 Evaluating loss across multiple examples
@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_examples(model, examples, device):
    was_training = model.training
    #A
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_examples = 0
 
    #B
    for example in examples:
        loss = compute_example_loss(model, example, device)
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_examples += 1
 
    #C
    if was_training:
        model.train()
 
    #D
    return total_loss / num_examples
 
#E
train_loss = evaluate_examples(model, train_examples[:3], device)
print(f"Train loss (3 examples): {train_loss:.2f}")
 
val_loss = evaluate_examples(model, val_examples[:3], device)
print(f"Validation loss (3 examples): {val_loss:.2f}")
#A Temporarily switch to evaluation mode while scoring the examples
#B Sum the loss over all examples
#C Restore training mode so this helper is safe to call during training
#D Average the loss over all examples
#E Estimate the current training loss on a small subset
#A 在对示例进行评分时，临时切换到评估模式 #B 对所有示例的损失求和 #C 恢复训练模式，以便在训练过程中安全调用此辅助函数 #D 对所有示例的损失取平均 #E 在一个小样本集上估计当前的训练损失

The output is:

输出是：

Train loss (3 examples): 0.98
Validation loss (3 examples): 1.02
训练损失（3个样本）：0.98 验证损失（3个样本）：1.02

We will reuse this evaluation function during training. Ideally, both quantities should decrease over time, which indicates that the student model is becoming better at matching the teacher-generated target sequences.

我们在训练过程中会重复使用这个评估函数。理想情况下，这两个值都应随时间逐渐下降，这表明学生模型越来越能够生成与教师模型所生成目标序列相匹配的序列。

In practice, the training loss, which is the loss computed on the training examples used for optimization, is often noisier because it is measured on the examples currently being optimized and can fluctuate depending on the sample order and recent parameter updates.

在实践中，训练损失——即在用于优化的训练样本上计算得到的损失——通常更为波动，因为它是在当前正在优化的样本上计算的，并且会随着样本顺序以及近期参数更新而发生起伏。

The validation loss, which is measured on a separate held-out validation set rather than on the examples currently being used for optimization, is computed without updating the model weights. As a result, it usually provides a cleaner signal of whether the student is improving in a way that generalizes beyond the training set. For this reason, the validation loss is often the more reliable metric to watch.

验证损失是在一个独立的、未参与训练的验证集上计算的，而不是在当前用于优化的样本上计算的。在计算验证损失时，模型权重不会被更新。因此，它通常能更清晰地反映出学生模型是否在朝着能够泛化到训练集之外数据的方向改进。正因如此，验证损失往往是更可靠的监控指标。

8.7 Implementing the training loop for distillation

8.7 实现知识蒸馏的训练循环

With the dataset preparation and loss computation in place, we can now implement the training loop for distillation. This stage is highlighted in figure 8.14.

在完成数据集准备和损失计算之后，我们现在可以实现知识蒸馏的训练循环。这一阶段如图8.14所示。

Figure 8.14 With dataset preparation and loss computation complete, we now turn to the training loop for distillation.
图8.14 在完成数据集准备和损失计算后，我们现在进入知识蒸馏的训练循环。

The training loop is very similar to the one from chapter 6. The main difference is that we now revisit the same training set multiple times across epochs and optimize the cross-entropy distillation loss instead of the GRPO objective (GRPO loss) used in RLVR. The detailed steps are shown in figure 8.15.

训练循环与第6章中的非常相似。主要区别在于，我们现在会在多个 epoch 中多次遍历同一训练集，并优化交叉熵蒸馏损失，而不是在 RLVR 中使用的 GRPO 目标函数（GRPO 损失）。详细步骤如图 8.15 所示。

Figure 8.15 Distillation training loop. In each epoch, the training examples are shuffled, the student model computes a cross-entropy loss for each example, gradients are backpropagated, and the model weights are updated. The validation loss is reported in certain intervals to track progress.
图8.15 蒸馏训练循环。在每个 epoch 中，训练样本会被打乱顺序，学生模型会为每个样本计算交叉熵损失，然后进行梯度反向传播，并更新模型权重。每隔一定间隔会报告验证损失，以跟踪训练进度。

The train_distillation function in listing 8.13 implements the loop shown in figure 8.15. It shuffles the training examples at the start of each epoch, computes the loss for each example, applies an optimizer step, optionally clips large gradients, and periodically evaluates on the validation set. The metrics are also written to a CSV file so that we can inspect the learning curves later.

清单 8.13 中的 train_distillation 函数实现了图 8.15 所示的训练循环。它在每个 epoch 开始时对训练样本进行打乱，为每个样本计算损失，执行一次优化器步骤，可选地对梯度进行裁剪，并定期在验证集上评估模型性能。同时，这些指标会被写入一个 CSV 文件，以便后续查看学习曲线。

Listing 8.13 Implementing the distillation training loop
import time
 
 
def train_distillation(
    model,
    train_examples,
    val_examples,
    device,
    epochs=2,
    lr=5e-6,
    grad_clip_norm=None,
    seed=123,
    log_every=50,
    checkpoint_dir="checkpoints",
    csv_log_path=None,
):
    #A
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    model.train()
 
    total_steps = epochs * len(train_examples)
    global_step = 0
    rng = random.Random(seed)
 
    if csv_log_path is None:
        timestamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        csv_log_path = f"train_distill_metrics_{timestamp}.csv"
    csv_log_path = Path(csv_log_path)
 
    #B
    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        #C
        epoch_examples = list(train_examples)
        rng.shuffle(epoch_examples)
 
        #D
        for example in epoch_examples:
            global_step += 1
 
            #E
            optimizer.zero_grad()
 
            #F
            loss = compute_example_loss(model, example, device)
 
            #G
            loss.backward()
 
            #H
            if grad_clip_norm is not None:
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    model.parameters(), grad_clip_norm
                )
 
            #I
            optimizer.step()
 
            #J
            if log_every and global_step % log_every == 0:
                val_loss = evaluate_examples(
                    model=model,
                    examples=val_examples,
                    device=device,
                )
                model.train()
                print(
                    f"[Epoch {epoch}/{epochs} "
                    f"Step {global_step}/{total_steps}] "
                    f"train_loss={loss.item():.4f} "
                    f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f}"
                )
                append_csv_metrics(
                    csv_log_path=csv_log_path,
                    epoch_idx=epoch,
                    total_steps=global_step,
                    train_loss=loss.item(),
                    val_loss=val_loss,
                )
 
        #K
        ckpt_path = save_checkpoint(
            model=model,
            checkpoint_dir=checkpoint_dir,
            step=global_step,
            suffix=f"epoch{epoch}",
        )
        print(f"Saved checkpoint to {ckpt_path}")
    return model
 
 
def save_checkpoint(model, checkpoint_dir, step, suffix=""):
    checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
    checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = f"-{suffix}" if suffix else ""
    ckpt_path = (
        checkpoint_dir /
        f"qwen3-0.6B-distill-step{step:05d}{suffix}.pth"
    )
    torch.save(model.state_dict(), ckpt_path)
    return ckpt_path
 
 
def append_csv_metrics(
    csv_log_path,
    epoch_idx,
    total_steps,
    train_loss,
    val_loss,
):
    if not csv_log_path.exists():
        csv_log_path.write_text(
            "epoch,total_steps,train_loss,val_loss\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    with csv_log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(
            f"{epoch_idx},{total_steps},{train_loss:.6f},"
            f"{val_loss:.6f}\n"
        )
#A Step 1: initialize optimizer (model is already loaded)
#B Step 2: iterate over training epochs
#C Step 3: shuffle the training examples at the start of the epoch
#D Step 4: iterate over training examples in epoch
#E Stage 5: reset loss gradient
#F Step 6: compute the cross-entropy loss for the current example
#G Step 7: backpropagate gradients
#H Optionally clip large gradients to improve training stability
#I Step 8: update the model weights
#J Step 9: periodically evaluate the current model on the validation set
#K Step 10: record the metrics and save a checkpoint for this epoch
#A 第1步：初始化优化器（模型已加载） #B 第2步：遍历训练轮次 #C 第3步：在每个轮次开始时打乱训练样本 #D 第4步：遍历当前轮次中的训练样本 #E 第5步：重置损失梯度 #F 第6步：计算当前样本的交叉熵损失 #G 第7步：进行反向传播，计算梯度 #H 可选：对过大的梯度进行裁剪，以提高训练稳定性 #I 第8步：更新模型参数 #J 第9步：定期在验证集上评估当前模型 #K 第10步：记录指标并保存该轮次的检查点

With a maximum sequence length of 2048, the full training run requires about 15 GB of GPU memory. If this is too high for your hardware, you can lower the resource requirements by filtering out longer sequences earlier in the notebook, for example by changing max_len from 2048 to 1024 or 512 in the filter_examples_by_max_len step in listing 8.6 (section 8.4.3).

在最大序列长度为2048的情况下，完整的训练运行大约需要15 GB的显存。如果这对您的硬件来说过高，您可以通过在笔记本中更早地过滤掉较长的序列来降低资源需求，例如在列表8.6（第8.4.3节）的`filter_examples_by_max_len`步骤中，将`max_len`从2048改为1024或512。

Let's execute a short training run:

让我们执行一次简短的训练运行：

Listing 8.14 Training the model
torch.manual_seed(0) #A
 
train_distillation(
    model,
    train_examples=train_examples[:10], #B
    val_examples=val_examples[:10],     #B
    device=device,
    epochs=2,
    lr=5e-6,
    grad_clip_norm=1.0,  #C
    seed=123,
    log_every=5,
    csv_log_path="train_distill_metrics.csv",
)
#A Seed PyTorch so the short demo is reproducible
#B Train on a tiny subset so this notebook run stays lightweight
#C Same as in chapter 6
#A 设置 PyTorch 的随机种子，使简短的示例可复现 #B 在一个很小的数据子集上训练，以保持笔记本运行的轻量化 #C 与第 6 章相同

Let's briefly talk about the settings before we inspect the results. We keep the training run intentionally short. For instance, we use only the first 10 training examples and 10 validation examples, and we train for just 2 epochs. This is purely to keep the notebook run lightweight and fast enough for experimentation. For a real distillation run, we would of course train on many more examples, ideally the whole training set.

在检查结果之前，我们先简单介绍一下设置。我们特意将训练过程设置得较短：例如，只使用前10个训练样本和10个验证样本，并且仅训练2个epoch。这样做只是为了使笔记本运行轻量、快速，便于实验。而在真正的知识蒸馏任务中，我们当然会使用更多的样本进行训练，理想情况下是整个训练集。

The learning rate (lr=5e-6) is in a reasonable range for fine-tuning a pre-trained model and works well in practice for this setup and worked well in practice in my experiments, as reflected in the loss curves discussed next.

学习率（lr=5e-6）处于微调预训练模型的合理范围，在该设置下表现良好，并且在我的实验中也取得了不错的效果，这一点从接下来讨论的损失曲线中可见一斑。

The gradient clipping setting (grad_clip_norm=1.0) is the same as in chapter 6 and helps prevent unstable updates when a particular example produces unusually large gradients.

梯度裁剪设置（grad_clip_norm=1.0）与第6章中的设置相同，有助于在某个样本产生异常大的梯度时防止更新不稳定。

The log_every=5 setting means that validation loss is measured every 5 training steps. Since this demo uses only a handful of examples, this produces frequent progress updates so that we can quickly verify that the training loop behaves as expected. In a larger run, we would usually increase this interval to reduce evaluation overhead.

log_every=5 的设置意味着每经过 5 个训练步骤就会计算一次验证损失。由于这个示例仅使用少量样本，因此会频繁地输出进度更新，以便我们能够快速确认训练循环的行为符合预期。而在更大的训练任务中，通常会增大这个间隔，以降低评估开销。

Finally, the csv_log_path="train_distill_metrics.csv" argument stores the training and validation losses in a CSV file so that we can inspect and plot them later.

最后，`csv_log_path="train_distill_metrics.csv"` 参数会将训练和验证损失保存到一个 CSV 文件中，以便我们后续查看和绘图。

The main goal of this run is not to achieve the best possible reasoning performance, but to confirm that the distillation pipeline works end to end. Once that is established, we can move on to larger runs and inspect the resulting learning curves and checkpoints in more detail.

本次运行的主要目标并非追求最佳的推理性能，而是验证蒸馏流程端到端是否正常工作。一旦确认这一点，我们就可以开展更大规模的训练，并更细致地分析由此产生的学习曲线和检查点。

Even though this is only a tiny demonstration run, the output already shows the expected overall behavior. Both the training loss and the validation loss decrease over time, which indicates that the student model is becoming better at matching the teacher-generated target sequences. The validation loss is especially useful here because it is computed on held-out examples and therefore provides a cleaner signal that the improvement is not limited to the training samples alone.

尽管这只是一次小型的演示运行，但输出已经显示出预期的整体行为。训练损失和验证损失均随时间下降，这表明学生模型在匹配教师生成的目标序列方面越来越出色。其中，验证损失尤为有用，因为它是在保留的测试样本上计算得出的，因此能够更清晰地反映出模型的改进并非仅限于训练数据，而是具有一定的泛化能力。

We can also see that checkpoints are saved at the end of each epoch. This is useful in practice because it allows us to resume training later or evaluate intermediate versions of the distilled model using the MATH-500 test set.

我们还可以看到，每个 epoch 结束时都会保存检查点。这在实际应用中非常有用，因为它允许我们在稍后恢复训练，或者使用 MATH-500 测试集评估蒸馏模型的中间版本。

The following listing 8.15 implements a utility function to visualize the training metrics stored in the CSV file:

以下代码清单 8.15 实现了一个实用函数，用于可视化存储在 CSV 文件中的训练指标：

Listing 8.15 Plotting distillation losses from a CSV log
import csv
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 
 
def plot_distill_metrics(csv_path="train_distill_metrics.csv"):
    total_steps, train_losses, val_losses, epoch_bounds = [], [], [], {}
 
    #A
    with open(csv_path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in csv.DictReader(f):
            step = int(row["total_steps"])
            epoch = int(row["epoch"])
            total_steps.append(step)
            train_losses.append(float(row["train_loss"]))
            val_losses.append(float(row["val_loss"]))
            epoch_bounds.setdefault(epoch, [step, step])[1] = step
 
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
    ax.plot(total_steps, train_losses, label="train_loss", alpha=0.3)
    ax.plot(total_steps, val_losses, label="val_loss")
    ax.set_xlabel("Total Steps")
    ax.set_ylabel("Loss")
    ax.legend()
 
    #B
    epoch_axis = ax.secondary_xaxis("bottom")
    epoch_axis.spines["bottom"].set_position(("outward", 45))
    epochs = sorted(epoch_bounds)
    epoch_axis.set_xticks(
        [
            (epoch_bounds[epoch][0] + epoch_bounds[epoch][1]) / 2
            for epoch in epochs
        ]
    )
    epoch_axis.set_xticklabels(epochs)
    epoch_axis.set_xlabel("Epoch")
 
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
 
 
plot_distill_metrics("deepseek-r1-2048_distill_metrics.csv")
#A Load and plot the logged losses
#B Add a second x-axis so the epoch numbers are visible below the step axis
#A 加载并绘制记录的损失值 #B 添加第二个x轴，使epoch编号显示在step轴下方

The resulting plot is shown in figure 8.17.

所得绘图如图8.17所示。

Figure 8.17 The training and validation loss of a 3-epoch distillation training run on DeepSeek-R1 reasoning traces.
图8.17 在DeepSeek-R1推理轨迹上进行的3轮蒸馏训练的训练损失和验证损失。

The training-loss curve and validation-loss curve shown in figure 8.17 should be interpreted slightly differently. The training loss is computed for each training example during training at the current step, whereas the validation loss is computed on a small fixed held-out set. The validation curve is therefore less noisy and the more informative signal here. We could also compute the training loss on a subset of examples, similar to the validation loss, but this would slow down the training; the training loss is much less important than the validation loss for estimating the training progress.

图8.17中所示的训练损失曲线和验证损失曲线应作稍有不同的解读。训练损失是在当前训练步骤中针对每个训练样本计算得出的，而验证损失则是在一个固定的小型保留数据集上计算的。因此，验证损失曲线通常更为平滑，也更能反映模型的真实性能。我们也可以像计算验证损失那样，在一部分样本上计算训练损失，但这样做会显著降低训练速度；相较于验证损失，训练损失对于评估训练进度的重要性要低得多。

As we would hope, the validation loss drops sharply at first and then begins to flatten out, indicating that the model is learning from the distillation data but that additional training yields diminishing returns. We could experiment with a larger learning rate or a different schedule to train more aggressively, but overall the curve looks healthy.

正如我们所期望的那样，验证损失起初大幅下降，随后逐渐趋于平缓，这表明模型正在从知识蒸馏数据中学习，但进一步训练带来的收益正在递减。我们可以通过尝试更大的学习率或不同的学习率调度策略来更激进地训练模型，不过总体来看，这条曲线是健康的。

表8.1 不同模型检查点在MATH-500任务上的准确率 方法 Epoch 最终验证损失 MATH-500准确率 1 基础Qwen3 0.6B（第3章） - - 15.2% 2 推理版Qwen3 0.6B（第3章） - - 48.2% 3 DeepSeek-R1 1 0.5436 30.6% 4 DeepSeek-R1 2 0.5349 32.4% 5 DeepSeek-R1 3 0.5343 33.6% 6 Qwen3 235B-A22B 1 0.4043 45.0% 7 Qwen3 235B-A22B 2 0.3963 43.8% 8 Qwen3 235B-A22B 3 0.3948 44.2%

Based on the results shown in table 8.1, for the DeepSeek-R1 run, we see that the MATH-500 accuracy improves from 30.6% after the first epoch to 33.6% after the third epoch, while the validation loss decreases from 0.5436 to 0.5343. This matches the previous learning-curve discussion based on figure 8.17, where the student clearly learns from the teacher-generated reasoning traces, but the gains begin to taper off after the initial improvement.

根据表8.1中的结果，对于DeepSeek-R1的运行，我们看到MATH-500任务的准确率从第一个epoch后的30.6%提升至第三个epoch后的33.6%，而验证损失则由0.5436降至0.5343。这与先前基于图8.17的学习曲线分析相吻合：学生模型能够从教师生成的推理轨迹中有效学习，但随着初始阶段的显著提升，后续的性能增益逐渐趋于平缓。

The Qwen3 235B-A22B run performs noticeably better in this setup. One likely reason is that the teacher and student come from the same model family, which means that the tokenizer, prompting conventions, and overall response style are more closely aligned. This can make the teacher targets easier for the smaller Qwen3 student to imitate.

在这一设置下，Qwen3 235B-A22B 模型的推理性能明显更优。一个可能的原因是，教师模型和学生模型出自同一模型家族，这意味着它们使用的分词器、提示规范以及整体响应风格更加一致。这种一致性使得较小的 Qwen3 学生模型更容易模仿教师模型的目标输出。

Considering the MATH-500 accuracy of 45% (row 6), our distillation recipe reaches almost the same performance as the reasoning reference model (48.2%, row 2), which is itself a distilled model but has been trained on a much larger dataset generated by Qwen3 235B-A22B. This is the main tradeoff behind distillation.

考虑到 MATH-500 数据集上的准确率为 45%（第 6 行），我们的蒸馏模型性能几乎与推理基准模型持平（48.2%，第 2 行）。该基准模型本身也是一个蒸馏模型，但其训练数据量要大得多，是由 Qwen3 235B-A22B 生成的。这正是模型蒸馏背后的主要权衡所在。

Note that in general, we do not expect the smaller student to match the teacher exactly. For instance, Qwen3 235B-A22B has a MATH-500 accuracy of 92.4%, and DeepSeek-R1 has a MATH-500 accuracy of 91.2%. But we can still recover a useful portion of the teacher's reasoning behavior in a much cheaper model. Also, note that our distilled model accuracy could be higher if we used a larger model (e.g., a 4- or 30-billion-parameter version of Qwen3 instead of Qwen3 0.6B), but this would increase the computational cost during training.

需要注意的是，通常情况下，我们并不期望较小的学生模型能够完全复现教师模型的行为。例如，Qwen3 235B-A22B 在 MATH-500 数据集上的准确率为 92.4%，而 DeepSeek-R1 的相应准确率为 91.2%。不过，即便如此，我们仍然可以在成本低得多的模型中恢复教师模型推理行为中有用的部分。此外，如果使用更大规模的教师模型（比如 Qwen3 的 40 亿或 300 亿参数版本，而非 Qwen3 0.6B），蒸馏得到的学生模型性能可能会更高，但这会显著增加训练过程中的计算开销。

Let's step back and connect the individual pieces we implemented into one complete workflow. Figure 8.18 summarizes the full distillation pipeline, starting with the introductory setup, followed by dataset generation and preprocessing, then the distillation training loop itself, and finally the evaluation of the distilled model on MATH-500.

让我们退一步，将之前实现的各个模块串联成一个完整的流水线。图8.18总结了整个知识蒸馏流程：首先进行基础环境的搭建，接着是数据集的生成与预处理，然后是知识蒸馏的训练循环，最后是在MATH-500数据集上对蒸馏后的模型进行评估。

Figure 8.18 The evaluation of the distilled model completes the technical content of this chapter.
图8.18 对蒸馏模型的评估完成了本章的技术内容。

This workflow shown in figure 8.18 completes the core technical recipe for distilling a smaller reasoning model from a stronger teacher. In practice, each stage offers room for variation, such as changing how the teacher data is generated and modifying the training settings.

图8.18所示的工作流完成了从强教师模型蒸馏出较小推理模型的核心技术流程。在实际应用中，每个阶段都存在调整空间，例如可以改变教师数据的生成方式，或修改训练设置。

Exercise 8.2: Distilling without <think> tokens
练习 8.2：不使用 <think> 标记的蒸馏
