8.9 Future directions for reasoning models

8.9 推理模型的未来发展方向

Before closing the chapter, let’s discuss where reasoning models are headed next.

在结束本章之前，让我们探讨一下推理模型的下一步发展方向。

For the foreseeable future, the overall broad pattern remains the same. For instance, the general strategy is to develop a stronger reasoning teacher, collect high-quality reasoning traces, and distill them into smaller student models.

在可预见的未来，总体的大致格局仍将保持不变。例如，总体策略是培养更强的推理能力教师模型，收集高质量的推理轨迹，并将其提炼到更小的学生模型中。

One obvious direction is continued refinement of the training recipe popularized by the DeepSeek-R1 paper, which includes both RLVR (chapters 6 and 7) for the flagship models and distillation for the smaller models geared towards computational efficiency.

一个显而易见的方向是继续优化DeepSeek-R1论文中提出的训练方案，该方案既包括针对旗舰模型的RLVR（第6章和第7章），也包括面向计算效率的小模型蒸馏技术。

A second direction is the optimization at inference time. In practice, a reasoning model should not always produce equally long answers. Some tasks benefit from short, direct responses, whereas others benefit from more detailed multi-step reasoning. This creates room for more automatic and flexible inference scaling at the application layer, where the surrounding system decides when to ask for a short answer, when to allocate more reasoning budget, and when to stop early. For example, OpenAI implemented such a system with the launch of GPT-5 in 2025, where they added an "auto" mode to steer the reasoning effort and reasoning trace generation length.

另一个方向是在推理时进行优化。在实际应用中，推理模型并不应总是生成长度一致的响应。有些任务更适合简短直接的回答，而另一些任务则受益于更详尽的多步推理。这为应用层上的自动化、灵活的推理规模调整提供了空间：由外围系统决定何时请求简短回答、何时分配更多的推理资源，以及何时提前终止推理。例如，OpenAI 在 2025 年推出 GPT-5 时就实现了这样的系统，在其中新增了“自动”模式，用以调控推理力度和推理轨迹的生成长度。

A third direction for improvement is the reward generation for RLVR. Much of the current work still relies heavily on rewards based on final answers, especially in math and code. But process rewards that check intermediate reasoning steps, not just the final result, may provide a richer training signal and help models learn more reliable reasoning strategies. For example, the DeepSeek-Math-V2 paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22570) recently demonstrated that judging the whole answer during training can meaningfully improve reasoning performance.

第三个改进方向是针对RLVR的奖励机制设计。目前的许多研究仍然高度依赖基于最终答案的奖励，尤其是在数学和代码任务中。然而，如果能够引入过程奖励，不仅评估最终结果，还检查中间推理步骤，则可以提供更为丰富的训练信号，帮助模型学习更可靠的推理策略。例如，DeepSeek-Math-V2论文（https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22570）最近表明，在训练过程中对整个解答进行评判，能够显著提升推理性能。

A fourth direction is the growing role of reasoning models as the engine inside larger agent applications such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw. In these settings, the model must not only solve a simple math or coding problem, but also plan, call tools, recover from failures, and coordinate longer workflows. This naturally pushes reward design beyond math and code correctness. We may want rewards for successful tool use, information retrieval, policy compliance, and more. In turn, this leads to multi-reward training, where several objectives are optimized together instead of relying on a single correctness score.

第四个方向是推理模型在更大规模智能体应用中作为核心引擎的作用日益增强，例如 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 等。在这些场景下，模型不仅需要解决简单的数学或编程问题，还必须进行任务规划、调用工具、从失败中恢复，并协调更复杂的流程。这自然促使奖励设计超越单纯的数学和代码正确性。我们可能希望为成功的工具使用、信息检索、政策合规等行为设计奖励。相应地，这就引出了多奖励训练范式：不再依赖单一的正确性评分，而是同时优化多个目标。

Distillation will likely remain important in this setting because it offers a practical way to transfer these richer behaviors from larger and more expensive teacher systems into smaller models that are easier to deploy or even run locally while being more cost-effective for users.

蒸馏技术很可能在此场景中仍将发挥重要作用，因为它提供了一种切实可行的方法，能够将更大、更昂贵的教师模型中更为丰富的行为迁移到更小的模型中。这些小型模型不仅更容易部署，甚至可以在本地运行，同时对用户而言也更具成本效益。

8.10 Conclusions

8.10 结论

This completes the main technical material of the book. The remaining sections are brief pointers on what to try next, how to keep up with a fast-moving field, and where to find additional material.

至此，本书的主要技术内容已全部完成。剩余章节则简要提示读者接下来可以尝试的方向、如何跟上快速发展的领域，以及在哪里可以找到更多相关资料。

8.10.1 What's next

8.10.1 下一步是什么

A practical next step is to start combining the methods from this book instead of treating them as isolated techniques. For example, you could distill a smaller model from a strong teacher, continue training it with RLVR, and then apply inference-time scaling methods such as self-consistency or self-refinement at deployment time. Running these kinds of comparisons is often the fastest way to develop intuition for which method helps most in a given setting.

一个切实可行的下一步是将本书中介绍的各种方法结合起来使用，而不是将其视为彼此孤立的技术。例如，你可以先从一个性能强大的教师模型蒸馏出一个较小的学生模型，再利用 RLVR 继续对其进行训练，最后在部署时应用推理时缩放方法，如自一致性或自我精炼。进行这类对比实验往往是最快捷的方式，能够帮助你建立起对在特定场景下哪种方法最有效的直觉。

The appendices are also a good place to continue. They cover additional topics such as LLM architecture details, batched execution for higher throughput, and alternative evaluation approaches.

附录也是一个不错的继续阅读之处。它们涵盖了更多主题，例如大语言模型的架构细节、用于提高吞吐量的批处理执行，以及替代性的评估方法。

Lastly, the supplementary code repository (https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch) includes bonus material and standalone scripts that are better suited for longer runs and larger experiments than a notebook.

最后，补充代码仓库（https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch）包含额外的资料和独立脚本，它们比 Jupyter 笔记本更适合长时间运行和大规模实验。

8.10.2 Staying up to date in a fast-moving field

8.10.2 在快速发展的领域中保持与时俱进

I hope this book gave you a clearer picture of how modern reasoning models work in practice!

希望这本书能让你对现代推理模型在实际中的运作方式有更清晰的认识！

Reasoning-model research is moving quickly, and specific algorithms, datasets, and best practices will continue to change. The core ideas in this book tend to remain relevant and useful. This includes careful model evaluation, distinguishing between inference-time and training-time methods, and a solid understanding of how the training losses and reward signals are computed.

推理模型的研究进展迅速，具体的算法、数据集和最佳实践也将持续演变。然而，本书的核心理念却往往保持相关性和实用性。这包括细致的模型评估、区分推理时方法与训练时方法，以及对训练损失和奖励信号计算方式的扎实理解。

When new methods appear, it helps to map them back to these fundamentals. Many new techniques are best understood as variations or combinations of the building blocks we implemented here, even when the surrounding training recipe becomes more complex.

当新方法出现时，将其与这些基础概念对应起来会很有帮助。许多新技术实际上可以被理解为我们在此实现的那些基本组件的变体或组合，即便周围的训练流程变得更加复杂。

In practice, I recommend several resources. First, you may skim recent machine learning and AI papers on arXiv (https://arxiv.org/list/cs.LG/recent), to spot new training and evaluation ideas early. However, be aware that the volume of new papers is now so large that keeping up comprehensively is nearly impossible, so it is usually better to treat arXiv as a way to scan for themes and promising papers than to try to read everything.

在实践中，我推荐几类资源。首先，可以快速浏览 arXiv 上近期的机器学习和人工智能论文（https://arxiv.org/list/cs.LG/recent），以便及早发现新的训练与评估方法。不过需要注意的是，如今新论文的数量极为庞大，全面跟进几乎不可能，因此通常建议将 arXiv 作为主题探索和寻找有前景论文的工具，而不是试图读完每一篇。

Second, read technical summaries and reports for newly released models, since they often contain the most useful details about prompting conventions, benchmarks, and limitations. These are usually shared directly by the developer on the Hugging Face model hub, announcement blog articles, and social media.

其次，阅读新发布模型的技术摘要和报告，因为它们通常包含关于提示规范、基准测试和局限性的最实用细节。这些内容通常由开发者直接在 Hugging Face 模型库、官方公告博客文章以及社交媒体上分享。

Third, keep an eye on practitioner discussions on the social media platform X and in communities such as r/LocalLLaMA (https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/), where implementation details, replications, and failure cases often show up before they make it into polished papers.

第三，密切关注从业者在社交媒体平台X以及r/LocalLLaMA等社区（https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/）中的讨论。在那里，模型的实现细节、复现结果以及失败案例往往会在正式论文发表之前就已出现。

AI-assistant or "deep research" tools can also be useful for monitoring these sources and summarizing new developments, but they work best as filters rather than substitutes for reading the original papers and model cards.

人工智能助手或“深度研究”工具也可用于监测这些信息来源并总结最新进展，但它们更适合作为筛选工具，而非替代阅读原始论文和模型卡片的手段。

I also regularly write about AI and LLM topics on my blog at https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com.

我也会在我的博客（https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com）上定期撰写关于人工智能和大语言模型的文章。

8.11 Summary

8.11 总结

  • Distillation trains a smaller student LLM on outputs produced by a larger teacher LLM.
  • 蒸馏技术是在一个较大的教师模型生成的输出上，训练一个较小的学生小模型。
  • Hard distillation is usually more practical than soft distillation because teacher logits are often unavailable and teacher text outputs are much cheaper to store and reuse.
  • 硬蒸馏通常比软蒸馏更为实用，这是因为教师模型的 logits 往往不可用，而教师模型生成的文本输出则更容易存储和重复使用，成本也更低。
  • We used DeepSeek-R1 as the teacher model and Qwen3 0.6B as the student model
  • 我们以 DeepSeek-R1 作为教师模型，Qwen3 0.6B 作为学生模型。
  • The distillation dataset was built from the 12,000 MATH training problems that do not overlap with MATH-500.
  • 蒸馏数据集是由12,000道与MATH-500不重叠的MATH训练题构建而成的。
  • Each training sample combines a rendered prompt with the teacher reasoning trace and final answer, optionally separated via <think>...</think> tags.
  • 每个训练样本由一个渲染后的提示、教师的推理轨迹以及最终答案组成，三者可选地通过<think>…</think>标签分隔。
  • For efficiency, we tokenize the dataset once, filter it by sequence length, and reuse the processed examples across multiple epochs.
  • 为提高效率，我们对数据集进行一次分词处理，并按序列长度进行过滤，然后在多个训练轮次中重复使用已处理的样本。
  • The training objective is answer-only cross-entropy, which is equivalent to the negative average log-probability of the correct next tokens.
  • 训练目标是仅预测答案的交叉熵损失，它等价于正确下一个标记的负平均对数概率。
  • The distillation training loop is a standard supervised learning loop, which includes shuffling the training examples each epoch, computing the loss, backpropagating, updating the model weights, and tracking validation loss.
  • 蒸馏训练循环是一个标准的监督学习循环，包括在每个 epoch 中打乱训练样本、计算损失、进行反向传播、更新模型权重，以及跟踪验证损失。
  • The validation loss is the main signal to watch during training, and saved checkpoints can later be evaluated on MATH-500 with the verifier from chapter 3.
  • 验证损失是训练过程中需要重点关注的指标，保存的检查点随后可以使用第3章中的验证器在MATH-500数据集上进行评估。
  • The distillation approach in this chapter improves the Qwen3 0.6B base model from 15.2% accuracy on MATH-500 to 45.0% accuracy.
  • 本章采用的蒸馏方法将Qwen3 0.6B基础模型在MATH-500数据集上的准确率从15.2%提升至45.0%。

This mode meaningfully improves reasoning capabilities by exploring many hypotheses simultaneously to solve problems."

The DeepSeekMath-V2 paper showed that self-consistency scaling can noticeably improve the answer accuracy, and combining self-consistency with their version of self-refinement (Best@32 in figure 2), the model achieved gold-level performance in several math competitions:

DeepSeekMath-V2 论文表明，自一致性缩放能够显著提升答案准确率；将自一致性与他们版本的自我精炼机制（图2中的 Best@32）相结合后，该模型在多项数学竞赛中达到了金牌级别表现：

  • DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning, https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22570v1
  • DeepSeekMath-V2：迈向自我验证的数学推理，https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22570v1

Instead of using a majority vote in self-consistency, we can use a scoring function to rank the different answers and select the best one. This approach is also known as Best-of-N. However, if applicable, majority voting often tends to give better results:

与其在自一致性方法中使用多数投票，我们也可以借助评分函数对不同的答案进行排序，从而选出最佳答案。这种方法也被称为“Best-of-N”。不过，在适用的情况下，多数投票通常能取得更好的效果：

  • Think Deep, Think Fast: Investigating Efficiency of Verifier-free Inference-time-scaling Methods, https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14047
  • 深度思考，快速决策：探究无验证器推理时扩展方法的效率，https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14047

B.1 Chapter 2

B.1 第二章

Exercise 2.1: Encoding unknown words

练习 2.1：编码未知词

We can use a prompt similar to "Hello, Ardwarklethyrx. Haus und Garten.", which contains a made-up word ("Ardwarklethyrx") and three words in a non-English language (German):

我们可以使用一个类似于“Hello, Ardwarklethyrx. Haus und Garten.”的提示，其中包含一个虚构的单词（“Ardwarklethyrx”）和三个非英语语言（德语）的词汇：

"Haus und Garten":
prompt = "Hello, Ardwarklethyrx. Haus und Garten."
input_token_ids_list = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
for i in input_token_ids_list:
    print(f"{[i]} --> {tokenizer.decode([i])}")
“房屋与花园”： prompt = “你好，Ardwarklethyrx。房屋与花园。” input_token_ids_list = tokenizer.encode(prompt) for i in input_token_ids_list: print(f"{[i]} --> {tokenizer.decode([i])}")

The output is:

输出是：

[9707] --> Hello
[11] --> ,
[1644] -->  Ar
[29406] --> dw
[838] --> ark
[273] --> le
[339] --> th
[10920] --> yr
[87] --> x
[13] --> .
[47375] -->  Haus
[2030] -->  und
[93912] -->  Garten
[13] --> .
[9707] --> 你好 [11] --> ， [1644] --> 阿尔 [29406] --> 没事 [838] --> 黑暗 [273] --> 勒 [339] --> 特 [10920] --> 年 [87] --> x [13] --> 。 [47375] --> 房子 [2030] --> 和 [93912] --> 花园 [13] --> 。

As we can see, unknown words are broken into smaller pieces of subwords or even single tokens; this allows the tokenizer and LLM to handle any input.

正如我们所见，未知词会被拆分成更小的子词片段，甚至单个标记；这使得分词器和大语言模型能够处理任何输入。

German words are not broken down into characters or even subwords here, suggesting that the tokenizer has seen German texts during training. This also suggests that the LLM was likely trained on German texts, too, and should be able to handle at least certain non-English languages well.

这里的德语单词既没有被拆解为字符，也没有被进一步切分成更小的子词单元，这表明该分词器在训练过程中接触过德语文本。这也暗示，该大语言模型很可能也曾在德语文本上进行过训练，因此应该能够较好地处理至少某些非英语语言。

Exercise 2.2: Rerun code on non-CPU devices

练习 2.2：在非 CPU 设备上重新运行代码

We can simply delete the line device = torch.device("cpu") in section 2.5, and then rerun the rest of the code in chapter 2 as is. Reference numbers for the hardware I tried the code on are provided in table 2.1 at the end of chapter 2.

我们只需删除第2.5节中的device = torch.device("cpu")这行代码，然后按原样重新运行第2章的其余代码即可。我在其上测试该代码的硬件型号参考编号见第2章末尾的表2.1。

B.2 第三章

Exercise 3.1: Adding more test cases

练习 3.1：添加更多测试用例

There is an endless number of different test cases we may add. Below is a selection of some interesting ones:

我们可以添加的测试用例数量是无限的。下面是一些有趣的示例：

from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    run_demos_table
)
 
more_tests = [
    ("check_17", "[1, 2]", "(1, 2)", True),  #A
    ("check_18", "1e-3", "0.001", True),  #B
    ("check_19", "(-3)^2", "9", True),  #C
    ("check_20", "−1", "-1", True),  #D
 
]
run_demos_table(more_tests)
#A Different bracket types
#B Scientific notation
#C Algebraic simplification with caret exponent
#D Unicode minus (U+2212) vs ASCII hyphen-minus
#A 不同的括号类型 #B 科学记数法 #C 使用脱字符表示指数的代数简化 #D Unicode 减号（U+2212）与 ASCII 短横线-

The output is:

输出是：

Test     | Expect | Got   | Status
check_17 | True   | True  | PASS
check_18 | True   | True  | PASS
check_19 | True   | True  | PASS
check_20 | True   | False | FAIL
测试 | 预期 | 实际 | 状态 check_17 | True | True | 通过 check_18 | True | True | 通过 check_19 | True | True | 通过 check_20 | True | False | 失败

As we can see, the tests pass in all cases except for check_20, which swaps the regular sign with a Unicode version of a minus sign that looks indistinguishable to the human eye (depending on which font or editor we use). We could fix this test case by adding one of the following lines anywhere to the normalize_text function:

正如我们所见，除了 check_20 之外，所有测试用例都通过了。check_20 测试用例将常规的减号符号替换为一个在人眼看来完全相同的 Unicode 减号符号（具体效果取决于所使用的字体或编辑器）。我们可以通过在 normalize_text 函数中的任意位置添加以下其中一行来修复这个测试用例：

text = text.replace("−", "-")
文本 = 文本.replace("−", "-")

or

或者

text = text.replace("\u2212", "-")
文本 = 文本.replace("\u2212", "-")

Another interesting test is the following one:

另一个有趣的测试是下面这个：

extra_tests_1 = [
    ("check_21", "Text around answer 3.", "3", True)
]
extra_tests_1 = [ ("check_21", "答案3周围的文本。", "3", 常识) ]

We can run it via the following code:

我们可以通过以下代码运行它：

run_demos_table(extra_tests_1)
运行演示表格(额外测试_1)

However, it fails the test:

然而，它未能通过测试：

Test     | Expect | Got   | Status
check_21 | True   | False | FAIL  
 
Passed 0/1
测试 | 预期 | 实际 | 状态 check_21 | True | False | 失败 通过 0/1

While it may seem that our code cannot handle such text-containing cases, this is actually a poorly designed test. In practice, the run_demos_table function is intended specifically to test the grade_answer function; nothing more, nothing less.

虽然看似我们的代码无法处理包含此类文本的情况，但实际上，这是一个设计不当的测试用例。在实际工作中，run_demos_table 函数的唯一目的就是测试 grade_answer 函数——仅此而已，别无他求。

The grade_answer function would never receive the entire answer in this text form, since the answer would have been extracted from the text before being passed to it. For instance, if we want to test text answers, we need to call the test as follows:

grade_answer 函数永远不会以这种文本形式接收到完整的答案，因为答案在传递给该函数之前就已经从文本中提取出来了。例如，如果我们想要测试文本答案，就需要按照如下方式调用测试：

from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    extract_final_candidate
)
extra_tests_2 = [
    ("check_21",
     extract_final_candidate("Text around answer 3."),
     "3", True)
]
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 模块的： 从字符串中提取最终候选答案 额外测试用例 2 = [ ("检查_21", 提取最终候选答案("答案3周围的文本。"), "3", 真) ]

As we can see based on the output, it now passes the test:

正如输出所示，它现在通过了测试：

run_demos_table(extra_tests_2)
Test     | Expect | Got  | Status
check_21 | True   | True | PASS  
 
Passed 1/1
运行演示表(额外测试_2) 测试 | 预期 | 实际 | 状态 check_21 | True | True | 通过 通过 1/1

Exercise 3.2: Calculating the average response length

练习3.2：计算平均回复长度

There are two options to calculate the average response length. The first option is to modify the evaluate_math500_stream function (listing 3.13 in chapter 3) by adding the following lines:

有两种方法可以计算平均响应长度。第一种方法是修改 evaluate_math500_stream 函数（见第3章的清单3.13），添加以下几行代码：

# ...
# below `num_correct = 0`
total_len = 0
 
# ...
# inside for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):
# anywhere below `gen_text = ...`
total_len += len(tokenizer.encode(gen_text))
 
# ...
# anywhere at the bottom before the return statement
avg_len = total_len / num_examples
print(f"Average length: {avg_len:.2f} tokens")
# ... # 在 `num_correct = 0` 下面 total_len = 0 # ... # 在 `for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):` 循环体内 # 在 `gen_text = ...` 语句下方的任意位置 total_len += len(tokenizer.encode(gen_text)) # ... # 在返回语句之前的底部任意位置 avg_len = total_len / num_examples print(f"平均长度: {avg_len:.2f} 个 token")

Alternatively, the second option is to calculate the response lengths from the .jsonl files that were created when we ran the evaluate_math500_stream function in the main chapter. This way, we avoid having to rerun the evaluation.

或者，第二种方法是直接从主章节中运行 `evaluate_math500_stream` 函数时生成的 `.jsonl` 文件中计算响应长度。这样就可以避免重新执行评估。

First, we load the .jsonl file as follows:

首先，我们按如下方式加载 .jsonl 文件：

import json
from pathlib import Path
 
WHICH_MODEL = "base"
dev_name = "mps"
 
local_path = Path(f"math500-{dev_name}.jsonl")  #A
if not local_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"{local_path} not found. Run ch03_main.ipynb to create it."
    )
 
results = []
with open(local_path, "r") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.strip():
            results.append(json.loads(line))
 
print("Number of entries:", len(results))
#A You may need to adjust this path
#A 您可能需要调整此路径

Let's print the dictionary keys to get a better idea of how the results dataset is structured:

让我们打印出字典的键，以便更好地了解结果数据集的结构：

print(results[0].keys())
打印(results[0].keys())

This prints:

这会打印：

dict_keys(['index', 'problem', 'gtruth_answer', 'generated_text', 
'extracted', 'correct'])
字典键：['index', 'problem', 'gtruth_answer', 'generated_text', 'extracted', 'correct']

Note that each entry has multiple keys, however, we are only interested in the "generated_text" key, which contains the model's full answer. Next, we need to load the tokenizer so that we can tokenize the answer text before we can calculate the number of tokens. This is similar to the code we used in listing 3.1 in chapter 3:

请注意，每个条目都有多个键，但我们只关心“generated_text”键，它包含了模型的完整回答。接下来，我们需要加载分词器，以便在计算 token 数量之前对回答文本进行分词。这与我们在第 3 章列表 3.1 中使用的代码类似：

from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import (
    download_qwen3_small,
    Qwen3Tokenizer
)
 
if WHICH_MODEL == "base":
 
    download_qwen3_small(
        kind="base", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir="qwen3"
    )
    tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-base.json"
    tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path)
 
elif WHICH_MODEL == "reasoning":
 
    download_qwen3_small(
        kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir="qwen3"
    )
    tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-reasoning.json"
    tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(
        tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path,
        apply_chat_template=True,
        add_generation_prompt=True,
        add_thinking=True,
    )
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import ( download_qwen3_small, Qwen3Tokenizer ) if WHICH_MODEL == "base": download_qwen3_small( kind="base", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir="qwen3" ) tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-base.json" tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path) elif WHICH_MODEL == "reasoning": download_qwen3_small( kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir="qwen3" ) tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-reasoning.json" tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer( tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path, apply_chat_template=True, add_generation_prompt=True, add_thinking=True, )

Then, we can calculate the average length as follows, which is similar to how we could have modified the evaluate_math500_stream function:

然后，我们可以按如下方式计算平均长度，这与我们原本可以修改 evaluate_math500_stream 函数的方式类似：

total_len = 0
 
for item in results:
    num_tokens = len(tokenizer.encode(item["generated_text"]))
    total_len += num_tokens
 
avg_len = total_len / len(results)
print(f"Average length: {avg_len:.2f} tokens")
total_len = 0 for item in results: num_tokens = len(tokenizer.encode(item["generated_text"])) total_len += num_tokens avg_len = total_len / len(results) print(f"平均长度：{avg_len:.2f} 个 token")

In addition, we can create an entirely new dataset in a similar style to MATH-500. For example, a dataset in MATH-500 style is included in this repository; we can use it in the main chapter by changing the filename from math500_test.json to math_new50_exercise.json (this dataset is included in this book's GitHub repository at https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/ch03/01_main-chapter-code).

Accuracy is similar for the base model and higher for the reasoning model compared to the 50-example subset of the MATH-500 test set (table B.2). This indicates that, despite the possibility of overlap with Qwen3’s training data, the model generalizes well to new math questions and does not show signs of extensive overfitting to the original MATH-500 data.

在MATH-500测试集的50个样本文本子集上，基础模型的准确率与推理模型相近，而推理模型的准确率更高（见表B.2）。这表明，尽管模型可能与通义千问3的训练数据存在重叠，但它仍能很好地泛化到新的数学题目，且未表现出对原始MATH-500数据的严重过拟合。

Exercise 3.4: Experimenting with different prompt templates

练习3.4：尝试不同的提示模板

We could use the alternative prompt similar to the one suggested in the chapter, which modifies the prompt to use the word "problem" instead of "question":

我们可以使用与章节中建议类似的替代提示，将提示中的“question”改为“problem”：

def render_prompt(prompt):
    template = (
        "You are a helpful math assistant.\n"
        "Solve the problem and write the final "
        "result on a new line as:\n"
        "\\boxed{ANSWER}\n\n"
        f"Problem:\n{prompt}\n\nAnswer:"
    )
    return template
def render_prompt(prompt): template = ( "你是一位 helpful 的数学助手。\n" "请解答题目，并将最终结果写在新的一行，格式为：\n" "\\boxed{ANSWER}\n\n" f"题目：\n{prompt}\n\n答案：" ) return template

Using this prompt improves the performance of the base model, on the 500 examples, from 15.3% to 31.2%. Also, it improves the performance of the reasoning model from 48.2% to 50.0%

使用该提示词可将基础模型在500个示例上的性能从15.3%提升至31.2%。此外，它还将推理模型的性能从48.2%提升至50.0%。

From these observations, we may conclude that the base model is much more sensitive to the prompt format (likely due to memorizing some prompt-formatted MATH-500 examples from the training set) than the reasoning model; the latter seems largely unaffected.

基于这些观察，我们可以得出结论：基础模型对提示格式的敏感度远高于推理模型（这很可能是因为它在训练过程中记住了部分以特定格式呈现的 MATH-500 示例）；而推理模型则似乎几乎不受影响。

Exercise 4.1: Use chain-of-thought prompting on MATH-500

练习4.1：在MATH-500数据集上使用思维链提示方法

The modification only requires adding a prompt suffix such as "\n\nExplain step by step." after applying the prompt template. There is only a very small portion of code that needs to be updated in the MATH-500 evaluation function from chapter 3, as shown below:

该修改只需在应用提示模板后，添加一个如“\n\n请逐步解释。”的提示后缀即可。第3章中的MATH-500评估函数中，仅需更新极小部分代码，如下所示：

def evaluate_math500_stream(...):
    # ...
        for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):
            prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"])
            prompt += "\n\nExplain step by step."  # NEW
            gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat(
                model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                verbose=verbose,
            )
 
     # ...
def evaluate_math500_stream(...): # ... for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1): prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"]) prompt += "\n\n请逐步解释。" # 新增 gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat( model, tokenizer, prompt, device, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, verbose=verbose, ) # ...

Exercise 4.2: Use temperature scaling and top-p filtering on MATH-500

练习4.2：在MATH-500数据集上使用温度缩放和top-p过滤

Here, we replace the generate_text_stream_concat function with generate_text_stream_concat_flex and pass in generate_text_top_p_stream_cache as its generation function. The updated MATH-500 evaluation function from chapter 3 is shown below, and the changes are marked with comments labeled # NEW.

在这里，我们用 generate_text_stream_concat_flex 替换了 generate_text_stream_concat 函数，并将 generate_text_top_p_stream_cache 作为其生成函数传入。第3章中更新后的 MATH-500 评估函数如下所示，改动部分已用标注为 # NEW 的注释标出。

def evaluate_math500_stream(
    model,
    tokenizer,
    device,
    math_data,
    out_path=None,
    max_new_tokens=512,
    verbose=False,
    temperature=1.0,  # NEW
    top_p=1.0,        # NEW
):
 
    # ...
 
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):
            prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"])
            gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( # NEW
                model, tokenizer, prompt, device,
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                verbose=verbose,
                generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache,  # NEW
                temperature=temperature,                         # NEW
                top_p=top_p                                      # NEW
            )
    # ...
def evaluate_math500_stream( model, tokenizer, device, math_data, out_path=None, max_new_tokens=512, verbose=False, temperature=1.0, # 新增 top_p=1.0, # 新增 ): # ... with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1): prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"]) gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( # 新增 model, tokenizer, prompt, device, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, verbose=verbose, generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache, # 新增 temperature=temperature, # 新增 top_p=top_p # 新增 ) # ...

The difference between this modified function and the baseline from chapter 3 can be seen in rows 1 and 4 in table 4.1, which can be found in section 4.6 in chapter 4.

本修正后的函数与第3章中的基准函数之间的差异，可在表4.1的第1行和第4行中看出，该表位于第4章的4.6节。

Exercise 4.3: Use self-consistency sampling on MATH-500

练习4.3：在MATH-500数据集上使用自洽采样

Starting from the evaluate_math500_stream function in chapter 3, the first modification is to replace the line gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat(...) with a call to results = self_consistency_vote(...) from chapter 4. The second modification adds a simple tie-breaking rule that selects the first occurrence of the most frequent answer. For instance, if the sampled results are 1, 3, 5, 3, 5, the function would return 3 because it is the earliest member of the most frequent group.

从第3章的evaluate_math500_stream函数开始，第一处修改是将gen_text = generate_text_stream_concat(...)这一行替换为调用第4章中的self_consistency_vote(...)。第二处修改则增加了一条简单的平局打破规则：选择出现频率最高的答案中首次出现的那个。例如，如果采样结果为1、3、5、3、5，该函数将返回3，因为它是在出现频率最高的一组中最早出现的元素。

Since the most frequent answers are stored in results["majority_winners"], one straightforward way to break ties is to take the first element of this list, that is, results["majority_winners"][0].

由于最常见的答案存储在 results["majority_winners"] 中，一种简单的破平方法就是取该列表的第一个元素，即 results["majority_winners"][0]。

Those changes are illustrated in the code excerpts below:

这些更改在下面的代码片段中有所体现：

def evaluate_math500_stream(
    model,
    tokenizer,
    device,
    math_data,
    out_path=None,
    max_new_tokens=2048,
    verbose=False,
    prompt_suffix="",    # NEW
    temperature=1.0,     # NEW
    top_p=1.0,           # NEW
    seed=None,           # NEW
    num_samples=10,      # NEW
):
 
    if out_path is None:
        dev_name = str(device).replace(":", "-")
        out_path = Path(f"math500-{dev_name}.jsonl")
 
    num_examples = len(math_data)
    num_correct = 0
    start_time = time.time()
 
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1):
            prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"])
 
            ##############################################################
            # NEW
            prompt += prompt_suffix
            results = self_consistency_vote(
                model=model,
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                prompt=prompt,
                device=device,
                num_samples=num_samples,
                temperature=temperature,
                top_p=top_p,
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                show_progress=False,
                show_long_answer=False,
                seed=seed,
            )
 
            # resolve ties
            if results["final_answer"] is None:
                extracted = results["majority_winners"][0]
            else:
                extracted = results["final_answer"]
 
            # extracted = extract_final_candidate(
            #     gen_text
            # )
 
            # Optionally, get long answer
            if extracted is not None:
                for idx, s in enumerate(results["short_answers"]):
                    if s == extracted:
                        long_answer = results["full_answers"][idx]
                        break
            gen_text = long_answer
            ##############################################################
 
            is_correct = grade_answer(
                extracted, row["answer"]
            )
            num_correct += int(is_correct)
    # ...
def evaluate_math500_stream( model, tokenizer, device, math_data, out_path=None, max_new_tokens=2048, verbose=False, prompt_suffix="", # 新增 temperature=1.0, # 新增 top_p=1.0, # 新增 seed=None, # 新增 num_samples=10, # 新增 ): if out_path is None: dev_name = str(device).replace(":", "-") out_path = Path(f"math500-{dev_name}.jsonl") num_examples = len(math_data) num_correct = 0 start_time = time.time() with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: for i, row in enumerate(math_data, start=1): prompt = render_prompt(row["problem"]) ############################################################## # 新增 prompt += prompt_suffix results = self_consistency_vote( model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, prompt=prompt, device=device, num_samples=num_samples, temperature=temperature, top_p=top_p, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, show_progress=False, show_long_answer=False, seed=seed, ) # 解决平局 if results["final_answer"] is None: extracted = results["majority_winners"][0] else: extracted = results["final_answer"] # extracted = extract_final_candidate( # gen_text # ) # 可选地获取长答案 if extracted is not None: for idx, s in enumerate(results["short_answers"]): if s == extracted: long_answer = results["full_answers"][idx] break gen_text = long_answer ############################################################## is_correct = grade_answer( extracted, row["answer"] ) num_correct += int(is_correct) # ...

Exercise 4.4: Early stopping in self-consistency sampling

练习4.4：自洽采样中的早停

The early stopping check can be implemented by adding a few lines of code that check whether the given answer is already counted multiple times, or, more specifically, if the given answer count is greater than num_samples / 2:

早停检查可以通过添加几行代码来实现，这些代码用于检查给定的答案是否已被多次计数，或者更具体地说，是否给定答案的计数大于 num_samples / 2：

if early_stop and counts[short] > num_samples / 2:
    majority_winners = [short]
    final_answer = short
    break
如果启用了早停机制，并且 counts[short] 大于 num_samples 的一半： majority_winners = [short] final_answer = short 跳出循环

The excerpt of the modified self_consistency_vote function below illustrates more specifically where to insert this code:

下面修改后的 self_consistency_vote 函数的片段更具体地展示了应将这段代码插入的位置：

def self_consistency_vote(
    # ...
    early_stop=True,   # NEW
):
    # ...
 
        if show_progress:
            print(f"[Sample {i+1}/{num_samples}] → {short!r}")
 
        #########################################################
        # NEW
        # Early stop if one answer already meets >= 50% majority
        if early_stop and counts[short] > num_samples / 2:
            majority_winners = [short]
            final_answer = short
            break
        #########################################################
 
    if final_answer is None:
        mc = counts.most_common()
        if mc:
            top_freq = mc[0][1]
            majority_winners = [s for s, f in mc if f == top_freq]
            final_answer = mc[0][0] if len(majority_winners) == 1 else None
 
    return {
        "full_answers": full_answers,
        "short_answers": short_answers,
        "counts": dict(counts),
        "groups": groups,
        "majority_winners": majority_winners,
        "final_answer": final_answer,
    }
def 自洽性投票( # ... 提前停止=True, # 新增 ): # ... if 显示进度: print(f"[样本 {i+1}/{样本数量}] → {short!r}") ######################################################### # 新增 # 如果已有答案达到 ≥50% 的多数，则提前停止 if 提前停止 and 计数[short] > 样本数量 / 2: 多数胜者 = [short] 最终答案 = short break ######################################################### if 最终答案 is None: 次数统计 = 计数.most_common() if 次数统计: 最高频次 = 次数统计[0][1] 多数胜者 = [s for s, f in 次数统计 if f == 最高频次] 最终答案 = 次数统计[0][0] if 多数胜者的数量 == 1 else None return { "完整答案": 完整答案, "简短答案": 简短答案, "计数": dict(计数), "分组": 分组, "多数胜者": 多数胜者, "最终答案": 最终答案, }

There are many ways to implement this. Perhaps the easiest approach is to handle it outside the self-consistency function and work directly with the returned dictionary, similar to what we did in exercise 4.4 when we implemented the tie-breaking logic directly inside the evaluate_math500_stream function. The relevant lines are shown below:

实现这一点的方法有很多。或许最简单的方式是在自洽性函数之外处理，直接操作返回的字典，这与我们在练习4.4中将平局解决逻辑直接嵌入evaluate_math500_stream函数中的做法类似。相关的代码行如下所示：

def evaluate_math500_stream(

    # ...
            results = self_consistency_vote(...)

            ### NEW: Break tie with heuristic_score
            else:

                best_score = float("-inf")

                        heuristic_score(results["full_answers"][idx],

                        for idx in results["groups"][cand]

                    score = max(scores)

            # ...
    # ...

Exercise 5.2: Using the heuristic scorer in a Best-of-N setup

练习 5.2：在最佳 N 个选项设置中使用启发式评分器

Best-of-N is similar to self-consistency in that we generate multiple answers. However, instead of selecting the final answer via a majority vote, we score all generated answers using a scoring function, such as heuristic_score, and return the highest-scoring one. There are several ways to implement this behavior, but the simplest approach is to use the existing self-consistency function from chapter 4 as a template and swap in heuristic_score, as shown below:

最佳-N方法与自洽性方法类似，都是生成多个答案。然而，不同于通过多数投票来选出最终答案，最佳-N方法会使用一个打分函数（例如 heuristic_score）对所有生成的答案进行评分，并返回得分最高的那个答案。实现这一行为有多种方式，但最简单的方法是将第4章中现有的自洽性函数作为模板，然后将其替换为 heuristic_score，如下所示：

# ...
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch05 import (
    heuristic_score
)
 
def self_consistency_vote( #...):
    full_answers, short_answers = [], []
    counts = Counter()
    groups = {}
    majority_winners, final_answer = [], None
    best_score, best_idx = float("-inf"), None
 
    for i in range(num_samples):
        if seed is not None:
            torch.manual_seed(seed + i + 1)
 
        answer = generate_text_stream_concat_flex(
            model=model,
            tokenizer=tokenizer,
            prompt=prompt,
            device=device,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            verbose=show_long_answer,
            generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache,
            temperature=temperature,
            top_p=top_p,
        )
 
        short = extract_final_candidate(answer, fallback="number_then_full")
        full_answers.append(answer)
        short_answers.append(short)
        counts[short] += 1
 
        if short in groups:
            groups[short].append(i)
        else:
            groups[short] = [i]
 
        score = heuristic_score(answer, prompt=prompt)
 
        if score > best_score:
            best_score, best_idx = score, i
        # ...
# ... from reasoning_from_scratch.ch05 import ( heuristic_score ) def self_consistency_vote( #...): full_answers, short_answers = [], [] counts = Counter() groups = {} majority_winners, final_answer = [], None best_score, best_idx = float("-inf"), None for i in range(num_samples): if seed is not None: torch.manual_seed(seed + i + 1) answer = generate_text_stream_concat_flex( model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, prompt=prompt, device=device, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, verbose=show_long_answer, generate_func=generate_text_top_p_stream_cache, temperature=temperature, top_p=top_p, ) short = extract_final_candidate(answer, fallback="number_then_full") full_answers.append(answer) short_answers.append(short) counts[short] += 1 if short in groups: groups[short].append(i) else: groups[short] = [i] score = heuristic_score(answer, prompt=prompt) if score > best_score: best_score, best_idx = score, i # ...

Exercise 6.1: Adding format-aware reward shaping

练习 6.1：添加格式感知的奖励塑造

We can assign a partial reward (score 0.5) if no "\boxed{}" answer is found as follows, using the fallback="number_then_full" fallback we coded in chapter 3:

如果未找到“\boxed{}”格式的答案，我们可以按照第3章中编写的 fallback="number_then_full" 回退策略，给予部分奖励（分数为0.5），如下所示：

from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    extract_final_candidate, grade_answer
)
 
def reward_rlvr(answer_text, ground_truth):
    
    # 1) Try to extract a boxed answer
    boxed = extract_final_candidate(
        answer_text, fallback=None
    )
    if boxed:
        correct = grade_answer(boxed, ground_truth)
        return 1.0 if correct else 0.0
 
    # 2) If no boxed answer is found, look for number
    unboxed = extract_final_candidate(
        answer_text, fallback="number_then_full"
    )
    if unboxed:
        correct = grade_answer(unboxed, ground_truth)
        return 0.5 if correct else 0.0
 
    return 0.0
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch03： from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import ( extract_final_candidate, grade_answer ) def reward_rlvr(answer_text, ground_truth): # 1) 尝试提取方框内的答案 boxed = extract_final_candidate( answer_text, fallback=None ) if boxed: correct = grade_answer(boxed, ground_truth) return 1.0 if correct else 0.0 # 2) 如果没有找到方框内的答案，则寻找数字 unboxed = extract_final_candidate( answer_text, fallback="number_then_full" ) if unboxed: correct = grade_answer(unboxed, ground_truth) return 0.5 if correct else 0.0 return 0.0

Exercise 6.2: Zero-advantage cases

练习6.2：零优势情形

If the rewards are all equal (for instance, they are all 0 or all 1), the advantages will all be 0, because subtracting the mean removes the shared reward value and leaves only zeros, which we can demonstrate below:

如果奖励都相等（例如，它们都是0或都是1），那么优势值都会是0，因为减去均值会消除共同的奖励值，只留下零。我们可以在下面加以说明：

import torch
 
rollout_rewards = [0., 0., 0., 0.]
rewards = torch.tensor(rollout_rewards)
advantages = (rewards - rewards.mean()) / (rewards.std() + 1e-4)
print(advantages)
import torch rollout_rewards = [0., 0., 0., 0.] rewards = torch.tensor(rollout_rewards) advantages = (rewards - rewards.mean()) / (rewards.std() + 1e-4) print(advantages)

This returns tensor([0., 0., 0., 0.]).

这会返回张量([0., 0., 0., 0.])。

Similarly, if we change the rollout rewards to rollout_rewards = [0., 0., 0., 0.], we get the same all-zero tensor, tensor([0., 0., 0., 0.]).

同样，如果我们把展开奖励改为 rollout_rewards = [0., 0., 0., 0.]，得到的结果仍然是全零张量，即 tensor([0., 0., 0., 0.])。

In short, if all rewards in a group are identical, for example all rewards 0 or all rewards are 1, then 𝑟𝑖 -𝜇𝑖 = 0 for all i rollouts. As a result, the policy gradient is zero and the model parameters are not updated for that prompt.

简而言之，如果一个批次中的所有奖励都相同——例如全部为0或全部为1——那么对于所有的 rollout，都有 𝑟𝑖 -𝜇𝑖 = 0。因此，策略梯度为零，模型参数不会针对该 prompt 进行更新。

This behavior is intentional. If all rollouts are equally bad or equally good, there is no relative signal to tell the model which behavior to reinforce or suppress. Intuitively, if the model answers all the questions correctly, there is no need to update it. Vice versa, if the model answers all questions incorrectly, we don't want to update the model to reinforce this behavior.

这种行为是故意设计的。如果所有的模型输出都同样糟糕或同样优秀，那么就不存在相对信号来指导模型强化或抑制某种行为。从直觉上讲，如果模型把所有问题都答对了，就没有必要对其进行更新；反之，如果模型把所有问题都答错了，我们也不希望去更新模型以强化这种错误的行为。

tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path)
 
prompt = "Calculate ..."
 
def check_case(name, rollout):
    token_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt + rollout)
    prompt_len = len(tokenizer.encode(prompt))
    reward = reward_format(
        token_ids=torch.tensor(token_ids),
        prompt_len=prompt_len,
    )
    print(f"{name}: {reward}")
 
# 1) Correct case
check_case(
    "Correct order",
    "Let's ... <think> ... </think> ..."
)
# 2) Typo in tag
check_case(
    "Typo in <think>",
    "Let's ... <thnik> ... </think> ..."
)
# 3) Reversed order
check_case(
    "Reversed order",
    "Let's ... </think> ... <think> ..."
)
 
# 4) Missing one tag
check_case(
    "Missing </think>",
    "Let's ... <think> ..."
)
from pathlib import Path import torch from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import Qwen3Tokenizer from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import download_qwen3_small from reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 import reward_format download_qwen3_small( kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=True, out_dir="qwen3" ) tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-reasoning.json" tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path) prompt = "计算…" def check_case(name, rollout): token_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt + rollout) prompt_len = len(tokenizer.encode(prompt)) reward = reward_format( token_ids=torch.tensor(token_ids), prompt_len=prompt_len, ) print(f"{name}: {reward}") # 1) 正确情况 check_case( "正确顺序", "让我们… <think> … </think> …" ) # 2) 标签拼写错误 check_case( "<think> 拼写错误", "让我们… <thnik> … </think> …" ) # 3) 顺序颠倒 check_case( "顺序颠倒", "让我们… </think> … <think> …" ) # 4) 缺少一个标签 check_case( "缺少 </think>", "让我们… <think> …" )

The output is as follows, indicating that the function requires correct <think>...</think> tag use to award a reward of 1.0

输出如下，表明该函数需要正确使用<think>…</think>标签才能获得1.0的奖励。

Correct order: 1.0
Typo in <think>: 0.0
Reversed order: 0.0
Missing </think>: 0.0

Exercise 7.2: Making the format reward conditional

练习 7.2：使格式奖励有条件地生效

The implementation of the conditional reward is very simple; in the main chapter, we discussed implementing the overall reward as follows:

条件奖励的实现非常简单；在主章节中，我们讨论了如下方式来实现整体奖励：

reward = rlvr_reward + format_reward_weight * format_reward
奖励 = rlvr_奖励 + 格式奖励权重 * 格式奖励

So, one way to disable the reward if the correctness reward (rlvr_reward) is 0.0 is

因此，如果正确性奖励（rlvr_reward）为 0.0，则禁用奖励的一种方法是：

if conditional_reward:
    format_reward *= rlvr_reward
reward = rlvr_reward + format_reward_weight * format_reward
如果 conditional_reward 为真： format_reward 乘以 rlvr_reward reward 等于 rlvr_reward 加上 format_reward_weight 乘以 format_reward

To use it in practice, you can run the 7_6_plus_format_reward.py script, which we used in section 7.6 in chapter 7 with the --conditional_reward flag enabled.

在实际使用中，您可以运行 `7_6_plus_format_reward.py` 脚本。该脚本我们在第7章的7.6节中已经使用过，并启用了 `--conditional_reward` 标志。

We can download the log file of this run (using similar settings as in section 7.6) and plot it as follows:

我们可以下载本次运行的日志文件（使用与第7.6节相同的设置），并按如下方式绘制图表：

from reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 import download_from_github
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 import plot_grpo_metrics
download_from_github(
    "ch07/02_logs/7_6_plus_format_reward_conditional_metrics.csv"
)
plot_grpo_metrics(

    columns=["loss", "reward_avg", "avg_response_len", "eval_acc"],

来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 的 download_from_github 和 plot_grpo_metrics 函数。从 GitHub 下载文件： download_from_github( "ch07/02_logs/7_6_plus_format_reward_conditional_metrics.csv" ) 绘制 GRPO 指标： plot_grpo_metrics( "7_6_plus_format_reward_conditional_metrics.csv", columns=["loss", "reward_avg", "avg_response_len", "eval_acc"], )
Figure B.1 Basic metrics from a GRPO training run with a conditional format reward.
图 B.1 带有条件格式奖励的 GRPO 训练运行中的基本指标。

The plots in figure 7.1 show that the evaluation accuracy and reward average take a big hit, but seem to recover.

图7.1中的曲线显示，评估准确率和奖励均值大幅下降，但随后似乎有所回升。

Overall, despite this performance crash, this looks more stable than before, and the trend indicates that the performance would improve further if we trained longer.

总体而言，尽管性能出现了大幅下降，但当前的训练过程比之前更加稳定。趋势表明，如果继续延长训练时间，性能还将进一步提升。

plot_grpo_metrics(
    "7_6_plus_format_reward_conditional_metrics.csv",
    columns=["reward_avg", "format_reward_avg", "adv_std", "entropy_avg"],
)
绘制grpo指标图( "7_6_plus_format_reward_conditional_metrics.csv", 列=["reward_avg", "format_reward_avg", "adv_std", "entropy_avg"], )
Figure B.2 Additional metrics from a GRPO training run with a conditional format reward.
图 B.2 带有条件格式奖励的 GRPO 训练运行中的附加指标。

In figure 7.2, we see the average format reward mimicking the average reward graph almost perfectly, which is a good sanity check that the conditional logic is working. Also, the average format reward shows how much of the total reward is coming from the format term on the subset of correct answers.

在图7.2中，我们看到平均格式奖励几乎完美地复现了平均奖励曲线，这是一个很好的合理性检验，表明条件逻辑正在正常工作。此外，平均格式奖励还展示了在正确答案子集上，总奖励中有多少是来自格式项的。

As we can see though, since the average format reward graph echoes the average reward one, it's mainly a bonus (and it looks like it's always awarded if the model is correct; this makes sense, because the trained reasoning model already knows how to use <think>...</think> tags correctly (and we can see that it doesn't unlearn this ability).

不过，正如我们所见，由于平均格式奖励曲线与平均奖励曲线基本一致，这实际上更多是一种额外的奖励（而且似乎只要模型正确，就会一直获得这种奖励；这一点也很合理，因为经过训练的推理模型已经掌握了如何正确使用<think>…</think>标签，而且我们也能观察到它并没有丧失这一能力）。

The entropy increase is still a bit troubling, though, and could hint towards training instabilities that could potentially be addressed by other means (like tighter clipping with smaller clip_eps).

然而，熵的增加仍然稍显令人担忧，这可能暗示训练过程中存在不稳定性，而这种不稳定性或许可以通过其他方式加以缓解（例如，使用更小的 clip_eps 进行更严格的裁剪）。
