Appendix C. Qwen3 LLM source code

附录C. 通义千问3大模型源代码

While this is a from scratch book, as mentioned in the main chapters, the from scratch part refers to the reasoning techniques, not the LLM itself. Implementing an LLM entirely from scratch would require a separate book, which is the topic of my Build A Large Language Model (From Scratch) book (http://mng.bz/orYv).

虽然本书是从零开始构建的，但正如主章节所提到的，这里的“从零开始”指的是推理技术，而非大语言模型本身。要完全从零实现一个大语言模型，需要一本专门的书籍，而这正是我的《从零构建大型语言模型》一书的主题（http://mng.bz/orYv）。

However, for readers interested in seeing the Qwen3 implementation we use in this Build A Reasoning Model (From Scratch) book, this appendix lists the source code for the Qwen3Model model that I implemented in and that we import from the book's reasoning_from_scratch Python package:

然而，对于有兴趣查看我们在《从零开始构建推理模型》一书中使用的通义千问3模型实现的读者，本附录列出了我所实现的Qwen3Model模型的源代码，该模型我们是从书中的reasoning_from_scratch Python包中导入的：

from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import Qwen3Model, Qwen3Tokenizer
从 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 导入 Qwen3Model 和 Qwen3Tokenizer

As shown in figure C.1, the Qwen3 architecture is very similar to GPT-2, which is covered in my Build A Large Language Model (From Scratch) book. While familiarity with GPT-2 is not required for this book, this appendix mentions comparisons to GPT-2 for those who are familiar with it. In fact, I wrote the Qwen3 implementation by porting the GPT-2 model from my other book piece by piece into the Qwen3 architecture, such that it follows similar style conventions to improve readability.

如图C.1所示，Qwen3的架构与我在《从零开始构建大型语言模型》一书中介绍的GPT-2非常相似。尽管阅读本书并不需要熟悉GPT-2，但本附录仍会提及与GPT-2的对比，以供对该模型有所了解的读者参考。事实上，我在实现Qwen3时，是将另一本书中的GPT-2模型逐模块移植到Qwen3的架构中，同时尽量沿用GPT-2的代码风格约定，从而提高代码的可读性。

Figure C.1 Architectural comparison between Qwen3 and GPT-2. Both models process text through embedding layers and stacked transformer blocks, but they differ in certain design choices.
图C.1 通义千问3与GPT-2的架构对比。两者均通过嵌入层和堆叠的Transformer块对文本进行处理，但在某些设计选择上存在差异。

As shown in figure C.1, both Qwen3 (released in 2025) and GPT-2 (released in 2019) are very similar overall in that they are both based on the decoder submodule of the original transformer architecture. However, some of the design choices have evolved since 2019. Note that most of these design choices found in Qwen3 are not unique to Qwen3 but are found in many other contemporary LLMs, which I discussed in my The Big LLM Architecture Comparison (https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/the-big-llm-architecture-comparison) article.

如图C.1所示，通义千问3（2025年发布）和GPT-2（2019年发布）在整体架构上非常相似，二者均基于原始Transformer架构中的解码器子模块。然而，自2019年以来，一些设计选择已经发生了演进。需要注意的是，通义千问3中的大多数设计选择并非其独有，而是广泛存在于许多其他当代大语言模型中，这一点我在《大型语言模型架构对比》一文中已有详细讨论（https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/the-big-llm-architecture-comparison）。

For readers new to LLMs who want to understand how these architectures are implemented, I recommend starting with GPT-2. Its design is simpler to implement, which makes it an easier entry point before exploring more modern variations.

对于初次接触大语言模型、希望了解其架构实现方式的读者，我建议从 GPT-2 入手。GPT-2 的设计相对简单，易于实现，因此是探索更现代变体之前的一个良好起点。

Since this book does not focus on architecture implementations, the remainder of this appendix will cover only a brief overview of Qwen3's code.

由于本书不着重探讨架构实现，本附录其余部分将仅对Qwen3的代码进行简要概述。

C.1 Root mean square layer normalization (RMSNorm)

C.1 均方根层归一化（RMSNorm）

In contrast to GPT-2, which used standard LayerNorm, the newer Qwen3 architecture replaces it with root mean square layer normalization (RMSNorm). This is a trend that has become increasingly common in recent model architectures.

与使用标准层归一化（LayerNorm）的GPT-2不同，较新的Qwen3架构将其替换为均方根层归一化（RMSNorm）。这一做法在近年来的模型架构中愈发常见。

RMSNorm fulfills the same core function as LayerNorm: normalizing layer activations to stabilize and improve training. However, it simplifies the computation by removing the mean-centering step, as shown in figure C.2. This means that activations will still be normalized, but they are not centered at 0.

RMSNorm 与 LayerNorm 具有相同的的核心功能：对层的激活值进行归一化，以稳定并提升训练过程。然而，如图 C.2 所示，RMSNorm 通过去除均值中心化步骤来简化计算。这意味着激活值仍然会被归一化，但不会以 0 为中心。

Figure C.2 Comparison of LayerNorm (used in GPT-2) and RMSNorm (used in Qwen3). LayerNorm (left) normalizes activations so that their average value (mean) is exactly zero and their spread (variance) is exactly one. RMSNorm (right) instead scales activations based on their root mean square, which does not enforce zero mean or unit variance, but still keeps the mean and variance within a reasonable range for stable training.
图 C.2 LayerNorm（用于 GPT-2）与 RMSNorm（用于 Qwen3）的对比。LayerNorm（左）对激活值进行归一化，使其均值精确为零、方差精确为一。而 RMSNorm（右）则基于激活值的均方根对其进行缩放，不强制要求均值为零或方差为一，但仍能将均值和方差控制在合理范围内，以保证训练的稳定性。

As we can see in figure C.2, both LayerNorm and RMSNorm scale the layer outputs to be in a reasonable range.

如图C.2所示，LayerNorm和RMSNorm均会将层输出缩放到一个合理的范围内。

LayerNorm subtracts the mean and divides by the standard deviation such that the layer outputs have a zero mean and unit variance (variance of one and standard deviation of one), which results in favorable properties, in terms of gradient values, for stable training.

层归一化通过减去均值并除以标准差，使得层的输出具有零均值和单位方差（即方差为1、标准差为1），从而在梯度值方面带来有利特性，有助于模型的稳定训练。

RMSNorm divides the inputs by the root mean square. This scales activations to a comparable magnitude without enforcing zero mean or unit variance. In this particular example shown in figure C.2, the mean is 0.77 and the variance is 0.41.

RMSNorm 通过将输入除以它们的均方根来实现归一化。这种方法能够在不强制激活值具有零均值或单位方差的情况下，将其缩放到一个可比较的幅度。在图 C.2 所示的这个特定示例中，均值为 0.77，方差为 0.41。

Both LayerNorm and RMSNorm stabilize activation scales and improve optimization; however, RMSNorm is often preferred in large-scale LLMs because it is computationally cheaper. Unlike LayerNorm, RMSNorm does not use a bias (shift) term by default, which reduces the number of trainable parameters. Moreover, RMSNorm reduces the expensive mean and variance computations to a single root-mean-square operation. This reduces the number of cross-feature reductions from two to one, which lowers communication overhead on GPUs and slightly improves training efficiency.

LayerNorm 和 RMSNorm 都能稳定激活值的尺度并改善优化过程；然而，在大规模大语言模型中，RMSNorm 通常更受青睐，因为它计算开销更低。与 LayerNorm 不同，RMSNorm 默认不使用偏置（平移）项，从而减少了可训练参数的数量。此外，RMSNorm 将昂贵的均值和方差计算简化为一次均方根运算。这一改进将跨特征的规约操作从两次减少到一次，进而降低了 GPU 上的通信开销，并略微提升训练效率。

Listing C.1 shows what RMSNorm looks like in code.

清单 C.1 展示了 RMSNorm 在代码中的实现。

Listing C.1 RMSNorm .
import torch.nn as nn
 
class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
 
    def __init__(
        self,
        emb_dim,
        eps=1e-6,
        bias=False,
        qwen3_compatible=True,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.eps = eps
        self.qwen3_compatible = qwen3_compatible
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(emb_dim))
        self.shift = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(emb_dim)) if bias else None
 
    def forward(self, x):
        input_dtype = x.dtype
 
        if self.qwen3_compatible:
            x = x.to(torch.float32)
 
        variance = x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        norm_x = x * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.eps)
        norm_x = norm_x * self.scale
 
        if self.shift is not None:
            norm_x = norm_x + self.shift
 
        return norm_x.to(input_dtype)
import torch.nn as nn class RMSNorm(nn.Module): def __init__( self, emb_dim, eps=1e-6, bias=False, qwen3_compatible=True, ): super().__init__() self.eps = eps self.qwen3_compatible = qwen3_compatible self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(emb_dim)) self.shift = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(emb_dim)) if bias else None def forward(self, x): input_dtype = x.dtype if self.qwen3_compatible: x = x.to(torch.float32) variance = x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) norm_x = x * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.eps) norm_x = norm_x * self.scale if self.shift is not None: norm_x = norm_x + self.shift return norm_x.to(input_dtype)

Note that, for brevity, this appendix does not provide detailed code walkthroughs for each LLM component. Instead, in section C.6, we will integrate all components into the Qwen3Model class, load the pre-trained weights into it, and then use this model to generate text in section C.9.

请注意，为简洁起见，本附录并未对每个大语言模型组件提供详细的代码解读。相反，在第 C.6 节中，我们将把所有组件整合到 Qwen3Model 类中，并将预训练权重加载到该类中；随后在第 C.9 节中，我们将使用该模型生成文本。

C.2 Feed forward module

C.2 前馈模块

The feed forward module (a small multi-layer perceptron) is replaced with a gated linear unit (GLU) variant, introduced in a 2020 paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05202). In this design, the standard two fully connected layers are replaced by three, as shown in figure C.3.

前馈模块（一个小型多层感知机）被一种门控线性单元（GLU）变体所替代，该变体于2020年的一篇论文中提出（https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05202）。在这一设计中，标准的两层全连接层被三层取代，如图C.3所示。

Figure C.3 In GPT-2 (top), the feed forward module consists of two fully connected (linear) layers separated by a non-linear activation function. In Qwen3 (bottom), this module is a gated linear unit (GLU) variant, which adds a third linear layer (linear layer 3) and multiplies the output of this linear layer 3 elementwise with the activated output of linear layer 1.
图 C.3 在 GPT-2（上）中，前馈模块由两个全连接（线性）层组成，两者之间通过一个非线性激活函数隔开。而在 Qwen3（下）中，该模块是一种门控线性单元（GLU）的变体，它增加了一个第三个线性层（线性层 3），并将该线性层 3 的输出与线性层 1 经过激活后的输出按元素相乘。

Qwen3's feed forward module (figure C.3) can be implemented as shown in listing C.2.

Qwen3 的前馈模块（图 C.3）可以按照清单 C.2 中所示的方式实现。

Listing C.2 Qwen3 feed forward module .
class FeedForward(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(
            cfg["emb_dim"], cfg["hidden_dim"], dtype=cfg["dtype"],
            bias=False
        )
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(
            cfg["emb_dim"], cfg["hidden_dim"], dtype=cfg["dtype"],
            bias=False
        )
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(
            cfg["hidden_dim"], cfg["emb_dim"], dtype=cfg["dtype"],
            bias=False
        )
 
    def forward(self, x):
        x_fc1 = self.fc1(x)
        x_fc2 = self.fc2(x)
        x = nn.functional.silu(x_fc1) * x_fc2  #A
        return self.fc3(x)
#A The non-linear activation function here is a SiLU function, which will be discussed later
#A 这里的非线性激活函数是SiLU函数，稍后会进行讨论。

At first glance, it might seem that the GLU feed forward variant used in Qwen3 should outperform the standard feed forward variant in GPT-2, simply because it adds an extra linear layer (three instead of two) and therefore appears to have more parameters.

初看起来，似乎通义千问3所采用的GLU前馈网络变体应该优于GPT-2中的标准前馈网络变体，原因很简单：它多了一个线性层（三个而非两个），因此看起来拥有更多的参数。

However, this intuition is misleading. In practice, the fc1 and fc2 layers in the GLU variant are each half the width of the fc1 layer in a standard feed forward module. In practice, the GLU variant has fewer parameters.

然而，这种直觉是具有误导性的。在实践中，GLU变体中的fc1和fc2层的宽度均为标准前馈模块中fc1层的一半。因此，GLU变体的实际参数量更少。

To illustrate this with a concrete example, suppose the input dimension to the "Linear layer 1" in figure C.3 is 1024. This corresponds to cfg["emb_dim"] in listing C.2. The output dimension of fc1 is 3,072 (cfg["hidden_dim"]). Note that these are the actual numbers used in the Qwen3 0.6B variant. In this case, we have the following parameter counts for the GLU variant in listing C.2:

为了通过一个具体的例子来说明这一点，假设图 C.3 中“线性层 1”的输入维度为 1024。这对应于清单 C.2 中的 cfg["emb_dim"]。而 fc1 的输出维度为 3,072（cfg["hidden_dim"]）。请注意，这些正是 Qwen3 0.6B 变体中实际使用的数值。在这种情况下，清单 C.2 中的 GLU 变体具有如下参数量：

  • fc1: 1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • fc1: 1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • fc2: 1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • fc2: 1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • fc3: 1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • fc3：1024 × 3,072 = 3,145,728
  • Total: 3 × 3,145,728 = 9,437,184 parameters
  • 总计：3 × 3,145,728 = 9,437,184 个参数

If we assume that fc1 in this GLU variant has half the width as would be typically chosen for an fc1 in a standard feed forward module, the parameter counts of the standard feed forward module would be as follows:

假设该 GLU 变体中的 fc1 宽度仅为标准前馈模块中 fc1 通常选择宽度的一半，则标准前馈模块的参数量将如下：

  • fc1: 1024 × 2×3,072 = 6,291,456
  • fc1: 1024 × 2×3,072 = 6,291,456
  • fc2: 1024 × 2×3,072 = 6,291,456
  • fc2: 1024 × 2×3,072 = 6,291,456
  • Total: 2 × 6,291,456 = 12,582,912 parameters
  • 总计：2 × 6,291,456 = 12,582,912 个参数

While GLU variants usually have fewer parameters than regular feed forward modules, they perform better. The improvement comes from the additional multiplicative interaction introduced by the gating mechanism, activation(x_fc1) * x_fc2, which increases the model's expressivity. This is similar to how deeper, slimmer networks can outperform shallower, wider ones, given proper training.

尽管GLU变体通常比普通的前馈模块参数量更少，但其性能却更好。这种提升源于门控机制引入的额外乘法交互项——activation(x_fc1) * x_fc2——它增强了模型的表达能力。这类似于在训练得当的情况下，更深、更窄的网络往往能胜过较浅、较宽的网络。

Before we proceed to the next section, there is one more thing to address. Note that the feed forward module shown in figure C.3 contains an element labeled as "Activation function, " whereas we used a nn.functional.silu activation as a concrete example in listing C.2.

在进入下一节之前，还有一件事需要说明。请注意，图C.3中所示的前馈模块包含一个标为“激活函数”的元素，而在清单C.2中，我们以 nn.functional.silu 激活函数作为具体示例。

Historically, activation functions were a hot topic of debate until the deep learning community largely converged on the rectified linear unit (ReLU) more than a decade ago. ReLU is simple and computationally cheap, but it has a sharp kink at zero. This motivated researchers to explore smoother functions such as the Gaussian error linear unit (GELU) and the sigmoid linear unit (SiLU), as shown in figure C.4.

历史上，激活函数曾是激烈争论的焦点，直到十多年前深度学习社区基本达成共识，普遍采用修正线性单元（ReLU）。ReLU 简单且计算开销低，但在零点处存在尖锐的折角。这一特性促使研究人员探索更为平滑的激活函数，例如高斯误差线性单元（GELU）和 Sigmoid 线性单元（SiLU），如图 C.4 所示。

Figure C.4 Different activation functions that can be used in a feed forward module (neural network). GELU and SiLU (Swish) offer smooth alternatives to ReLU, which has a sharp kink at input zero.
图 C.4 前馈模块（神经网络）中可使用的不同激活函数。GELU 和 SiLU（Swish）为 ReLU 提供了平滑的替代方案，而 ReLU 在输入为零处存在尖锐的折点。

GELU involves the Gaussian cumulative distribution function (CDF). Computing this CDF is slow because it uses piecewise logic and exponentials, which makes it hard to write fused, optimized GPU kernels (although a tanh approximation exists that uses cheaper operations and runs faster with near-identical results).

GELU 涉及高斯累积分布函数（CDF）。计算该 CDF 的速度较慢，因为它使用了分段逻辑和指数运算，这使得难以编写融合且经过优化的 GPU 内核（不过，存在一种基于 tanh 的近似方法，它采用更廉价的操作，在结果几乎相同的情况下运行得更快）。

In short, while GELU produces smooth activation curves, it is overall computationally more expensive than simpler functions.

简而言之，尽管GELU能够产生平滑的激活曲线，但其整体计算开销仍高于较为简单的激活函数。

Newer models have largely replaced GELU with the SiLU (also known as Swish) function, which smoothly suppresses large negative inputs toward ~0 and is approximately linear for large positive inputs, as shown in figure C.4.

较新的模型已大多用 SiLU（也称 Swish）函数取代 GELU 函数。SiLU 函数能够平滑地将较大的负输入压制到接近 0，并在较大的正输入范围内呈现近似线性特性，如图 C.4 所示。

SiLU has a similar smoothness, but it is slightly cheaper to compute than GELU and offers comparable modeling performance. In practice, SiLU is now used in most architectures, while GELU remains in use in only some models, such as Google's Gemma open-weight LLM. In the implementation of the feed forward module in listing C.2, this SiLU function is called via nn.functional.silu. The feed forward module in listing C.2 is also often called SwiGLU, an abbreviation that is derived from the terms Swish and GLU.

SiLU 具有类似的平滑性，但在计算上比 GELU 略为便宜，同时能提供相当的建模性能。实际上，SiLU 目前已被大多数架构所采用，而 GELU 仅在少数模型中继续使用，例如 Google 的 Gemma 开源权重大语言模型。在清单 C.2 中前馈模块的实现中，通过 nn.functional.silu 调用了该 SiLU 函数。清单 C.2 中的前馈模块通常也被称为 SwiGLU，这一缩写源自 Swish 和 GLU 这两个术语。

C.3 Rotary position embeddings (RoPE)

C.3 旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）

In transformer-based LLMs, positional encoding is necessary because of the attention mechanism. By default, attention treats the input tokens as if they have no order. In the original GPT architecture, absolute positional embeddings addressed this by adding a learned embedding vector for each position in the sequence, which is then added to the token embeddings.

在基于 Transformer 的大语言模型中，位置编码是必不可少的，这是由自注意力机制决定的。默认情况下，自注意力机制会将输入标记视为无序的。在最初的 GPT 架构中，通过为序列中的每个位置学习一个位置嵌入向量，并将其与标记嵌入相加，从而解决了这一问题。

RoPE (short for rotary position embeddings) introduced a different approach: instead of adding position information as separate embeddings, it encodes position information by rotating the query and key vectors in the attention mechanism (section C.4) in a way that depends on each token's position. RoPE is an elegant idea, but also a long topic in itself. Interested readers can find more information in the original RoPE paper at https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09864. (While first introduced in 2021, RoPE became widely adopted with the release of the original Llama model in 2023 and has since become a staple in modern LLMs, so it is not unique to Qwen3.)

RoPE（旋转位置嵌入的简称）提出了一种不同的方法：它不是将位置信息作为独立的嵌入添加进去，而是在注意力机制中（见C.4节），根据每个 token 的位置对查询向量和键向量进行旋转编码。RoPE 是一个非常优雅的思路，但本身也是一个相当复杂的话题。感兴趣的读者可以参阅原始的 RoPE 论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09864。（尽管 RoPE 最早在 2021 年提出，但它直到 2023 年 Llama 模型发布后才被广泛采用，并迅速成为现代大语言模型中的标准组件，因此它并不仅限于通义千问 3。）

RoPE can be implemented in two mathematically equivalent ways: the interleaved form, which pairs adjacent dimensions for rotation, or in a two-halves form, which splits the dimension into cosine and sine halves for convenience. Listing C.3 implements the two-halves variant, which can be easier to read.

RoPE 可以用两种数学上等价的方式实现：一种是交错形式，将相邻的维度两两配对进行旋转；另一种是分半形式，为了方便起见，将每个维度一分为二，分别对应余弦和正弦部分。清单 C.3 实现的是分半形式，通常更易于阅读。

Listing C.3 RoPE functions .
import torch
 
 
def compute_rope_params(head_dim, theta_base=10_000, context_length=4096,
                        dtype=torch.float32):
    assert head_dim % 2 == 0, "Embedding dimension must be even"
    inv_freq = 1.0 / (theta_base ** (
        torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2, dtype=dtype)[: (head_dim // 2)].float()
        / head_dim
    ))
    positions = torch.arange(context_length, dtype=dtype)
    angles = positions[:, None] * inv_freq[None, :]
    angles = torch.cat([angles, angles], dim=1)
 
    cos = torch.cos(angles)
    sin = torch.sin(angles)
 
    return cos, sin
 
 
def apply_rope(x, cos, sin, offset=0):
    batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = x.shape    #A
    assert head_dim % 2 == 0, "Head dimension must be even"
 
    x1 = x[..., : head_dim // 2]  # First half    #B
    x2 = x[..., head_dim // 2:]  # Second half    #B
 
    
    cos = cos[offset:offset + seq_len, :].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
    sin = sin[offset:offset + seq_len, :].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
    # Shape after:  (1, 1, seq_len, head_dim)
 
    rotated = torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)
    x_rotated = (x * cos) + (rotated * sin)
 
    return x_rotated.to(dtype=x.dtype)    #C
#A The shape is (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
#B Split x into first half and second half
#C It's ok to use lower-precision after applying cos and sin rotation
#A 形状为 (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim) #B 将 x 分成前半部分和后半部分 #C 应用余弦和正弦旋转后，可以使用较低的精度。

The RoPE code in listing C.3 will be used in the grouped query attention mechanism in section C.4.

清单 C.3 中的 RoPE 代码将在第 C.4 节的分组查询注意力机制中使用。

RoPE implementation variants
RoPE 实现变体

Readers familiar with the original RoPE paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09864), you may be wondering about the particular implementation I have chosen.

熟悉原始 RoPE 论文（https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.09864）的读者可能会对我所采用的具体实现方式感到好奇。

There are two common styles to implement RoPE, which are mathematically equivalent. The implementations mainly differ in how the rotation matrix pairs dimensions. I chose the split-halves style as it is a bit easier to read and implement.

实现 RoPE 的常见方式有两种，它们在数学上是等价的。这两种实现的主要区别在于旋转矩阵如何对特征维度进行配对。我选择了“分半”式，因为它在阅读和实现上都稍微简单一些。

1) Split-halves style (this book, Hugging Face Transformers):
      [ x0   x1   x2   x3   x4   x5   x6   x7 ]
        │    │    │    │    │    │    │    │
        ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼
       cos  cos  cos  cos  sin  sin  sin  sin
1) 分半式（本书、Hugging Face Transformers）： [ x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 x7 ] │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ cos cos cos cos sin sin sin sin

Rotation matrix:

旋转矩阵：

      [ cosθ   -sinθ    0      0   ... ]
      [ sinθ    cosθ    0      0   ... ]
      [  0       0    cosθ   -sinθ ... ]
      [  0       0    sinθ    cosθ ... ]
[ cosθ -sinθ 0 0 ... ] [ sinθ cosθ 0 0 ... ] [ 0 0 cosθ -sinθ ... ] [ 0 0 sinθ cosθ ... ]

Here, the embedding dimensions are split into two halves and then each one is rotated in blocks.

在这里，嵌入维度被分成两半，然后分别对每一半进行分块旋转。

2) Interleaved (even/odd) style (original paper, Llama repo):

2) 交错（偶数/奇数）样式（原始论文、Llama 仓库）：

      [ x0   x1   x2   x3   x4   x5   x6   x7 ]
        │    │    │    │    │    │    │    │
        ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼    ▼
       cos  sin  cos  sin  cos  sin  cos  sin
[ x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 x7 ] │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ ▼ cos sin cos sin cos sin cos sin

Rotation matrix:

旋转矩阵：

      [ cosθ  -sinθ    0      0   ... ]
      [ sinθ   cosθ    0      0   ... ]
      [  0      0    cosθ   -sinθ ... ]
      [  0      0    sinθ    cosθ ... ]
[ cosθ -sinθ 0 0 ... ] [ sinθ cosθ 0 0 ... ] [ 0 0 cosθ -sinθ ... ] [ 0 0 sinθ cosθ ... ]

Here, embedding dims are interleaved as even/odd cosine/sine pairs.

在这里，嵌入维度以偶数/奇数的余弦/正弦对交错排列。

Both layouts encode the same relative positions. The only difference is how dimensions are paired.

两种布局编码了相同的相对位置。唯一的区别在于维度的配对方式。

C.4 Grouped query attention (GQA)

C.4 分组查询注意力（GQA）

Grouped query attention (GQA) has become the standard, more compute- and parameter-efficient alternative to the original multi-head attention (MHA) mechanism.

分组查询注意力（GQA）已成为替代原始多头注意力（MHA）机制的标准方案，它在计算和参数效率上均有显著提升。

Unlike MHA, where each head also has its own set of keys and values, to reduce memory usage, GQA groups multiple heads to share the same key and value projections, as shown in figure C.5.

与多头注意力机制（MHA）不同，在MHA中每个注意力头都有一组独立的键和值，而为降低内存占用，分组式多头注意力机制（GQA）会将多个注意力头分组，使其共享相同的键和值投影，如图C.5所示。

Figure C.5 A comparison between MHA and GQA. Here, the group size is 2, where a key and value pair is shared among 2 queries.
图 C.5 MHA 与 GQA 的对比。此处分组大小为 2，即一组键值对被 2 个查询共享。

So, the core idea behind GQA, shown in figure C.5, is to reduce the number of key and value heads by sharing them across multiple query heads. This (1) lowers the model's parameter count and (2) reduces the memory bandwidth usage for key and value tensors during inference since fewer keys and values need to be stored and retrieved from the KV cache (section C.7).

因此，如图 C.5 所示，GQA 的核心思想是通过让多个查询头共享键头和值头，从而减少键头和值头的数量。这样做可以（1）降低模型的参数量，以及（2）在推理过程中减少键张量和值张量的内存带宽占用，因为需要存储和从 KV 缓存中读取的键和值数量更少（见第 C.7 节）。

While GQA is primarily a computational efficiency workaround for MHA, ablation studies (as presented in the original GQA paper, https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13245) show that it performs comparably to standard MHA in terms of LLM modeling performance.

尽管GQA主要是针对多头注意力机制的一种计算效率优化方案，但消融实验（如原始GQA论文中所示，https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13245）表明，在大语言模型的建模性能方面，其表现与标准的多头注意力机制相当。

Listing C.4 implements the GQA mechanism with KV cache support.

清单C.4实现了支持KV缓存的GQA机制。

Listing C.4 Grouped query attention .
class GroupedQueryAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_in, num_heads, num_kv_groups, head_dim=None,
                 qk_norm=False, dtype=None):
        super().__init__()
        assert num_heads % num_kv_groups == 0
 
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.num_kv_groups = num_kv_groups
        self.group_size = num_heads // num_kv_groups
 
        if head_dim is None:
            assert d_in % num_heads == 0
            head_dim = d_in // num_heads
 
        self.head_dim = head_dim
        self.d_out = num_heads * head_dim
 
        self.W_query = nn.Linear(
            d_in, self.d_out, bias=False, dtype=dtype
        )
        self.W_key = nn.Linear(
            d_in, num_kv_groups * head_dim, bias=False,dtype=dtype
        )
        self.W_value = nn.Linear(
            d_in, num_kv_groups * head_dim, bias=False, dtype=dtype
        )
 
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(self.d_out, d_in, bias=False, dtype=dtype)
 
        if qk_norm:
            self.q_norm = RMSNorm(head_dim, eps=1e-6)
            self.k_norm = RMSNorm(head_dim, eps=1e-6)
        else:
            self.q_norm = self.k_norm = None
 
    def forward(self, x, mask, cos, sin, start_pos=0, cache=None):
        b, num_tokens, _ = x.shape
 
        queries = self.W_query(x)            #A
        keys = self.W_key(x)                 #B
        values = self.W_value(x)             #B
 
        queries = queries.view(b, num_tokens, self.num_heads,
                               self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        keys_new = keys.view(b, num_tokens, self.num_kv_groups,
                             self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        values_new = values.view(b, num_tokens, self.num_kv_groups,
                                 self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
 
        if self.q_norm:
            queries = self.q_norm(queries)
        if self.k_norm:
            keys_new = self.k_norm(keys_new)
 
        queries = apply_rope(queries, cos, sin, offset=start_pos)
        keys_new = apply_rope(keys_new, cos, sin, offset=start_pos)
 
        if cache is not None:
            prev_k, prev_v = cache
            keys = torch.cat([prev_k, keys_new], dim=2)
            values = torch.cat([prev_v, values_new], dim=2)
        else:
            start_pos = 0                    #C
            keys, values = keys_new, values_new            
        next_cache = (keys, values)
 
        
        keys = keys.repeat_interleave(       #D
            self.group_size, dim=1           #D
        )                                    #D
        values = values.repeat_interleave(   #D
            self.group_size, dim=1           #D
        )                                    #D
 
        attn_scores = queries @ keys.transpose(2, 3)
        attn_scores = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask, -torch.inf)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(
            attn_scores / self.head_dim**0.5, dim=-1
        )
 
        context = (attn_weights @ values).transpose(1, 2)
        context = context.reshape(b, num_tokens, self.d_out)
        return self.out_proj(context), next_cache
#A The shape is (b, num_tokens, num_heads * head_dim)
#B The shapes are (b, num_tokens, num_kv_groups * head_dim)
#C Reset RoPE
#D Expand K and V to match number of heads
#A 形状为 (b, num_tokens, num_heads * head_dim) #B 形状为 (b, num_tokens, num_kv_groups * head_dim) #C 重置 RoPE #D 将 K 和 V 扩展到与注意力头数匹配

You may have noticed that the GQA mechanism in listing C.4 also includes a qk_norm parameter. This is not part of the standard GQA design. When qk_norm=True, an additional Query/Key-RMSNorm-based normalization, called QKNorm, is applied to both the queries and keys, which is a technique used in Qwen3. As discussed earlier in the RMSNorm section (section C.1), QKNorm helps improve training stability.

你可能已经注意到，清单 C.4 中的 GQA 机制还包含一个 qk_norm 参数。这并不是标准 GQA 设计的一部分。当 qk_norm=True 时，会对查询和键分别应用一种基于 RMSNorm 的归一化操作，称为 QKNorm，这是 Qwen3 中使用的一项技术。正如前面在 RMSNorm 部分（第 C.1 节）所讨论的那样，QKNorm 有助于提高训练稳定性。

C.5 Transformer block

C.5 变压器块

The transformer block is the central component of an LLM, which combines all the individual elements covered in this appendix so far. As shown in figure C.6, it is repeated multiple times; in the 0.6-billion-parameter version of Qwen3, it is repeated 28 times.

Transformer模块是大型语言模型的核心组件，它将本附录迄今为止讨论的所有独立元素整合在一起。如图C.6所示，该模块会被重复多次；在通义千问3的0.6亿参数版本中，它被重复了28次。

Figure C.6 The Structure of the transformer block in Qwen3. Each block includes RMSNorm, RoPE, masked grouped-query attention, and a feed-forward module, and is repeated 28 times in the 0.6B-parameter model.
图 C.6 Qwen3 中的 Transformer 块结构。每个块包括 RMSNorm、RoPE、带掩码的分组查询注意力以及前馈模块，在 0.6B 参数模型中重复 28 次。

Listing C.5 implements the transformer block shown in figure C.6.

清单C.5实现了图C.6所示的Transformer块。

Listing C.5 Transformer block .
class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        super().__init__()
        self.att = GroupedQueryAttention(
            d_in=cfg["emb_dim"],
            num_heads=cfg["n_heads"],
            head_dim=cfg["head_dim"],
            num_kv_groups=cfg["n_kv_groups"],
            qk_norm=cfg["qk_norm"],
            dtype=cfg["dtype"]
        )
        self.ff = FeedForward(cfg)
        self.norm1 = RMSNorm(cfg["emb_dim"], eps=1e-6)
        self.norm2 = RMSNorm(cfg["emb_dim"], eps=1e-6)
 
    def forward(self, x, mask, cos, sin, start_pos=0, cache=None):
        shortcut = x
        x = self.norm1(x)
        x, next_cache = self.att(
            x, mask, cos, sin, start_pos=start_pos,cache=cache
        )  #A
        x = x + shortcut
 
        shortcut = x
        x = self.norm2(x)
        x = self.ff(x)
        x = x + shortcut
 
        return x, next_cache
#A The shape is (batch_size, num_tokens, emb_size)
#A 形状为 (batch_size, num_tokens, emb_size)

As we can see, in listing C.5, the transformer block simply connects various elements we implemented in previous sections.

正如我们所见，在清单 C.5 中，Transformer 块只是将我们在先前章节中实现的各个组件连接起来。

C.6 Main model code

C.6 主模型代码

In this section, we will define the Qwen3Model class that we imported and used in chapter 2.

在本节中，我们将定义我们在第2章中导入并使用的Qwen3Model类。

To implement the Qwen3Model class, the code in listing C.6 follows the architecture previously shown in figure C.6, where the transformer block sits at the heart of the LLM.

为了实现 Qwen3Model 类，清单 C.6 中的代码遵循了先前图 C.6 所示的架构，其中 Transformer 块位于大型语言模型的核心位置。

Listing C.6 Main Qwen3Model code .
class Qwen3Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        super().__init__()
 
        # Main model parameters
        self.tok_emb = nn.Embedding(cfg["vocab_size"], cfg["emb_dim"],
                                    dtype=cfg["dtype"])
 
        self.trf_blocks = nn.ModuleList(
            [TransformerBlock(cfg) for _ in range(cfg["n_layers"])]
        )
        self.final_norm = RMSNorm(cfg["emb_dim"])
        self.out_head = nn.Linear(
            cfg["emb_dim"], cfg["vocab_size"],
            bias=False, dtype=cfg["dtype"]
        )
 
        # Reusable utilities
        if cfg["head_dim"] is None:
            head_dim = cfg["emb_dim"] // cfg["n_heads"]
        else:
            head_dim = cfg["head_dim"]
        cos, sin = compute_rope_params(
            head_dim=head_dim,
            theta_base=cfg["rope_base"],
            context_length=cfg["context_length"]
        )
        self.register_buffer("cos", cos, persistent=False)
        self.register_buffer("sin", sin, persistent=False)
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.current_pos = 0  # Track current position in KV cache
 
    def forward(self, in_idx, cache=None):
        tok_embeds = self.tok_emb(in_idx)
        x = tok_embeds
 
        num_tokens = x.shape[1]
        if cache is not None:
            pos_start = self.current_pos
            pos_end = pos_start + num_tokens
            self.current_pos = pos_end
            mask = torch.triu(
                torch.ones(
                    pos_end, pos_end, device=x.device, dtype=torch.bool
                ),
                diagonal=1
            )[pos_start:pos_end, :pos_end]
        else:
            pos_start = 0  # Not strictly necessary but helps torch.compile
            mask = torch.triu(
                torch.ones(num_tokens, num_tokens, device=x.device,
                           dtype=torch.bool),
                diagonal=1
            )
        
        mask = mask[None, None, :, :]                 #A
 
        for i, block in enumerate(self.trf_blocks):
            blk_cache = cache.get(i) if cache else None
            x, new_blk_cache = block(x, mask, self.cos, self.sin,
                                     start_pos=pos_start,
                                     cache=blk_cache)
            if cache is not None:
                cache.update(i, new_blk_cache)
 
        x = self.final_norm(x)
        logits = self.out_head(x.to(self.cfg["dtype"]))
        return logits
 
    def reset_kv_cache(self):
        self.current_pos = 0
#A Prefill: Shape (1, 1, T, T) to broadcast across batch and heads. Cached: Shape (1, 1, T, K+T) where T=new tokens, K=cached keys.
# 预填充：形状为 (1, 1, T, T)，以便在批次和头维度上进行广播。缓存：形状为 (1, 1, T, K+T)，其中 T 为新标记的数量，K 为已缓存的键。

Since we already have all the main ingredients, the Qwen3Model class in listing C.6 only adds a few more components around the transformer block, namely the embedding and output layers (including one more RMSNorm layer). However, the code may appear somewhat complicated, which is due to the KV cache option.

由于我们已经具备了所有主要组件，清单 C.6 中的 Qwen3Model 类仅在 Transformer 块周围添加了几处组件，即嵌入层和输出层（还包括一个额外的 RMSNorm 层）。不过，这段代码看起来略显复杂，这是由 KV 缓存选项所致。

As discussed in chapter 2, the KV cache can speed up the text generation process, but it is a topic outside the scope of this book. Interested readers can find more information about KV caching in my Understanding and Coding the KV Cache in LLMs from Scratch article at https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/coding-the-kv-cache-in-llms.

正如第2章所讨论的那样，KV缓存可以加速文本生成过程，但这一主题超出了本书的范围。感兴趣的读者可以在我的文章《从零开始理解并实现大语言模型中的KV缓存》中找到更多相关信息，该文章发布于 https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/coding-the-kv-cache-in-llms。

Note that the Qwen3Model class, as implemented in listing C.6, supports various model sizes (see appendix D for more information). In chapter 2, we use the 0.6-billion-parameter model as it is the least resource-intensive model in the Qwen3 model family. The specific configuration of this model is visualized in figure C.7.

请注意，如清单 C.6 所示，Qwen3Model 类支持多种模型规模（更多信息请参阅附录 D）。在第 2 章中，我们使用的是 0.6 亿参数的模型，因为它是 Qwen3 系列中资源消耗最低的模型。该模型的具体配置如图 C.7 所示。

Figure C.7 Architecture of the Qwen3 0.6B model. The model consists of a token embedding layer followed by 28 transformer blocks, each containing RMSNorm, RoPE, QKNorm, masked grouped-query attention with 16 heads, and a feed-forward module with an intermediate size of 3,072.
图 C.7 Qwen3 0.6B 模型的架构。该模型由一个词元嵌入层组成，其后接 28 个 Transformer 块，每个 Transformer 块包含 RMSNorm 归一化、RoPE 位置编码、QKNorm 归一化、具有 16 个注意力头的掩码分组查询注意力机制，以及中间层维度为 3,072 的前馈网络模块。

To use the 0.6B model shown in figure C.7 via the Qwen3Model class, we can define the following configuration in listing C.7 that we provide as input (cfg=QWEN_CONFIG_06_B) upon instantiating a new Qwen3Model instance.

要通过 Qwen3Model 类使用图 C.7 中所示的 0.6B 模型，我们可以在清单 C.7 中定义如下配置，并在实例化新的 Qwen3Model 实例时将其作为输入（cfg=QWEN_CONFIG_06_B）。

Listing C.7 Qwen3 0.6B configuration
QWEN_CONFIG_06_B = {
    "vocab_size": 151_936,     # Vocabulary size
    "context_length": 40_960,  # Length originally used during training
    "emb_dim": 1024,           # Embedding dimension
    "n_heads": 16,             # Number of attention heads
    "n_layers": 28,            # Number of layers
    "hidden_dim": 3072,        # Size of intermediate dim in FeedForward
    "head_dim": 128,           # Size of the heads in GQA
    "qk_norm": True,           # Whether to normalize queries & keys in GQA
    "n_kv_groups": 8,          # Key-Value groups for GQA
    "rope_base": 1_000_000.0,  # The base in RoPE's "theta"
    "dtype": torch.bfloat16,   # Lower-precision dtype to reduce memory
}
QWEN_CONFIG_06_B = { "vocab_size": 151_936, # 词汇表大小 "context_length": 40_960, # 训练时使用的序列长度 "emb_dim": 1024, # 嵌入维度 "n_heads": 16, # 注意力头数 "n_layers": 28, # 层数 "hidden_dim": 3072, # 前馈网络中间层的维度 "head_dim": 128, # GQA中每个头的维度 "qk_norm": True, # GQA中是否对查询和键进行归一化 "n_kv_groups": 8, # GQA中的键值分组数 "rope_base": 1_000_000.0, # RoPE中“theta”的基数 "dtype": torch.bfloat16, # 使用较低精度的数据类型以减少内存占用 }

We will use the QWEN_CONFIG_06_B configuration from listing C.7 to instantiate the Qwen3 0.6B model later in section C.9.

我们将使用清单C.7中的QWEN_CONFIG_06_B配置，在第C.9节中实例化Qwen3 0.6B模型。

More Precise Context Length Information
更精确的上下文长度信息

For Qwen3 0.6B, the default maximum supported context length is 40,960 tokens. However, the model itself was trained with only 32,768 tokens. The 40,960-token allocation reserves 32,768 tokens for model outputs (the generated text) and 8,192 tokens for typical prompts (the user's question or instruction).

对于Qwen3 0.6B，默认支持的最大上下文长度为40,960个token。然而，该模型在训练时仅使用了32,768个token。40,960个token的分配中，32,768个token用于模型输出（即生成的文本），而8,192个token则用于常规的提示（用户的提问或指令）。

To put this in perspective, 40 thousand tokens correspond to roughly one half of the first Harry Potter book.

从这个角度来看，4万个标记大约相当于第一本《哈利·波特》小说的一半。

Since this length is sufficient for most reasoning tasks, the developers note that context-extension methods (such as YaRN) are not recommended unless the average context regularly exceeds 32 thousand tokens, as enabling them in shorter contexts can slightly degrade performance.

由于这一长度已足以应对大多数推理任务，开发者指出，除非平均上下文长度经常超过3.2万个标记，否则不建议使用上下文扩展方法（如YaRN）；因为在较短的上下文中启用这些方法可能会略微降低性能。

C.7 KV cache

C.7 KV缓存

The KV-cache-related heavy-lifting is mostly done in the Qwen3Model (listing C.6) and GroupedQueryAttention (listing C.4) code. The KVCache, shown in listing C.8, stores the key-value pairs themselves during text generation, which results in the speedup we experienced when enabling KV caching in chapter 2.

与KV缓存相关的核心工作主要是在Qwen3Model（清单C.6）和GroupedQueryAttention（清单C.4）的代码中完成的。如清单C.8所示，KVCache在文本生成过程中存储键值对本身，这正是我们在第2章中启用KV缓存时所体验到的加速效果的来源。

Listing C.8 KV Cache
class KVCache:
    def __init__(self, n_layers):
        self.cache = [None] * n_layers
 
    def get(self, layer_idx):
        return self.cache[layer_idx]
 
    def update(self, layer_idx, value):
        self.cache[layer_idx] = value
 
    def get_all(self):
        return self.cache
 
    def reset(self):
        for i in range(len(self.cache)):
            self.cache[i] = None
class KVCache: def __init__(self, n_layers): self.cache = [None] * n_layers def get(self, layer_idx): return self.cache[layer_idx] def update(self, layer_idx, value): self.cache[layer_idx] = value def get_all(self): return self.cache def reset(self): for i in range(len(self.cache)): self.cache[i] = None

The KVCache class in listing C.8 is used inside the generate_text_basic_stream_cache function that we implemented in chapter 2.

清单 C.8 中的 KVCache 类用于我们在第 2 章中实现的 generate_text_basic_stream_cache 函数内部。

C.8 Tokenizer

C.8 分词器

The tokenizer code is somewhat complicated, as it supports a variety of special tokens, in addition to the base model and the so-called "Thinking" model variant of Qwen3, which is a reasoning model. The full reimplementation of the tokenizer is shown in listing C.9.

分词器的代码较为复杂，因为它不仅支持基础模型，还支持通义千问3的所谓“Thinking”模型变体——这是一种推理模型——并且还兼容多种特殊标记。分词器的完整重实现见清单C.9。

Listing C.9 Tokenizer
import re
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
 
class Qwen3Tokenizer:
    _SPECIALS = [
        "<|endoftext|>",
        "<|im_start|>", "<|im_end|>",
        "<|object_ref_start|>", "<|object_ref_end|>",
        "<|box_start|>", "<|box_end|>",
        "<|quad_start|>", "<|quad_end|>",
        "<|vision_start|>", "<|vision_end|>",
        "<|vision_pad|>", "<|image_pad|>", "<|video_pad|>",
    ]
    _SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"(<\|[^>]+?\|>)")
 
    def __init__(self,
                 tokenizer_file_path="tokenizer-base.json",
                 apply_chat_template=False,
                 add_generation_prompt=False,
                 add_thinking=False):
 
        self.apply_chat_template = apply_chat_template
        self.add_generation_prompt = add_generation_prompt
        self.add_thinking = add_thinking
 
        tok_path = Path(tokenizer_file_path)
        if not tok_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Tokenizer file '{tok_path}' not found. "
            )
 
        self._tok = Tokenizer.from_file(str(tok_path))
        self._special_to_id = {t: self._tok.token_to_id(t) 
                               for t in self._SPECIALS}
 
        self.pad_token = "<|endoftext|>"
        self.pad_token_id = self._special_to_id.get(self.pad_token)
 
        f = tok_path.name.lower()                      #A
        if "base" in f and "reasoning" not in f:       #A
            self.eos_token = "<|endoftext|>"           #A
        else:                                          #A
            self.eos_token = "<|im_end|>"              #A
        self.eos_token_id = self._special_to_id.get(self.eos_token)
 
    def encode(self, prompt, chat_wrapped=None):
        if chat_wrapped is None:
            chat_wrapped = self.apply_chat_template
 
        stripped = prompt.strip()
        if stripped in self._special_to_id and "\n" not in stripped:
            return [self._special_to_id[stripped]]
 
        if chat_wrapped:
            prompt = self._wrap_chat(prompt)
 
        ids = []
        for part in filter(None, self._SPLIT_RE.split(prompt)):
            if part in self._special_to_id:
                ids.append(self._special_to_id[part])
            else:
                ids.extend(self._tok.encode(part).ids)
        return ids
 
    def decode(self, token_ids):
        return self._tok.decode(token_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
 
    def _wrap_chat(self, user_msg):
        s = f"<|im_start|>user\n{user_msg}<|im_end|>\n"
        if self.add_generation_prompt:
            s += "<|im_start|>assistant"
            if self.add_thinking:
                s += "\n"          #B
            else:
                s += "\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n"
        return s
#A Match HF behavior: chat model: <|im_end|>, base model: <|endoftext|>
#B insert no <think> tag, just a new line
#A 匹配HF行为：聊天模型：<|im_end|>，基础模型：<|endoftext|> #B 不插入<think>标签，只换行

Note that my Qwen3Tokenizer reimplementation in listing C.9 may appear somewhat complicated, as it aims to replicate the behavior of the official tokenizer released by the Qwen3 team in the Hugging Face Transformers library.

请注意，我在程序清单 C.9 中重新实现的 Qwen3Tokenizer 可能显得有些复杂，这是因为它的设计目标是尽可能复现通义千问团队在 Hugging Face Transformers 库中发布的官方分词器的行为。

At first glance, it appears to have a few quirks. For example, when add_thinking=True, no "\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n" tokens are inserted (where \n is anewline character), and when add_thinking=False, these tokens are added. This is intentional because the non-base Qwen3 0.6B model is a hybrid that supports both reasoning ("thinking") and standard modes.

初看之下，它似乎存在一些小怪癖。例如，当 add_thinking=True 时，不会插入 `\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n` 这样的标记（其中 `\n` 表示换行符）；而当 add_thinking=False 时，则会添加这些标记。这是有意为之的，因为非基础版的 Qwen3 0.6B 模型是一种混合模型，同时支持推理（“思考”）模式和标准模式。

C.9 Using the model

C.9 使用模型

Let's now instantiate and use the model to confirm that the code works by reusing the text generation approach from chapter 2.

现在，让我们实例化这个模型，并沿用第2章中的文本生成方法来使用它，以确认代码是否正常工作。

First, we instantiate the model using the pre-trained model weights:

首先，我们使用预训练的模型权重实例化模型：

from pathlib import Path
import torch
 
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import download_qwen3_small
 
# device = get_device()         #A
device = torch.device("cpu")
 
download_qwen3_small(kind="base", tokenizer_only=False, out_dir="qwen3")
 
tokenizer_file_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-base.json"
model_file = Path("qwen3") / "qwen3-0.6B-base.pth"
 
tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_file_path)
model = Qwen3Model(QWEN_CONFIG_06_B)
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(model_file))
 
model.to(device)
#A Optional: Uncomment to use automatic device picker
#A 可选：取消注释以使用自动设备选择器

The output shows the structure of the instantiated model, which should match the values we used in the configuration file in listing C.7:

✓ qwen3/qwen3-0.6B-base.pth already up-to-date
✓ qwen3/tokenizer-base.json already up-to-date

  (tok_emb): Embedding(151936, 1024)
  (trf_blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-27): 28 x TransformerBlock(

        (W_query): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=2048, bias=False)
        (W_key): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=1024, bias=False)
        (W_value): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=1024, bias=False)
        (out_proj): Linear(in_features=2048, out_features=1024, bias=False)

      )

  (out_head): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=151936, bias=False)
)
✓ qwen3/qwen3-0.6B-base.pth 已是最新 ✓ qwen3/tokenizer-base.json 已是最新 Qwen3Model( (tok_emb): 嵌入层(151936, 1024) (trf_blocks): 模块列表( (0-27): 28 个 Transformer 块( (att): 分组查询注意力机制( (W_query): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=2048，无偏置) (W_key): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=1024，无偏置) (W_value): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=1024，无偏置) (out_proj): 线性层(输入特征数=2048，输出特征数=1024，无偏置) (q_norm): RMS 归一化层() (k_norm): RMS 归一化层() ) (ff): 前馈网络( (fc1): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=3072，无偏置) (fc2): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=3072，无偏置) (fc3): 线性层(输入特征数=3072，输出特征数=1024，无偏置) ) (norm1): RMS 归一化层() (norm2): RMS 归一化层() ) ) (final_norm): RMS 归一化层() (out_head): 线性层(输入特征数=1024，输出特征数=151936，无偏置) )

Next, we re-use the text generation functions from chapter 2 to generate text:

接下来，我们复用第2章中的文本生成函数来生成文本：

import time
 
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import (
   generate_text_basic_stream_cache,
   generate_stats
)
 
prompt = "Explain large language models in a single sentence."
input_token_ids_tensor = torch.tensor(
    tokenizer.encode(prompt),
    device=device
    ).unsqueeze(0)
max_new_tokens = 200
 
start_time = time.time()
generated_ids = []
 
for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache(
    model=model,
    token_ids=input_token_ids_tensor,
    max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
    eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id
):
    token_id = token.squeeze(0).tolist()
    print(
        tokenizer.decode(token_id),
        end="",
        flush=True
    )
 
    next_token_id = token.squeeze(0)
    generated_ids.append(next_token_id)  # Collect generated tokens
 
end_time = time.time()
 
output_token_ids_tensor = torch.cat(generated_ids, dim=0)
generate_stats(output_token_ids_tensor, tokenizer, start_time, end_time)
import time from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import ( generate_text_basic_stream_cache, generate_stats ) prompt = "用一句话解释大型语言模型。" input_token_ids_tensor = torch.tensor( tokenizer.encode(prompt), device=device ).unsqueeze(0) max_new_tokens = 200 start_time = time.time() generated_ids = [] for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache( model=model, token_ids=input_token_ids_tensor, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id ): token_id = token.squeeze(0).tolist() print( tokenizer.decode(token_id), end="", flush=True ) next_token_id = token.squeeze(0) generated_ids.append(next_token_id) # 收集生成的标记 end_time = time.time() output_token_ids_tensor = torch.cat(generated_ids, dim=0) generate_stats(output_token_ids_tensor, tokenizer, start_time, end_time)

Since we used the same prompt as in chapter 2, the generated text matches the generated text from chapter 2 exactly:

由于我们使用了与第2章相同的提示，生成的文本与第2章生成的文本完全一致：

Time: 1.46 sec
28 tokens/sec
 
 Large language models are artificial intelligence systems that can
understand, generate, and process human language, enabling them to
perform a wide range of tasks, from answering questions to writing
articles, and even creating creative content.
时间：1.46秒 28个词/秒 大型语言模型是能够理解、生成和处理人类语言的人工智能系统，使它们能够执行广泛的任务，从回答问题到撰写文章，甚至创作创意内容。

While the main chapters use the 0.6-billion-parameter variant of Qwen3 to lower the resource requirements for this book, interested readers can find more information on how to use the larger models in appendix D.

尽管主章节采用通义千问3模型中参数量为6亿的版本，以降低本书的资源需求，但感兴趣的读者可在附录D中找到有关如何使用更大规模模型的更多信息。

Appendix D. Using larger LLMs

附录D. 使用更大的大语言模型

The main chapters use the 0.6-billion-parameter (0.6B) Qwen3 base model because it is the smallest model in the Qwen3 family and therefore the easiest to run on consumer hardware.

主要章节使用了参数量为6亿（0.6B）的通义千问3基础模型，因为它是通义千问3系列中规模最小的模型，因此在消费级硬件上运行起来最为容易。

However, the same Qwen3Model implementation from appendix C is not limited to the 0.6B checkpoint. We can also use it to load larger Qwen3 checkpoints with the same from-scratch PyTorch code. In practice, this means that once we understand how to work with the 0.6B model, moving to a larger model mainly involves three changes:

然而，附录C中提供的同一Qwen3Model实现并不局限于0.6B参数量的检查点。我们同样可以使用这套从零开始编写的PyTorch代码来加载更大规模的Qwen3检查点。实际上，这意味着一旦掌握了如何操作0.6B模型，迁移到更大规模模型时主要只需进行三处改动：

  1. selecting the matching configuration dictionary;
  2. 选择匹配的配置字典；
  3. downloading the larger checkpoint from Hugging Face;
  4. 从Hugging Face下载较大的检查点；
  5. loading the appropriate tokenizer for the base or reasoning variant.
  6. 加载适用于基础模型或推理模型的相应分词器。

This appendix illustrates this process using the Qwen3 4B model as a concrete example, because it is large enough to be meaningfully stronger than the 0.6B model while still being easier to handle than the larger 8B, 14B, and 32B variants.

本附录以通义千问3 4B模型为例，具体说明这一过程。之所以选择该模型，是因为它规模适中：相较于0.6B模型有显著性能提升，同时又比8B、14B和32B等更大规模的版本更容易部署和运行。

D.1 Larger dense Qwen3 configurations

D.1 更大的稠密Qwen3模型配置

The repository includes configuration dictionaries for several larger Qwen3 models in the reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c Python library, which are listed in table D.1. (You can also view the source code in the supplementary materials at https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/blob/main/reasoning_from_scratch/appendix_c.py).

该代码库包含 reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c Python 库中多个较大规模通义千问3模型的配置字典，这些配置字典列于表D.1。（您也可以在补充材料中查看源代码：https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/blob/main/reasoning_from_scratch/appendix_c.py）。

Note that the models listed in table D.1 are the dense Qwen3 variants, similar to the Qwen3 0.6B model used in the main chapters and discussed in appendix C. Here, "dense" means these are not the sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants of Qwen3. MoE models are not supported by this book's code, but a from-scratch implementation is available here: https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch05/11_qwen3.

请注意，表D.1中列出的模型是稠密型的Qwen3版本，与主章节中使用的、附录C中讨论的Qwen3 0.6B模型类似。这里的“稠密”指的是这些并非Qwen3的稀疏专家混合（MoE）版本。本书的代码不支持MoE模型，但有一个从头开始实现的版本，地址如下：https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch05/11_qwen3。

Figure D.1 summarizes the differences between the models in table D.1 more visually.

图D.1以更直观的方式总结了表D.1中各模型之间的差异。

Figure D.1 Comparison of different Qwen3 variants, from 0.6-billion to 32-billion parameters.
图D.1 不同Qwen3模型变体的对比，参数量从6亿到320亿不等。

As can be seen in figure D.1, all the different Qwen3 size variants use the same overall architecture pattern as the 0.6B model from appendix C. Concretely, they still use token embeddings, grouped-query attention, rotary position embeddings, feed-forward layers, and RMS normalization. What changes are the model dimensions, such as the embedding size, the number of layers, the number of attention heads, and the feed-forward hidden dimension.

如图D.1所示，所有不同规模的Qwen3模型均采用与附录C中0.6B模型相同的总体架构模式。具体而言，它们仍然使用词嵌入、分组查询注意力机制、旋转位置嵌入、前馈层以及RMS归一化。发生变化的是模型的各个维度，例如嵌入维度、层数、注意力头数以及前馈网络的隐藏层维度。

Table D.2 lists the memory requirement estimates when loading the models into RAM (and GPU RAM). Here, as a rough lower bound, storing weights in bfloat16 precision (which is the common default for LLMs) requires about 2 bytes per parameter.

表D.2列出了将模型加载到内存（包括显存）时的内存需求估算。在此，作为粗略的下限，以bfloat16精度存储权重（这是大型语言模型的常见默认精度）大约需要每个参数2字节。
