表 D.2 通义千问3模型尺寸 模型尺寸 bfloat16格式下的大致权重内存占用 17亿 约3.4 GB 40亿 约8 GB 80亿 约16 GB 140亿 约28 GB 320亿 约64 GB

The numbers in table D.2 are only approximate lower bounds for the weights themselves. In practice, the real runtime memory usage is higher because we also need memory for activations, temporary buffers, the KV cache, and so on. In addition, model loading can temporarily increase memory usage because tensors may exist in more than one place while they are being copied into the Qwen3Model instance. Please see the supplementary materials of my Build A Large Language Model (From Scratch) book for more details on this: https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch05/08_memory_efficient_weight_loading

表D.2中的数值只是权重本身的大致下界。在实际应用中，真正的运行时内存占用会更高，因为我们还需要为激活值、临时缓冲区、KV缓存等分配内存。此外，模型加载过程可能会暂时增加内存使用量，因为在张量被复制到Qwen3Model实例的过程中，它们可能同时存在于多个位置。有关这方面的更多细节，请参阅我的《从零构建大型语言模型》一书的补充材料：https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch05/08_memory_efficient_weight_loading。

D.2 Downloading larger checkpoints overview

D.2 下载较大检查点概述

Unlike the 0.6B checkpoints used in the main chapters, which I converted into a PyTorch checkpoint to minimize external code dependencies, larger official Qwen3 models are typically distributed as safetensors files, sometimes split across multiple shards.

与主章节中使用的0.6B参数量检查点不同——那些检查点已被转换为PyTorch格式，以尽量减少对外部代码的依赖——更大的官方Qwen3模型通常以safetensors文件的形式分发，有时还会被拆分成多个分片。

The reasoning-from-scratch Python library provides a helper function, download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots, to handle this. This function, which we will use in the next section, downloads the Hugging Face snapshot into a local directory and then loads either a single model.safetensors file or multiple shards referenced via a model.safetensors.index.json file.

从零开始的推理 Python 库提供了一个辅助函数 download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots 来处理这一任务。该函数将在下一节中使用，它会将 Hugging Face 的快照下载到本地目录，然后加载单个 model.safetensors 文件，或者通过 model.safetensors.index.json 文件引用的多个分片。

Because this helper relies on additional packages that were not required in the earlier chapters, you may need to install them first:

由于这个辅助工具依赖于前面章节中未要求的额外包，您可能需要先安装它们：

uv add huggingface_hub safetensors

uv 添加 huggingface_hub safetensors

or

或者

pip install huggingface_hub safetensors

pip 安装 huggingface_hub safetensors

Once these packages are installed, loading a larger checkpoint follows the same broad pattern as before. For instance, we download the files, instantiate the model, load the weights, prepare the tokenizer, and then run the text generation, as we will see in the next section.

一旦这些包安装完毕，加载较大的检查点就遵循与之前相同的总体流程。例如，我们会下载文件、实例化模型、加载权重、准备分词器，然后执行文本生成，这一点我们将在下一节中看到。

D.3 Loading a larger base model

D.3 加载更大的基础模型

We will now walk through a complete example using the official Qwen3 4B base model. The first step, shown in listing D.1, is to download the model snapshot from the Hugging Face Model hub (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base):

接下来，我们将使用通义千问3 4B基础模型的官方版本，演示一个完整的示例。第一步，如代码清单D.1所示，是从Hugging Face Model Hub（https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base）下载该模型的快照：

Listing D.1 Download model weights
from pathlib import Path
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device
from reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c import (
    download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots,
)
 
 
device = get_device()
local_dir = Path("qwen3-4b-base")
 
weights = download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots(
    repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base",
    local_dir=local_dir,
)
from pathlib import Path from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device from reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c import ( download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots, ) device = get_device() local_dir = Path("qwen3-4b-base") weights = download_from_huggingface_from_snapshots( repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base", local_dir=local_dir, )

The local_dir path specifies where the snapshot should be stored on disk. In this example, we keep the 4B base model in a dedicated qwen3-4b-base folder so that it stays separate from the smaller qwen3 directory used throughout the main chapters.

local_dir 路径指定了快照在磁盘上的存储位置。在本示例中，我们将 4B 基础模型存放在一个专门的 qwen3-4b-base 文件夹中，使其与主章节中使用的较小 qwen3 目录分开。

Next, we use the code in listing D.2 to instantiate the 4B model and load the Hugging Face weights into the from-scratch Qwen3Model implementation:

接下来，我们使用清单 D.2 中的代码实例化 4B 模型，并将 Hugging Face 的权重加载到从零开始实现的 Qwen3Model 中：

Listing D.2 Load weights into Qwen3Model
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import (
    Qwen3Model,
    load_hf_weights_into_qwen,
)
from reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c import QWEN3_CONFIG_4B
 
 
model = Qwen3Model(QWEN3_CONFIG_4B)
load_hf_weights_into_qwen(
    model,
    param_config={
        "n_layers": QWEN3_CONFIG_4B["n_layers"],
        "hidden_dim": QWEN3_CONFIG_4B["hidden_dim"],
    },
    params=weights,
)
model.to(device)
model.eval()
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import ( Qwen3Model, load_hf_weights_into_qwen, ) from reasoning_from_scratch.appendix_c import QWEN3_CONFIG_4B model = Qwen3Model(QWEN3_CONFIG_4B) load_hf_weights_into_qwen( model, param_config={ "n_layers": QWEN3_CONFIG_4B["n_layers"], "hidden_dim": QWEN3_CONFIG_4B["hidden_dim"], }, params=weights, ) model.to(device) model.eval()

The QWEN3_CONFIG_4B dictionary defines the architecture dimensions for the 4B model. The load_hf_weights_into_qwen helper then maps the Hugging Face parameter names into the parameter names used by our own implementation. After that, model.to(device) moves the model to the selected device, and model.eval() switches the model into inference mode.

QWEN3_CONFIG_4B 字典定义了 4B 模型的架构维度。随后，load_hf_weights_into_qwen 辅助函数将 Hugging Face 的参数名称映射为我们自实现中使用的参数名称。之后，model.to(device) 将模型移动到指定的设备上，而 model.eval() 则将模型切换到推理模式。

After the model is loaded, we prepare the tokenizer via the code in listing D.3:

模型加载完成后，我们通过清单 D.3 中的代码准备分词器：

Listing D.3 Load base tokenizer
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import Qwen3Tokenizer
import shutil
 
tokenizer_src = local_dir / "tokenizer.json"
tokenizer_path = local_dir / "tokenizer-base.json"
 
if not tokenizer_path.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(tokenizer_src, tokenizer_path)
 
tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path)
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import Qwen3Tokenizer import shutil tokenizer_src = local_dir / "tokenizer.json" tokenizer_path = local_dir / "tokenizer-base.json" if not tokenizer_path.exists(): shutil.copyfile(tokenizer_src, tokenizer_path) tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path)

The Hugging Face snapshot stores the tokenizer under the generic name "tokenizer.json". In listing D.3, we copy it to "tokenizer-base.json" so that it is easy to distinguish from the reasoning tokenizer that we will use in the next section.

Hugging Face 的快照将分词器存储为通用名称“tokenizer.json”。在清单 D.3 中，我们将其复制为“tokenizer-base.json”，以便与我们在下一节中使用的推理分词器区分开来。

We can now use the model for generation, exactly as we did with the smaller 0.6B model in chapter 2, using the code in listing D.4:

现在我们可以像第2章中使用较小的0.6B模型那样，利用该模型进行生成，具体方法是使用清单D.4中的代码：

Listing D.4 Generate text
import torch
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import (
    generate_text_basic_stream_cache,
)
 
prompt = "Explain large language models in two sentences."
input_ids = torch.tensor(
    tokenizer.encode(prompt),
    device=device,
).unsqueeze(0)
 
for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache(
    model=model,
    token_ids=input_ids,
    max_new_tokens=64,
    eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
):
    print(tokenizer.decode(token.squeeze(0).tolist()), end="", flush=True)
import torch from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import ( generate_text_basic_stream_cache, ) prompt = "用两句话解释大型语言模型。" input_ids = torch.tensor( tokenizer.encode(prompt), device=device, ).unsqueeze(0) for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache( model=model, token_ids=input_ids, max_new_tokens=64, eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id, ): print(tokenizer.decode(token.squeeze(0).tolist()), end="", flush=True)

Similar to the main book content in chapter 2, we encode the input prompt, add a batch dimension via unsqueeze(0), and then stream the generated tokens one by one.

与第2章的主体内容类似，我们对输入提示进行编码，通过 unsqueeze(0) 添加批次维度，然后逐个流式生成并输出标记。

The output is shown below:

输出如下所示：

 Large language models are artificial intelligence systems that use deep learning 
techniques to understand and generate human-like text. They are trained on vast 
amounts of data and can perform a wide range of natural language processing tasks, 
such as translation, summarization, and question answering.
大型语言模型是利用深度学习技术来理解和生成类人文本的人工智能系统。它们基于海量数据进行训练，能够执行多种自然语言处理任务，例如翻译、摘要生成和问答等。

This is one of the nice properties of reusing the same Qwen3Model abstraction across model sizes. Once the checkpoint and tokenizer are set up correctly, the inference code looks essentially the same.

这正是在不同模型规模间复用同一 Qwen3Model 抽象的一个优点。只要检查点和分词器配置正确，推理代码基本上就完全一致。

D.4 Loading a larger reasoning variant

D.4 加载更大的推理模型

The same idea also works for larger reasoning-style Qwen3 models. The architecture for a given model size stays the same. Compared to the previous section, only the checkpoint and tokenizer settings change.

同样的思路同样适用于更大规模的推理型通义千问3模型。对于特定规模的模型，其架构保持不变。与上一节相比，仅需调整检查点和分词器的配置。

For example, to load the 4B reasoning variant instead of the 4B base variant, we would:

例如，若要加载 4B 推理版本而非 4B 基础版本，我们需要：

  • switch the repository ID from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base to Qwen/Qwen3-4B;
  • 将仓库ID从Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base切换为Qwen/Qwen3-4B；
  • copy or rename the tokenizer.json file to tokenizer-reasoning.json;
  • 将 tokenizer.json 文件复制或重命名为 tokenizer-reasoning.json；
  • Initialize the tokenizer as follows, using the code in listing D.5:
  • 按照清单 D.5 中的代码，如下初始化分词器：
Listing D.5 Load reasoning tokenizer
tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(
    tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path,
    apply_chat_template=True,
    add_generation_prompt=True,
    add_thinking=True,
)
tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer( tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path, apply_chat_template=True, add_generation_prompt=True, add_thinking=True, )

These three tokenizer settings match the chat-style prompt formatting used by the reasoning models, as discussed in chapter 2 and 8. In other words, we still use the same 4B architecture configuration (QWEN3_CONFIG_4B), but we pair it with the reasoning checkpoint and the reasoning-style tokenizer behavior.

这三种分词器设置与第2章和第8章中讨论的推理模型所采用的聊天式提示格式一致。换言之，我们仍然使用相同的40亿参数架构配置（QWEN3_CONFIG_4B），但将其与推理检查点以及推理风格的分词器行为相匹配。

The rest of the model-loading and model-usage code stays the same. We still download the snapshot, instantiate Qwen3Model(QWEN3_CONFIG_4B), load the weights via load_hf_weights_into_qwen, move the model to the target device, and then generate text using the same streaming function from chapter 2.

其余的模型加载和使用代码保持不变。我们仍然会下载快照，实例化 Qwen3Model(QWEN3_CONFIG_4B)，通过 load_hf_weights_into_qwen 加载权重，将模型移动到目标设备上，然后使用第2章中的相同流式生成函数来生成文本。

D.5 Practical recommendations

D.5 实用建议

The main point of this appendix is that the same from-scratch model code from appendix C can be reused across larger official Qwen3 checkpoints, provided that we select the matching configuration dictionary and tokenizer setup.

本附录的核心要点是：只要选择匹配的配置字典和分词器设置，附录C中从零开始编写的模型代码就可以在更大的通义千问3系列官方检查点之间复用。

This means moving to a larger model is mostly a matter of loading a different checkpoint and configuration rather than learning an entirely new concept.

这意味着，切换到更大规模的模型通常只需加载不同的检查点和配置文件，而无需学习全新的概念。

If you want to experiment beyond the 4B example shown here, the 1.7B and 8B variants are natural next steps. The 1.7B model is a modest step up from 0.6B, in case the 4B is too resource-intensive for your hardware. The 8B model is substantially larger and may give stronger outputs if your hardware can handle it.

如果你想在此处展示的4B模型之外进行更多实验，1.7B和8B这两个版本自然是接下来的自然选择。1.7B模型相比0.6B只是适度提升，如果你的硬件资源不足以支持4B模型，它会是一个更合适的选择。而8B模型则规模更大得多，如果你的硬件能够承受，它通常能生成更高质量的输出。

Appendix E. Batching and throughput-oriented execution

附录E. 面向批处理和吞吐量的执行

In the code we implemented throughout the main chapters, we usually process one prompt or example at a time. This keeps the code compact and easier to understand, and it also helps keep the resource requirements somewhat more manageable.

在主章节中我们实现的代码里，通常每次只处理一个提示或示例。这样做可以使代码更加简洁易懂，同时也有助于将资源需求控制在较为可控的范围内。

In practice, the code in this book is already expensive to run, so adding batching support everywhere would often increase complexity without any real benefits in many cases, depending on your available hardware.

在实践中，本书中的代码本身运行开销就较高，因此在各处添加批处理支持往往只会增加复杂性，而在许多情况下，并不会带来实际收益，具体效果取决于你所使用的硬件配置。

That being said, if you have access to relatively modern GPUs with enough memory, batched execution, illustrated in figure E.1, is very useful in some settings. For example, if we want to evaluate many problems, sample several responses per prompt, or train on multiple examples at once, then batching can help increase the throughput and lower the overall time.

话虽如此，如果你可以使用具有足够显存的较新GPU，那么如图E.1所示的批处理执行在某些场景下非常有用。例如，当我们需要评估大量问题、为每个提示采样多个响应，或者同时在多个样本上进行训练时，批处理能够提高吞吐量并缩短总耗时。

This appendix explains the broad idea behind batching and shows how to use the batched implementations in the supplementary materials across different chapters.

本附录阐述了批处理的基本思想，并展示了如何在不同章节的补充材料中使用批处理实现。

Figure E.1 An overview of single-example versus batched generation. In batched generation, several prompts are packed into one batch, processed in parallel, and then decoded together to improve throughput.
图 E.1 单样本生成与批处理生成的概览。在批处理生成中，多个提示被打包成一个批次，以并行方式处理，随后一起解码，从而提高吞吐量。

E.1 Why batching helps

E.1 为什么批处理有帮助

When we talk about computational performance, it helps to separate between the following overall goals:

在讨论计算性能时，有必要将总体目标区分为以下几类：

  1. latency: how quickly we get the answer for one prompt;
  2. 延迟：我们对一个提示获得回答的速度；
  3. throughput: how many prompts we can process in a fixed amount of time.
  4. 吞吐量：在固定时间内能够处理多少个提示。

Single-example generation is often best for understanding the conceptual implementation of a concept, minimizing latency, and for debugging.

单例生成通常最适用于理解某个概念的实现原理、降低延迟以及进行调试。

Batching can be seen as an extension of single-example generation that primarily targets throughput. For example, if we want to evaluate hundreds of problems on MATH-500, generate several self-consistency samples, or train on a larger distillation dataset, batching can reduce total runtime substantially on suitable hardware.

批处理可以看作是单样本生成的扩展，其主要目标是提升吞吐量。例如，当我们需要在 MATH-500 数据集上评估数百个题目、生成若干自一致性样本，或者在更大的蒸馏数据集上进行训练时，在合适的硬件上使用批处理能够显著缩短总运行时间。

However, batching is not automatically faster on every device. Small models on CPUs or less optimized GPUs may benefit only a little, or not at all, because we have to introduce additional code complexity, including padding and other overheads, that can offset the gains from the parallelism that we gain through batching.

然而，批处理并不总能在所有设备上自动带来性能提升。在 CPU 或优化程度较低的 GPU 上运行的小型模型，可能只会获得少量甚至完全没有加速效果，这是因为我们需要引入额外的代码复杂度，包括填充和其他开销，这些开销可能会抵消通过批处理获得的并行化优势。

So batching is best understood as a throughput optimization, not as a universal speedup.

因此，批处理最好被理解为一种吞吐量优化，而非普遍适用的加速手段。

E.2 Running batched generation

E.2 批量生成

The main technical obstacle in batching is that prompts usually have different lengths. One math problem may tokenize to 40 tokens while another may tokenize to 120 tokens, but PyTorch tensors still have to be rectangular. So if we want to run several prompts together, we need a way to pad shorter rows and keep track of which positions are real tokens and which are just padding tokens.

在批量处理中，主要的技术障碍在于提示通常具有不同的长度。例如，一道数学题可能被分词成40个标记，而另一道则可能被分词成120个标记，但 PyTorch 张量必须是矩形的。因此，如果我们想同时处理多个提示，就需要一种方法来对较短的序列进行填充，并记录哪些位置是真正的标记，哪些只是填充标记。

Padding tokens are placeholder tokens that are added to a prompt to make it a certain length, for example to, extend a three-token prompt "3 + 3" to a five-token prompt, we may add two additional padding tokens to the right or the left: "<pad><pad> 3 + 3". (In practice, it doesn't matter which token we use as padding token, and it's common to use an end-of-sequence token like <eos> or <|endoftext|>.)

填充标记是用于将提示扩展到特定长度的占位符标记。例如，要将一个包含三个标记的提示“3 + 3”扩展为包含五个标记的提示，我们可以在其左侧或右侧添加两个额外的填充标记：`<pad><pad> 3 + 3`。（在实际应用中，使用哪个标记作为填充标记并无本质区别，通常会使用序列结束标记，如 `<eos>` 或 `<|endoftext|>`。）

Conceptually, padding and keeping track of padded positions makes batched generation more complicated than single-prompt generation. In the main chapters, we used the Qwen3Model class from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3, which is the plain single-example implementation explained in appendix C.

从概念上讲，填充以及对填充位置的跟踪使得批处理生成比单个提示的生成更加复杂。在主体章节中，我们使用了 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 模块中的 Qwen3Model 类，该类是附录 C 中所介绍的纯单样本实现。

For batched generation, the supplementary materials therefore include a separate Qwen3Model class in reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched, which can be used as a drop-in replacement but adds the bookkeeping needed for padding-aware execution that is required in batching.

因此，在批处理生成场景下，配套材料中在 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched 模块中新增了一个独立的 Qwen3Model 类。该类可作为直接替换使用，同时增加了批处理所需、用于支持填充感知执行的账务管理功能。

To make this concrete, it helps to start with a single-sequence example that looks very similar to the code we already used in the main chapters. Here, in listing E.1, we apply it to two very small prompts, but we still run them one after the other:

为了使这一点更加具体，不妨从一个单序列示例开始，它与我们在主章节中已经使用过的代码非常相似。在这里，在清单 E.1 中，我们将该方法应用于两个非常简短的提示，但仍然按顺序依次执行：

Listing E.1 Single-example generation
import torch
 
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import (
    get_device,
    generate_text_basic_stream_cache,
)
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch03 import (
    load_model_and_tokenizer,
    render_prompt,
)
 
device = get_device()
model, tokenizer = load_model_and_tokenizer(
    which_model="base",
    device=device,
    use_compile=False,
)
 
for problem in ["2+2?", "3+3=6?"]:  #A
    prompt = render_prompt(problem)
    input_ids = torch.tensor(
        tokenizer.encode(prompt),
        dtype=torch.long,
        device=device,
    ).unsqueeze(0)
 
    for token in generate_text_basic_stream_cache(
        model=model,
        token_ids=input_ids,
        max_new_tokens=32,
        eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    ):
        next_token_id = token.squeeze(0)
        print(tokenizer.decode(next_token_id.tolist()), end="", flush=True)
 
    print()  #B
#A The two prompts we sequentially process
#B Force a new line after each answer
#A 我们依次处理的两个提示 #B 在每个答案后强制换行

The resulting output is:

产生的输出是：

 \boxed{4}
 \boxed{6}
\boxed{4} \boxed{6}

The code in listing E.1 is still ordinary single-example generation. We render the prompt, tokenize it, add a batch dimension of size 1, and then stream the generated tokens as they arrive. This is conceptually simple, which is why the main chapters prefer this style.

清单 E.1 中的代码仍然是普通的单样本生成。我们先渲染提示，将其分词，添加一个大小为 1 的批次维度，然后在生成的标记到达时逐个流式输出。这种实现从概念上来说非常简单，这也是为什么主章节更倾向于采用这种风格。

Listing E.2 now shows the corresponding batched version. The overall workflow is similar, but now we switch to reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched, tokenize both prompts up front, left-pad them to the same length, and generate them together:

清单 E.2 现在展示了对应的批处理版本。整体工作流程类似，但现在我们改用 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched，预先对两个提示进行分词，将它们左填充至相同长度，然后一起生成：

Listing E.2 Batched generation
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched import (
    generate_text_basic_batched_cache,
    load_model_and_tokenizer,
)
 
model, tokenizer = load_model_and_tokenizer(
    which_model="base",
    device=device,
    use_compile=False,
)
 
problems = ["2+2?", "3+3=6?"]
prompts = [render_prompt(problem) for problem in problems]
tokenized = [tokenizer.encode(p) for p in prompts]
pad_id = tokenizer.pad_token_id
max_len = max(len(t) for t in tokenized)
 
left_padded = [  #A
    [pad_id] * (max_len - len(t)) + t
    for t in tokenized
]
input_ids = torch.tensor(left_padded, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
 
generated = generate_text_basic_batched_cache(
    model=model,
    token_ids=input_ids,
    max_new_tokens=32,
    eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    pad_id=pad_id,  #B
)
 
for row in generated:
    eos_pos = (row == tokenizer.eos_token_id).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    if len(eos_pos) > 0:
        row = row[:eos_pos[0]]
    print(tokenizer.decode(row.tolist()))
#A Left-pad shorter sequences so all prompts in the batch have the same length
#B Needed so generation can distinguish real tokens from padding
#A 将较短的序列左填充，使批次中的所有提示具有相同的长度 #B 这是必要的，以便生成过程能够区分真实标记和填充标记。

The results are the same as before, but this time they are produced in parallel:

结果与之前相同，但这次是并行产生的：

 \boxed{4}
 \boxed{6}
\boxed{4} \boxed{6}

In this example, we use the non-streaming batched helper, so we wait until the whole batch is finished before decoding and printing the results. That keeps the usage example simple and makes it easier to see the role of padding before we dig into the internal masking logic.

在这个示例中，我们使用了非流式的批处理辅助工具，因此会等待整个批次处理完毕后再进行解码和打印结果。这样做可以使使用示例更加简单，并便于我们在深入探讨内部的掩码逻辑之前，清晰地理解填充的作用。

There is also a more optimized text generation function variant, generate_text_basic_batched_cache_stop, which removes finished rows from the active compute batch instead of carrying them along until the longest row finishes. In contrast, the generate_text_basic_batched_cache we use in listing E.2 keeps every row in the active batch for every decode step.

此外，还有一种经过优化的文本生成函数变体——generate_text_basic_batched_cache_stop，它会在计算过程中将已完成的行从活动批中移除，而不是一直保留这些行，直到最长的那行处理完毕。相比之下，我们在示例 E.2 中使用的 generate_text_basic_batched_cache 会在每一个解码步骤中都将所有行保留在活动批中。

In generate_text_basic_batched_cache, once a row has emitted EOS, the implementation forces that row to keep producing EOS so that the batch shape stays aligned, even though the row is already finished from the perspective of the final decoded output. The difference between these two functions is illustrated in figure E.2.

在 generate_text_basic_batched_cache 中，一旦某一行生成了 EOS 标记，实现就会强制该行继续生成 EOS，以保持批次形状的一致性，尽管从最终解码输出的角度来看，该行实际上已经完成。这两者的区别如图 E.2 所示。

Figure E.2 Sequential generation (1) versus regular batched generation (2) and early-stop batched generation (3). The regular batched helper (2) keeps finished rows in the batch as placeholder EOS rows, whereas the _stop variant (3) removes finished rows from the active compute batch as soon as they emit EOS.
图 E.2 顺序生成（1）与常规批处理生成（2）及提前停止的批处理生成（3）的对比。常规批处理辅助程序（2）会将已完成的行保留在批次中作为占位的 EOS 行，而 _stop 变体（3）则会在这些行发出 EOS 标记后立即将其从当前计算批次中移除。

As a side note, Qwen3 uses <|endoftext|> as the EOS token for the base model, but figure E.2 labels it simply as <eos> for visual compactness.

顺便提一下，Qwen3 在基础模型中使用 <|endoftext|> 作为 EOS 标记，但在图 E.2 中，为了视觉上的简洁，将其简写为 <eos>。

The next section goes into a bit more detail regarding how the padding is handled internally.

下一节将更详细地介绍填充在内部是如何处理的。

E.3 Padding and attention masks

E.3 填充和注意力掩码

In single-example mode, if we tokenize a short prompt such as "2+2?", we can pass it to the model as a simple tensor of shape (1, 4):

在单样本模式下，如果我们对一个短提示（如“2+2?”）进行分词，就可以将其作为一个形状为 (1, 4) 的简单张量传递给模型：

input_ids = torch.tensor([[17, 10, 17, 30]])
input_ids = torch.tensor([[17, 10, 17, 30]])

Internally, the model builds a standard causal attention mask internally so that each position can only attend to itself and earlier tokens. If you are unfamiliar with causal attention masks and self-attention, I have an article that provides more background information: https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/understanding-and-coding-self-attention.

在模型内部，会自动生成一个标准的因果注意力掩码，使得每个位置只能关注自己及之前的标记。如果你对因果注意力掩码和自注意力机制不太熟悉，我有一篇文章提供了更详细的背景介绍：https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/understanding-and-coding-self-attention。

The causal attention mask for the "2+2?" prompt is illustrated in figure E.3.

“2+2?”提示的因果注意力掩码如图E.3所示。

Figure E.3 The causal mask used in single-example generation. Tokens can attend only to themselves and earlier positions, which is the standard autoregressive setup.
图 E.3 单样本生成中使用的因果掩码。标记只能关注自身及更早的位置，这是标准的自回归设置。

In the causal mask shown in figure E.3, 1 means "masked out" and 0 means "allowed".

在图E.3所示的因果掩码中，1表示“被遮蔽”，0表示“允许”。

In this context, as illustrated in figure E.3, the first token cannot look ahead to later positions, the second token can only look at the first two positions, and so on, which is the standard autoregressive masking pattern.

在此背景下，如图E.3所示，第一个标记无法向前查看后续位置，第二个标记只能查看前两个位置，依此类推，这就是标准的自回归掩码模式。

Batching changes the situation because different prompts usually have different lengths. Suppose we process "2+2?" together with the slightly longer prompt, "3+3=6?".

批处理会改变这一情况，因为不同的提示通常具有不同的长度。假设我们将“2+2?”与稍长一些的提示“3+3=6?”放在一起处理。

Since PyTorch tensors must be rectangular, the shorter row has to be padded to match the longer one, which is illustrated in figure E.4 using left padding.

由于 PyTorch 张量必须是矩形的，较短的行需要进行填充以匹配较长的行，如图 E.4 所示，这里采用左对齐填充。

Figure E.4 Left padding in batched generation. The shorter row is padded up to the maximum sequence length in the batch, and the padding-aware mask ensures that these padded positions do not affect attention.
图 E.4 批量生成中的左填充。较短的序列会被填充至批次中的最大序列长度，而填充感知掩码则确保这些填充位置不会影响注意力机制。

Note that figure E.4 shows that we keep an additional attn_mask internally. This mask is used to keep track of the padded positions, where True means padded and False means not padded.

请注意，图E.4显示我们在内部维护了一个额外的attn_mask。该掩码用于标记填充位置：True表示填充位置，False表示非填充位置。

We use this additional attn_mask to identify the tokens in the causal mask that correspond to the pad token IDs.

我们使用这个额外的注意力掩码来识别因果掩码中对应于填充标记 ID 的那些标记。

Masking padded keys and zeroing padded queries are important steps to make batching behave similarly to the single-example execution.

对填充后的键进行掩码处理、对填充后的查询进行清零，是使批处理行为与单样本执行行为保持一致的重要步骤。

In the remainder of this appendix, we will see how we can use scripts from the supplementary materials that implement the optional batched variants for the different chapters.

在本附录的其余部分，我们将探讨如何使用补充材料中的脚本，这些脚本实现了各章节的可选批处理变体。

E.4 Chapter 3: batched MATH-500 evaluation

E.4 第三章：批处理的MATH-500评估

The supplementary materials include a script for the single-example evaluation method from chapter 3 that we can download and run directly using the download function we introduced in chapter 7:

补充材料包括第3章中单样本评估方法的脚本，我们可以通过第7章介绍的下载功能直接下载并运行：

Listing E.3 Download single-example evaluation script
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 import download_from_github
 
download_from_github(
    "ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500.py"
)
download_from_github(
    "ch03/01_main-chapter-code/math500_test.json",
    out="math500_test.json",
)
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch07 的 download_from_github download_from_github( "ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500.py" ) download_from_github( "ch03/01_main-chapter-code/math500_test.json", out="math500_test.json", )

After downloading the script and dataset via listing E.3, we can run the single-example evaluation from the terminal as shown below (if you are not using uv, simply replace uv run with python):

在通过清单 E.3 下载脚本和数据集之后，我们可以在终端中运行单样本评估，如下所示（如果您未使用 uv，只需将 `uv run` 替换为 `python`）：

uv run evaluate_math500.py \
  --dataset_size 500 \
  --which_model "reasoning"
uv 运行 evaluate_math500.py \ --dataset_size 500 \ --which_model "reasoning"

The supplementary material also includes a batched version that applies the batching method we discussed above. The download is almost identical, except that we replace evaluate_math500.py with evaluate_math500_batched.py, as shown in listing E.4:

补充材料中还包含一个批处理版本，该版本应用了我们前面讨论的批处理方法。下载内容几乎完全相同，唯一的区别是将 evaluate_math500.py 替换为 evaluate_math500_batched.py，如列表 E.4 所示：

Listing E.4 Download evaluation script with batch support
download_from_github(
    "ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500_batched.py"
)
从GitHub下载( “ch03/02_math500-verifier-scripts/evaluate_math500_batched.py” )

The usage of the batched script is also very similar to the non-batched version, except that we now provide an additional --batch_size argument to specify how many prompts and answers the model should process in parallel:

批处理脚本的用法也与非批处理版本非常相似，只是我们现在提供了一个额外的 --batch_size 参数，用于指定模型应并行处理多少个提示和响应：

uv run evaluate_math500_batched.py \
  --dataset_size 500 \
  --which_model "reasoning" \
  --batch_size 64
uv run evaluate_math500_batched.py \ --dataset_size 500 \ --which_model "reasoning" \ --batch_size 64

The ideal batch size depends entirely on what your hardware can handle, so in practice it is best to start with a smaller value and then scale upward until you hit the throughput and memory limit that makes sense for your setup.

理想的批次大小完全取决于你的硬件能够承受的范围。因此，在实践中，最好从较小的值开始，逐步增大，直到达到适合你当前配置的吞吐量和内存限制。

We will return to a comparison of the single-example and batched generation performances at the end of the chapter.

我们在本章结尾将再次比较单样本生成与批处理生成的性能。

E.5 Chapter 4: batched self-consistency sampling

E.5 第四章：批处理自一致性采样

The optional self_consistency_math500_batched.py script for chapter 4 does not mix different prompts into one padded tensor. Instead, it repeats the same prompt num_samples times and samples several continuations in parallel for self-consistency voting, since parallelizing over the different number of samples for each prompt is a natural angle here that we can take advantage of.

第4章的可选脚本 self_consistency_math500_batched.py 并不会将不同的提示混放在一个经过填充的张量中。相反，它会将同一个提示重复 num_samples 次，并并行采样出若干个续写结果，用于自洽性投票。这是因为针对每个提示的不同样本数量进行并行化，正是此处可以充分利用的一个自然切入点。

Because every row starts from the same prompt length, this script can use the regular Qwen3Model from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 instead of reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched. In other words, the batch dimension here is used for multiple sampled rollouts of the same prompt, not for padding together unrelated prompts of different lengths.

由于每一行都从相同的提示长度开始，因此该脚本可以使用 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 中的常规 Qwen3Model，而无需使用 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3_batched。换言之，这里的批处理维度用于对同一提示进行多次采样回放，而不是将不同长度的互不相关提示拼接在一起进行填充。

We can download the script as shown in listing E.5:

我们可以按照清单 E.5 所示下载该脚本：

Listing E.5 Download self-consistently sampling with batch support
download_from_github(
    "ch04/02_math500-inference-scaling-scripts/"
    "self_consistency_math500_batched.py"
)
从 GitHub 下载( "ch04/02_math500-inference-scaling-scripts/" "self_consistency_math500_batched.py" )

To download the non-batched version instead, simply remove the "_batched" part from the file name in listing E.5.

如需下载非批处理版本，只需从附录E.5中的文件名中去掉“_batched”部分即可。

We can run the batched script as follows, and the syntax for the non-batched script is otherwise the same:

我们可以按如下方式运行批处理脚本，而非批处理脚本的语法则保持不变：

uv run self_consistency_math500_batched.py \
  --which_model base \
  --temperature 0.9 \
  --top_p 0.9 \
  --num_samples 3 \
  --dataset_size 500 \
  --prompt_suffix "\n\nExplain step by step."
uv run self_consistency_math500_batched.py \ --which_model base \ --temperature 0.9 \ --top_p 0.9 \ --num_samples 3 \ --dataset_size 500 \ --prompt_suffix "\n\n请逐步解释。"

E.6 Chapter 6: batched GRPO rollouts

E.6 第六章：批处理GRPO上线

Self-refinement in chapter 5 is fundamentally sequential and therefore does not benefit much from simple batching. One could in principle run self-refinement loops for multiple inputs in parallel, but that is non-trivial to implement and is therefore not part of the supplementary material. Instead, the next batched example appears in the chapter 6 RLVR code.

第5章中的自我精炼本质上是顺序执行的，因此难以从简单的批量处理中获益。理论上，可以并行运行多个输入的自我精炼循环，但其实现并不简单，故未纳入补充材料。相反，下一个支持批量处理的示例出现在第6章的RLVR代码中。

In chapter 6, we again use the same prompt for multiple rollouts, so no padding is required. As in section E.5, the code can therefore stay with the regular Qwen3Model class from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3.

在第6章中，我们再次对多个推理过程使用相同的提示，因此无需进行填充。与E.5节一样，代码可以沿用 reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 模块中的常规 Qwen3Model 类。

The relevant scripts can be fetched as follows:

相关脚本可以按如下方式获取：

Listing E.6 Download RLVR script with batch support
download_from_github(
    "ch06/02_rlvr_grpo_scripts_intro/"
    "rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl_batched.py"
)
从GitHub下载( "ch06/02_rlvr_grpo_scripts_intro/" "rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl_batched.py" )

Similar to before, to download the single-generation script, simply drop "_batched" from the file name in listing E.6.

与之前相同，要下载单次执行的脚本，只需在清单E.6中将文件名中的“_batched”去掉即可。

A typical batched run looks like this:
uv run rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl_batched.py \
  --num_rollouts 8 \
  --batch_size 4 \
  --max_new_tokens 512
一个典型的批处理运行如下所示： uv run rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl_batched.py \ --num_rollouts 8 \ --batch_size 4 \ --max_new_tokens 512

Here, --batch_size controls how many rollouts are generated in parallel within one training step. This improves throughput, but it also increases memory pressure, so in practice you may need to reduce --num_rollouts or --max_new_tokens.

在这里，--batch_size 控制在一个训练步骤中并行生成多少条轨迹。这可以提高吞吐量，但也会增加显存压力，因此在实际应用中，你可能需要减少 --num_rollouts 或 --max_new_tokens 的值。

E.7 Chapter 8: batched distillation

E.7 第八章：间歇精馏

Chapter 8 returns to the padding-aware style from chapter 3 because the distillation examples have different prompt and answer lengths. In other words, we are again batching unrelated examples of different lengths into a single rectangular tensor, which means that masking and padding matter again.

第8章回到了第3章中考虑填充的样式，这是因为知识蒸馏的示例中提示和答案的长度各不相同。换言之，我们再次将长度各异、彼此无关的样本合并成一个单一的矩形张量，这就意味着掩码和填充再次变得重要起来。

We can download the batched training script and fetch a sample training dataset as follows:

我们可以按如下方式下载批处理训练脚本并获取一个示例训练数据集：

Listing E.7 Download distillation script with batch support
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch08 import load_distill_data
 
download_from_github(
    "ch08/04_train_with_distillation/distill_batched.py"
)
_ = load_distill_data(
    partition="deepseek-r1-math-train",
    local_path="deepseek-r1-math-train.json",
)
来自 reasoning_from_scratch.ch08 的 load_distill_data 从 GitHub 下载 “ch08/04_train_with_distillation/distill_batched.py” _ = load_distill_data( 分区="deepseek-r1-math-train", 本地路径="deepseek-r1-math-train.json", )

For the non-batched version, remove the "_batched" part from the file name in listing E.7. A representative batched run looks like this:

对于非批处理版本，请从清单E.7中的文件名中删除“_batched”部分。一个典型的批处理运行如下所示：

uv run distill_batched.py \
  --data_path deepseek-r1-math-train.json \
  --dataset_size 500 \
  --validation_size 10 \
  --epochs 2 \
  --use_think_tokens \
  --batch_size 32
uv run distill_batched.py \ --data_path deepseek-r1-math-train.json \ --dataset_size 500 \ --validation_size 10 \ --epochs 2 \ --use_think_tokens \ --batch_size 32

Here, --batch_size lets us process multiple distillation examples per optimization step, but because training also has to store activations, the resource demands can become much higher than in the chapter 3 evaluator. So chapter 8 gives us the training analogue of the padding-aware batching strategy introduced earlier in this appendix.

在这里，--batch_size 参数使我们能够在每一步优化中处理多个蒸馏样本；但由于训练还需要存储激活值，资源需求可能会比第 3 章的评估器高得多。因此，第 8 章为我们提供了本附录前面介绍的、针对填充数据的批处理策略的训练版。

E.8 Single-sequence versus batch generation

E.8 单序列生成与批量生成

The supplementary scripts in chapters 3 and 8 batch together different-length examples, so they need padding-aware attention masks and more careful bookkeeping. Chapters 4 and 6 batch repeated copies of the same prompt or rollout setup, so they can stay with the regular model implementation and avoid the more complicated padding logic.

第3章和第8章中的补充脚本会将不同长度的样本批量合并，因此需要使用考虑填充的注意力掩码，并进行更细致的状态管理。而第4章和第6章则会将相同的提示或轨迹采样设置重复复制后进行批量处理，因此可以沿用常规的模型实现，避免复杂的填充逻辑。

Either way, batched generation can result in higher throughput and shorter runtimes, at the cost of increased RAM usage. Table 8.1 compares single to batched generation using the settings shown in the previous sections.

无论哪种方式，批处理生成都能带来更高的吞吐量和更短的运行时间，但会增加内存占用。表8.1比较了在前几节所示设置下，单次生成与批处理生成的效果。

表 E.1 内存使用与运行时间对比 脚本 批量大小 内存 H100 总耗时 DGX Spark 总耗 1 evaluate_math500.py - 1.8 GB 90 分钟 174 分钟 2 evaluate_math500_batched.py 64 23.39 GB 16 分钟 108 分钟 3 self_consistency_math500.py - 1.79 GB 252 分钟 340 分钟 4 self_consistency_math500_batched.py 3 2.45 GB 129 分钟 243 分钟 5 rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl.py - 43.35 GB 68 分钟 63 分钟 6 rlvr_grpo_original_no_kl_batched.py 4 44.91 GB 19 分钟 23 分钟 7 distill.py - 8.29 GB 10 分钟 32 分钟 8 distill_batched.py 4 8.34 GB 9 分钟 28 分钟

As shown in table E.1, the batched variants are always faster than the single-sequence variants. In most cases, the difference is very noticeable. One exception is distillation (row 7 and 8), where batching only yields a modest advantage.

如表E.1所示，批处理变体始终比单序列变体更快。在大多数情况下，这种差异非常显著。唯一的例外是蒸馏（第7行和第8行），在该场景下，批处理仅带来适度的性能提升。

This could be because the GPU is already well utilized in single-batch mode, and the extra overhead in the batched generation due to the additional mask generation is not worth it, given the small model size of the Qwen3 6-billion-parameter model.

这可能是因为在单批次模式下，GPU 已经得到了充分的利用；而对于 Qwen3 这一仅有 60 亿参数的小模型而言，批处理生成带来的额外开销（主要源于额外的掩码生成）并不值得付出，因此单批次模式反而更为高效。

Appendix F. Common approaches to model evaluation

附录F. 模型评估的常用方法

F.1 Understanding the main evaluation methods for LLMs

F.1 理解大语言模型的主要评估方法

There are four common ways of evaluating trained LLMs in practice: multiple choice, verifiers, leaderboards, and LLM judges, as shown in figure F.1. Research papers, marketing materials, technical reports, and model cards (a term for LLM-specific technical reports) often include results from two or more of these categories.

在实践中，评估训练好的大语言模型有四种常见方式：选择题、验证器、排行榜和由大语言模型担任的评判者，如图F.1所示。研究论文、市场宣传材料、技术报告以及模型卡片（专指针对大语言模型的技术报告）中，通常会同时呈现来自其中两种或两种以上类别 的评估结果。

Figure F.1 A mental model of the topics covered in this book with a focus on the two broad evaluation categories, benchmark-based evaluation and judgment-based evaluation, covered in this appendix.
图 F.1 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型，重点突出本附录中讨论的两大评估类别：基于基准的评估和基于判断的评估。

Furthermore, as shown in figure F.1, the four categories introduced here fall into two groups: benchmark-based evaluation and judgment-based evaluation.

此外，如图F.1所示，此处介绍的四类评估方法可归为两大类：基于基准的评估和基于判断的评估。

Other measures, such as training loss, perplexity, and rewards, are typically used internally during model development. (They are covered in the model training chapters.)

其他指标，例如训练损失、困惑度和奖励，通常在模型开发过程中内部使用。（这些内容将在模型训练章节中介绍。）

The following subsections provide brief overviews of each method.

以下小节将对每种方法进行简要概述。

F.2 Evaluating answer-choice accuracy

F.2 评估选项准确性

We begin with a benchmark‑based method: multiple‑choice question answering.

我们首先介绍一种基于基准的方法：选择题问答。

Historically, one of the most widely used evaluation methods is multiple-choice benchmarks such as MMLU (short for Massive Multitask Language Understanding, https://huggingface.co/datasets/cais/mmlu). An example task from the MMLU dataset is shown in figure F.2.

从历史上看，最常用的评估方法之一是多项选择基准，例如 MMLU（全称：大规模多任务语言理解，网址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/cais/mmlu）。MMLU 数据集中的一个示例任务如图 F.2 所示。

Figure F.2 Evaluating an LLM on MMLU by comparing its multiple-choice prediction with the correct answer from the dataset.
图 F.2 通过将大语言模型的多选题预测与数据集中的正确答案进行比较，来评估其在 MMLU 上的表现。

Figure F.2 shows just a single example from the MMLU dataset. The complete MMLU dataset consists of 57 subjects (from high school math to biology) with about 16 thousand multiple-choice questions in total, and performance is measured in terms of accuracy (the fraction of correctly answered questions), for example 87.5% if 14,000 out of 16,000 questions are answered correctly.

图F.2仅展示了MMLU数据集中的一个示例。完整的MMLU数据集包含57个学科（从高中数学到生物学），共计约1.6万道选择题。模型的性能以准确率（即答对题目所占的比例）来衡量，例如，在1.6万道题目中答对1.4万道，则准确率为87.5%。

Multiple-choice benchmarks, such as MMLU, test an LLM's knowledge recall in a straightforward, quantifiable way similar to standardized tests, many school exams, or theoretical driving tests.

多项选择基准测试，如 MMLU，以一种直接、可量化的方式检验大型语言模型的知识回忆能力，类似于标准化考试、学校考试或理论驾驶考试。

Note that figure F.2 shows a simplified version of multiple-choice evaluation, where the model's predicted answer letter is compared directly to the correct one. Two other popular methods exist that involve log-probability scoring (log-probabilities are discussed in chapter 4 in more detail).

请注意，图F.2展示了一种简化的多选题评估方法，其中直接将模型预测的答案选项字母与正确答案进行比较。此外，还有两种较为流行的方法采用对数概率评分（对数概率将在第4章中更详细地讨论）。

The following subsections illustrate how the MMLU scoring shown in figure F.2 can be implemented in code. End-to-end MMLU scripts, including the different scoring variants, will be provided as bonus materials in this book's code repository.

以下小节将展示如何在代码中实现图F.2所示的MMLU评分方法。本书的代码仓库中将以附加材料的形式提供端到端的MMLU脚本，其中包括不同的评分变体。

F.2.1 Loading the model

F.2.1 加载模型

First, before we can evaluate it on MMLU, we have to load the pre-trained model. The following code is identical to listing 3.1 in chapter 3.

首先，在我们能够在 MMLU 上对其进行评估之前，必须先加载预训练模型。以下代码与第 3 章中的代码清单 3.1 完全相同。

Listing F.1 Loading a pre-trained model
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import get_device
from reasoning_from_scratch.qwen3 import (
    download_qwen3_small, Qwen3Tokenizer,
    Qwen3Model, QWEN_CONFIG_06_B
)
 
device = get_device()
torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")  #A
 
# device = "cpu"  #B
 
WHICH_MODEL = "base"  #C
 
if WHICH_MODEL == "base":
    download_qwen3_small(
        kind="base", tokenizer_only=False, out_dir="qwen3"
    )
    tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-base.json"
    model_path = Path("qwen3") / "qwen3-0.6B-base.pth"
    tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path)
 
elif WHICH_MODEL == "reasoning":
    download_qwen3_small(
        kind="reasoning", tokenizer_only=False, out_dir="qwen3"
    )
    tokenizer_path = Path("qwen3") / "tokenizer-reasoning.json"
    model_path = Path("qwen3") / "qwen3-0.6B-reasoning.pth"
    tokenizer = Qwen3Tokenizer(
        tokenizer_file_path=tokenizer_path,
        apply_chat_template=True,
        add_generation_prompt=True,
        add_thinking=True,
    )
 
else:
    raise ValueError(f"Invalid choice: WHICH_MODEL={WHICH_MODEL}")
 
model = Qwen3Model(QWEN_CONFIG_06_B)
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(model_path))
model.to(device)
 
USE_COMPILE = False  #D
if USE_COMPILE:
  torch._dynamo.config.allow_unspec_int_on_nn_module = True
  model = torch.compile(model)
#A Lower precision from "highest" to enable Tensor Cores if applicable
#B Uncomment this line if you have compatibility issues with your device
#C Uses the base model, similar to chapter 2, by default
#D Optionally set to true to enable model compilation
#A 从“highest”降低精度，以便在适用时启用 Tensor Core #B 如果您的设备存在兼容性问题，请取消注释此行 #C 默认使用基础模型，类似于第2章 #D 可选地设置为true以启用模型编译

F.2.2 Checking the generated answer letter

F.2.2 检查生成的答复信

In this section, we implement the simplest and perhaps most intuitive MMLU scoring method, which relies on checking whether a generated multiple-choice answer letter matches the correct answer. This is similar to what was illustrated earlier in figure F.2.

在本节中，我们实现了一种最简单且可能最为直观的 MMLU 评分方法，该方法通过检查生成的多项选择题答案字母是否与正确答案匹配来完成评分。这与前面图 F.2 所示的内容类似。

For this, we will work with an example from the MMLU dataset:

为此，我们将使用 MMLU 数据集中的一个示例：

example = {
    "question": (
        "How many ways are there to put 4 distinguishable"
        " balls into 2 indistinguishable boxes?"
    ),
    "choices": ["7", "11", "16", "8"],
    "answer": "D",
}
example = { "question": ( "将4个可区分的球放入2个不可区分的盒子中，共有多少种方法？" ), "choices": ["7", "11", "16", "8"], "answer": "D", }

Next, we define a function to format the LLM prompts:

接下来，我们定义一个用于格式化大模型提示词的函数：

Listing F.2 Formatting the LLM prompt
def format_prompt(example):
    return (
        f"{example['question']}\n"
        f"A. {example['choices'][0]}\n"
        f"B. {example['choices'][1]}\n"
        f"C. {example['choices'][2]}\n"
        f"D. {example['choices'][3]}\n"
        "Answer: " #A
    )
#A trailing space encourages a single-letter next token
#尾部空格会促使下一个标记为单字母

Let's execute the function on the MMLU example to get an idea of what the formatted LLM input looks like:

让我们在 MMLU 示例上执行该函数，以了解格式化后的大模型输入是什么样子：

prompt = format_prompt(example)
print(prompt)
提示 = 格式化提示(示例) print(提示)

The output is:

输出是：

How many ways are there to put 4 distinguishable balls into 2
indistinguishable boxes?
A. 7
B. 11
C. 16
D. 8
Answer:
将4个可区分的球放入2个不可区分的盒子中，共有多少种方法？ A. 7 B. 11 C. 16 D. 8 答案：

The model prompt, as shown above, provides the model with a list of the different answer choices and ends with an "Answer: " text that encourages the model to generate the correct answer.

如上所示，模型提示提供了一个包含不同选项的列表，并以“Answer: ”字样结尾，以此引导模型生成正确答案。

While it is not strictly necessary, it can sometimes also be helpful to provide additional questions along with the correct answers as input, so that the model can observe how it is expected to solve the task. (For example, cases where 5 examples are provided are also known as 5-shot MMLU.) However, for current generations of LLMs, where even the base models are quite capable, this is not required.

虽然这并非严格必要，但有时在输入中同时提供额外的问题及其正确答案，也有助于模型理解预期的解题方式。（例如，提供5个示例的情况也被称为5-shot MMLU。）不过，对于当前几代大型语言模型而言，即便是基础模型本身已经相当强大，这种做法已不再必需。

Loading different MMLU samples
加载不同的 MMLU 样本

You can load examples from the MMLU dataset directly via the datasets library (which can be installed via pip install datasets or uv add datasets):

你可以通过 datasets 库直接加载 MMLU 数据集中的示例（可通过 pip install datasets 或 uv add datasets 安装该库）：

from datasets import load_dataset
configs = get_dataset_config_names("cais/mmlu")
dataset = load_dataset("cais/mmlu", "high_school_mathematics")
 
example = dataset["test"][0]  #A
print(example)
#A Inspect the first example from the test set
#A 检查测试集中的第一个示例

Above, we used the "high_school_mathematics" subset; to get a list of the other subsets, use the following code:

上面我们使用了“high_school_mathematics”子集；要获取其他子集的列表，请使用以下代码：

from datasets import get_dataset_config_names
subsets = get_dataset_config_names("cais/mmlu")
print(subsets)
from datasets import get_dataset_config_names 子集 = get_dataset_config_names("cais/mmlu") print(子集)

Next, we tokenize the prompt and wrap it in a PyTorch tensor object as input to the LLM (similar to what we did in chapter 2):

接下来，我们对提示进行分词，并将其封装为 PyTorch 张量对象，作为大语言模型的输入（类似于我们在第 2 章中所做的操作）：

prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt)
prompt_fmt = torch.tensor(prompt_ids, device=device).unsqueeze(0)
prompt_ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt)prompt_fmt = torch.tensor(prompt_ids, device=device).unsqueeze(0)

Then, we define the main scoring function in listing F.3, which generates a few tokens (here, 8 tokens by default) and extracts the first instance of letter A/B/C/D that the model prints.

随后，我们在代码清单 F.3 中定义了主评分函数，该函数会生成若干个标记（此处默认为 8 个），并提取模型首次打印出的字母 A/B/C/D。

Listing F.3 Extracting the generated letter
from reasoning_from_scratch.ch02 import (
    generate_text_basic_stream_cache
)
 
def predict_choice(
    model, tokenizer, prompt_fmt, max_new_tokens=8
):
    pred = None
    for t in generate_text_basic_stream_cache(
        model=model,
        token_ids=prompt_fmt,
        max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
        eos_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    ):
        answer = tokenizer.decode(t.squeeze(0).tolist())
        for letter in answer:
            letter = letter.upper()
            if letter in "ABCD":  #A
                pred = letter
                break
        if pred:
            break
    return pred
#A stop as soon as a letter appears
# 一旦出现字母就停止

We can then check the generated letter using the function from listing F.3 as follows:

然后，我们可以使用清单 F.3 中的函数来检查生成的信件，如下所示：

pred1 = predict_choice(model, tokenizer, prompt_fmt)
print(
    f"Generated letter: {pred1}\n"
    f"Correct? {pred1 == example['answer']}"
)
pred1 = predict_choice(模型, 分词器, prompt_fmt) print( f"生成的信件：{pred1}\n" f"正确吗？{pred1 == 示例['answer']}" )

The result is:

结果是：

Generated letter: C
Correct? False
生成的字母：C 正确吗？错误

As we can see, the generated answer is incorrect (False) in this case.

正如我们所见，生成的答案在这种情况下是错误的（False）。

Multiple-choice answer formats
多项选择题答题格式

Note that this section implemented a simplified version of multiple-choice evaluation for illustration purposes, where the model's predicted answer letter is compared directly to the correct one. In practice, more widely used variations exist, such as log-probability scoring, where we measure how likely the model considers each candidate answer rather than just checking the final letter choice. (We discuss probability-based scoring in chapter 4.) For reasoning models, evaluation can also involve assessing the likelihood of generating the correct answer when it is provided as input.

请注意，本节为了说明问题，实现了一个简化的多项选择评估方法：直接将模型预测的答案字母与正确答案进行对比。而在实际应用中，更常见的做法是采用对数概率评分法——我们不是简单地检查模型最终选择的字母，而是衡量模型认为每个候选答案有多大概率。（我们在第4章中会讨论基于概率的评分方法。）对于推理模型，评估还可以包括在给定正确答案作为输入时，评估模型生成该答案的可能性。

Regardless of the variant, the evaluation still amounts to checking whether the model selects from the predefined answer options. Examples of these variations will be included in the code repository as optional bonus material.

无论采用哪种变体，评估的核心仍然是检查模型是否从预定义的答案选项中进行选择。这些变体的示例将作为可选的附加材料收录在代码仓库中。

A limitation of multiple‑choice benchmarks like MMLU is that they only measure an LLM's ability to select from predefined options and thus is not very useful for evaluating reasoning capabilities besides checking if and how much knowledge the model has forgotten compared to the base model. It does not capture free-form writing ability or real-world utility. Still, it remains a simple and useful diagnostic: a high MMLU score doesn't necessarily mean the model is strong in practical use, but a low score can highlight potential knowledge gaps.

像MMLU这样的选择题基准存在一个局限性：它仅衡量大语言模型从预设选项中进行选择的能力，因此在评估推理能力方面作用有限——除了能够检测模型相较于基础模型是否以及在多大程度上遗忘了知识之外。这类基准无法捕捉模型的自由写作能力或其在真实场景中的实用性。尽管如此，它仍然是一种简单而有用的诊断工具：较高的MMLU得分并不一定意味着模型在实际应用中表现优异，但较低的得分则可能暴露出潜在的知识短板。

F.3 Using verifiers to check answers

F.3 使用验证器检查答案

Related to multiple-choice question answering discussed in the previous section, verification-based approaches quantify the LLMs capabilities via an accuracy metric. However, in contrast to multiple-choice benchmarks, verification methods allow LLMs to provide a free-form answer. We then extract the relevant answer portion and use a so-called verifier to compare the answer portion to the correct answer provided in the dataset, as illustrated in figure F.3.

与上一节讨论的多项选择题问答相关，基于验证的方法通过准确率指标来量化大语言模型的能力。然而，与多项选择基准不同的是，验证方法允许大语言模型给出自由格式的回答。随后，我们提取出与答案相关的内容，并使用所谓的验证器将其与数据集中提供的正确答案进行比较，如图F.3所示。

Figure F.3 Evaluating an LLM with a verification-based method in free-form question answering. The model generates a free-form answer (which may include multiple steps) and a final boxed answer, which is extracted and compared against the correct answer from the dataset.
图 F.3 在自由格式问答中使用验证方法评估大语言模型。模型生成一个自由格式的答案（可能包含多个步骤）以及一个最终的方框内答案，该方框内答案会被提取出来，并与数据集中的正确答案进行比较。

When we compare the extracted answer with the provided answer, as shown in figure F.3, we can employ external tools, such as code interpreters or calculator software.

当我们把提取的答案与提供的答案进行比较时，如图F.3所示，可以使用外部工具，例如代码解释器或计算器软件。

The downside is that this method can only be applied to domains that can be easily (and ideally deterministically) verified, such as math and code. Also, this approach can introduce additional complexity and dependencies, and it may shift part of the evaluation burden from the model itself to the external tool.

其缺点在于，这种方法只能应用于那些能够轻松（ ideally deterministically）验证的领域，例如数学和编程。此外，这种做法可能会引入额外的复杂性和依赖关系，并且可能将部分评估负担从模型本身转移到外部工具上。

However, because it allows us to generate an unlimited number of math problem variations programmatically and benefits from step-by-step reasoning, it has become a cornerstone of reasoning model evaluation and development.

然而，由于它能够以编程方式生成数量无限的数学问题变体，并且受益于逐步推理机制，因此已成为推理模型评估与开发的基石。

An extensive example of this method is provided in chapter 3, which is why we skip a code demonstration here.

本方法的详尽示例见第3章，因此此处不再进行代码演示。

F.4 Comparing models using preferences and leaderboards

F.4 使用偏好和排行榜比较模型

So far, we have covered two methods that offer easily quantifiable metrics such as model accuracy. However, none of the aforementioned methods evaluate LLMs in a more holistic way, including judging the style of the responses. In this section, as illustrated in figure F.4, we discuss a judgment-based method, namely, LLM leaderboards.

到目前为止，我们已经介绍了两种能够提供易于量化指标（如模型准确率）的方法。然而，上述方法均未能从更全面的角度评估大语言模型，例如对回答风格的评判。在本节中，如图F.4所示，我们将讨论一种基于人工评判的方法——大语言模型排行榜。

Figure F.4 A mental model of the topics covered in this book with a focus on the judgment- and benchmark-based evaluation methods covered in this appendix. Having already covered benchmark-based approaches (multiple choice, verifiers) in the previous section, we now introduce judgment-based approaches to measure LLM performance, with this subsection focusing on leaderboards.
图F.4 本书所涵盖主题的心理模型，重点在于本附录中介绍的基于判断与基于基准的评估方法。鉴于上一节已讨论了基于基准的方法（选择题、验证器），本小节现介绍用于衡量大语言模型性能的基于判断的方法，并将焦点放在排行榜上。

The leaderboard method mentioned in figure F.4 is a judgment-based approach where models are ranked not by accuracy values or other fixed benchmark scores but by user (or other LLM) preferences on their outputs.

图F.4中提到的排行榜方法是一种基于判断的评估方式。在这种方法中，模型的排序并非依据准确率或其他固定的基准分数，而是根据用户（或其他大语言模型）对其输出的偏好来确定。

A popular leaderboard is LM Arena (formerly Chatbot Arena, https://lmarena.ai/), where users compare responses from two user-selected or anonymous models and vote for the one they prefer, as shown in figure F.5.

一个广受欢迎的排行榜是 LM Arena（前身为 Chatbot Arena，网址：https://lmarena.ai/），用户可以在其中比较由自己选择或匿名的两款模型的回答，并投票选出自己更喜欢的那一款，如图 F.5 所示。

Figure F.5 Example of a judgment-based leaderboard interface (LM Arena). Two LLMs are given the same prompt, their responses are shown side by side, and users vote for the preferred answer.
图 F.5 基于人类判断的排行榜界面示例（LM Arena）。两个大语言模型接收相同的提示，它们的回复并排显示，用户投票选出更优的答案。

These preference votes, which are collected as shown in figure F.5, are then aggregated across all users into a leaderboard that ranks different models by user preference. In the remainder of this section, we will implement a simple example of a leaderboard.

这些偏好投票按照图F.5所示的方式收集后，会被汇总到所有用户的数据中，形成一张按用户偏好排序的模型排行榜。在本节的剩余部分，我们将实现一个简单的排行榜示例。

To create a concrete example, consider users prompting different LLMs in a setup similar to figure F.5. The list below represents pairwise votes where the first model is the winner:

为了举一个具体的例子，考虑用户在类似于图F.5的设置中分别向不同的大语言模型提出请求。下面的列表展示了两两对比的投票结果，其中第一个模型为胜者：

votes = [
    ("GPT-5", "Claude-3"),
    ("GPT-5", "Llama-4"),
    ("Claude-3", "Llama-3"),
    ("Llama-4", "Llama-3"),
    ("Claude-3", "Llama-3"),
    ("GPT-5", "Llama-3"),
]
投票 = [ ("GPT-5", "Claude-3"), ("GPT-5", "Llama-4"), ("Claude-3", "Llama-3"), ("Llama-4", "Llama-3"), ("Claude-3", "Llama-3"), ("GPT-5", "Llama-3"), ]

In the list above, each tuple in the votes list represents a pairwise preference between two models, written as (winner, loser). So, ("GPT-5", "Claude-3") means that a user preferred GPT-5 over a Claude-3 model answer.

在上面的列表中，votes 列表中的每个元组代表两个模型之间的两两偏好关系，格式为 (胜者, 败者)。例如，("GPT-5", "Claude-3") 表示用户更倾向于 GPT-5 的回答，而非 Claude-3 模型的回答。

In the remainder of this section, we will turn the votes list into a leaderboard. For this, we will use the popular Elo rating system, which was originally developed for ranking chess players. Before we look at the concrete code implementation, in short, it works as follows. Each model starts with a baseline score. Then, after each comparison and the preference vote, the model’s rating is updated. Specifically, if a user prefers a current model over a highly ranked model, the current model will get a relatively large ranking update and rank higher in the leaderboard. Vice versa, if the current model wins against a lowly ranked model, it increases the rating only a little. (And if the current model loses, it is updated in a similar fashion, but with ranking points getting subtracted instead of added.)

在本节的剩余部分，我们将把投票列表转换为排行榜。为此，我们将使用广受欢迎的 Elo 评分系统，该系统最初是为排名国际象棋选手而设计的。在查看具体的代码实现之前，简而言之，其工作原理如下：每个模型初始都拥有一个基准分数。随后，在每次比较和偏好投票之后，模型的评分都会被更新。具体来说，如果用户更倾向于当前模型而非排名较高的模型，则当前模型的排名将获得较大的提升，在排行榜中名次也会相应提高。反之，如果当前模型战胜了排名较低的模型，其评分只会小幅上升。（而当当前模型失利时，更新方式类似，只是此时会扣除排名积分，而非增加。）

The code to turn these pairwise rankings into a leaderboard is shown in listing F.4.

将这些成对排名转换为排行榜的代码如清单 F.4 所示。

Listing F.4 Constructing a leaderboard
def elo_ratings(vote_pairs, k_factor=32, initial_rating=1000):
    ratings = {  #A
        model: initial_rating
        for pair in vote_pairs
        for model in pair
    }
 
    for winner, loser in vote_pairs:  #B
        rating_winner, rating_loser = ratings[winner], ratings[loser]
 
        
        expected_winner = 1.0 / (  #C
            1.0 + 10 ** ((ratings[loser] - ratings[winner]) / 400.0)
        )
 
        ratings[winner] = (  #D
            ratings[winner] + k_factor * (1 - expected_winner)
        )
        ratings[loser] = (
            ratings[loser] + k_factor * (0 - (1 - expected_winner))
        )
 
    return ratings
#A Initialize all models with the same base rating
#B Update ratings after each match
#C Expected score for the current winner given the ratings
#D k_factor determines sensitivity of rating updates
#A 使用相同的初始评分初始化所有模型 #B 每场比赛后更新评分 #C 根据当前评分计算获胜方的预期得分 #D k系数决定评分更新的敏感度

The elo_ratings function in listing F.4 takes the votes as input and turns it into a leaderboard, as follows:

清单F.4中的elo_ratings函数以投票结果作为输入，并将其转换为排行榜，如下所示：

ratings = elo_ratings(votes, k_factor=32, initial_rating=1000)
for model in sorted(ratings, key=ratings.get, reverse=True):
    print(f"{model:8s} : {ratings[model]:.1f}")
评分 = elo评分(投票, k系数=32, 初始评分=1000) for 模型 in sorted(评分, key=评分.get, reverse=True): print(f"{模型:8s} : {评分[模型]:.1f}")

This results in the following leaderboard ranking, where the higher the score, the better:

由此得出如下排行榜排名，分数越高，排名越靠前：

GPT-5    : 1043.7
Claude-3 : 1015.2
Llama-4  : 1000.7
Llama-3  : 940.4
GPT-5 : 1043.7 Claude-3 : 1015.2 Llama-4 : 1000.7 Llama-3 : 940.4

So, how does this work? For each pair, we compute the expected score of the winner using the following formula:

那么，这是如何运作的呢？对于每一对选手，我们使用以下公式计算胜者的预期得分：

expected_winner = 1 / (1 + 10 ** ((rating_loser - rating_winner) / 400))
预期胜率 = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((败者等级分 - 胜者等级分) / 400))

This value expected_winner is the model's predicted chance to win in a no-draw setting based on the current ratings. It determines how large the rating update is.

这个值 expected_winner 是模型根据当前等级分预测的在不允许平局情况下的胜率。它决定了等级分调整的幅度。

First, each model starts at initial_rating = 1000. If the two ratings (winner and loser) are equal, we have expected_winner = 0.5, which indicates an even match. In this case, the updates are:

首先，每个模型的初始评分为 initial_rating = 1000。如果两位选手的评分相等，则 expected_winner = 0.5，这表明比赛势均力敌。在这种情况下，评分的更新公式为：

rating_winner + k_factor * (1 - 0.5) = rating_winner + 16
rating_loser  + k_factor * (0 - (1 - 0.5)) = rating_loser - 16
胜者等级分 + K值 × (1 - 0.5) = 胜者等级分 + 16 败者等级分 + K值 × (0 - (1 - 0.5)) = 败者等级分 - 16

Now, if a heavy favorite (a model with a high rating) wins, we have expected_winner ≈ 1. The favorite gains only a small amount and the loser loses only a little:

现在，如果热门选手（评分较高的模型）获胜，那么 expected_winner ≈ 1。热门选手的得分只会小幅上升，而冷门选手的得分也只会小幅下降：

rating_winner + 32 * (1 - 0.99) = rating_winner + 0.32
rating_loser  + 32 * (0 - (1 - 0.99)) = rating_loser - 0.32
胜者等级分 + 32 × (1 - 0.99) = 胜者等级分 + 0.32败者等级分 + 32 × (0 - (1 - 0.99)) = 败者等级分 - 0.32

However, if an underdog (a model with a low rating) wins, we have expected_winner ≈ 0, and the winner gets almost the full k_factor points while the loser loses about the same magnitude:

然而，如果弱队（评分较低的模型）获胜，我们有 expected_winner ≈ 0，此时胜者将获得几乎全部的 k_factor 分数，而败者则会损失大致相同数量的分数：

rating_winner + 32 * (1 - 0.01) = rating_winner + 31.68
rating_loser  + 32 * (0 - (1 - 0.01)) = rating_loser - 31.68
rating_winner + 32 * (1 - 0.01) = rating_winner + 31.68 rating_loser + 32 * (0 - (1 - 0.01)) = rating_loser - 31.68
Order matters
顺序很重要

The Elo approach updates ratings after each match (model comparisons), so later results build on ratings that have already been updated. This means the same set of outcomes, when presented in a different order, can end with slightly different final scores. This effect is usually mild, but it can happen especially when an upset happens early versus late.

Elo评级法会在每场比赛（即模型对比）后更新评级，因此后续比赛的结果会基于已经更新过的评级。这意味着，即使是一组完全相同的比赛结果，如果呈现的顺序不同，最终的评级也可能略有差异。这种影响通常比较轻微，但在以下情况下更容易出现：当冷门事件发生在比赛初期时，与发生在后期相比，最终的评级可能会有所不同。

To reduce this order effect, we can shuffle the votes pairs and run the elo_ratings function multiple times and average the ratings.

为了减少顺序效应，我们可以对投票对进行随机打乱，多次运行 elo_ratings 函数，并对得到的评分取平均值。

Leaderboard approaches such as the one described above provide a more dynamic view of model quality than static benchmark scores. However, the results can be influenced by user demographics, prompt selection, and voting biases. Benchmarks and leaderboards can also be gamed, and users may select responses based on style rather than correctness. Finally, compared to automated benchmark harnesses, leaderboards do not provide instant feedback on newly developed variants, which makes them harder to use during active model development.

诸如上述所述的排行榜方法，相较于静态的基准测试分数，能够提供更为动态的模型质量视图。然而，其结果可能会受到用户人口统计特征、提示词选择以及投票偏见的影响。基准测试和排行榜同样存在被“刷分”的可能性，且用户在选择回答时，往往更倾向于基于风格而非正确性。此外，与自动化的基准测试框架相比，排行榜无法对新开发的模型变体提供即时反馈，这使得它们在模型的持续开发过程中较难应用。

Other ranking methods
其他排名方法

The LM Arena originally used the Elo method described in this section but recently transitioned to a statistical approach based on the Bradley–Terry model. The main advantage of the Bradley–Terry model is that, being statistically grounded, it allows the construction of confidence intervals to express uncertainty in the rankings. Also, in contrast to the Elo ratings, the Bradley–Terry model estimates all ratings jointly using a statistical fit over the entire dataset, which makes it immune to order effects.

LM竞技场最初采用本节所述的埃洛评级法，但近期已转而使用基于布拉德利–特里模型的统计方法。布拉德利–特里模型的主要优势在于其坚实的统计学基础，能够构建置信区间来量化排名中的不确定性。此外，与埃洛评级不同，该模型通过在整个数据集上进行统计拟合，联合估计所有选手的评分，从而不受顺序效应的影响。

To keep the reported scores in a familiar range, the Bradley–Terry model is fitted to produce values comparable to Elo. Even though the leaderboard no longer officially uses Elo ratings, the term "Elo" remains widely used by LLM researchers and practitioners when comparing models. A code example showing the Elo rating is included in this book's bonus materials at https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/chF/03_leaderboards.

为了使报告的分数保持在熟悉的范围内，我们拟合了布拉德利–特里模型，以生成与 Elo 分数可比的值。尽管排行榜已不再正式使用 Elo 评分，但在比较模型时，LLM 研究人员和从业者仍然广泛使用“Elo”这一术语。本书的附加资料中包含一个展示 Elo 评分的代码示例，地址为：https://github.com/rasbt/reasoning-from-scratch/tree/main/chF/03_leaderboards。

F.5 Judging responses with other LLMs

F.5 使用其他大语言模型评估响应

In the early days, LLMs were evaluated using statistical and heuristics-based methods, including a measure called BLEU, which is a crude measure of how well generated text matches reference text. The problem with such metrics is that they require exact word matches and don't account for synonyms, word changes, and so on.

在早期，大语言模型主要采用基于统计和启发式的方法进行评估，其中就包括一种名为BLEU的指标。BLEU是一种粗略的衡量标准，用于评估生成文本与参考文本的匹配程度。然而，这类指标存在一个显著问题：它们要求词汇完全匹配，无法考虑同义词、词语替换等情况，因而难以准确反映生成文本的质量。

One solution to this problem, if we want to judge the written answer text as a whole, is to use relative rankings and leaderboard-based approaches as discussed in the previous section. However, a downside of leaderboards is the subjective nature of the preference-based comparisons as it involves human feedback (as well as the challenges that are associated with collecting this feedback).

如果我们要从整体上评判书面回答文本，一种解决方案是采用前一节讨论的基于相对排名和排行榜的方法。然而，排行榜的一个缺点在于，其基于偏好的比较具有主观性，因为它依赖于人工反馈（以及收集此类反馈所面临的挑战）。

A related method is to use another LLM with a pre-defined grading rubric (i.e., an evaluation guide) to compare an LLM's response to a reference response and judge the response quality based on a pre-defined rubric, as illustrated in figure F.6.

一种相关的方法是使用另一台具备预定义评分量表（即评估指南）的大型语言模型，将待评估语言模型的输出与参考答案进行对比，并依据该预定义量表对输出质量作出判断，如图F.6所示。

Figure F.6 Example of an LLM-judge evaluation. The model to be evaluated generates an answer, which is then scored by a separate judge LLM according to a rubric and a provided reference answer.
图 F.6 大语言模型评判者评估示例。待评估的模型生成一个答案，随后由另一台评判用的大语言模型根据评分标准和提供的参考答案对该答案进行打分。

In practice, the judge-based approach shown in figure F.6 works well when the judge LLM is strong. Common setups use leading proprietary LLMs via API, though specialized judge models also exist (see appendix A for references). One of the reasons why judges work so well is also that evaluating an answer is often easier than generating one.

在实践中，如图F.6所示的基于裁判模型的方法，在裁判大语言模型性能较强时效果良好。常见的做法是通过API调用业界领先的专有大语言模型，当然也有专门训练的裁判模型（相关参考文献见附录A）。裁判模型之所以表现优异，原因之一在于：评估一个答案通常比生成一个答案更容易。

To implement a judge-based model evaluation as shown in figure F.6 programmatically in Python, we could either load one of the Qwen3 models (appendix D) and prompt it with a grading rubric and the model answer we want to evaluate.

为了以编程方式在 Python 中实现图 F.6 所示的基于人工评判的模型评估，我们可以加载 Qwen3 系列中的任意一个模型（附录 D），并为其提供评分标准以及待评估的模型答案作为输入提示。

Alternatively, we can use other LLMs through an API, for example the ChatGPT or Ollama API. In the remainder of the section, we will implement the judge-based evaluation shown in figure F.6 using the Ollama API in Python.

或者，我们也可以通过 API 使用其他大语言模型，例如 ChatGPT 或 Ollama 的 API。在本节的剩余部分，我们将使用 Python 和 Ollama API 实现图 F.6 中所示的基于裁判的评估方法。

Specifically, we will use the 20-billion parameter gpt-oss open-weight model by OpenAI as it offers a good balance between capabilities and efficiency. For more information about gpt-oss, please see my From GPT-2 to gpt-oss: Analyzing the Architectural Advances article at https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/from-gpt-2-to-gpt-oss-analyzing-the.

具体而言，我们将使用 OpenAI 提供的 200 亿参数 gpt-oss 开源权重模型，因为它在功能性和效率之间取得了良好的平衡。有关 gpt-oss 的更多信息，请参阅我在 https://magazine.sebastianraschka.com/p/from-gpt-2-to-gpt-oss-analyzing-the 上发表的文章《从 GPT-2 到 gpt-oss：解析架构上的进步》。

F.5.1 Implementing a LLM-as-a-judge approach in Ollama

F.5.1 在 Ollama 中实现 LLM 作为裁判的方法

Ollama (https://ollama.com) is an efficient open-source application for running LLMs on a laptop. It serves as a wrapper around the open-source llama.cpp library (https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp), which implements LLMs in pure C/C++ to maximize efficiency. However, note that Ollama is only a tool for generating text using LLMs (inference) and does not support training or fine-tuning LLMs.

Ollama（https://ollama.com）是一款高效的开源应用，可在笔记本电脑上运行大语言模型。它封装了开源的 llama.cpp 库（https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp），该库以纯 C/C++ 实现大语言模型，从而最大限度地提升效率。需要注意的是，Ollama 仅用于利用大语言模型生成文本（即推理），并不支持大语言模型的训练或微调。

To execute the following code, please install Ollama by visiting https://ollama.com and follow the provided instructions for your operating system:

要执行以下代码，请访问 https://ollama.com 安装 Ollama，并按照针对您操作系统的说明进行操作：

  • For macOS and Windows users: Open the downloaded Ollama application. If prompted to install command-line usage, select "yes."
  • 对于 macOS 和 Windows 用户：打开已下载的 Ollama 应用程序。如果提示您安装命令行工具，请选择“是”。
  • For Linux users: Use the installation command available on the Ollama website.
  • 对于 Linux 用户：请使用 Ollama 官网上提供的安装命令。

Before implementing the model evaluation code, let's first download the gpt-oss model and verify that Ollama is functioning correctly by using it from the command line terminal.

在执行模型评估代码之前，我们先下载 gpt-oss 模型，并通过在命令行终端中使用它来验证 Ollama 是否正常工作。

Execute the following command on the command line (not in a Python session) to try out the 20 billion parameter gpt-oss model:

替代的 Ollama 模型

Note that the gpt-oss:20b in the ollama run gpt-oss:20b command refers to the 20 billion parameter gpt-oss model. Using Ollama with the gpt-oss:20b model requires approximately 13 GB of RAM. If your machine does not have sufficient RAM, you can try using a smaller model, such as the 4 billion parameter qwen3:4b model via ollama run qwen3:4b, which only requires around 4 GB of RAM.

请注意，`ollama run gpt-oss:20b` 命令中的 `gpt-oss:20b` 指的是拥有 200 亿参数的 gpt-oss 模型。使用 Ollama 运行 gpt-oss:20b 模型大约需要 13 GB 的内存。如果您的机器内存不足，可以尝试使用较小的模型，例如通过 `ollama run qwen3:4b` 启动的拥有 40 亿参数的 Qwen3:4b 模型，该模型仅需约 4 GB 内存。

For more powerful computers, you can also use the larger 120-billion parameter gpt-oss model by replacing gpt-oss:20b with gpt-oss:120b. However, keep in mind that this model requires significantly more computational resources.

Once the model download is complete, we are presented with a command-line interface that allows us to interact with the model. For example, try asking the model, "What is 1+2?":

模型下载完成后，我们会看到一个命令行界面，允许我们与模型进行交互。例如，可以试着问模型：“1+2等于多少？”：
